```tsx
<MultiSelect label="Notify" placeholder="Choose people" items={people} disabled />
```

Required fields, errors and warnings: [Forms and validation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/forms/).

## Keyboard

| Key | List closed | List open |
|---|---|---|
| ↓, Enter, Space | Open the list | Enter and Space check or uncheck the highlighted row; the list stays open |
| ↓ / ↑, Page Down / Page Up, Home / End | ↑ does nothing; Home / End open on the first / last row | Move the highlight |
| Letters | Open on the next option that starts with them | Jump to the next option that starts with them |
| Delete, Backspace, Esc | Clear every choice | Esc closes |
| Tab | Moves on | Closes and moves on |

With `filterable`, the field is a text box: letters, Space, Home, End, Delete and Backspace edit the text, ↓ or Enter open the list, Enter checks the highlighted row, and Esc on a closed list clears the choices and the text.

## Accessibility

- The list is a `listbox` with `aria-multiselectable`; the highlight is announced through `aria-activedescendant`, so focus stays on the field.
- The × buttons are not Tab stops (as in Carbon). Delete, Backspace or Esc clear the choices from the keyboard.
- "Loading…", "Searching…" and "No matching items" are announced.

Unstyled React parts with the same behaviour: [Headless Multi-select](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-multi-select/).

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-multi-select>` · React `UiMultiSelect`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` | Visible label text; the `label` slot replaces it when markup is needed. |
| `hide-label` | `hideLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep the label for screen readers but don't show it. |
| `helper-text` | `helperText` | `string` | `''` | Helper text under the field, shown while there is no error or warning. |
| `invalid-text` | `invalidText` | `string` | `''` | Error text shown while `invalid` or while the field fails validation. |
| `invalid` | `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Forces the error state, e.g. after server-side validation. |
| `warn` | `warn` | `boolean` | `false` | Non-blocking warning; shown when there is no error. |
| `warn-text` | `warnText` | `string` | `''` | Text of the warning shown while `warn`. |
| `placeholder` | `placeholder` | `string` | `''` | Text always shown in the field (Carbon's `label`), e.g. "Choose options". |
| `name` | `name` | `string` | `''` | Reflected: form-associated elements submit under the `name` attribute. |
| `size` | `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Field height: sm 32px, md 40px, lg 48px (tokens `--ui-field-height-*`). |
| `direction` | `direction` | `'bottom' \| 'top'` | `'bottom'` | Preferred side for the list; it flips when there is no room. |
| `selection-feedback` | `selectionFeedback` | `SelectionFeedback` | `'top-after-reopen'` |  |
| `select-all` | `selectAll` | `boolean` | `false` | Adds a "Select all" row. |
| `filterable` | `filterable` | `boolean` | `false` | The field is a text box that narrows the list (Carbon `FilterableMultiSelect` / `filterable`). |
| `filter` | `filter` | `MultiSelectFilter` | `'contains'` | With `filterable`: `contains` (Carbon), `starts-with`, or `none` to leave the list to a server search. |
| `loading` | `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | The options are on their way: "Searching…" with `filterable` (a server search), else "Loading…"; the keys pick nothing. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control; a disabled `<fieldset>` ancestor does the same. |
| `required` | `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Blocks form submission while the field is empty. |
| `readonly` | `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows and submits the value but blocks changes. |
| `fluid` | `fluid` | `boolean` | `false` | Carbon `FluidMultiSelect`: the label inside a 64px box, an error / warning inside it. `<ui-fluid-form>` sets it for every field inside. |

#### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string[]` | Chosen option values. Initial choices can also come from `<option selected>`. |
| `inputValue` |  | With `filterable`, what the user typed; set it to search for something. |
| `willValidate` |  | (read-only) Whether the field takes part in constraint validation (not while disabled), as natively. |
| `labels` |  | (read-only) The `<label>`s that point at this field. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `setCustomValidity(message)` | Like `<input>.setCustomValidity()`: a non-empty message makes the field invalid (and is shown as its error once touched) until cleared with ''. |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-toggle` | `onUiToggle` | detail: { open } after the list opens or closes (Carbon React `onMenuChange`) |
| `input` | `onInput` | Whenever the set of chosen values changes, as ui-dropdown and ui-combobox; with `filterable`, also native and composed as the user types, where `value` is unchanged (kept for compatibility: listen to `ui-input` for the typing) |
| `ui-input` | `onUiInput` | detail: { value } the typed text (`inputValue`) with `filterable`, as the user types or when the text is emptied |
| `change` | `onChange` | Whenever the set of chosen values changes |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `label` | Label content with markup; the `label` attribute is the plain-text fallback |
| `helper-text` | Helper text with markup (links, bold); overrides `helper-text` |
| `warn-text` | Warning text shown while `warn`; overrides `warn-text` |
| `invalid-text` | Error text shown while invalid; overrides `invalid-text` |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `option-description` | Second line of an option (`<option data-description>`) |
| `base` | The field box |
| `label` | The label |
| `input` | The field button, or the text box with `filterable` (role=combobox) |
| `toggle` | The chevron button (`filterable`) |
| `clear-filter-button` | The × that clears the text (`filterable`) |
| `empty` | The "searching" / "no results" row (`filterable`) |
| `tag` | The selected-count pill |
| `clear-button` | The × inside the pill |
| `chevron` | The arrow icon |
| `status-icon` | The error / warning icon |
| `helper-text` | The helper line |
| `warning-text` | The warning line |
| `warn-text` | Same line as `warning-text` (named after the `warn-text` attribute / slot) |
| `error-text` | The error line |
| `invalid-text` | Same line as `error-text` (named after the `invalid-text` attribute / slot) |
| `menu` | The floating list |
| `option` | Each row |
| `select-all` | The "Select all" row |
| `checkbox` | The box drawn in each row |
| `group-label` | An `<optgroup>` heading |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-count-tag-background` |  | The count pill's fill (default `--ui-ink`); also `--ui-count-tag-ink` (`--ui-inverse-ink`) and `--ui-count-tag-hover` (its ×, `--ui-secondary-hover`) |
| `--ui-field-border` |  | Border on every side of the box (default none: Carbon's underline only; Kanok: a 1px outline) |
| `--ui-field-disabled-border-color` |  | Border colour when disabled (default: the underline transparent) |
| `--ui-field-readonly-border-color` |  | Border colour when read-only (default: a hairline underline) |
| `--ui-field-radius` |  | Corner radius of the box (default 0; Kanok: 6px) |
| `--ui-field-background` |  | Fill of the box (default `--ui-surface-1`; Kanok: transparent) |
| `--ui-label-font` |  | Font of the label (default `--ui-font-caption`; Kanok: 14px semibold) |
| `--ui-label-color` |  | Colour of the label (default `--ui-ink-muted`; Kanok: `--ui-ink`) |
| `--ui-menu-radius` |  | Corner radius of the open list (default 0; Kanok: 8px) |
| `--ui-menu-border` |  | Border around the list (default none; Kanok: a hairline) |
| `--ui-menu-shadow` |  | `box-shadow` of the list (default Carbon's 0 2px 6px) |
| `--ui-menu-padding` |  | Padding of the open list (default 0; Kanok: 4px, rows inset) |
| `--ui-menu-item-radius` |  | Corner radius of a row (default 0; Kanok: 6px) |
| `--ui-menu-item-ink` |  | Text of a row at rest (default `--ui-ink-muted`; Kanok: `--ui-ink`) |
| `--ui-menu-divider` |  | Rule between rows (default `--ui-row-divider`; Kanok: none) |
| `--ui-menu-item-selected` |  | Fill of the chosen row (default `--ui-surface-2`; Kanok: `--ui-highlight`) |
| `--ui-menu-item-selected-hover` |  | The chosen row under the pointer (default `--ui-layer-selected-hover`; Kanok: the highlight a shade deeper) |
| `--ui-field-readonly-background` |  | The box's fill when read-only (default transparent; Kanok: a faint ink tint, so read-only reads as set and never weaker than disabled) |
| `--ui-field-open-background` |  | The box's fill while its list is open (default the field's hover fill; Kanok: transparent) |
| `--ui-fluid-background` |  | / --ui-fluid-gap - A fluid box's fill and the space under it (default the layer's fill, 0: boxes that touch; Kanok: transparent, 8px) |
| `--ui-menu-item-active-outline` |  | / --ui-menu-item-active-background - The keyboard-highlighted row: its ring and its fill (default focus, transparent) |
| `--ui-option-box-align` |  | / --ui-option-box-offset - A two-line row's checkbox: `align-self` and top margin (default auto, 0: centred; Kanok: beside the label line) |
| `--ui-icon-control-radius` |  | Corners of its small icon buttons, their hover fill and ring (default 0; Kanok: round) |
| `--ui-menu-item-pressed` |  | Fill of a pressed option (default `--ui-surface-2`; Kanok: the 20% pressed tint) |
| `--ui-focus-offset` |  | `outline-offset` of its focus ring (default -2px: inside; Kanok: 2px outside) |




---

# Checkbox

A checkbox turns one option on or off. In a group, people can pick any number of options, including none.


HTML:

```html
<ui-checkbox-group label="Send updates by" helper-text="Pick as many as you like">
  <ui-checkbox name="channels" value="email" checked>Email</ui-checkbox>
  <ui-checkbox name="channels" value="sms">SMS</ui-checkbox>
  <ui-checkbox name="channels" value="post">Post</ui-checkbox>
</ui-checkbox-group>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiCheckboxGroup label="Send updates by" helperText="Pick as many as you like">
  <UiCheckbox name="channels" value="email" checked>Email</UiCheckbox>
  <UiCheckbox name="channels" value="sms">SMS</UiCheckbox>
  <UiCheckbox name="channels" value="post">Post</UiCheckbox>
</UiCheckboxGroup>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<FormGroup legend="Send updates by" message="Pick as many as you like">
  <Checkbox label="Email" name="channels" value="email" defaultChecked />
  <Checkbox label="SMS" name="channels" value="sms" />
  <Checkbox label="Post" name="channels" value="post" />
</FormGroup>
```

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/checkbox @kanok-ui/tile
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-checkbox
```

Manual:

```bash
# Web component
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install lit@^3.3.0
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/checkbox.json
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tile.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/primitives/checkbox/checkbox-group.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/checkbox/checkbox-skeleton.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/checkbox/checkbox.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/expandable-tile.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/radio-tile.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/selectable-tile.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/selection-tiles-shared.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/selection-tiles.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/tile.ts
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    shared-element, shared-field, shared-form-control, shared-localize, shared-skeleton, shared-slots, tokens, radio, shared-events, shared-navigate

# React + Tailwind
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install @purpurabog/ui@^1.4.3
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tw-checkbox.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/react-tw/checkbox.tsx
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    tw-field, tw-theme, tw-utils
```

npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Use it


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">
  import '@purpurabog/ui/checkbox';
  import '@purpurabog/ui/checkbox-group';
</script>

<ui-checkbox name="terms" required>I accept the terms</ui-checkbox>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiCheckbox, UiCheckboxGroup } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiCheckbox name="terms" required>I accept the terms</UiCheckbox>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/checkbox';

<Checkbox label="I accept the terms" name="terms" required />
```

The label is the element's content on the web component and the `label` prop in React + Tailwind. Import `checkbox-group` only when you use the group.

## One checkbox

- `checked` sets the state. `change` fires when the user toggles it.
- A checked box submits `value` (`on` by default) under `name`; an unchecked box submits nothing.
- `required` blocks submit until the box is checked, as for accepting terms.


HTML:

```html
<ui-checkbox id="checkbox-newsletter" name="newsletter" value="yes">Send me the newsletter</ui-checkbox>
<p>checked: <output id="checkbox-newsletter-out">false</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const box = document.getElementById('checkbox-newsletter');
  box.addEventListener('change', () => (document.getElementById('checkbox-newsletter-out').value = box.checked));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
import type { UiCheckbox as CheckboxElement } from '@purpurabog/ui';

const [on, setOn] = useState(false);

<UiCheckbox name="newsletter" value="yes" checked={on} onChange={(e) => setOn((e.target as CheckboxElement).checked)}>
  Send me the newsletter
</UiCheckbox>
<p>checked: <output>{String(on)}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [on, setOn] = useState(false);

<Checkbox label="Send me the newsletter" name="newsletter" value="yes" checked={on} onChange={(e) => setOn(e.target.checked)} />
<p>checked: <output>{String(on)}</output></p>
```

## A group of checkboxes

`ui-checkbox-group` labels a set of boxes and is announced as one group:

- `required` means "at least one": the form won't submit until a box is checked.
- `orientation="horizontal"` puts the boxes in a row.
- `disabled` and `readonly` apply to every box, without overwriting each box's own setting.
- Each checkbox still submits its own `name` and `value`, so read them with `FormData.getAll()`.


HTML:

```html
<ui-checkbox-group label="Documents received" orientation="horizontal" required>
  <ui-checkbox name="docs" value="id">ID card</ui-checkbox>
  <ui-checkbox name="docs" value="house">House registration</ui-checkbox>
  <ui-checkbox name="docs" value="bank">Bank book</ui-checkbox>
</ui-checkbox-group>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiCheckboxGroup label="Documents received" orientation="horizontal" required>
  <UiCheckbox name="docs" value="id">ID card</UiCheckbox>
  <UiCheckbox name="docs" value="house">House registration</UiCheckbox>
  <UiCheckbox name="docs" value="bank">Bank book</UiCheckbox>
</UiCheckboxGroup>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
// npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-form-group
import { FormGroup } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/form-group';

<FormGroup legend="Documents received" invalid={!!docsError} message={docsError}>
  <div className="flex gap-6">
    <Checkbox label="ID card" name="docs" value="id" />
    <Checkbox label="House registration" name="docs" value="house" />
    <Checkbox label="Bank book" name="docs" value="bank" />
  </div>
</FormGroup>
```

React + Tailwind has no checkbox group: use `FormGroup` (Carbon's fieldset), lay the boxes out yourself, and check "at least one" in your own validation. In the example, `docsError` comes from your own validation, such as "Select at least one option."

## Helper text, warnings and errors on one box

A single checkbox has its own message line under the label: `helper-text`, a non-blocking `warn` with `warn-text`, and `invalid` with `invalid-text`. An error beats a warning, and a warning beats the helper text.


HTML:

```html
<ui-checkbox name="stamp" helper-text="Tick when the receipt is attached">Stamp duty paid</ui-checkbox>
<ui-checkbox name="witness" checked warn warn-text="Only one witness has signed">Witnesses signed</ui-checkbox>
<ui-checkbox name="terms" invalid invalid-text="You must accept the terms to continue">I accept the terms</ui-checkbox>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiCheckbox name="stamp" helperText="Tick when the receipt is attached">Stamp duty paid</UiCheckbox>
<UiCheckbox name="witness" checked warn warnText="Only one witness has signed">Witnesses signed</UiCheckbox>
<UiCheckbox name="terms" invalid invalidText="You must accept the terms to continue">I accept the terms</UiCheckbox>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Checkbox label="Stamp duty paid" name="stamp" helperText="Tick when the receipt is attached" />
<Checkbox label="Witnesses signed" name="witness" defaultChecked warn warnText="Only one witness has signed" />
<Checkbox label="I accept the terms" name="terms" invalid invalidText="You must accept the terms to continue" />
```

## Warnings and errors on a group

On `ui-checkbox-group`, the message belongs to the whole group and shows once under it. An error also turns every enabled box red, and each box repeats the error for screen readers.


HTML:

```html
<ui-checkbox-group label="Signing parties" warn warn-text="The guarantor usually signs too">
  <ui-checkbox name="parties" value="lessor" checked>Lessor</ui-checkbox>
  <ui-checkbox name="parties" value="lessee" checked>Lessee</ui-checkbox>
  <ui-checkbox name="parties" value="guarantor">Guarantor</ui-checkbox>
</ui-checkbox-group>
<ui-checkbox-group label="Copies to keep" invalid invalid-text="Keep at least one copy on paper or as a PDF">
  <ui-checkbox name="copies" value="paper">Paper</ui-checkbox>
  <ui-checkbox name="copies" value="pdf">PDF</ui-checkbox>
</ui-checkbox-group>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiCheckboxGroup label="Signing parties" warn warnText="The guarantor usually signs too">…</UiCheckboxGroup>
<UiCheckboxGroup label="Copies to keep" invalid invalidText="Keep at least one copy on paper or as a PDF">…</UiCheckboxGroup>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<FormGroup legend="Copies to keep" invalid message="Keep at least one copy on paper or as a PDF">
  <Checkbox label="Paper" name="copies" value="paper" />
  <Checkbox label="PDF" name="copies" value="pdf" />
</FormGroup>
```

React + Tailwind's `FormGroup` has `invalid` and `message` (the message turns red) but no warning state.

## Indeterminate

`indeterminate` shows a bar instead of a check: a parent box whose children are partly checked. The user's next click clears it. Keep the parent in step with its children in your code:


HTML:

```html
<ui-stack gap="3">
  <ui-checkbox id="checkbox-all" indeterminate>All channels</ui-checkbox>
  <div id="checkbox-channels" style="padding-inline-start: 24px">
    <ui-checkbox value="email" checked>Email</ui-checkbox>
    <ui-checkbox value="sms">SMS</ui-checkbox>
  </div>
</ui-stack>

<script type="module">
  const all = document.getElementById('checkbox-all');
  const channels = [...document.getElementById('checkbox-channels').children];
  const sync = () => {
    const on = channels.filter((box) => box.checked).length;
    all.checked = on === channels.length;
    all.indeterminate = on > 0 && on < channels.length;
  };
  all.addEventListener('change', () => {
    for (const box of channels) box.checked = all.checked;
    sync();
  });
  for (const box of channels) box.addEventListener('change', sync);
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const all = ['email', 'sms'];
const [chosen, setChosen] = useState(['email']);
const some = chosen.length > 0 && chosen.length < all.length;
const pick = (value: string, on: boolean) => setChosen((c) => (on ? [...c, value] : c.filter((v) => v !== value)));

<UiCheckbox checked={chosen.length === all.length} indeterminate={some} onChange={(e) => setChosen((e.target as CheckboxElement).checked ? all : [])}>
  All channels
</UiCheckbox>
<UiCheckbox checked={chosen.includes('email')} onChange={(e) => pick('email', (e.target as CheckboxElement).checked)}>Email</UiCheckbox>
<UiCheckbox checked={chosen.includes('sms')} onChange={(e) => pick('sms', (e.target as CheckboxElement).checked)}>SMS</UiCheckbox>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Checkbox label="All channels" checked={chosen.length === all.length} indeterminate={some} onChange={(e) => setChosen(e.target.checked ? all : [])} />
<Checkbox label="Email" checked={chosen.includes('email')} onChange={(e) => pick('email', e.target.checked)} />
<Checkbox label="SMS" checked={chosen.includes('sms')} onChange={(e) => pick('sms', e.target.checked)} />
```

`all`, `chosen`, `some` and `pick` are the same in every React version. On the web component, do the same in `change` listeners: set `checked` and `indeterminate` on the parent from its children.

## Hide the label

`hide-label` keeps the label for screen readers but doesn't show it, such as for a checkbox in a table row.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
  <ui-checkbox hide-label>Select contract C-2026-0142</ui-checkbox>
  <span>C-2026-0142 · Lease of the warehouse on Rama IV Road</span>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiCheckbox hideLabel>Select contract C-2026-0142</UiCheckbox>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Checkbox label="Select contract C-2026-0142" hideLabel />
```

## Read-only and disabled

`readonly` (`readOnly` in React + Tailwind) keeps the state and submits it, but clicks and Space change nothing. `disabled` greys the box out, and it isn't submitted.


HTML:

```html
<ui-checkbox checked readonly>Signed by both parties</ui-checkbox>
<ui-checkbox disabled>Archived</ui-checkbox>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiCheckbox checked readonly>Signed by both parties</UiCheckbox>
<UiCheckbox disabled>Archived</UiCheckbox>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Checkbox label="Signed by both parties" defaultChecked readOnly />
<Checkbox label="Archived" disabled />
```

## Required in a form

A required group needs at least one box; a required single box must be checked. The errors wait until the user has used the field or pressed Submit. Press Submit with nothing checked to see both.


HTML:

```html
<form id="checkbox-form" style="display: grid; gap: 16px">
  <ui-checkbox-group label="Send copies to" required helper-text="Pick at least one">
    <ui-checkbox name="cc" value="legal">Legal</ui-checkbox>
    <ui-checkbox name="cc" value="finance">Finance</ui-checkbox>
    <ui-checkbox name="cc" value="procurement">Procurement</ui-checkbox>
  </ui-checkbox-group>
  <ui-checkbox name="terms" value="accepted" required invalid-text="Accept the terms to continue">I have read the contract terms</ui-checkbox>
  <div><ui-button type="submit">Submit</ui-button></div>
</form>
<p>Submitted: <output id="checkbox-form-out"></output></p>

<script type="module">
  const form = document.getElementById('checkbox-form');
  form.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    document.getElementById('checkbox-form-out').value = [...new FormData(form)].map(([key, value]) => `${key}=${value}`).join(', ');
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<form onSubmit={submit}>
  <UiCheckboxGroup label="Send copies to" required helperText="Pick at least one">
    <UiCheckbox name="cc" value="legal">Legal</UiCheckbox>
    <UiCheckbox name="cc" value="finance">Finance</UiCheckbox>
    <UiCheckbox name="cc" value="procurement">Procurement</UiCheckbox>
  </UiCheckboxGroup>
  <UiCheckbox name="terms" value="accepted" required invalidText="Accept the terms to continue">I have read the contract terms</UiCheckbox>
  <UiButton type="submit">Submit</UiButton>
</form>
<p>Submitted: <output>{sent}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
// validation is your app's: `ccError` and `termsError` come from your checks on submit
<form onSubmit={submit}>
  <FormGroup legend="Send copies to" invalid={!!ccError} message={ccError ?? 'Pick at least one'}>
    <Checkbox label="Legal" name="cc" value="legal" />
    <Checkbox label="Finance" name="cc" value="finance" />
    <Checkbox label="Procurement" name="cc" value="procurement" />
  </FormGroup>
  <Checkbox label="I have read the contract terms" name="terms" value="accepted" invalid={!!termsError} invalidText={termsError} />
  <Button type="submit">Submit</Button>
</form>
<p>Submitted: <output>{sent}</output></p>
```

`submit` prevents the navigation and puts `new FormData(form)` into `sent`, as in the HTML. The group's message is built in, in Thai and English; `required-text` or `invalid-text` replaces it. More: [Forms and validation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/forms/).

## Selectable tiles

When each option needs a title and a description, use `ui-selectable-tile`: a checkbox drawn as a tile (Carbon's `SelectableTile`), from `@purpurabog/ui/selection-tiles`. It submits `name` and `value` like a checkbox, and Space toggles it. In a `ui-checkbox-group` the tiles are members like checkboxes: the group's `required`, `disabled`, `readonly` and error apply to them.


HTML:

```html
<ui-checkbox-group label="Add-on services" orientation="horizontal">
  <ui-selectable-tile name="addons" value="stamp"><b>Stamp duty</b><br />Calculate and pay</ui-selectable-tile>
  <ui-selectable-tile name="addons" value="translate" checked><b>Translation</b><br />Thai ⇄ English</ui-selectable-tile>
  <ui-selectable-tile name="addons" value="courier"><b>Courier</b><br />Signed copies by messenger</ui-selectable-tile>
</ui-checkbox-group>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiSelectableTile } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiCheckboxGroup label="Add-on services" orientation="horizontal">
  <UiSelectableTile name="addons" value="stamp"><b>Stamp duty</b><br />Calculate and pay</UiSelectableTile>
  <UiSelectableTile name="addons" value="translate" checked><b>Translation</b><br />Thai ⇄ English</UiSelectableTile>
  <UiSelectableTile name="addons" value="courier"><b>Courier</b><br />Signed copies by messenger</UiSelectableTile>
</UiCheckboxGroup>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
// npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-tile
import { SelectableTile } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/tile';

<FormGroup legend="Add-on services">
  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
    <SelectableTile name="addons" value="stamp"><b>Stamp duty</b><br />Calculate and pay</SelectableTile>
    <SelectableTile name="addons" value="translate" defaultChecked><b>Translation</b><br />Thai ⇄ English</SelectableTile>
    <SelectableTile name="addons" value="courier"><b>Courier</b><br />Signed copies by messenger</SelectableTile>
  </div>
</FormGroup>
```

## Skeleton

While the options load, show one `ui-checkbox-skeleton` per row: an empty box and a label bar. It is hidden from screen readers, so say "loading" on the container (for example `aria-busy`).


HTML:

```html
<div aria-busy="true">
  <ui-checkbox-skeleton></ui-checkbox-skeleton>
  <ui-checkbox-skeleton></ui-checkbox-skeleton>
  <ui-checkbox-skeleton></ui-checkbox-skeleton>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiCheckboxSkeleton } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<div aria-busy="true">
  <UiCheckboxSkeleton />
  <UiCheckboxSkeleton />
  <UiCheckboxSkeleton />
</div>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { CheckboxSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/checkbox';

<div aria-busy="true">
  <CheckboxSkeleton />
  <CheckboxSkeleton />
  <CheckboxSkeleton />
</div>
```

On the web component, import it from `@purpurabog/ui/checkbox-skeleton`.

## Keyboard

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Space | Checks or unchecks the focused box |
| Tab | Moves to the next box: each checkbox is its own Tab stop |

## Accessibility

- Each box is a native checkbox inside a `<label>`, so the whole row is clickable and screen readers hear its state, "mixed" included.
- `ui-checkbox-group` is a `role="group"` named by its label; its helper, warning or error text describes the group, and every box repeats the group's error so it is heard on the first box.
- Don't use a checkbox for a setting that applies at once; use a [Toggle](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/toggle/).

Unstyled React parts with the same behaviour: [Headless Checkbox](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-checkbox/).

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-checkbox>` · React `UiCheckbox`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `checked` | `checked` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `indeterminate` | `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | Mixed state, e.g. a "select all" box with some children checked. Cleared on user toggle. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control; a disabled `<fieldset>` ancestor does the same. |
| `required` | `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Blocks form submission while the field is empty. |
| `readonly` | `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows and submits the value but blocks changes. |
| `hide-label` | `hideLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep the label text for screen readers but don't show it. |
| `name` | `name` | `string` | `''` | Reflected: form-associated elements submit under the `name` attribute. |
| `value` | `value` | `string` | `'on'` |  |
| `helper-text` | `helperText` | `string` | `''` | Helper text under the field, shown while there is no error or warning. |
| `invalid-text` | `invalidText` | `string` | `''` | Error text shown while `invalid` or while the field fails validation. |
| `invalid` | `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Forces the error state, e.g. after server-side validation. |
| `warn` | `warn` | `boolean` | `false` | Non-blocking warning; shown when there is no error. |
| `warn-text` | `warnText` | `string` | `''` | Text of the warning shown while `warn`. |

#### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `groupDisabled` | `boolean` | Set by ui-checkbox-group; kept apart from the author's own disabled / readonly. |
| `groupMessage` | `string` | Error text of the owning ui-checkbox-group while the group is invalid. The group shows it once below the boxes; each box repeats it as its own accessible description and reports aria-invalid, so a screen reader landing on the first box hears why (an IDREF cannot cross the group's shadow root). |
| `willValidate` |  | (read-only) Whether the field takes part in constraint validation (not while disabled), as natively. |
| `labels` |  | (read-only) The `<label>`s that point at this field. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `setCustomValidity(message)` | Like `<input>.setCustomValidity()`: a non-empty message makes the field invalid (and is shown as its error once touched) until cleared with ''. |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `change` | none (use a ref) | When the user toggles the box |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Label text |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `base` | The clickable row (label element) |
| `control` | The native checkbox input |
| `box` | The drawn 16px box |
| `label` | The text beside the box |
| `status-icon` | The error / warning icon |
| `helper-text` | The helper line |
| `warning-text` | The warning line |
| `warn-text` | Same line as `warning-text` (named after the `warn-text` attribute / slot) |
| `error-text` | The error line |
| `invalid-text` | Same line as `error-text` (named after the `invalid-text` attribute / slot) |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-checkbox-border` |  | Border of the box (default `--ui-ink`; Kanok: `--ui-ink-subtle`) |
| `--ui-checkbox-checked` |  | Fill and border when checked or mixed (default `--ui-ink`; Kanok: `--ui-primary`) |
| `--ui-checkbox-mark` |  | Check mark colour (default `--ui-icon-inverse`; Kanok: `--ui-on-primary`) |

### `<ui-checkbox-group>` · React `UiCheckboxGroup`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` | Visible label text; the `label` slot replaces it when markup is needed. |
| `hide-label` | `hideLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep the group label for screen readers but don't show it. |
| `helper-text` | `helperText` | `string` | `''` | Helper text under the field, shown while there is no error or warning. |
| `required` | `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Blocks form submission while the field is empty. |
| `required-text` | `requiredText` | `string` | `''` | Error for an empty required group. |
| `invalid` | `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Forces the error state, e.g. after server-side validation. |
| `invalid-text` | `invalidText` | `string` | `''` | Error text shown while `invalid` or while the field fails validation. |
| `warn` | `warn` | `boolean` | `false` | Non-blocking warning; shown when there is no error. |
| `warn-text` | `warnText` | `string` | `''` | Text of the warning shown while `warn`. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control; a disabled `<fieldset>` ancestor does the same. |
| `readonly` | `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows and submits the value but blocks changes. |
| `orientation` | `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | `'vertical'` |  |

#### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `willValidate` |  | (read-only) Whether the field takes part in constraint validation (not while disabled), as natively. |
| `labels` |  | (read-only) The `<label>`s that point at this field. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `setCustomValidity(message)` | Like `<input>.setCustomValidity()`: a non-empty message makes the field invalid (and is shown as its error once touched) until cleared with ''. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | `<ui-checkbox>` or `<ui-selectable-tile>` elements |
| `label` | Label content with markup; the `label` attribute is the plain-text fallback |
| `helper-text` | Helper text with markup (links, bold); overrides `helper-text` |
| `warn-text` | Warning text shown while `warn`; overrides `warn-text` |
| `invalid-text` | Error text shown while invalid; overrides `invalid-text` |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `base` | The group box holding the checkboxes |
| `label` | The group label |
| `status-icon` | The error / warning icon |
| `helper-text` | The helper line |
| `warning-text` | The warning line |
| `warn-text` | Same line as `warning-text` (named after the `warn-text` attribute / slot) |
| `error-text` | The error line |
| `invalid-text` | Same line as `error-text` (named after the `invalid-text` attribute / slot) |

# Radio button

Radio buttons pick exactly one option from a small set, with every option in view. Once one is picked, the user can change it but not clear it.


HTML:

```html
<ui-radio-group label="Payment" name="payment" value="transfer">
  <ui-radio value="transfer">Bank transfer</ui-radio>
  <ui-radio value="card">Credit card</ui-radio>
  <ui-radio value="cash">Cash at the branch</ui-radio>
</ui-radio-group>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiRadioGroup label="Payment" name="payment" value="transfer">
  <UiRadio value="transfer">Bank transfer</UiRadio>
  <UiRadio value="card">Credit card</UiRadio>
  <UiRadio value="cash">Cash at the branch</UiRadio>
</UiRadioGroup>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<RadioGroup label="Payment" name="payment" defaultValue="transfer">
  <Radio value="transfer">Bank transfer</Radio>
  <Radio value="card">Credit card</Radio>
  <Radio value="cash">Cash at the branch</Radio>
</RadioGroup>
```

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/radio @kanok-ui/tile
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-radio-group
```

Manual:

```bash
# Web component
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install lit@^3.3.0
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/radio.json
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tile.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/primitives/radio/radio-group.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/radio/radio-shared.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/radio/radio-skeleton.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/radio/radio.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/expandable-tile.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/radio-tile.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/selectable-tile.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/selection-tiles-shared.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/selection-tiles.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/tile.ts
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-roving, shared-element, shared-field, shared-form-control, shared-localize, shared-skeleton, shared-slots, tokens, checkbox, shared-events, shared-navigate

# React + Tailwind
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install @purpurabog/ui@^1.4.3
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tw-radio-group.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/react-tw/radio-group.tsx
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    tw-field, tw-i18n, tw-theme, tw-utils
```

npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Use it


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">import '@purpurabog/ui/radio';</script>

<ui-radio-group label="Payment" name="payment">
  <ui-radio value="transfer">Bank transfer</ui-radio>
  <ui-radio value="card">Credit card</ui-radio>
</ui-radio-group>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiRadio, UiRadioGroup } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiRadioGroup label="Payment" name="payment">
  <UiRadio value="transfer">Bank transfer</UiRadio>
  <UiRadio value="card">Credit card</UiRadio>
</UiRadioGroup>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { Radio, RadioGroup } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/radio-group';

<RadioGroup label="Payment" name="payment">
  <Radio value="transfer">Bank transfer</Radio>
  <Radio value="card">Credit card</Radio>
</RadioGroup>
```

Radios always go in a group: the group holds the label, the `name` and the value, and submits the checked option's `value`. More than about five options, or not enough room? Use a [Select or Dropdown](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/select/#select-dropdown-combobox-or-multiselect).

## Starting value and changes

The group's `value` is the checked option. Without it, a `<ui-radio checked>` is the starting choice; with neither, nothing is checked. Reset goes back to the starting choice. `change` fires on the group when the user picks another option.


HTML:

```html
<ui-radio-group id="radio-payment" label="Payment" name="payment" value="card">
  <ui-radio value="transfer">Bank transfer</ui-radio>
  <ui-radio value="card">Credit card</ui-radio>
  <ui-radio value="cash">Cash at the branch</ui-radio>
</ui-radio-group>
<p>Value: <output id="radio-payment-out"></output></p>

<script type="module">
  const payment = document.getElementById('radio-payment');
  const out = document.getElementById('radio-payment-out');
  out.value = payment.value;
  payment.addEventListener('change', () => (out.value = payment.value));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
import type { UiRadioGroup as RadioGroupElement } from '@purpurabog/ui';

const [payment, setPayment] = useState('card');

<UiRadioGroup label="Payment" name="payment" value={payment} onChange={(e) => setPayment((e.target as RadioGroupElement).value)}>…</UiRadioGroup>
<p>Value: <output>{payment}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [payment, setPayment] = useState('card');

<RadioGroup label="Payment" name="payment" value={payment} onValueChange={setPayment}>…</RadioGroup>
<p>Value: <output>{payment}</output></p>
```

## Orientation

Groups are vertical by default. `orientation="horizontal"` puts the options in a row; keep it for two or three short options.


HTML:

```html
<ui-radio-group label="Contract length" name="length" orientation="horizontal" value="12">
  <ui-radio value="6">6 months</ui-radio>
  <ui-radio value="12">1 year</ui-radio>
  <ui-radio value="36">3 years</ui-radio>
</ui-radio-group>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiRadioGroup label="Contract length" name="length" orientation="horizontal" value="12">
  <UiRadio value="6">6 months</UiRadio>
  <UiRadio value="12">1 year</UiRadio>
  <UiRadio value="36">3 years</UiRadio>
</UiRadioGroup>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<RadioGroup label="Contract length" name="length" orientation="horizontal" defaultValue="12">
  <Radio value="6">6 months</Radio>
  <Radio value="12">1 year</Radio>
  <Radio value="36">3 years</Radio>
</RadioGroup>
```

## Label position

`label-position="left"` puts each option's text before its circle (Carbon `labelPosition`). A vertical group then lines the circles up at its end. Set it on one radio to move only that one.


HTML:

```html
<ui-radio-group label="Signing order" name="order" label-position="left" value="internal">
  <ui-radio value="internal">Internal first</ui-radio>
  <ui-radio value="parallel">Parallel</ui-radio>
  <ui-radio value="external">External first</ui-radio>
</ui-radio-group>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiRadioGroup label="Signing order" name="order" labelPosition="left" value="internal">
  <UiRadio value="internal">Internal first</UiRadio>
  <UiRadio value="parallel">Parallel</UiRadio>
  <UiRadio value="external">External first</UiRadio>
</UiRadioGroup>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<RadioGroup label="Signing order" name="order" labelPosition="left" defaultValue="internal">
  <Radio value="internal">Internal first</Radio>
  <Radio value="parallel">Parallel</Radio>
  <Radio value="external">External first</Radio>
</RadioGroup>
```

## Helper text, warnings and errors

The group has one message line under its options: `helper-text`, a non-blocking `warn` with `warn-text`, and `invalid` with `invalid-text`. An error beats a warning, and a warning beats the helper text.


HTML:

```html
<ui-radio-group label="Signing order" name="order1" value="internal" helper-text="Who signs first">
  <ui-radio value="internal">Internal first</ui-radio>
  <ui-radio value="external">External first</ui-radio>
</ui-radio-group>
<ui-radio-group label="Delivery of the signed copy" name="delivery" value="post" warn warn-text="Registered post takes 3 to 5 working days">
  <ui-radio value="email">Email</ui-radio>
  <ui-radio value="post">Registered post</ui-radio>
</ui-radio-group>
<ui-radio-group label="Governing law" name="law" invalid invalid-text="Choose the law that governs the contract">
  <ui-radio value="th">Thai law</ui-radio>
  <ui-radio value="sg">Singapore law</ui-radio>
</ui-radio-group>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiRadioGroup label="Signing order" name="order1" value="internal" helperText="Who signs first">…</UiRadioGroup>
<UiRadioGroup label="Delivery of the signed copy" name="delivery" value="post" warn warnText="Registered post takes 3 to 5 working days">…</UiRadioGroup>
<UiRadioGroup label="Governing law" name="law" invalid invalidText="Choose the law that governs the contract">…</UiRadioGroup>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<RadioGroup label="Signing order" name="order1" defaultValue="internal" helperText="Who signs first">…</RadioGroup>
<RadioGroup label="Delivery of the signed copy" name="delivery" defaultValue="post" warn warnText="Registered post takes 3 to 5 working days">…</RadioGroup>
<RadioGroup label="Governing law" name="law" invalid invalidText="Choose the law that governs the contract">…</RadioGroup>
```

## Disabled options, read-only and disabled

- `disabled` on one radio skips it; on the group, it disables every option and the group isn't submitted.
- `readonly` (`readOnly` in React + Tailwind) keeps the value and submits it. The arrow keys still move focus so people can read the options, but nothing changes.


HTML:

```html
<ui-radio-group label="Payment" value="transfer" readonly>
  <ui-radio value="transfer">Bank transfer</ui-radio>
  <ui-radio value="cash" disabled>Cash at the branch</ui-radio>
</ui-radio-group>
<ui-radio-group label="Payment" value="transfer" disabled>
  <ui-radio value="transfer">Bank transfer</ui-radio>
  <ui-radio value="cash">Cash at the branch</ui-radio>
</ui-radio-group>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiRadioGroup label="Payment" value="transfer" readonly>
  <UiRadio value="transfer">Bank transfer</UiRadio>
  <UiRadio value="cash" disabled>Cash at the branch</UiRadio>
</UiRadioGroup>
<UiRadioGroup label="Payment" value="transfer" disabled>…</UiRadioGroup>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<RadioGroup label="Payment" defaultValue="transfer" readOnly>
  <Radio value="transfer">Bank transfer</Radio>
  <Radio value="cash" disabled>Cash at the branch</Radio>
</RadioGroup>
<RadioGroup label="Payment" defaultValue="transfer" disabled>…</RadioGroup>
```

## Show more fields for one choice

A choice often needs details that only apply to it, such as a bank account for a transfer. Listen to `change` and show the extra field only for that option.


HTML:

```html
<ui-radio-group id="radio-refund" label="Refund the deposit by" name="refund" value="cash">
  <ui-radio value="cash">Cash at the branch</ui-radio>
  <ui-radio value="transfer">Bank transfer</ui-radio>
</ui-radio-group>
<div id="radio-refund-account" hidden>
  <ui-text-input label="Account number" name="account" helper-text="The tenant's own account"></ui-text-input>
</div>

<script type="module">
  const refund = document.getElementById('radio-refund');
  const account = document.getElementById('radio-refund-account');
  refund.addEventListener('change', () => (account.hidden = refund.value !== 'transfer'));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [refund, setRefund] = useState('cash');

<UiRadioGroup label="Refund the deposit by" name="refund" value={refund} onChange={(e) => setRefund((e.target as RadioGroupElement).value)}>
  <UiRadio value="cash">Cash at the branch</UiRadio>
  <UiRadio value="transfer">Bank transfer</UiRadio>
</UiRadioGroup>
{refund === 'transfer' && <UiTextInput label="Account number" name="account" helperText="The tenant's own account" />}
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [refund, setRefund] = useState('cash');

<RadioGroup label="Refund the deposit by" name="refund" value={refund} onValueChange={setRefund}>
  <Radio value="cash">Cash at the branch</Radio>
  <Radio value="transfer">Bank transfer</Radio>
</RadioGroup>
{refund === 'transfer' && <TextInput label="Account number" name="account" helperText="The tenant's own account" />}
```

## Required in a form

`required` on the group blocks submit until an option is picked, with a built-in message (`required-text` changes it). The rest: [Forms and validation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/forms/). Press Submit without a choice to see the message.


HTML:

```html
<form id="radio-form" style="display: grid; gap: 16px">
  <ui-radio-group label="Contract type" name="type" required required-text="Choose the contract type">
    <ui-radio value="sale">Sale</ui-radio>
    <ui-radio value="lease">Lease</ui-radio>
  </ui-radio-group>
  <div><ui-button type="submit">Submit</ui-button></div>
</form>
<p>Submitted: <output id="radio-form-out"></output></p>

<script type="module">
  const form = document.getElementById('radio-form');
  form.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    document.getElementById('radio-form-out').value = [...new FormData(form)].map(([key, value]) => `${key}=${value}`).join(', ');
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<form onSubmit={submit}>
  <UiRadioGroup label="Contract type" name="type" required requiredText="Choose the contract type">
    <UiRadio value="sale">Sale</UiRadio>
    <UiRadio value="lease">Lease</UiRadio>
  </UiRadioGroup>
  <UiButton type="submit">Submit</UiButton>
</form>
<p>Submitted: <output>{sent}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
// validation is your app's: `tried` is set on the first submit
<form onSubmit={submit}>
  <RadioGroup label="Contract type" name="type" value={type} onValueChange={setType} required invalid={tried && !type} invalidText="Choose the contract type">
    <Radio value="sale">Sale</Radio>
    <Radio value="lease">Lease</Radio>
  </RadioGroup>
  <Button type="submit">Submit</Button>
</form>
<p>Submitted: <output>{sent}</output></p>
```

`submit` prevents the navigation and puts `new FormData(form)` into `sent`, as in the HTML.

## Radio tiles

The same group also holds radio tiles (`<ui-radio-tile>`, from `@purpurabog/ui/selection-tiles`) when each option needs more room: a title and a line of description. The check mark shows only on the chosen tile.


HTML:

```html
<ui-radio-group label="Signing method" name="method" orientation="horizontal" value="esign">
  <ui-radio-tile value="esign"><b>E-signature</b><br />Sign online in minutes</ui-radio-tile>
  <ui-radio-tile value="paper"><b>Paper</b><br />Print, sign, scan</ui-radio-tile>
  <ui-radio-tile value="hybrid" disabled><b>Hybrid</b><br />Coming soon</ui-radio-tile>
</ui-radio-group>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiRadioTile } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiRadioGroup label="Signing method" name="method" orientation="horizontal" value="esign">
  <UiRadioTile value="esign"><b>E-signature</b><br />Sign online in minutes</UiRadioTile>
  <UiRadioTile value="paper"><b>Paper</b><br />Print, sign, scan</UiRadioTile>
  <UiRadioTile value="hybrid" disabled><b>Hybrid</b><br />Coming soon</UiRadioTile>
</UiRadioGroup>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
// npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-tile
import { RadioTile } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/tile';

<RadioGroup label="Signing method" name="method" orientation="horizontal" defaultValue="esign">
  <RadioTile value="esign"><b>E-signature</b><br />Sign online in minutes</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="paper"><b>Paper</b><br />Print, sign, scan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="hybrid" disabled><b>Hybrid</b><br />Coming soon</RadioTile>
</RadioGroup>
```

## Skeleton

While the options load, show one `ui-radio-skeleton` per option: a label bar (Carbon draws no circle). It is hidden from screen readers, so say "loading" on the container (for example `aria-busy`).


HTML:

```html
<div aria-busy="true">
  <ui-radio-skeleton></ui-radio-skeleton>
  <ui-radio-skeleton></ui-radio-skeleton>
  <ui-radio-skeleton></ui-radio-skeleton>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiRadioSkeleton } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<div aria-busy="true">
  <UiRadioSkeleton />
  <UiRadioSkeleton />
  <UiRadioSkeleton />
</div>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { RadioSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/radio-group';

<div aria-busy="true">
  <RadioSkeleton />
  <RadioSkeleton />
  <RadioSkeleton />
</div>
```

On the web component, import it from `@purpurabog/ui/radio-skeleton`.

## Keyboard

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Tab | Enters the group on the checked option (else the first), and leaves it on the next Tab |
| ↓ / → | Moves to the next option and checks it; wraps from the last to the first |
| ↑ / ← | Moves to the previous option and checks it; wraps from the first to the last |
| Space | Checks the focused option |

## Accessibility

- The group is a `role="radiogroup"` named by its label, with one Tab stop, as the WAI-ARIA radio group pattern describes. Disabled options are skipped.
- The group's helper, warning or error text describes it, and each radio repeats the error so a screen reader hears it on the option it lands on.
- Use `hide-label` only when the context already names the group; the label then stays for screen readers.

Unstyled React parts with the same behaviour: [Headless Radio button](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-radio/).

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-radio-group>` · React `UiRadioGroup`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` | Group label (rendered like a fieldset legend). |
| `hide-label` | `hideLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep the group label for screen readers but don't show it. |
| `name` | `name` | `string` | `''` | Reflected: form-associated elements submit under the `name` attribute. |
| `value` | `value` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `orientation` | `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | `'vertical'` |  |
| `label-position` | `labelPosition` | `RadioLabelPosition` | `'right'` | Carbon `labelPosition`: `left` puts each radio's text before its circle (default `right`, after it). |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control; a disabled `<fieldset>` ancestor does the same. |
| `required` | `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Blocks form submission while the field is empty. |
| `readonly` | `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows and submits the value but blocks changes. |
| `helper-text` | `helperText` | `string` | `''` | Helper text under the field, shown while there is no error or warning. |
| `invalid-text` | `invalidText` | `string` | `''` | Error text shown while `invalid` or while the field fails validation. |
| `invalid` | `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Forces the error state, e.g. after server-side validation. |
| `warn` | `warn` | `boolean` | `false` | Non-blocking warning; shown when there is no error. |
| `warn-text` | `warnText` | `string` | `''` | Text of the warning shown while `warn`. |
| `required-text` | `requiredText` | `string` | `''` | Error text for an empty required group. |

#### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `willValidate` |  | (read-only) Whether the field takes part in constraint validation (not while disabled), as natively. |
| `labels` |  | (read-only) The `<label>`s that point at this field. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `setCustomValidity(message)` | Like `<input>.setCustomValidity()`: a non-empty message makes the field invalid (and is shown as its error once touched) until cleared with ''. |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `input` | none (use a ref) |  |
| `change` | none (use a ref) | When the user picks an option |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | `<ui-radio>` options |
| `label` | Label content with markup; the `label` attribute is the plain-text fallback |
| `helper-text` | Helper text with markup (links, bold); overrides `helper-text` |
| `warn-text` | Warning text shown while `warn`; overrides `warn-text` |
| `invalid-text` | Error text shown while invalid; overrides `invalid-text` |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `base` | The group box holding the radios |
| `label` | The group label |
| `status-icon` | The error / warning icon |
| `helper-text` | The helper line |
| `warning-text` | The warning line |
| `warn-text` | Same line as `warning-text` (named after the `warn-text` attribute / slot) |
| `error-text` | The error line |
| `invalid-text` | Same line as `error-text` (named after the `invalid-text` attribute / slot) |

### `<ui-radio>` · React `UiRadio`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `value` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `checked` | `checked` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control; a disabled `<fieldset>` ancestor does the same. |
| `label-position` | `labelPosition` | `RadioLabelPosition \| undefined` |  | Carbon `labelPosition`: `left` puts the text before the circle; unset, the group's `label-position` applies. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Label text |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `circle` | The drawn radio circle |
| `label` | The text beside it |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-radio-border` |  | Ring colour (default `--ui-ink`; Kanok: `--ui-ink-subtle`) |
| `--ui-radio-checked` |  | Ring and dot when chosen (default `--ui-ink`; Kanok: `--ui-primary`) |

### `<ui-radio-tile>` · React `UiRadioTile`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `value` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `checked` | `checked` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control; a disabled `<fieldset>` ancestor does the same. |
| `label-position` | `labelPosition` | `RadioLabelPosition \| undefined` |  | Carbon `labelPosition`: `left` puts the text before the circle; unset, the group's `label-position` applies. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Tile content (title, description…) |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `circle` | The drawn radio circle |
| `label` | The text beside it |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-tile-border-color` |  | Border of an unchosen tile (default transparent; Kanok: a hairline); `--ui-card-radius` its corners |
| `--ui-card-background` |  | Its fill (default `--ui-surface-1`; Kanok paper: a cool grey that sets it apart from the page, no border) |
| `--ui-tile-selected-border` |  | Border of the chosen tile (default `--ui-layer-selected-inverse`; Kanok: primary blue); `--ui-tile-selected-mark` its check mark (default `--ui-icon-primary`) |
| `--ui-tile-selected-background` |  | Fill of the chosen tile (default `--ui-card-background`; Kanok: soft highlight wash) |
| `--ui-radio-border` |  | Ring colour (default `--ui-ink`; Kanok: `--ui-ink-subtle`) |
| `--ui-radio-checked` |  | Ring and dot when chosen (default `--ui-ink`; Kanok: `--ui-primary`) |

# Toggle

A toggle switches a setting on or off, and the change takes effect right away. The label sits above the switch and the state text beside it.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 32px; align-items: center">
  <ui-toggle label="Email alerts" checked></ui-toggle>
  <ui-toggle label="Auto-renew"></ui-toggle>
  <ui-toggle label="Locked" checked disabled></ui-toggle>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiToggle label="Email alerts" checked />
<UiToggle label="Auto-renew" />
<UiToggle label="Locked" checked disabled />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Toggle label="Email alerts" defaultChecked />
<Toggle label="Auto-renew" />
<Toggle label="Locked" defaultChecked disabled />
```

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/toggle
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-toggle
```

Manual:

```bash
# Web component
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install lit@^3.3.0
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/toggle.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/primitives/toggle/toggle-skeleton.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/toggle/toggle.ts
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    shared-element, shared-field, shared-form-control, shared-localize, shared-skeleton, shared-slots, tokens

# React + Tailwind
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install @purpurabog/ui@^1.4.3
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tw-toggle.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/react-tw/toggle.tsx
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    tw-field, tw-i18n, tw-refs, tw-theme, tw-utils
```

npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Use it


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">import '@purpurabog/ui/toggle';</script>

<ui-toggle label="Email alerts"></ui-toggle>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiToggle } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiToggle label="Email alerts" />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { Toggle } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/toggle';

<Toggle label="Email alerts" />
```

## Toggle or checkbox?

Use a toggle when the change applies at once, such as a setting. In a form that the user submits later, or for agreeing to terms, use a [Checkbox](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/checkbox/).

## On and off

`checked` is the state. `change` fires after the user flips it, with `checked` already updated.


HTML:

```html
<ui-toggle id="toggle-alerts" label="Email alerts"></ui-toggle>
<p>Email alerts: <output id="toggle-alerts-out">off</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const alerts = document.getElementById('toggle-alerts');
  alerts.addEventListener('change', () => {
    document.getElementById('toggle-alerts-out').textContent = alerts.checked ? 'on' : 'off';
    // saveSetting('alerts', alerts.checked);
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
import type { UiToggle as ToggleElement } from '@purpurabog/ui';

<UiToggle label="Email alerts" checked={on} onChange={(e) => setOn((e.target as ToggleElement).checked)} />
<p>Email alerts: <output>{on ? 'on' : 'off'}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Toggle label="Email alerts" checked={on} onCheckedChange={setOn} />
<p>Email alerts: <output>{on ? 'on' : 'off'}</output></p>
```

`saveSetting` stands for your own code.

## Labels

- `label` is the text above the switch (the `label` slot takes markup).
- `label-a` and `label-b` are the state text beside it, for off and on. By default it reads "Off" / "On", translated to the page language.
- `hide-label` drops the label above; the label then replaces the state text beside the switch, as in Carbon.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 32px; align-items: center">
  <ui-toggle label="Visibility" label-a="Private" label-b="Public"></ui-toggle>
  <ui-toggle label="Dark mode" hide-label></ui-toggle>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiToggle label="Visibility" labelA="Private" labelB="Public" />
<UiToggle label="Dark mode" hideLabel />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Toggle label="Visibility" labelA="Private" labelB="Public" />
<Toggle label="Dark mode" hideLabel />
```

## Markup in the label

When part of the label needs weight, put it in the `label` slot; it replaces the `label` attribute. In React + Tailwind, `label` takes the markup itself.


HTML:

```html
<ui-toggle>
  <span slot="label">Copy <strong>Procurement</strong> on new purchase requests</span>
</ui-toggle>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiToggle>
  <span slot="label">Copy <strong>Procurement</strong> on new purchase requests</span>
</UiToggle>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Toggle label={<>Copy <strong>Procurement</strong> on new purchase requests</>} />
```

## Sizes

`size`: `md` is a 48×24 track (the default); `sm` is 32×16, with a check mark in the knob when on.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 32px; align-items: center">
  <ui-toggle label="Medium" checked></ui-toggle>
  <ui-toggle label="Small" size="sm" checked></ui-toggle>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiToggle label="Medium" checked />
<UiToggle label="Small" size="sm" checked />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Toggle label="Medium" defaultChecked />
<Toggle label="Small" size="sm" defaultChecked />
```

## A list of settings

For a list of related settings, put small toggles with `hide-label` in a form group, so each label sits beside its switch. When one setting turns the others off, disable the group: `disabled` on `ui-form-group` (`FormGroup` in React + Tailwind) disables every toggle inside.


HTML:

```html
<ui-toggle id="toggle-notify" label="Email notifications" checked></ui-toggle>
<ui-form-group id="toggle-notify-group" legend="Send me an email when">
  <div style="display: grid; gap: 16px">
    <ui-toggle size="sm" hide-label label="A purchase request needs my approval" checked></ui-toggle>
    <ui-toggle size="sm" hide-label label="A contract is about to expire" checked></ui-toggle>
    <ui-toggle size="sm" hide-label label="Someone comments on my request"></ui-toggle>
  </div>
</ui-form-group>

<script type="module">
  const notify = document.getElementById('toggle-notify');
  const group = document.getElementById('toggle-notify-group');
  notify.addEventListener('change', () => { group.disabled = !notify.checked; });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiFormGroup, UiToggle } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiToggle label="Email notifications" checked={notify} onChange={(e) => setNotify((e.target as ToggleElement).checked)} />
<UiFormGroup legend="Send me an email when" disabled={!notify}>
  <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 16 }}>
    <UiToggle size="sm" hideLabel label="A purchase request needs my approval" checked />
    <UiToggle size="sm" hideLabel label="A contract is about to expire" checked />
    <UiToggle size="sm" hideLabel label="Someone comments on my request" />
  </div>
</UiFormGroup>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { FormGroup } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/form-group';

<Toggle label="Email notifications" checked={notify} onCheckedChange={setNotify} />
<FormGroup legend="Send me an email when" disabled={!notify}>
  <div className="grid gap-4">
    <Toggle size="sm" hideLabel label="A purchase request needs my approval" defaultChecked />
    <Toggle size="sm" hideLabel label="A contract is about to expire" defaultChecked />
    <Toggle size="sm" hideLabel label="Someone comments on my request" />
  </div>
</FormGroup>
```

## State text in the page language

The default state text comes from the language of the page, or of the closest `lang` around the toggle. Set `lang` on the toggle, or on a part of the page, to change it there.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 32px; align-items: center">
  <ui-toggle label="Email alerts" checked></ui-toggle>
  <ui-toggle lang="th" label="แจ้งเตือนทางอีเมล" checked></ui-toggle>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiToggle label="Email alerts" checked />
<UiToggle lang="th" label="แจ้งเตือนทางอีเมล" checked />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Toggle label="Email alerts" defaultChecked />
<Toggle lang="th" label="แจ้งเตือนทางอีเมล" defaultChecked />
```

## In a form

With a `name`, a toggle that is on submits `value` (`on` by default) with its form; off, it submits nothing. Form reset puts it back to its starting state.


HTML:

```html
<form id="toggle-form" method="dialog" style="display: grid; gap: 16px; justify-items: start">
  <ui-toggle label="Auto-renew" name="autoRenew" value="yes" checked></ui-toggle>
  <ui-toggle label="Paper invoice" name="paperInvoice" value="yes"></ui-toggle>
  <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
    <ui-button type="submit">Save</ui-button>
    <ui-button type="reset" kind="secondary">Reset</ui-button>
  </div>
</form>
<p>Submitted: <output id="toggle-form-out">nothing yet</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const form = document.getElementById('toggle-form');
  form.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const entries = [...new FormData(form)].map(([key, value]) => `${key}=${value}`);
    document.getElementById('toggle-form-out').textContent = entries.join(', ') || '(nothing)';
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); save(new FormData(e.currentTarget)); }}>
  <UiToggle label="Auto-renew" name="autoRenew" value="yes" checked />
  <UiToggle label="Paper invoice" name="paperInvoice" value="yes" />
  <UiButton type="submit">Save</UiButton>
  <UiButton type="reset" kind="secondary">Reset</UiButton>
</form>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); save(new FormData(e.currentTarget)); }}>
  <Toggle label="Auto-renew" name="autoRenew" value="yes" defaultChecked />
  <Toggle label="Paper invoice" name="paperInvoice" value="yes" />
  <Button type="submit">Save</Button>
  <Button type="reset" kind="secondary">Reset</Button>
</form>
```

`save` stands for your own code.

## Read-only and disabled

`readonly` (`readOnly` in React + Tailwind) shows the state and submits it, but clicks and keys don't flip it. `disabled` greys it out, and it isn't submitted.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 32px; align-items: center">
  <ui-toggle label="Auto-renew" checked readonly></ui-toggle>
  <ui-toggle label="Auto-renew" disabled></ui-toggle>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiToggle label="Auto-renew" checked readonly />
<UiToggle label="Auto-renew" disabled />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Toggle label="Auto-renew" defaultChecked readOnly />
<Toggle label="Auto-renew" disabled />
```

## Skeleton

While the settings load, show `<ui-toggle-skeleton>` in the toggle's place, as Carbon's `ToggleSkeleton`. It has its own import, `@purpurabog/ui/toggle-skeleton`, and is hidden from screen readers.


HTML:

```html
<ui-toggle-skeleton></ui-toggle-skeleton>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiToggleSkeleton } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiToggleSkeleton />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { ToggleSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/toggle';

<ToggleSkeleton />
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Space, Enter | Flips the toggle |
| Tab | Moves to the next control |

## Accessibility

- The switch is a `<button role="switch">` with `aria-checked`, named by the label above (or, with `hide-label`, by the label beside it). Screen readers hear "on" or "off" from the role, so the state text beside it is hidden from them.
- Clicking the track or the state text flips the switch, as in Carbon, and focus stays on it.
- Write the label as the setting ("Email alerts"), not as an action ("Turn on email alerts").

Unstyled React parts with the same behaviour: [Headless Toggle](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-toggle/).

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-toggle>` · React `UiToggle`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` | Label above the switch; the `label` slot replaces it when markup is needed. |
| `hide-label` | `hideLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Hide the label above; it then replaces the On / Off text beside the switch (Carbon `hideLabel`). |
| `label-a` | `labelA` | `string` | `''` | Side text while off (Carbon `labelA`). |
| `label-b` | `labelB` | `string` | `''` | Side text while on (Carbon `labelB`). |
| `checked` | `checked` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `value` | `value` | `string` | `'on'` | Submitted under `name` while checked. |
| `name` | `name` | `string` | `''` | Reflected: form-associated elements submit under the `name` attribute. |
| `size` | `size` | `ToggleSize` | `'md'` | md: 48×24 track (default) · sm: 32×16 with a check mark in the knob. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control; a disabled `<fieldset>` ancestor does the same. |
| `readonly` | `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows and submits the state but blocks toggling. |

#### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `willValidate` |  | (read-only) Whether the field takes part in constraint validation (not while disabled), as natively. |
| `labels` |  | (read-only) The `<label>`s that point at this field. |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `input` | none (use a ref) |  |
| `change` | none (use a ref) | After the user toggles it (`checked` already updated) |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `label` | Label content with markup; the `label` attribute is the plain-text fallback |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `base` | The row holding the switch and the side text |
| `label` | The label above the switch |
| `switch` | The track |
| `handle` | The knob |
| `text` | The On / Off text beside the switch |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-toggle-on` |  | Track colour when on (default `--ui-success`; Kanok: `--ui-primary`) |




---

# Date picker

A date picker takes a date that users type or pick from a calendar. On a Thai page it shows the Buddhist era (พ.ศ.); your code always gets an ISO date in the Gregorian year.


HTML:

```html
<ui-date-picker label="Contract start" name="start" clearable></ui-date-picker>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiDatePicker label="Contract start" name="start" clearable />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<DatePicker label="Contract start" name="start" clearable />
```

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/date-picker @kanok-ui/calendar
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-date-picker
```

Manual:

```bash
# Web component
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install lit@^3.3.0
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/date-picker.json
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/calendar.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/primitives/date-picker/calendar.styles.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/date-picker/calendar.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/date-picker/date-field.styles.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/date-picker/date-field.ts

#    components/ui/primitives/date-picker/date-picker.styles.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/date-picker/date-picker.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/calendar/calendar.styles.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/calendar/calendar.ts
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-date, core-overlay, core-popup, core-sheet, shared-element, shared-field, shared-form-control, shared-localize, shared-position, shared-quiet-focus, shared-skeleton, shared-slots, tokens
```
