# File uploader

A file uploader lets people pick files from their device, with a button or by dropping them on a drop zone. The chosen files are listed under it, each with its state: ready, uploading, uploaded, or an error.


HTML:

```html
<ui-file-uploader label-title="Attachments" label-description="PDF or JPG, up to 5 MB each" accept=".pdf,.jpg" max-file-size="5000000" multiple></ui-file-uploader>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiFileUploader labelTitle="Attachments" labelDescription="PDF or JPG, up to 5 MB each" accept=".pdf,.jpg" maxFileSize={5_000_000} multiple />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<FileUploader labelTitle="Attachments" labelDescription="PDF or JPG, up to 5 MB each" accept=".pdf,.jpg" maxFileSize={5_000_000} multiple />
```

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/file-uploader
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-file-uploader
```

Manual:

```bash
# Web component
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install lit@^3.3.0
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/file-uploader.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/primitives/file-uploader/file-uploader-item.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/file-uploader/file-uploader-shared.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/file-uploader/file-uploader-skeleton.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/file-uploader/file-uploader.ts
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    button, core-file-uploader, progress-bar, shared-element, shared-field, shared-form-control, shared-localize, shared-skeleton, tokens

# React + Tailwind
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install @purpurabog/ui@^1.4.3
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tw-file-uploader.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/react-tw/file-uploader.tsx
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-file-uploader, core-i18n, tw-button, tw-field, tw-i18n, tw-progress-bar, tw-theme, tw-utils
```

npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Use it


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">import '@purpurabog/ui/file-uploader';</script>

<ui-file-uploader label-title="Attachments" name="attachments" multiple></ui-file-uploader>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiFileUploader } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiFileUploader labelTitle="Attachments" name="attachments" multiple onUiChange={(e) => setFiles(e.detail.currentFiles)} />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { FileUploader } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/file-uploader';

<FileUploader labelTitle="Attachments" name="attachments" multiple onChange={(change) => setFiles(change.currentFiles)} />
```

- Each file in the list is a `FileItem`: `uuid`, `name`, the `File` itself, and its `status`, `invalid`, `errorSubject`, `errorBody`, `progress` and `retryable`.
- The element fires `ui-add` right after a pick (refused files included), before `files` updates (as Carbon's `onAddFiles`), `ui-change` with `addedFiles`, `removedFiles`, `currentFiles` and `action` (`add`, `remove` or `clear`), and `ui-delete` when the user removes a file. In React these are `onUiAdd`, `onUiChange` and `onUiDelete`; in React + Tailwind, `onAdd`, `onChange` and `onDelete`.
- Without `multiple`, a new pick replaces the list.

## Button or drop zone

The default is Carbon's "Add file" button. `drop` shows the dashed drop zone instead (Carbon's `FileUploaderDropContainer`): people can drop files on it, or click it to open the file dialog. Folders dropped on it are skipped.

- `button-label` changes the button text, and `button-kind` its kind (`primary` by default). After a pick the button shows the file name, or "3 files"; `keep-label` keeps your text.
- `drop-label` changes the drop zone text.
- `size` (`sm`, `md`, `lg`) sizes the button and the rows.


HTML:

```html
<ui-file-uploader label-title="Floor plans" label-description="Drop the files or click to choose them" drop multiple></ui-file-uploader>
<ui-file-uploader label-title="Signed contract" button-label="Choose PDF" button-kind="tertiary" keep-label size="sm"></ui-file-uploader>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiFileUploader labelTitle="Floor plans" labelDescription="Drop the files or click to choose them" drop multiple />
<UiFileUploader labelTitle="Signed contract" buttonLabel="Choose PDF" buttonKind="tertiary" keepLabel size="sm" />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<FileUploader labelTitle="Floor plans" labelDescription="Drop the files or click to choose them" drop multiple />
<FileUploader labelTitle="Signed contract" buttonLabel="Choose PDF" buttonKind="tertiary" keepLabel size="sm" />
```

## Sizes

`size` sets the height of the button and of every row: `sm`, `md` (the default) or `lg`. A row on its own takes `size` too.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: grid; gap: 8px; max-width: 320px">
  <ui-file-uploader-item size="sm" name="invoice-0142-sm.pdf"></ui-file-uploader-item>
  <ui-file-uploader-item size="md" name="invoice-0142-md.pdf"></ui-file-uploader-item>
  <ui-file-uploader-item size="lg" name="invoice-0142-lg.pdf"></ui-file-uploader-item>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiFileUploaderItem size="sm" name="invoice-0142-sm.pdf" />
<UiFileUploaderItem size="md" name="invoice-0142-md.pdf" />
<UiFileUploaderItem size="lg" name="invoice-0142-lg.pdf" />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<FileUploaderItem size="sm" name="invoice-0142-sm.pdf" />
<FileUploaderItem size="md" name="invoice-0142-md.pdf" />
<FileUploaderItem size="lg" name="invoice-0142-lg.pdf" />
```

## Limit the files

- `accept` lists the file types: extensions and MIME types, comma-separated (`.pdf,.jpg,image/png`).
- `max-file-size` is the largest size of one file, in bytes (5 MB = `5000000`).
- `max-files` is the most files in the list, and `max-total-size` the most bytes they may add up to. These two go beyond Carbon.

A refused file still shows in the list, marked as an error with the reason, so people see what went wrong. It isn't submitted with the form, and the user removes it with ×. Set the error titles with `invalid-type-text`, `too-large-text`, `too-many-text` and `total-too-large-text`, and the line under them with `invalid-body-text`. The built-in texts are translated ("File type not supported", "File is too large", "Too many files"…).


HTML:

```html
<ui-file-uploader label-title="ID documents" label-description="JPG or PNG, 2 MB each, 2 files at most" accept=".jpg,.png" max-file-size="2000000" max-files="2" multiple drop show-size invalid-type-text="Only JPG or PNG photos"></ui-file-uploader>
<ui-file-uploader label-title="Site photos" label-description="Up to 1 MB in all" max-total-size="1000000" multiple show-size></ui-file-uploader>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiFileUploader labelTitle="ID documents" labelDescription="JPG or PNG, 2 MB each, 2 files at most" accept=".jpg,.png" maxFileSize={2_000_000} maxFiles={2} multiple drop showSize invalidTypeText="Only JPG or PNG photos" />
<UiFileUploader labelTitle="Site photos" labelDescription="Up to 1 MB in all" maxTotalSize={1_000_000} multiple showSize />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<FileUploader labelTitle="ID documents" labelDescription="JPG or PNG, 2 MB each, 2 files at most" accept=".jpg,.png" maxFileSize={2_000_000} maxFiles={2} multiple drop showSize invalidTypeText="Only JPG or PNG photos" />
<FileUploader labelTitle="Site photos" labelDescription="Up to 1 MB in all" maxTotalSize={1_000_000} multiple showSize />
```

`show-size` shows each file's size in its row ("1.2 MB", in the page language). `accept` also filters the file dialog, but a dropped file is checked too.

## File states

Each row shows one of these. A row also works on its own, for files that are already on the server; it fires `ui-delete` and `ui-retry`, and removing it from the page is up to you.


HTML:

```html
<div style="max-width: 320px">
  <ui-file-uploader-item name="lease-agreement.pdf" file-size="482000"></ui-file-uploader-item>
  <ui-file-uploader-item name="floor-plan.jpg" status="uploading"></ui-file-uploader-item>
  <ui-file-uploader-item name="site-photos.zip" status="uploading" progress="45"></ui-file-uploader-item>
  <ui-file-uploader-item name="tenant-id.jpg" status="complete"></ui-file-uploader-item>
  <ui-file-uploader-item name="setup.exe" invalid error-subject="File type not supported" error-body="Remove the file and choose another."></ui-file-uploader-item>
  <ui-file-uploader-item name="inspection-report.pdf" invalid retryable></ui-file-uploader-item>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiFileUploaderItem name="lease-agreement.pdf" fileSize={482000} />
<UiFileUploaderItem name="floor-plan.jpg" status="uploading" />
<UiFileUploaderItem name="site-photos.zip" status="uploading" progress={45} />
<UiFileUploaderItem name="tenant-id.jpg" status="complete" />
<UiFileUploaderItem name="setup.exe" invalid errorSubject="File type not supported" errorBody="Remove the file and choose another." />
<UiFileUploaderItem name="inspection-report.pdf" invalid retryable onUiRetry={() => uploadAgain()} />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { FileUploaderItem } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/file-uploader';

<FileUploaderItem name="lease-agreement.pdf" fileSize={482000} />
<FileUploaderItem name="floor-plan.jpg" status="uploading" />
<FileUploaderItem name="site-photos.zip" status="uploading" progress={45} />
<FileUploaderItem name="tenant-id.jpg" status="complete" />
<FileUploaderItem name="setup.exe" invalid errorSubject="File type not supported" errorBody="Remove the file and choose another." />
<FileUploaderItem name="inspection-report.pdf" invalid retryable onRetry={() => uploadAgain()} />
```

- `edit`: ready, with × to remove it.
- `uploading`: a spinner, or with `progress` the percentage, a bar and × to cancel.
- `complete`: a check mark; it can't be removed.
- `invalid`: a red outline with `error-subject` and `error-body`. Add `retryable` for an upload that failed: a retry button appears, and the title is "Upload failed" unless you set one. Refused files aren't retryable.

## Files already on the server

When a record already has files, put them in the uploader as `<ui-file-uploader-item>` children (`FileUploaderItem` in React + Tailwind). They show after the picked files. Their × fires `ui-delete` on the row itself: remove the row and the file on the server. The event passes through the uploader as it is, so listen on the row, not for the uploader's own `ui-delete`.


HTML:

```html
<ui-file-uploader id="file-uploader-saved" label-title="Contract attachments" label-description="Two files are on record. Add more, or remove one." multiple>
  <ui-file-uploader-item name="contract-2026-014.pdf" file-size="482000"></ui-file-uploader-item>
  <ui-file-uploader-item name="company-certificate.pdf" file-size="1250000"></ui-file-uploader-item>
</ui-file-uploader>

<script type="module">
  for (const row of document.querySelectorAll('#file-uploader-saved > ui-file-uploader-item')) {
    row.addEventListener('ui-delete', () => row.remove()); // and delete the file on the server
  }
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiFileUploader labelTitle="Contract attachments" multiple>
  {saved.map((file) => (
    <UiFileUploaderItem key={file.id} uuid={file.id} name={file.name} fileSize={file.size}
      onUiDelete={() => removeSaved(file.id)} />
  ))}
</UiFileUploader>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<FileUploader labelTitle="Contract attachments" multiple>
  {saved.map((file) => (
    <FileUploaderItem key={file.id} uuid={file.id} name={file.name} fileSize={file.size}
      onDelete={() => removeSaved(file.id)} />
  ))}
</FileUploader>
```

`saved` and `removeSaved` stand for your own data and code.

## Disabled

`disabled` turns off the button or drop zone and every listed row, for example when a request is closed. A row on its own takes `disabled` too.


HTML:

```html
<ui-file-uploader label-title="Supporting documents" label-description="This request is closed." disabled></ui-file-uploader>
<div style="max-width: 320px">
  <ui-file-uploader-item name="quotation.pdf" disabled></ui-file-uploader-item>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiFileUploader labelTitle="Supporting documents" labelDescription="This request is closed." disabled />
<UiFileUploaderItem name="quotation.pdf" disabled />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<FileUploader labelTitle="Supporting documents" labelDescription="This request is closed." disabled />
<FileUploaderItem name="quotation.pdf" disabled />
```

## In a form

- With a `name`, every valid file is submitted under that name, like `<input type="file" multiple>`. Refused files are left out.
- `required` blocks the submit until there is at least one valid file; change the message with `required-text`. More in [Forms and validation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/forms/).
- A form reset empties the list. `disabled`, or a disabled fieldset, turns everything off.


HTML:

```html
<form id="file-uploader-form" method="dialog" style="display: grid; gap: 16px">
  <ui-file-uploader label-title="Signed contract" name="contract" accept=".pdf" required required-text="Attach the signed contract"></ui-file-uploader>
  <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
    <ui-button type="submit">Send for approval</ui-button>
    <ui-button type="reset" kind="secondary">Reset</ui-button>
  </div>
</form>
<p>Submitted: <output id="file-uploader-form-out">nothing yet</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const form = document.getElementById('file-uploader-form');
  form.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const entries = [...new FormData(form)].map(([key, value]) => `${key}=${value instanceof File ? value.name : value}`);
    document.getElementById('file-uploader-form-out').textContent = entries.join(', ');
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); send(new FormData(e.currentTarget)); }}>
  <UiFileUploader labelTitle="Signed contract" name="contract" accept=".pdf" required requiredText="Attach the signed contract" />
  <UiButton type="submit">Send for approval</UiButton>
  <UiButton type="reset" kind="secondary">Reset</UiButton>
</form>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<form onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); send(new FormData(e.currentTarget)); }}>
  <FileUploader labelTitle="Signed contract" name="contract" accept=".pdf" required requiredText="Attach the signed contract" />
  <Button type="submit">Send for approval</Button>
  <Button type="reset" kind="secondary">Reset</Button>
</form>
```

`send` stands for your own code.


## Read the chosen files

`ui-change` tells you what changed (`action`) and gives the whole list (`currentFiles`), so it is the one event to keep your state in step with. Pick a few files below, then remove one.


HTML:

```html
<ui-file-uploader id="file-uploader-events" label-title="Quotations" label-description="Attach every quotation you received" multiple></ui-file-uploader>
<p>Last change: <output id="file-uploader-events-out">none yet</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const quotes = document.getElementById('file-uploader-events');
  quotes.addEventListener('ui-change', (event) => {
    const { action, currentFiles } = event.detail;
    const names = currentFiles.map((f) => f.name).join(', ') || 'no files';
    document.getElementById('file-uploader-events-out').textContent = `${action}: ${names}`;
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiFileUploader labelTitle="Quotations" multiple
  onUiChange={(e) => setQuotes(e.detail.currentFiles)} />
<p>{quotes.map((f) => f.name).join(', ') || 'no files'}</p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<FileUploader labelTitle="Quotations" multiple
  onChange={(change) => setQuotes(change.currentFiles)} />
<p>{quotes.map((f) => f.name).join(', ') || 'no files'}</p>
```

## Upload the files

The uploader doesn't upload by itself: it lists the files and you send them. Update the list as each upload moves on: replace `files` with a new array, and each row follows its item's `status`.

- `uploading` shows a spinner. With a `progress` (0–100) it shows the percentage and a small bar instead, and × cancels the upload: the file is removed and `ui-delete` tells you to stop sending it.
- `complete` shows a check mark, and screen readers hear "Uploaded: contract.pdf".
- `status` on the uploader sets the state new files start in (`edit` by default, with ×).

Pick some files below: each one uploads at once. The upload here is a stand-in that moves on a timer, and a file with "fail" in its name fails halfway, so you can retry it.


HTML:

```html
<ui-file-uploader id="file-uploader-upload" label-title="Supporting documents" label-description="Uploads start as soon as you pick" multiple show-size></ui-file-uploader>

<script type="module">
  const uploader = document.getElementById('file-uploader-upload');

  // stand-in for your upload: 10% every 300 ms; a file named "…fail…" fails at 50%
  const timers = new Map();
  const sendFile = (file, onProgress) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let percent = 0;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      percent += 10;
      if (percent < 100 && !(file.name.includes('fail') && percent >= 50)) return onProgress(percent);
      clearInterval(timer);
      if (percent < 100) reject(new Error('Connection dropped'));
      else resolve();
    }, 300);
    timers.set(file, timer);
  });
  const cancelUpload = (item) => clearInterval(timers.get(item.file));

  const update = (uuid, changes) => {
    uploader.files = uploader.files.map((f) => (f.uuid === uuid ? { ...f, ...changes } : f));
  };

  async function upload(item) {
    update(item.uuid, { status: 'uploading', progress: 0, invalid: false });
    try {
      await sendFile(item.file, (percent) => update(item.uuid, { progress: percent }));
      update(item.uuid, { status: 'complete' });
    } catch {
      update(item.uuid, { status: 'edit', invalid: true, retryable: true, errorBody: 'Check your connection and try again.' });
    }
  }

  uploader.addEventListener('ui-change', (e) => {
    if (e.detail.action === 'add') e.detail.addedFiles.filter((f) => !f.invalid).forEach(upload);
  });
  uploader.addEventListener('ui-retry', (e) => upload(e.detail.retriedFile));
  uploader.addEventListener('ui-delete', (e) => cancelUpload(e.detail.deletedFile));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
import type { FileItem } from '@purpurabog/ui/file-uploader';

const [files, setFiles] = useState<FileItem[]>([]);
const update = (uuid: string, changes: Partial<FileItem>) =>
  setFiles((list) => list.map((f) => (f.uuid === uuid ? { ...f, ...changes } : f)));
// upload(item) as in the HTML tab, with this update

<UiFileUploader
  labelTitle="Attachments"
  multiple
  files={files}
  onUiChange={(e) => {
    setFiles(e.detail.currentFiles);
    if (e.detail.action === 'add') e.detail.addedFiles.filter((f) => !f.invalid).forEach(upload);
  }}
  onUiRetry={(e) => upload(e.detail.retriedFile)}
  onUiDelete={(e) => cancelUpload(e.detail.deletedFile)}
/>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { FileUploader, type FileItem } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/file-uploader';

const [files, setFiles] = useState<FileItem[]>([]);
const update = (uuid: string, changes: Partial<FileItem>) =>
  setFiles((list) => list.map((f) => (f.uuid === uuid ? { ...f, ...changes } : f)));
// upload(item) as in the HTML tab, with this update

<FileUploader
  labelTitle="Attachments"
  multiple
  files={files}
  onChange={(change) => {
    setFiles(change.currentFiles);
    if (change.action === 'add') change.addedFiles.filter((f) => !f.invalid).forEach(upload);
  }}
  onRetry={upload}
  onDelete={({ deletedFile }) => cancelUpload(deletedFile)}
/>
```

## Skeleton

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
|---|---|
| Enter or Space on the button or the drop zone | Opens the file dialog |
| Enter or Space on × | Removes the file, or cancels its upload; focus moves to the next file's ×, else the previous one's, else the button |
| Enter or Space on the retry button | Fires `ui-retry` |

## Accessibility

- The uploader is a group named by `label-title`, and the hidden file input is labelled by it too.
- The × and retry buttons are named with the file: "Remove file - contract.pdf", "Retry upload - contract.pdf".
- An error is an alert, read as soon as it appears. A finished upload is announced, since a spinner turning into a check mark is silent.
- The progress bar is a `progressbar` screen readers can query; the percentage isn't read on every change.

Unstyled React parts with the same behaviour: [Headless File uploader](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-file-uploader/).

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-file-uploader>` · React `UiFileUploader`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label-title` | `labelTitle` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `label-description` | `labelDescription` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `button-label` | `buttonLabel` | `string` | `''` | Button text; replaced by the file name / "N files" after a pick unless `keep-label`. |
| `button-kind` | `buttonKind` | `ButtonKind` | `'primary'` |  |
| `size` | `size` | `FileUploaderSize` | `'md'` | Button and item sizes. |
| `drop` | `drop` | `boolean` | `false` | Render the dashed drop zone instead of the button (Carbon `FileUploaderDropContainer`). |
| `drop-label` | `dropLabel` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `accept` | `accept` | `string` | `''` | Comma-separated extensions / MIME types, e.g. ".pdf,.jpg,image/png". |
| `multiple` | `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `max-file-size` | `maxFileSize` | `number` | `0` | Bytes; larger files are added as invalid. |
| `max-files` | `maxFiles` | `number` | `0` | Most valid files in the list; the ones past it are added as invalid (0 = no limit). |
| `max-total-size` | `maxTotalSize` | `number` | `0` | Bytes the valid files may add up to; a file that would go over is added as invalid (0 = no limit). |
| `show-size` | `showSize` | `boolean` | `false` | Show each file's size in its row ("1.2 MB", in the page language). |
| `name` | `name` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `status` | `status` | `FileStatus` | `'edit'` | Status new items start in (Carbon `filenameStatus`). |
| `icon-label` | `iconLabel` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `keep-label` | `keepLabel` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `required` | `required` | `boolean` | `false` | At least one valid file must be chosen before the form submits. |
| `required-text` | `requiredText` | `string` | `''` | Validation message for `required`; defaults to the translation. |
| `invalid-type-text` | `invalidTypeText` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `too-large-text` | `tooLargeText` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `too-many-text` | `tooManyText` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `total-too-large-text` | `totalTooLargeText` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `invalid-body-text` | `invalidBodyText` | `string` | `''` |  |

#### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `files` | `FileItem[]` | The current list; replace it (new array) to update statuses or errors. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `setCustomValidity(message)` | Like `<input>.setCustomValidity()`: a non-empty message makes the field invalid until cleared with ''. |
| `browse()` | Open the file dialog. |
| `addFiles(files)` | Add files as if the user picked them. |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-add` | `onUiAdd` | detail: { addedFiles } right after the user picks files (invalid ones included) |
| `ui-delete` | `onUiDelete` | detail: { deletedFile, remainingFiles } |
| `ui-change` | `onUiChange` | detail: { addedFiles, removedFiles, currentFiles, action } |
| `change` | none (use a ref) | Native-style, alongside `ui-change` |
| `ui-retry` | `onUiRetry` | detail: { retriedFile } when the user retries a failed upload |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Extra `<ui-file-uploader-item>`s (e.g. files already on the server) |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `title` | Label title |
| `description` | Label description |
| `trigger` | The button or drop zone |
| `items` | The file list |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-field-radius` |  | Corner radius of the drop zone (the field setting) |

### `<ui-file-uploader-item>` · React `UiFileUploaderItem`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `name` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `uuid` | `uuid` | `string` | `''` | Identifies the file in `ui-delete`; defaults to `name`. |
| `status` | `status` | `FileStatus` | `'edit'` |  |
| `invalid` | `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `error-subject` | `errorSubject` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `error-body` | `errorBody` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `size` | `size` | `FileUploaderSize` | `'md'` |  |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `icon-label` | `iconLabel` | `string` | `''` | Describes the state icon / remove button: "Remove file", "Uploading", "Uploaded" (Carbon `iconDescription`); with `progress`, the bar. |
| `progress` | `progress` | `number \| undefined` |  | Upload progress 0–100, shown while `status` is uploading (percentage, bar, cancel button) instead of the spinner. |
| `retryable` | `retryable` | `boolean` | `false` | On an invalid row: a retry button (`ui-retry`) for a failed upload. |
| `file-size` | `fileSize` | `number \| undefined` |  | Bytes; shows the size in the row ("1.2 MB"). |

#### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `removable` |  | (read-only) The row has a remove button (edit, or uploading with `progress`) and isn't disabled. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `requestDelete()` | Ask the owner to remove this file (fires `ui-delete`). |
| `requestRetry()` | Ask the owner to upload this file again (fires `ui-retry`). |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-delete` | `onUiDelete` | detail: { uuid, name } when the user removes the file |
| `ui-retry` | `onUiRetry` | detail: { uuid, name } when the user retries a failed upload |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `base` | The row |
| `name` | File name |
| `size` | The file size (`file-size`) |
| `percent` | The upload percentage (`progress`) |
| `progress` | The `<ui-progress-bar>` under the row (`progress`) |
| `retry-button` | The retry button (`retryable` invalid row) |
| `delete-button` | The × button (edit status, or uploading with `progress`) |
| `error` | The error block (invalid) |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-file-item-radius` |  | Corners of the row (default 0; Kanok: 6px); `--ui-file-item-edge` its box-shadow edge (default none; Kanok: a hairline) |
| `--ui-icon-control-radius` |  | Corners of its small icon buttons, their hover fill and ring (default 0; Kanok: round) |
| `--ui-focus-offset` |  | `outline-offset` of its focus ring (default -2px: inside; Kanok: 2px outside) |

# Modal

A modal asks for the user's full attention: it opens over the page, the page behind it can't be used, and focus stays inside until it closes. Use it for a short task or a decision. For a long form or a flow with steps, use a [Tearsheet](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/tearsheet/); for details beside the page, a [Side panel](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/side-panel/).


HTML:

```html
<ui-button id="modal-open">Open contract</ui-button>
<ui-modal id="modal-contract" heading="Contract details">
  <span slot="label">CT-2026-0142</span>
  <p style="margin: 0">Master services agreement with Siam Logistics Co., Ltd., effective 2 October 2026.</p>
  <ui-button slot="footer" kind="secondary">Cancel</ui-button>
  <ui-button slot="footer">Save</ui-button>
</ui-modal>

<script type="module">
  const modal = document.getElementById('modal-contract');
  document.getElementById('modal-open').addEventListener('click', () => modal.show());
  for (const button of modal.querySelectorAll('[slot="footer"]')) button.addEventListener('click', () => modal.close());
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<UiButton onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Open contract</UiButton>
<UiModal open={open} heading="Contract details" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  <span slot="label">CT-2026-0142</span>
  <p>Master services agreement with Siam Logistics Co., Ltd., effective 2 October 2026.</p>
  <UiButton slot="footer" kind="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</UiButton>
  <UiButton slot="footer" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Save</UiButton>
</UiModal>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Open contract</Button>
<Modal
  open={open}
  onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
  label="CT-2026-0142"
  heading="Contract details"
  footer={<>
    <Button kind="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Save</Button>
  </>}
>
  <p>Master services agreement with Siam Logistics Co., Ltd., effective 2 October 2026.</p>
</Modal>
```

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/modal
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-modal
```

Manual:

```bash
# Web component
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install lit@^3.3.0
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/modal.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/primitives/modal/modal.ts
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-modal, core-overlay, shared-element, shared-events, shared-field, shared-focus-ring, shared-localize, shared-quiet-focus, shared-slots, tokens

# React + Tailwind
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install @purpurabog/ui@^1.4.3
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tw-modal.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/react-tw/modal.tsx
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-modal, tw-i18n, tw-theme, tw-utils
```

npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Use it


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">import '@purpurabog/ui/modal';</script>

<ui-button onclick="document.getElementById('contract').show()">Open contract</ui-button>
<ui-modal id="contract" heading="Contract details">
  <p>Master services agreement with Siam Logistics Co., Ltd.</p>
</ui-modal>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiModal } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiModal open={open} heading="Contract details" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  <p>Master services agreement with Siam Logistics Co., Ltd.</p>
</UiModal>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { Modal } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/modal';

<Modal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} heading="Contract details">
  <p>Master services agreement with Siam Logistics Co., Ltd.</p>
</Modal>
```

It is built on the native `<dialog>`: the browser puts it in the top layer, makes the page behind it inert and keeps Tab inside. Open it with the `open` attribute, `show()` or `open = true`; close it with `close()` or `open = false`. `ui-close` fires after it has closed, however that happened. The page doesn't scroll while it is open.

React + Tailwind is controlled: `onClose(reason)` reports ×, Esc, an outside click or a `<form method="dialog">` inside; set `open` to false to close it, or leave it to keep it open.

## Passive modal

A modal with no footer buttons only shows information. It closes with ×, Esc or a click outside it.


HTML:

```html
<ui-button id="modal-passive-open" kind="tertiary">Stamp duty rates</ui-button>
<ui-modal id="modal-passive" heading="Stamp duty rates" size="sm">
  <span slot="label">Revenue Department</span>
  <p style="margin: 0">Lease contracts: 1 baht for every 1,000 baht of rent, or part of it, for the whole term.</p>
</ui-modal>

<script type="module">
  const modal = document.getElementById('modal-passive');
  document.getElementById('modal-passive-open').addEventListener('click', () => modal.show());
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiButton kind="tertiary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Stamp duty rates</UiButton>
<UiModal open={open} heading="Stamp duty rates" size="sm" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  <span slot="label">Revenue Department</span>
  <p>Lease contracts: 1 baht for every 1,000 baht of rent, or part of it, for the whole term.</p>
</UiModal>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Button kind="tertiary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Stamp duty rates</Button>
<Modal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} label="Revenue Department" heading="Stamp duty rates" size="sm">
  <p>Lease contracts: 1 baht for every 1,000 baht of rent, or part of it, for the whole term.</p>
</Modal>
```

## Sizes

`size`: `sm` 480px, `md` 672px (the default), `lg` 1056px. It is never wider than the screen minus 16px a side, and never taller than 768px.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
  <ui-button kind="tertiary" data-size="sm">Small</ui-button>
  <ui-button kind="tertiary" data-size="md">Medium</ui-button>
  <ui-button kind="tertiary" data-size="lg">Large</ui-button>
</div>
<ui-modal id="modal-size" heading="Approval history">
  <p style="margin: 0">Requested by Ananya P. on 2 October 2026, approved by the legal team on 3 October 2026.</p>
</ui-modal>

<script type="module">
  const modal = document.getElementById('modal-size');
  for (const button of document.querySelectorAll('[data-size]')) {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      modal.size = button.dataset.size;
      modal.show();
    });
  }
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiModal open={open} size="sm" heading="Approval history" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>…</UiModal>
<UiModal open={open} heading="Approval history" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>…</UiModal>
<UiModal open={open} size="lg" heading="Approval history" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>…</UiModal>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Modal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} size="sm" heading="Approval history">…</Modal>
<Modal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} heading="Approval history">…</Modal>
<Modal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} size="lg" heading="Approval history">…</Modal>
```

## Danger: confirm before you delete

`alert` is for a confirmation that interrupts, such as deleting something. The dialog gets `role="alertdialog"`, the body becomes its description, and focus starts on the safest footer button (the first one whose `kind` is neither primary nor a danger kind), so Enter doesn't delete by accident.


HTML:

```html
<ui-button id="modal-alert-open" kind="danger">Delete contract</ui-button>
<ui-modal id="modal-alert" alert heading="Delete this contract?" size="sm">
  This removes CT-2026-0142 and its signatures for good.
  <ui-button slot="footer" kind="secondary" data-answer="kept">Cancel</ui-button>
  <ui-button slot="footer" kind="danger" data-answer="deleted">Delete</ui-button>
</ui-modal>
<p>Result: <output id="modal-alert-out"></output></p>

<script type="module">
  const modal = document.getElementById('modal-alert');
  const out = document.getElementById('modal-alert-out');
  document.getElementById('modal-alert-open').addEventListener('click', () => modal.show());
  for (const button of modal.querySelectorAll('[data-answer]')) {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      out.value = button.dataset.answer;
      modal.close();
    });
  }
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiButton kind="danger" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Delete contract</UiButton>
<UiModal open={open} alert heading="Delete this contract?" size="sm" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  This removes CT-2026-0142 and its signatures for good.
  <UiButton slot="footer" kind="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</UiButton>
  <UiButton slot="footer" kind="danger" onClick={remove}>Delete</UiButton>
</UiModal>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Button kind="danger" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Delete contract</Button>
<Modal
  open={open}
  onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
  alert
  heading="Delete this contract?"
  size="sm"
  footer={<>
    <Button kind="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button kind="danger" onClick={remove}>Delete</Button>
  </>}
>
  This removes CT-2026-0142 and its signatures for good.
</Modal>
```

## A click outside

As in Carbon, a modal with footer buttons never closes on a click outside it, so nothing typed is lost. A passive modal does, unless it is `persistent`: then only ×, Esc or your own button close it.


HTML:

```html
<ui-button id="modal-persistent-open" kind="tertiary">Read the terms</ui-button>
<ui-modal id="modal-persistent" heading="Terms of use" persistent>
  <p style="margin: 0">A click outside doesn't close this modal. Use × or Esc.</p>
</ui-modal>

<script type="module">
  const modal = document.getElementById('modal-persistent');
  document.getElementById('modal-persistent-open').addEventListener('click', () => modal.show());
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiModal open={open} heading="Terms of use" persistent onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  <p>A click outside doesn't close this modal. Use × or Esc.</p>
</UiModal>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Modal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} heading="Terms of use" persistent>
  <p>A click outside doesn't close this modal. Use × or Esc.</p>
</Modal>
```

## A form in a modal

On open, focus goes to the first control in the body; with none, to the first footer button; else to ×. Put `autofocus` on another control to start there. The footer buttons sit outside your `<form>`, so the primary one calls `requestSubmit()`: the browser then checks the required fields first. Enter in a field submits too.


HTML:

```html
<ui-button id="modal-form-open">Add a signer</ui-button>
<ui-modal id="modal-form" heading="Add a signer">
  <span slot="label">CT-2026-0142</span>
  <form id="modal-form-fields" style="display: grid; gap: 16px">
    <ui-text-input label="Full name" name="name" required></ui-text-input>
    <ui-text-input label="Email" name="email" type="email" required></ui-text-input>
    <ui-select label="Role" name="role">
      <option value="signer">Signer</option>
      <option value="witness">Witness</option>
    </ui-select>
  </form>
  <ui-button slot="footer" kind="secondary" id="modal-form-cancel">Cancel</ui-button>
  <ui-button slot="footer" id="modal-form-add">Add signer</ui-button>
</ui-modal>
<p>Added: <output id="modal-form-out"></output></p>

<script type="module">
  const modal = document.getElementById('modal-form');
  const form = document.getElementById('modal-form-fields');
  document.getElementById('modal-form-open').addEventListener('click', () => {
    form.reset();
    modal.show();
  });
  document.getElementById('modal-form-cancel').addEventListener('click', () => modal.close());
  document.getElementById('modal-form-add').addEventListener('click', () => form.requestSubmit());
  form.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    document.getElementById('modal-form-out').value = [...new FormData(form)].map(([key, value]) => `${key}=${value}`).join(', ');
    modal.close();
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const form = useRef<HTMLFormElement>(null);

<UiModal open={open} heading="Add a signer" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  <span slot="label">CT-2026-0142</span>
  <form ref={form} onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); add(new FormData(e.currentTarget)); setOpen(false); }}>
    <UiTextInput label="Full name" name="name" required />
    <UiTextInput label="Email" name="email" type="email" required />
    <UiSelect label="Role" name="role">
      <option value="signer">Signer</option>
      <option value="witness">Witness</option>
    </UiSelect>
  </form>
  <UiButton slot="footer" kind="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</UiButton>
  <UiButton slot="footer" onClick={() => form.current?.requestSubmit()}>Add signer</UiButton>
</UiModal>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Modal
  open={open}
  onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
  label="CT-2026-0142"
  heading="Add a signer"
  footer={<>
    <Button kind="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button type="submit" form="signer-form">Add signer</Button>
  </>}
>
  <form id="signer-form" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); add(new FormData(e.currentTarget)); setOpen(false); }}>
    <TextInput label="Full name" name="name" required />
    <TextInput label="Email" name="email" type="email" required />
    <Select label="Role" name="role">
      <option value="signer">Signer</option>
      <option value="witness">Witness</option>
    </Select>
  </form>
</Modal>
```

In React + Tailwind the footer buttons are native `<button>`s, so `form="signer-form"` connects the submit button to the form.

## Ask before closing

×, Esc and a click outside first fire `ui-request-close`, cancelable, with the `reason`: `close-button`, `escape` or `backdrop`. Call `preventDefault()` to keep the modal open, for example while there are unsaved changes. Type a note below, then try to close the modal.


HTML:

```html
<ui-button id="modal-guard-open" kind="tertiary">Edit note</ui-button>
<ui-modal id="modal-guard" heading="Edit note">
  <ui-notification id="modal-guard-warning" kind="warning" low-contrast open="false" heading="Unsaved changes" subtitle="Close again to discard them."></ui-notification>
  <ui-text-area id="modal-guard-note" label="Note to the approver"></ui-text-area>
  <ui-button slot="footer" kind="secondary" id="modal-guard-cancel">Cancel</ui-button>
  <ui-button slot="footer" id="modal-guard-save">Save</ui-button>
</ui-modal>
<p>Closed by: <output id="modal-guard-out"></output></p>

<script type="module">
  const modal = document.getElementById('modal-guard');
  const note = document.getElementById('modal-guard-note');
  const warning = document.getElementById('modal-guard-warning');
  let warned = false;
  document.getElementById('modal-guard-open').addEventListener('click', () => {
    note.value = '';
    warned = false;
    warning.open = false;
    modal.show();
  });
  modal.addEventListener('ui-request-close', (event) => {
    if (event.target !== modal) return; // the notification inside asks too
    document.getElementById('modal-guard-out').value = event.detail.reason;
    if (note.value && !warned) {
      event.preventDefault();
      warned = true;
      warning.open = true;
    }
  });
  document.getElementById('modal-guard-cancel').addEventListener('click', () => modal.requestClose('close-button'));
  document.getElementById('modal-guard-save').addEventListener('click', () => modal.close());
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiModal
  open={open}
  heading="Edit note"
  onUiRequestClose={(e) => { if (dirty && !warned) { e.preventDefault(); setWarned(true); } }}
  onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}
>
  <UiNotification kind="warning" lowContrast open={warned} heading="Unsaved changes" subtitle="Close again to discard them." />
  <UiTextArea label="Note to the approver" />
  …
</UiModal>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
// onClose only reports: the modal stays open until you set open to false
<Modal
  open={open}
  onClose={() => { if (dirty && !warned) setWarned(true); else setOpen(false); }}
  heading="Edit note"
  footer={…}
>
  <Notification kind="warning" lowContrast open={warned} title="Unsaved changes" subtitle="Close again to discard them." />
  <TextArea label="Note to the approver" />
</Modal>
```

`ui-request-close` and `ui-close` bubble, and a notification inside the modal fires them too: check that `event.target` is the modal. React's `UiModal` does that for you: `onUiRequestClose` and `onUiClose` get only the modal's own events. `close()` and `open = false` close without asking; `requestClose(reason)` asks first, as × does. Give feedback inside a modal with an inline [Notification](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/notification/), as here: a [toast](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/toast/) would sit behind the inert page.

## Scrolling content

When the body is taller than the modal, only the body scrolls; the heading and the footer stay. The body then becomes a focusable region named by the heading, so keyboard users can scroll it.


HTML:

```html
<ui-button id="modal-scroll-open" kind="tertiary">Read the agreement</ui-button>
<ui-modal id="modal-scroll" heading="Data processing agreement">
  <span slot="label">Version 3, October 2026</span>
  <div id="modal-scroll-terms"></div>
  <ui-button slot="footer" kind="secondary">Decline</ui-button>
  <ui-button slot="footer">Accept</ui-button>
</ui-modal>

<script type="module">
  const modal = document.getElementById('modal-scroll');
  const terms = document.getElementById('modal-scroll-terms');
  for (let n = 1; n <= 12; n++) {
    const clause = document.createElement('p');
    clause.textContent = `Clause ${n}. The processor handles personal data only on the controller's written instructions and keeps it confidential.`;
    terms.append(clause);
  }
  document.getElementById('modal-scroll-open').addEventListener('click', () => modal.show());
  for (const button of modal.querySelectorAll('[slot="footer"]')) button.addEventListener('click', () => modal.close());
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiModal open={open} heading="Data processing agreement" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  <span slot="label">Version 3, October 2026</span>
  {clauses.map((text, n) => <p key={n}>{text}</p>)}
  <UiButton slot="footer" kind="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Decline</UiButton>
  <UiButton slot="footer" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Accept</UiButton>
</UiModal>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Modal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} label="Version 3, October 2026" heading="Data processing agreement" footer={…}>
  {clauses.map((text, n) => <p key={n}>{text}</p>)}
</Modal>
```

## Header actions

The `header-actions` slot puts controls at the top end of the header, beside ×. One 48px button fits. React + Tailwind takes them in `headerActions`.


HTML:

```html
<ui-button id="modal-actions-open" kind="tertiary">Open with an action</ui-button>
<ui-modal id="modal-actions" heading="Lease summary">
  <ui-icon-button slot="header-actions" label="Edit contract">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="m13.7 4.3-2-2a1 1 0 0 0-1.4 0L2 10.6V14h3.4l8.3-8.3a1 1 0 0 0 0-1.4ZM5 13H3v-2l6-6 2 2Zm7-7-2-2 1-1 2 2Z"/></svg>
  </ui-icon-button>
  <p style="margin: 0">Office lease, 3rd floor, 24 months from 1 November 2026, 45,000 baht a month.</p>
</ui-modal>

<script type="module">
  const modal = document.getElementById('modal-actions');
  document.getElementById('modal-actions-open').addEventListener('click', () => modal.show());
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
import { Edit as EditIcon } from '@carbon/icons-react';

<UiModal open={open} heading="Lease summary" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  <UiIconButton slot="header-actions" label="Edit contract"><EditIcon /></UiIconButton>
  <p>Office lease, 3rd floor, 24 months from 1 November 2026, 45,000 baht a month.</p>
</UiModal>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { Edit as EditIcon } from '@carbon/icons-react';

<Modal
  open={open}
  onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
  heading="Lease summary"
  headerActions={<IconButton label="Edit contract"><EditIcon /></IconButton>}
>
  <p>Office lease, 3rd floor, 24 months from 1 November 2026, 45,000 baht a month.</p>
</Modal>
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Moves through the controls inside the modal only |
| Esc | Asks to close (`escape`); focus goes back to what opened it |
| Enter, Space | Press the focused button |

## Accessibility

- The native modal `<dialog>` makes the rest of the page inert for the mouse, the keyboard and screen readers, and gives focus back to the control that opened it.
- The heading names the dialog. With no heading, the `label` slot names it; with neither, set `label` (React + Tailwind: `aria-label`).
- `alert` makes it an `alertdialog` described by its body; use it for confirmations only.
- The × button is named "Close" in the page language; `close-label` (`closeLabel`) changes it.

Unstyled React parts with the same behaviour: [Headless Modal](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-modal/).

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-modal>` · React `UiModal`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `open` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `heading` | `heading` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible name when there is no heading (Carbon `aria-label`); the `label` slot is used before it. |
| `size` | `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Dialog width (Carbon modal sizes): sm 480px, md 672px, lg 1056px — never wider than the viewport minus 16px a side. |
| `persistent` | `persistent` | `boolean` | `false` | A passive modal (no footer) ignores outside clicks too; one with footer buttons always does (Carbon). |
| `close-label` | `closeLabel` | `string` | `''` | Accessible name for the close button. |
| `alert` | `alert` | `boolean` | `false` | Interrupting confirmation: role="alertdialog", focus starts on the safest action. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `requestClose(reason)` | Ask to close — fires cancelable `ui-request-close` first. |
| `focus(options)` | Focus inside the open dialog (the least destructive control, as on open). |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-close` | `onUiClose` | After the modal has closed |
| `ui-request-close` | `onUiRequestClose` | Cancelable; detail: { reason }. preventDefault() keeps it open. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Body content |
| `label` | Small label above the heading (the row renders only when slotted) |
| `footer` | Action buttons (laid out full-bleed, Carbon style) |
| `header-actions` | Controls at the top end of the header, beside the close button (one 48px button fits) |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `dialog` | The native `<dialog>` panel |
| `header` | Header row |
| `header-actions` | Wrapper of the `header-actions` slot |
| `label` | The small label above the heading |
| `heading` | The heading |
| `close-button` | The × button |
| `body` | Scrollable body |
| `footer` | Footer holding the action buttons |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-modal-radius` |  | Corner radius (default 0; Kanok: 12px) |
| `--ui-modal-shadow` |  | `box-shadow` of the box (default none) |
| `--ui-modal-scrim` |  | The overlay behind the box (default `rgb(22 22 22 / 0.5)`) |
| `--ui-overlay-background` |  | The box's surface, shared by every floating surface (default layer 1) |
| `--ui-overlay-border` |  | The box's border, shared by modal, side panel and tearsheet (default none) |
| `--ui-modal-footer-gap` |  | Gap between footer buttons (default none: they touch) |
| `--ui-modal-footer-height` |  | Footer `min-height` (default 64px) |
| `--ui-modal-footer-padding` |  | Footer padding (default 0: full-bleed buttons) |
| `--ui-modal-footer-border` |  | Border above the footer (default none) |
| `--ui-modal-button-flex` |  | `flex` of each footer button (default `0 1 50%`: halves) |
| `--ui-modal-button-height` |  | Height of the footer buttons (default 64px) |
| `--ui-modal-button-align` |  | `align-items` of their content (default `flex-start`: text at the top) |
| `--ui-modal-button-padding-top` |  | Their top padding (default 14px) |
| `--ui-close-size` |  | Size of the × button (default 48px; Kanok: 32px) |
| `--ui-close-inset` |  | Margin that sets the × in from the corner (default 0; Kanok: 8px) |
| `--ui-icon-control-radius` |  | Corners of the ×, its hover fill and its ring (default 0; Kanok: round) |
| `--ui-focus-offset` |  | `outline-offset` of the ×'s focus ring (default -2px: inside; Kanok: 2px outside) |
| `--ui-modal-body-focus-radius` |  | Corners of the scrolling body's focus ring (default 0; Kanok: 6px) |




---

# Side panel

A side panel slides in from the edge of the screen, under the 48px UI shell header, to show details or a short form while the page stays in view. It is Carbon for IBM Products' `SidePanel`. For a task that needs the whole screen, use a [Tearsheet](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/tearsheet/); for a short decision, a [Modal](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/modal/).

The panel is `position: fixed`. The live examples below sit in a box that holds it, with `--ui-side-panel-top: 0px` because the box has no header above it.


HTML:

```html
<div style="transform: translateZ(0); position: relative; height: 420px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--ui-hairline); --ui-side-panel-top: 0px">
  <div style="padding: 16px"><ui-button id="side-panel-open">Edit incident</ui-button></div>
  <ui-side-panel id="side-panel-edit" heading="Incident INC-2041" size="sm" selector-initial-focus="#side-panel-edit-title">
    <span slot="subtitle">Reported by the finance team on 8 October 2026.</span>
    <div style="display: grid; gap: 16px; padding-block: 16px">
      <ui-text-input id="side-panel-edit-title" label="Title" value="Invoice export fails"></ui-text-input>
      <ui-select label="Priority" value="high">
        <option value="low">Low</option>
        <option value="high">High</option>
      </ui-select>
      <ui-text-area label="Notes"></ui-text-area>
    </div>
    <ui-button slot="actions" kind="secondary">Cancel</ui-button>
    <ui-button slot="actions">Save</ui-button>
  </ui-side-panel>
</div>

<script type="module">
  const panel = document.getElementById('side-panel-edit');
  document.getElementById('side-panel-open').addEventListener('click', () => (panel.open = true));
  for (const button of panel.querySelectorAll('[slot="actions"]')) button.addEventListener('click', () => (panel.open = false));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<UiButton onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Edit incident</UiButton>
<UiSidePanel open={open} heading="Incident INC-2041" size="sm" selectorInitialFocus="#incident-title" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  <span slot="subtitle">Reported by the finance team on 8 October 2026.</span>
  <UiTextInput id="incident-title" label="Title" value="Invoice export fails" />
  <UiSelect label="Priority" value="high">…</UiSelect>
  <UiTextArea label="Notes" />
  <UiButton slot="actions" kind="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</UiButton>
  <UiButton slot="actions" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Save</UiButton>
</UiSidePanel>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Edit incident</Button>
<SidePanel
  open={open}
  onRequestClose={() => setOpen(false)}
  heading="Incident INC-2041"
  subtitle="Reported by the finance team on 8 October 2026."
  size="sm"
  selectorInitialFocus="#incident-title"
  actions={[
    { label: 'Cancel', kind: 'secondary', onClick: () => setOpen(false) },
    { label: 'Save', onClick: () => setOpen(false) },
  ]}
>
  <TextInput id="incident-title" label="Title" defaultValue="Invoice export fails" />
  <Select label="Priority" defaultValue="high">…</Select>
  <TextArea label="Notes" />
</SidePanel>
```

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/side-panel
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-side-panel
```

Manual:

```bash
# Web component
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install lit@^3.3.0
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/side-panel.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/primitives/side-panel/side-panel.styles.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/side-panel/side-panel.ts
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-action-set, core-modal, core-motion, core-overlay, core-position, icon-button, layer, shared-action-set, shared-element, shared-events, shared-field, shared-localize, shared-quiet-focus, tokens

# React + Tailwind
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install @purpurabog/ui@^1.4.3
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tw-side-panel.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/react-tw/side-panel.tsx
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-action-set, core-motion, core-position, tw-action-set, tw-i18n, tw-icon-button, tw-layer, tw-refs, tw-theme, tw-utils
```

npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Use it


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">import '@purpurabog/ui/side-panel';</script>

<ui-button onclick="document.getElementById('incident').open = true">Edit incident</ui-button>
<ui-side-panel id="incident" heading="Incident INC-2041">
  <p>Invoice export fails.</p>
</ui-side-panel>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiSidePanel } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiSidePanel open={open} heading="Incident INC-2041" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  <p>Invoice export fails.</p>
</UiSidePanel>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { SidePanel } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/side-panel';

<SidePanel open={open} onRequestClose={() => setOpen(false)} heading="Incident INC-2041">
  <p>Invoice export fails.</p>
</SidePanel>
```

Set `open` to show it and back to false to hide it; it slides 320px in from its edge while fading in, and out the same way (150ms each, as Carbon), with no movement when the reader asks for reduced motion. `heading` is also the panel's accessible name. On open, focus goes to `selector-initial-focus` (a selector inside the panel), else to the first control. On close it goes back to what had it.

×, Esc and a click on the overlay ask to close first (see [Ask before closing](#ask-before-closing)); `ui-close` fires after the panel has slid out. React + Tailwind is controlled: `onRequestClose(reason)` reports them, and you set `open` to false.

## Sizes

`size`: `xs` 16rem, `sm` 20rem, `md` 30rem (the default), `lg` 40rem, `xl` 65rem, `2xl` 80rem. From medium screens up a panel is never wider than 75% of the screen, and never wider than its container.


HTML:

```html
<div style="transform: translateZ(0); position: relative; height: 360px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--ui-hairline); --ui-side-panel-top: 0px">
  <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; padding: 16px">
    <ui-button kind="tertiary" data-side-panel-size="xs">xs</ui-button>
    <ui-button kind="tertiary" data-side-panel-size="sm">sm</ui-button>
    <ui-button kind="tertiary" data-side-panel-size="md">md</ui-button>
    <ui-button kind="tertiary" data-side-panel-size="lg">lg</ui-button>
  </div>
  <ui-side-panel id="side-panel-size" heading="Vendor details">
    <p>Siam Logistics Co., Ltd. Tax ID 0105556000000.</p>
  </ui-side-panel>
</div>

<script type="module">
  const panel = document.getElementById('side-panel-size');
  for (const button of document.querySelectorAll('[data-side-panel-size]')) {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      panel.size = button.dataset.sidePanelSize;
      panel.heading = `Vendor details (${panel.size})`;
      panel.open = true;
    });
  }
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiSidePanel open={open} size="xs" heading="Vendor details" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>…</UiSidePanel>
<UiSidePanel open={open} size="lg" heading="Vendor details" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>…</UiSidePanel>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<SidePanel open={open} onRequestClose={() => setOpen(false)} size="xs" heading="Vendor details">…</SidePanel>
<SidePanel open={open} onRequestClose={() => setOpen(false)} size="lg" heading="Vendor details">…</SidePanel>
```

## From the left

`placement="left"` slides the panel in from the start edge instead of the end.


HTML:

```html
<div style="transform: translateZ(0); position: relative; height: 320px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--ui-hairline); --ui-side-panel-top: 0px">
  <div style="display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 16px"><ui-button id="side-panel-left-open" kind="tertiary">Filters</ui-button></div>
  <ui-side-panel id="side-panel-left" heading="Filters" placement="left" size="sm">

      <ui-checkbox>Open</ui-checkbox>
      <ui-checkbox>Waiting for approval</ui-checkbox>
      <ui-checkbox>Closed</ui-checkbox>
    </div>
  </ui-side-panel>
</div>

<script type="module">
  const panel = document.getElementById('side-panel-left');
  document.getElementById('side-panel-left-open').addEventListener('click', () => (panel.open = true));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiSidePanel open={open} heading="Filters" placement="left" size="sm" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  <UiCheckbox>Open</UiCheckbox>
  <UiCheckbox>Waiting for approval</UiCheckbox>
  <UiCheckbox>Closed</UiCheckbox>
</UiSidePanel>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<SidePanel open={open} onRequestClose={() => setOpen(false)} heading="Filters" placement="left" size="sm">
  <Checkbox label="Open" />

```

## Dim the page

`include-overlay` dims the page behind the panel and stops it scrolling. A click on the overlay asks to close (`overlay`), unless `prevent-close-on-click-outside` is set.


HTML:

```html
<div style="transform: translateZ(0); position: relative; height: 320px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--ui-hairline); --ui-side-panel-top: 0px">
  <div style="padding: 16px"><ui-button id="side-panel-overlay-open">Assign reviewer</ui-button></div>
  <ui-side-panel id="side-panel-overlay" heading="Assign reviewer" include-overlay size="sm">
    <div style="padding-block: 16px">
      <ui-radio-group label="Reviewer" name="reviewer" value="ananya">
        <ui-radio value="ananya">Ananya P.</ui-radio>
        <ui-radio value="boonmee">Boonmee S.</ui-radio>
      </ui-radio-group>
    </div>
    <ui-button slot="actions" kind="secondary">Cancel</ui-button>
    <ui-button slot="actions">Assign</ui-button>
  </ui-side-panel>
</div>

<script type="module">
  const panel = document.getElementById('side-panel-overlay');
  document.getElementById('side-panel-overlay-open').addEventListener('click', () => (panel.open = true));
  for (const button of panel.querySelectorAll('[slot="actions"]')) button.addEventListener('click', () => (panel.open = false));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiSidePanel open={open} heading="Assign reviewer" includeOverlay size="sm" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  <UiRadioGroup label="Reviewer" name="reviewer" value="ananya">…</UiRadioGroup>
  <UiButton slot="actions" kind="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</UiButton>
  <UiButton slot="actions" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Assign</UiButton>
</UiSidePanel>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<SidePanel
  open={open}
  onRequestClose={() => setOpen(false)}
  heading="Assign reviewer"
  includeOverlay
  size="sm"
  actions={[
    { label: 'Cancel', kind: 'secondary', onClick: () => setOpen(false) },
    { label: 'Assign', onClick: () => setOpen(false) },
  ]}
>
  <RadioGroup label="Reviewer" name="reviewer" defaultValue="ananya">…</RadioGroup>
</SidePanel>
```

## Push the page aside

`slide-in` makes room for the panel instead of covering the page: the element that `selector-page-content` points to gets a margin as wide as the panel. A slide-in panel doesn't take focus, keep Tab inside or close on Esc, so the page stays usable beside it.


HTML:

```html
<div style="transform: translateZ(0); position: relative; height: 300px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--ui-hairline); --ui-side-panel-top: 0px">
  <div id="side-panel-page" style="display: grid; gap: 16px; padding: 16px">
    <p style="margin: 0">Contract list: 24 contracts waiting for a signature.</p>
    <div><ui-button id="side-panel-push-open" kind="tertiary">Show summary</ui-button></div>
  </div>
  <ui-side-panel id="side-panel-push" heading="Summary" slide-in selector-page-content="#side-panel-page" size="xs">
    <p>8 sale, 12 lease, 4 service contracts.</p>
  </ui-side-panel>
</div>

<script type="module">
  const panel = document.getElementById('side-panel-push');
  document.getElementById('side-panel-push-open').addEventListener('click', () => (panel.open = !panel.open));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<main id="contracts">…</main>
<UiSidePanel open={open} heading="Summary" slideIn selectorPageContent="#contracts" size="xs" onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  <p>8 sale, 12 lease, 4 service contracts.</p>
</UiSidePanel>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<main id="contracts">…</main>
<SidePanel open={open} onRequestClose={() => setOpen(false)} heading="Summary" slideIn selectorPageContent="#contracts" size="xs">
  <p>8 sale, 12 lease, 4 service contracts.</p>
</SidePanel>
```

## Action buttons

Up to four `<ui-button slot="actions">` sit at the foot of the panel, laid out as Carbon's ActionSet for the panel's size: side by side, or one per row in an `xs` or `sm` panel and in an `md` panel with more than two. They are 64px tall; `condensed-actions` makes them 48px. React + Tailwind takes them as data in `actions`.


HTML:

```html
<div style="transform: translateZ(0); position: relative; height: 380px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--ui-hairline); --ui-side-panel-top: 0px">
  <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; padding: 16px">
    <ui-button id="side-panel-actions-open" kind="tertiary">Three actions</ui-button>
    <ui-button id="side-panel-actions-condensed" kind="tertiary">Condensed</ui-button>
  </div>
  <ui-side-panel id="side-panel-actions" heading="Approve request" size="lg">
    <p>Purchase request PR-2026-0318, 128,500 baht, from the IT department.</p>
    <ui-button slot="actions" kind="ghost">Cancel</ui-button>
    <ui-button slot="actions" kind="secondary">Return</ui-button>
    <ui-button slot="actions">Approve</ui-button>
  </ui-side-panel>
</div>

<script type="module">
  const panel = document.getElementById('side-panel-actions');
  const show = (condensed) => {
    panel.condensedActions = condensed;
    panel.open = true;
  };
  document.getElementById('side-panel-actions-open').addEventListener('click', () => show(false));
  document.getElementById('side-panel-actions-condensed').addEventListener('click', () => show(true));
  for (const button of panel.querySelectorAll('[slot="actions"]')) button.addEventListener('click', () => (panel.open = false));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiSidePanel open={open} heading="Approve request" size="lg" condensedActions onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  <p>Purchase request PR-2026-0318, 128,500 baht, from the IT department.</p>
  <UiButton slot="actions" kind="ghost" onClick={close}>Cancel</UiButton>
  <UiButton slot="actions" kind="secondary" onClick={sendBack}>Return</UiButton>
  <UiButton slot="actions" onClick={approve}>Approve</UiButton>
</UiSidePanel>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<SidePanel
  open={open}
  onRequestClose={() => setOpen(false)}
  heading="Approve request"
  size="lg"
  condensedActions
  actions={[
    { label: 'Cancel', kind: 'ghost', onClick: close },
    { label: 'Return', kind: 'secondary', onClick: sendBack },
    { label: 'Approve', onClick: approve },
  ]}
>
  <p>Purchase request PR-2026-0318, 128,500 baht, from the IT department.</p>
</SidePanel>
```

## Heading that shrinks on scroll

With a `label-text`, a subtitle or a toolbar, and enough content to scroll, the label and subtitle fade as the content scrolls and the heading shrinks into a compact bar (Carbon's default). `animate-title="false"` keeps the header still; reduced motion turns it off too. Scroll the panel below.

```html
    </div>
    <ui-button slot="actions" kind="secondary">Save draft</ui-button>
    <ui-button slot="actions">Submit</ui-button>
  </ui-side-panel>

<script type="module">
```

## Steps

A panel can hold a short flow. `current-step` above 0 shows a back button at the top; pressing it fires `ui-navigate-back` (React + Tailwind: `onNavigationBack`), and you change the step and the content. The content scrolls back to the top when the step changes.


HTML:

```html
<div style="transform: translateZ(0); position: relative; height: 360px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--ui-hairline); --ui-side-panel-top: 0px">
  <div style="padding: 16px"><ui-button id="side-panel-steps-open">New request</ui-button></div>
  <ui-side-panel id="side-panel-steps" heading="Choose a template" size="sm">
    <div id="side-panel-step-0" style="padding-block: 16px">
      <ui-radio-group label="Template" name="template" value="purchase">
        <ui-radio value="purchase">Purchase request</ui-radio>
        <ui-radio value="travel">Travel request</ui-radio>
      </ui-radio-group>
    </div>
    <div id="side-panel-step-1" hidden style="padding-block: 16px">
      <ui-text-input label="Amount" suffix-text="THB"></ui-text-input>
    </div>
    <ui-button slot="actions" id="side-panel-steps-next">Next</ui-button>
  </ui-side-panel>
</div>

<script type="module">
  const panel = document.getElementById('side-panel-steps');
  const next = document.getElementById('side-panel-steps-next');
  const step = (n) => {
    panel.currentStep = n;
    panel.heading = n ? 'Request details' : 'Choose a template';
    document.getElementById('side-panel-step-0').hidden = n !== 0;
    document.getElementById('side-panel-step-1').hidden = n !== 1;
    next.textContent = n ? 'Send' : 'Next';
  };
  document.getElementById('side-panel-steps-open').addEventListener('click', () => {
    step(0);
    panel.open = true;
  });
  next.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (panel.currentStep === 0) step(1);
    else panel.open = false;
  });
  panel.addEventListener('ui-navigate-back', () => step(panel.currentStep - 1));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [step, setStep] = useState(0);

<UiSidePanel open={open} heading={step ? 'Request details' : 'Choose a template'} currentStep={step} onUiNavigateBack={() => setStep(step - 1)} onUiClose={() => setOpen(false)}>
  {step === 0 ? <TemplateStep /> : <DetailsStep />}
  <UiButton slot="actions" onClick={() => (step === 0 ? setStep(1) : send())}>{step ? 'Send' : 'Next'}</UiButton>
</UiSidePanel>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [step, setStep] = useState(0);

<SidePanel
  open={open}
  onRequestClose={() => setOpen(false)}
  heading={step ? 'Request details' : 'Choose a template'}
  currentStep={step}
  onNavigationBack={() => setStep(step - 1)}
  actions={[{ label: step ? 'Send' : 'Next', onClick: () => (step === 0 ? setStep(1) : send()) }]}
>
  {step === 0 ? <TemplateStep /> : <DetailsStep />}
</SidePanel>
```

The back button is named "Back" in the page language; `navigation-back-icon-description` changes it.

## Content above and below the title

`slot="above-title"` goes above the label and heading, `slot="below-title"` under the subtitle: a status tag, a search field. React + Tailwind has neither: put the content at the start of the panel's children.

```html
</div>

<script type="module">
  const panel = document.getElementById('side-panel-slots');
  document.getElementById('side-panel-slots-open').addEventListener('click', () => (panel.open = true));

```

React:
