## Tooltip, toggletip, definition tooltip or popover?

| Component | Use it when |
|---|---|
| [Tooltip](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/tooltip/) | A short plain-text hint or the name of an icon. It opens on hover and focus and holds nothing to click. |
| [Toggletip](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/toggletip/) | The explanation has a link or a button, or should stay open until the user closes it. It opens on a click. |
| [Definition tooltip](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/definition-tooltip/) | A word in running text needs a definition. The word gets a dotted underline. |
| [Popover](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/popover/) | Your own content (filters, a small form) beside a trigger. |

## Placement

The bubble opens above the trigger (`placement="top"`). `bottom`, `left` and `right` move it. When there is no room, it flips to the other side. `align` is Carbon's name for the same attribute.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
  <ui-tooltip text="Opens above" placement="top"><ui-button kind="tertiary" size="sm">Top</ui-button></ui-tooltip>
  <ui-tooltip text="Opens below" placement="bottom"><ui-button kind="tertiary" size="sm">Bottom</ui-button></ui-tooltip>
  <ui-tooltip text="Opens on the left" placement="left"><ui-button kind="tertiary" size="sm">Left</ui-button></ui-tooltip>
  <ui-tooltip text="Opens on the right" placement="right"><ui-button kind="tertiary" size="sm">Right</ui-button></ui-tooltip>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiTooltip text="Opens above" placement="top"><UiButton kind="tertiary" size="sm">Top</UiButton></UiTooltip>
<UiTooltip text="Opens below" placement="bottom"><UiButton kind="tertiary" size="sm">Bottom</UiButton></UiTooltip>
<UiTooltip text="Opens on the left" placement="left"><UiButton kind="tertiary" size="sm">Left</UiButton></UiTooltip>
<UiTooltip text="Opens on the right" placement="right"><UiButton kind="tertiary" size="sm">Right</UiButton></UiTooltip>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Tooltip text="Opens above" placement="top"><Button kind="tertiary" size="sm">Top</Button></Tooltip>
<Tooltip text="Opens below" placement="bottom"><Button kind="tertiary" size="sm">Bottom</Button></Tooltip>
<Tooltip text="Opens on the left" placement="left"><Button kind="tertiary" size="sm">Left</Button></Tooltip>
<Tooltip text="Opens on the right" placement="right"><Button kind="tertiary" size="sm">Right</Button></Tooltip>
```

## Start and end

Add `-start` or `-end` to line the bubble up with one edge of the trigger instead of its centre, for a trigger near the edge of the screen or a table. The caret still points at the trigger. In right-to-left pages, start and end swap sides.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
  <ui-tooltip text="Lined up with the start edge of the button" placement="bottom-start"><ui-button kind="tertiary" size="sm">Bottom start</ui-button></ui-tooltip>
  <ui-tooltip text="Lined up with the end edge of the button" placement="bottom-end"><ui-button kind="tertiary" size="sm">Bottom end</ui-button></ui-tooltip>
  <ui-tooltip text="Lined up with the start edge, above" placement="top-start"><ui-button kind="tertiary" size="sm">Top start</ui-button></ui-tooltip>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiTooltip text="Lined up with the start edge of the button" placement="bottom-start">…</UiTooltip>
<UiTooltip text="Lined up with the end edge of the button" placement="bottom-end">…</UiTooltip>
<UiTooltip text="Lined up with the start edge, above" placement="top-start">…</UiTooltip>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Tooltip text="Lined up with the start edge of the button" placement="bottom-start">…</Tooltip>
<Tooltip text="Lined up with the end edge of the button" placement="bottom-end">…</Tooltip>
<Tooltip text="Lined up with the start edge, above" placement="top-start">…</Tooltip>
```

## Name an icon-only button

A button with only an icon has no visible name. `as-label` (`asLabel` in React) makes the text the button's accessible name, and gives the bubble Carbon's icon-tooltip look: smaller padding and caret, 8px from the button. [`<ui-icon-button>`](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/button/#icon-only-buttons) does this for you with its `label`.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center">
  <ui-tooltip text="Edit contract" as-label>
    <ui-button kind="ghost" icon-only>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="m13.7 4.3-2-2a1 1 0 0 0-1.4 0L2 10.6V14h3.4l8.3-8.3a1 1 0 0 0 0-1.4ZM5 13H3v-2l6-6 2 2Zm7-7-2-2 1-1 2 2Z"/></svg>
    </ui-button>
  </ui-tooltip>
  <ui-tooltip text="Duplicate contract" as-label>
    <ui-button kind="ghost" icon-only>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M14 5v9H5V5h9m0-1H5a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v9a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h9a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V5a1 1 0 0 0-1-1Z"/><path d="M2 9H1V2a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h7v1H2Z"/></svg>
    </ui-button>
  </ui-tooltip>
  <ui-tooltip text="Delete contract" as-label>
    <ui-button kind="ghost" icon-only>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M6 6h1v6H6zm3 0h1v6H9z"/><path d="M2 3v1h1v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h8a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V4h1V3Zm2 11V4h8v10ZM6 1h4v1H6z"/></svg>
    </ui-button>
  </ui-tooltip>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
import { Copy as CopyIcon, Edit as EditIcon, TrashCan as TrashCanIcon } from '@carbon/icons-react';

<UiTooltip text="Edit contract" asLabel>

```

React + Tailwind:


## Small

`small` gives the same compact look as `as-label`, but the text stays a description. Use it for a short hint on a control that already has a visible name.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
  <ui-tooltip text="Ctrl+S" small>
    <ui-button kind="secondary" size="sm">Save draft</ui-button>
  </ui-tooltip>
  <ui-tooltip text="Jumps to the table below" small placement="bottom">
    <a href="#keyboard">Keyboard</a>
  </ui-tooltip>
</div>
```

```tsx
<UiTooltip text="Ctrl+S" small>
  <UiButton kind="secondary" size="sm">Save draft</UiButton>
</UiTooltip>

  <a href="#keyboard">Keyboard</a>
</UiTooltip>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx

  <Button kind="secondary" size="sm">Save draft</Button>
</Tooltip>

  <a href="#keyboard">Keyboard</a>
</Tooltip>
```

## Any focusable trigger

The trigger can be any element that takes focus: our buttons, a native `<button>`, a link. Wrap exactly one. The text joins the trigger's own descriptions (`aria-describedby`) and replaces none. A plain `<span>` or icon never gets keyboard focus, so keyboard users would never see its tooltip: wrap a button instead.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
  <ui-tooltip text="Last changed 12 March 2026 by Somchai">
    <button type="button">Version 3</button>
  </ui-tooltip>
  <ui-tooltip text="Contract CN-2026-0142, lease of the Silom office" placement="bottom">
    <a href="#any-focusable-trigger">CN-2026-0142</a>
  </ui-tooltip>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiTooltip text="Last changed 12 March 2026 by Somchai">
  <button type="button">Version 3</button>
</UiTooltip>
<UiTooltip text="Contract CN-2026-0142, lease of the Silom office" placement="bottom">
  <a href="/contracts/0142">CN-2026-0142</a>
</UiTooltip>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Tooltip text="Last changed 12 March 2026 by Somchai">
  <button type="button">Version 3</button>
</Tooltip>
<Tooltip text="Contract CN-2026-0142, lease of the Silom office" placement="bottom">
  <a href="/contracts/0142">CN-2026-0142</a>
</Tooltip>
```

## Explain a disabled action

A `disabled` button can't take focus, so its tooltip never shows to keyboard users. Use `disabled-focusable` on the button instead: it looks and acts disabled but stays in the Tab order, and the tooltip says why.


HTML:

```html
<ui-tooltip text="Only approvers can sign. Ask Ananya in Legal." placement="right">
  <ui-button disabled-focusable>Sign contract</ui-button>
</ui-tooltip>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiTooltip text="Only approvers can sign. Ask Ananya in Legal." placement="right">
  <UiButton disabledFocusable>Sign contract</UiButton>
</UiTooltip>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Tooltip text="Only approvers can sign. Ask Ananya in Legal." placement="right">
  <Button disabledFocusable>Sign contract</Button>
</Tooltip>
```

## Longer text

The bubble grows to fit its text up to 288px wide, then wraps. Keep it to a sentence or two: nobody can scroll a tooltip, and it disappears when the pointer moves away. Longer help belongs in a [toggletip](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/toggletip/) or on the page.


HTML:

```html
<ui-tooltip text="The retention period starts on the day the last party signs. After 10 years the signed copy moves to the archive, where only Legal can open it." placement="bottom">
  <ui-button kind="tertiary">How retention works</ui-button>
</ui-tooltip>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiTooltip text="The retention period starts on the day the last party signs. After 10 years the signed copy moves to the archive, where only Legal can open it." placement="bottom">
  <UiButton kind="tertiary">How retention works</UiButton>
</UiTooltip>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Tooltip text="The retention period starts on the day the last party signs. After 10 years the signed copy moves to the archive, where only Legal can open it." placement="bottom">
  <Button kind="tertiary">How retention works</Button>
</Tooltip>
```

## Inside a box that clips

The bubble opens in the browser's top layer, so a parent with `overflow: hidden` or a small height can't cut it off. Hover the button in the short box below.


HTML:

```html
<div style="overflow: hidden; height: 56px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--ui-hairline)">
  <ui-tooltip text="This box hides its overflow, and the tooltip still shows in full" placement="bottom">
    <ui-button kind="tertiary" size="sm">Contract status</ui-button>
  </ui-tooltip>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<div style={{ overflow: 'hidden', height: 56 }}>
  <UiTooltip text="This box hides its overflow, and the tooltip still shows in full" placement="bottom">
    <UiButton kind="tertiary" size="sm">Contract status</UiButton>
  </UiTooltip>
</div>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<div className="h-14 overflow-hidden">
  <Tooltip text="This box hides its overflow, and the tooltip still shows in full" placement="bottom">
    <Button kind="tertiary" size="sm">Contract status</Button>
  </Tooltip>
</div>
```

## Keep it open: "Copied"

`open` shows the bubble. Together with `pinned`, it stays open whatever the pointer, focus, clicks and Esc do, until you clear `open`. Use it for a short confirmation, as Carbon's copy button does. Click the contract number below.


HTML:

```html
<ui-tooltip id="tooltip-copy" text="Copy contract number" small>
  <ui-button id="tooltip-copy-button" kind="ghost">CN-2026-0142</ui-button>
</ui-tooltip>

<script type="module">
  const tip = document.getElementById('tooltip-copy');
  const button = document.getElementById('tooltip-copy-button');
  let timer;
  button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    await navigator.clipboard?.writeText('CN-2026-0142').catch(() => {});
    tip.text = 'Copied';
    tip.pinned = true;
    tip.open = true;
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      tip.pinned = false;
      tip.open = false;
      tip.text = 'Copy contract number';
    }, 2000);
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
const copy = async () => {
  await navigator.clipboard.writeText('CN-2026-0142');
  setCopied(true);
  setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
};

<UiTooltip text={copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy contract number'} small open={copied} pinned={copied}>
  <UiButton kind="ghost" onClick={copy}>CN-2026-0142</UiButton>
</UiTooltip>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
// open only while copied: left undefined, hover and focus decide
<Tooltip text={copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy contract number'} small open={copied ? true : undefined}>
  <Button kind="ghost" onClick={copy}>CN-2026-0142</Button>
</Tooltip>
```

`copy` and `copied` are the same in both React versions. React + Tailwind has no `pinned`: while `open` is set, hover and focus only report through `onOpenChange`.

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
|---|---|
| Tab | Focus reaching the trigger opens the tooltip; focus leaving closes it |
| Esc | Closes the tooltip only. Focus stays on the trigger, and a surrounding modal stays open |
| Enter, Space | Activate the trigger and close the tooltip, so it doesn't cover the result |

A mouse click focuses the trigger without opening the tooltip a second time: the hover already showed it.

## Accessibility

- The bubble has `role="tooltip"`. Its text is the trigger's accessible description, or with `as-label` its accessible name. Screen readers read it without the bubble showing.
- It follows WCAG 1.4.13: the pointer can move onto the bubble without closing it, and Esc dismisses it.
- Never put links, buttons or anything else to click in a tooltip. Nobody can reach them. Use a [toggletip](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/toggletip/) or a [popover](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/popover/).
- The text must not be the only place for information a user needs to finish a task. Touch screens have no hover.

Unstyled React parts with the same behaviour: [Headless Tooltip](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-tooltip/).

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-tooltip>` · React `UiTooltip`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `align` |  |  |  | Carbon's name for `placement` (same values) |
| `text` | `text` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `placement` | `placement` | `TooltipPlacement` | `'top'` |  |
| `as-label` | `asLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Use the text as the trigger's accessible name instead of its description. |
| `small` | `small` | `boolean` | `false` | The icon tooltip's look (as `as-label`: 8px off, 2px / 16px padding, 8×4 caret) without naming the trigger. |
| `open` | `open` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the bubble is showing. Hover / focus manage it; set it yourself together with `pinned`. |
| `pinned` | `pinned` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep the bubble open regardless of hover, focus, clicks and Escape — for a confirmation such as "Copied!" (Carbon copy button). While pinned, only `open` closes it. |

#### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `anchor` | `HTMLElement \| null` | The element the bubble points at, listens to and names / describes, instead of the slotted trigger — for a focusable host that renders its tooltip in its own shadow root (an icon-only content switcher item). |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `focus(options)` | Focus the slotted trigger (delegatesFocus does not reach slotted light DOM). |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The trigger (one focusable element, e.g. `<ui-button>`) |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `bubble` | The tooltip bubble |
| `caret` | The arrow pointing at the trigger |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-tooltip-radius` |  | Corner radius of the bubble (default `--ui-radius-xs`) |

# Definition tooltip

A definition tooltip explains a word in running text. The word gets a dotted underline; a click, Enter or Space shows its definition in a dark bubble below it. Use it for terms readers may not know, such as legal or internal words.


HTML:

```html
<p style="margin: 0; max-width: 560px">
  Choose <ui-definition-tooltip definition="A signing round in which every signer receives the document at the same time.">parallel signing</ui-definition-tooltip> when the order of signers does not matter.
</p>
```

React:

```tsx
<p>
  Choose <UiDefinitionTooltip definition="A signing round in which every signer receives the document at the same time.">parallel signing</UiDefinitionTooltip> when the order of signers does not matter.
</p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<p>
  Choose <DefinitionTooltip definition="A signing round in which every signer receives the document at the same time.">parallel signing</DefinitionTooltip> when the order of signers does not matter.
</p>
```

npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/definition-tooltip
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-definition-tooltip
```

Manual:

```bash
# Web component
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install lit@^3.3.0
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/definition-tooltip.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/primitives/definition-tooltip/definition-tooltip.ts
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-popup, shared-align, shared-element, shared-events, shared-field, shared-position, tokens

# React + Tailwind
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install @purpurabog/ui@^1.4.3
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tw-definition-tooltip.json
#    to its target:

# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-position, tw-floating, tw-theme, tw-utils
```

npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Use it

Put the term inside the element and the explanation in `definition`.


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">import '@purpurabog/ui/definition-tooltip';</script>

<p>
  The <ui-definition-tooltip definition="The last day the contract is valid.">expiry date</ui-definition-tooltip> is set by the owner.
</p>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiDefinitionTooltip } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<p>
  The <UiDefinitionTooltip definition="The last day the contract is valid.">expiry date</UiDefinitionTooltip> is set by the owner.
</p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { DefinitionTooltip } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/definition-tooltip';

<p>
  The <DefinitionTooltip definition="The last day the contract is valid.">expiry date</DefinitionTooltip> is set by the owner.
</p>
```

A [tooltip](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/tooltip/) explains a control; a definition tooltip explains a word. When the explanation needs a link, use a [toggletip](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/toggletip/).

## Open on hover

By default only a click, Enter, Space or keyboard focus opens the definition. `open-on-hover` (`openOnHover` in React) opens it when the pointer rests on the word too, as Carbon's `openOnHover`. However it opened, it closes 100ms after the pointer leaves the word and the bubble, so the pointer can move onto the bubble.


HTML:

```html
<p style="margin: 0; max-width: 560px">
  Every contract above 5 million baht needs a <ui-definition-tooltip open-on-hover definition="A second approver from Finance, on top of the department head.">dual approval</ui-definition-tooltip> before it is sent.
</p>
```

React:

```tsx
<p>
  Every contract above 5 million baht needs a <UiDefinitionTooltip openOnHover definition="A second approver from Finance, on top of the department head.">dual approval</UiDefinitionTooltip> before it is sent.
</p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<p>
  Every contract above 5 million baht needs a <DefinitionTooltip openOnHover definition="A second approver from Finance, on top of the department head.">dual approval</DefinitionTooltip> before it is sent.
</p>
```

## Placement

The definition opens below the word (`placement="bottom"`). `top`, `left` and `right` move it, and `-start` / `-end` line it up with one edge of the word. It flips when there is no room. `align` is Carbon's name for the same attribute.


HTML:

```html
<p style="margin: 0; max-width: 560px">
  A <ui-definition-tooltip placement="top" definition="The person who keeps the signed copy.">custodian</ui-definition-tooltip> and a
  <ui-definition-tooltip placement="bottom-start" definition="The person who checks the terms before signing.">reviewer</ui-definition-tooltip> are named on every
  <ui-definition-tooltip placement="right" definition="A contract with more than two parties.">multi-party contract</ui-definition-tooltip>.
</p>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiDefinitionTooltip placement="top" definition="The person who keeps the signed copy.">custodian</UiDefinitionTooltip>
<UiDefinitionTooltip placement="bottom-start" definition="The person who checks the terms before signing.">reviewer</UiDefinitionTooltip>
<UiDefinitionTooltip placement="right" definition="A contract with more than two parties.">multi-party contract</UiDefinitionTooltip>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<DefinitionTooltip placement="top" definition="The person who keeps the signed copy.">custodian</DefinitionTooltip>
<DefinitionTooltip placement="bottom-start" definition="The person who checks the terms before signing.">reviewer</DefinitionTooltip>
<DefinitionTooltip placement="right" definition="A contract with more than two parties.">multi-party contract</DefinitionTooltip>
```

## Rich definition

For bold text or a line break, put the definition in the `definition` slot instead of the attribute. In React + Tailwind, `definition` takes any React node. Keep it short and with nothing to click: the bubble closes when focus leaves the word.


HTML:

```html
<p style="margin: 0; max-width: 560px">
  The <ui-definition-tooltip>POA<span slot="definition"><strong>Power of attorney</strong>: who may sign on behalf of the company.</span></ui-definition-tooltip> list comes from HR.
</p>
```

React:

```tsx
<p>
  The <UiDefinitionTooltip>POA<span slot="definition"><strong>Power of attorney</strong>: who may sign on behalf of the company.</span></UiDefinitionTooltip> list comes from HR.
</p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<p>
  The <DefinitionTooltip definition={<><strong>Power of attorney</strong>: who may sign on behalf of the company.</>}>POA</DefinitionTooltip> list comes from HR.
</p>
```

## In a table header

A column header with an abbreviation is a common place for a definition. The bubble opens in the top layer, so the table's own overflow can't clip it.


HTML:

```html
<table style="border-collapse: collapse; font: var(--ui-font-body-sm)">
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th style="padding: 8px 16px; text-align: start">Contract</th>
      <th style="padding: 8px 16px; text-align: start"><ui-definition-tooltip definition="Service level agreement: the response time promised to the customer.">SLA</ui-definition-tooltip></th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
    <tr><td style="padding: 8px 16px">Maintenance, Silom office</td><td style="padding: 8px 16px">4 hours</td></tr>
    <tr><td style="padding: 8px 16px">Cleaning, Asok branch</td><td style="padding: 8px 16px">1 day</td></tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
```

React:

```tsx
<th>
  <UiDefinitionTooltip definition="Service level agreement: the response time promised to the customer.">SLA</UiDefinitionTooltip>
</th>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<th>
  <DefinitionTooltip definition="Service level agreement: the response time promised to the customer.">SLA</DefinitionTooltip>
</th>
```

## Longer definitions

The bubble is at most 176px wide, so a longer definition wraps over several lines. Two short sentences is about the limit; beyond that, link to a glossary instead.


HTML:

```html
<p style="margin: 0; max-width: 560px">
  Send the draft to the <ui-definition-tooltip definition="The team that checks every clause against company policy and current Thai law before a contract goes out. They reply within two working days.">legal review queue</ui-definition-tooltip> before Friday.
</p>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiDefinitionTooltip definition="The team that checks every clause against company policy and current Thai law before a contract goes out. They reply within two working days.">legal review queue</UiDefinitionTooltip>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<DefinitionTooltip definition="The team that checks every clause against company policy and current Thai law before a contract goes out. They reply within two working days.">legal review queue</DefinitionTooltip>
```

## Open state and events

`open` is the state, and you can set it yourself. `ui-toggle` fires after the definition opens or closes, with `detail.open`. Use it, for example, to count which terms people look up. Open the term below a few times.


HTML:

```html
<p style="margin: 0; max-width: 560px">
  A <ui-definition-tooltip id="definition-tooltip-escrow" definition="Money held by a third party until both sides meet the terms.">escrow account</ui-definition-tooltip> protects the deposit.
</p>
<p style="margin: 0">Opened <output id="definition-tooltip-escrow-out">0</output> times</p>

<script type="module">
  const term = document.getElementById('definition-tooltip-escrow');
  const out = document.getElementById('definition-tooltip-escrow-out');
  let count = 0;
  term.addEventListener('ui-toggle', (event) => {
    if (event.detail.open) out.value = String(++count);
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [count, setCount] = useState(0);

<UiDefinitionTooltip definition="Money held by a third party until both sides meet the terms." onUiToggle={(e) => e.detail.open && setCount((n) => n + 1)}>
  escrow account
</UiDefinitionTooltip>
<p>Opened <output>{count}</output> times</p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [count, setCount] = useState(0);

<DefinitionTooltip definition="Money held by a third party until both sides meet the terms." onOpenChange={(open) => open && setCount((n) => n + 1)}>
  escrow account
</DefinitionTooltip>
<p>Opened <output>{count}</output> times</p>
```

React + Tailwind also takes `open` (controlled) and `defaultOpen`.

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
|---|---|
| Tab | Focus reaching the word opens the definition; focus leaving closes it |
| Enter, Space | Open or close the definition |
| Esc | Closes the definition only; a surrounding modal stays open |

The word is a real `<button>` with `tabindex="0"`, so Tab reaches it in every browser, Safari included.

## Accessibility

- The word is a button with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. The bubble has `role="tooltip"`.
- The definition is also the word's accessible description, so screen readers read it on focus without opening the bubble.
- The underline is dotted and turns blue on hover and focus, so it doesn't look like a link. Don't use it on words that go somewhere: use a link.

Unstyled React parts with the same behaviour: [Headless Definition tooltip](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-definition-tooltip/).

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-definition-tooltip>` · React `UiDefinitionTooltip`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `align` |  |  |  | Carbon's name for `placement` (same values) |
| `definition` | `definition` | `string` | `''` | The explanation (plain text); use the `definition` slot for markup. |
| `placement` | `placement` | `Placement` | `'bottom'` |  |
| `open` | `open` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `open-on-hover` | `openOnHover` | `boolean` | `false` | Also open on pointer hover (Carbon `openOnHover`). |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-toggle` | `onUiToggle` | detail: { open } |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The term (inline text) |
| `definition` | Rich definition (overrides the `definition` attribute) |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `trigger` | The term button |
| `bubble` | The popover |
| `caret` | The arrow |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-tooltip-radius` |  | Corner radius of the bubble (default `--ui-radius-xs`; the tooltip setting) |




---

# Popover

A popover is a floating box with your own content beside a trigger: a few filters, a short form, settings for a table. It is Carbon's `Popover`, the box behind tooltips, toggletips and menus. You decide when it opens; `auto-close` lets Esc and a click outside close it.


HTML:

```html
<ui-popover id="popover-filters" label="Filter requests" auto-close>
  <ui-button slot="trigger" kind="tertiary">Filters</ui-button>
  <div style="display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; width: 240px">
    <strong>Filter requests</strong>
    <ui-checkbox checked>Mine</ui-checkbox>
    <ui-checkbox>Awaiting signature</ui-checkbox>
    <ui-checkbox>Archived</ui-checkbox>
  </div>
</ui-popover>

<script type="module">
  const popover = document.getElementById('popover-filters');
  popover.querySelector('[slot="trigger"]').addEventListener('click', () => (popover.open = !popover.open));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<UiPopover label="Filter requests" autoClose open={open} onUiToggle={(e) => setOpen(e.detail.open)}>
  <UiButton slot="trigger" kind="tertiary" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>Filters</UiButton>
  <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 8, padding: 16, width: 240 }}>
    <strong>Filter requests</strong>
    <UiCheckbox checked>Mine</UiCheckbox>
    <UiCheckbox>Awaiting signature</UiCheckbox>
    <UiCheckbox>Archived</UiCheckbox>
  </div>
</UiPopover>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<Popover label="Filter requests" autoClose open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} trigger={<Button kind="tertiary" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>Filters</Button>}>
  <div className="grid w-60 gap-2 p-4">
    <strong>Filter requests</strong>
    <Checkbox label="Mine" defaultChecked />
    <Checkbox label="Awaiting signature" />
    <Checkbox label="Archived" />
  </div>
</Popover>
```




The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Use it

Put the trigger in the `trigger` slot and the content inside. The popover doesn't open by itself: toggle `open` when the trigger is clicked.


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">import '@purpurabog/ui/popover';</script>

<ui-popover id="filters" label="Filter requests" auto-close>
  <ui-button slot="trigger" kind="tertiary">Filters</ui-button>
  <div style="padding: 16px">…</div>
</ui-popover>

<script type="module">
  const popover = document.getElementById('filters');
  popover.querySelector('[slot="trigger"]').addEventListener('click', () => (popover.open = !popover.open));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiPopover, UiButton } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<UiPopover label="Filter requests" autoClose open={open} onUiToggle={(e) => setOpen(e.detail.open)}>
  <UiButton slot="trigger" kind="tertiary" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>Filters</UiButton>
  <div style={{ padding: 16 }}>…</div>
</UiPopover>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { Popover } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/popover';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/button';

const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<Popover label="Filter requests" autoClose open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} trigger={<Button kind="tertiary" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>Filters</Button>}>
  <div className="p-4">…</div>
</Popover>
```

`show()` and `hide()` on the element do the same as setting `open`. In React + Tailwind the trigger is the `trigger` prop: it gets `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.

## Popover, toggletip or modal?

| Component | Use it when |
|---|---|
| [Popover](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/popover/) | Your own content beside the trigger, and the page around it stays usable. |
| [Toggletip](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/toggletip/) | An explanation with a link or a button, behind an info icon. It is a popover with the trigger and closing rules built in. |
| [Menu](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/menu/) | A list of actions to pick from. |
| Modal | The user must finish or cancel a task before going back to the page. |

## Close it yourself

Without `auto-close`, only your code closes the popover: Esc and clicks outside do nothing. Use it when the user must answer, for example a "what's new" hint with its own button.


HTML:

```html
<ui-popover id="popover-hint" label="New feature" placement="right">
  <ui-button slot="trigger" kind="tertiary">Bulk signing</ui-button>
  <div style="display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; width: 240px">
    <strong>New: sign up to 50 contracts at once</strong>
    <span>Select the contracts in the list, then choose Sign.</span>
    <div><ui-button id="popover-hint-done" size="sm">Got it</ui-button></div>
  </div>
</ui-popover>

<script type="module">
  const popover = document.getElementById('popover-hint');
  const trigger = popover.querySelector('[slot="trigger"]');
  trigger.addEventListener('click', () => (popover.open = !popover.open));
  document.getElementById('popover-hint-done').addEventListener('click', () => {
    popover.open = false;
    trigger.focus();
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiPopover label="New feature" placement="right" open={open}>
  <UiButton slot="trigger" kind="tertiary" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>Bulk signing</UiButton>
  <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 8, padding: 16, width: 240 }}>
    <strong>New: sign up to 50 contracts at once</strong>
    <span>Select the contracts in the list, then choose Sign.</span>
    <div><UiButton size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Got it</UiButton></div>
  </div>
</UiPopover>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Popover label="New feature" placement="right" open={open} trigger={<Button kind="tertiary" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>Bulk signing</Button>}>
  <div className="grid w-60 gap-2 p-4">
    <strong>New: sign up to 50 contracts at once</strong>
    <span>Select the contracts in the list, then choose Sign.</span>
    <div><Button size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Got it</Button></div>
  </div>
</Popover>
```

When your code closes the popover while focus is inside it, give focus back to the trigger yourself, as the demo does. With `auto-close`, Esc does that for you.

## Placement

The box opens below the trigger (`placement="bottom"`). `top`, `left`, `right` and the `-start` / `-end` forms move it; it flips when there is no room. `align` is Carbon's name for the same attribute.


HTML:

```html
<div id="popover-placement" style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
  <ui-popover placement="top" auto-close label="Above">
    <ui-button slot="trigger" kind="tertiary" size="sm">Top</ui-button>
    <div style="padding: 16px">Opens above</div>
  </ui-popover>
  <ui-popover placement="bottom-start" auto-close label="Below, start">
    <ui-button slot="trigger" kind="tertiary" size="sm">Bottom start</ui-button>
    <div style="padding: 16px">Lined up with the start edge</div>
  </ui-popover>
  <ui-popover placement="right" auto-close label="Right">
    <ui-button slot="trigger" kind="tertiary" size="sm">Right</ui-button>
    <div style="padding: 16px">Opens on the right</div>
  </ui-popover>
</div>

<script type="module">
  for (const popover of document.querySelectorAll('#popover-placement ui-popover')) {
    popover.querySelector('[slot="trigger"]').addEventListener('click', () => (popover.open = !popover.open));
  }
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiPopover placement="top" autoClose label="Above" open={open} onUiToggle={(e) => setOpen(e.detail.open)}>…</UiPopover>
<UiPopover placement="bottom-start" autoClose label="Below, start" …>…</UiPopover>
<UiPopover placement="right" autoClose label="Right" …>…</UiPopover>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Popover placement="top" autoClose label="Above" open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} trigger={…}>…</Popover>
<Popover placement="bottom-start" autoClose label="Below, start" …>…</Popover>
<Popover placement="right" autoClose label="Right" …>…</Popover>
```

## Caret and shadow

The caret (12×6px, 10px from the trigger) and the drop shadow are on by default. `caret="false"` puts the box flush against the trigger with no arrow; `drop-shadow="false"` removes the shadow, for a box on a layer that already stands out.


HTML:

```html
<div id="popover-look" style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
  <ui-popover caret="false" auto-close label="No caret">
    <ui-button slot="trigger" kind="tertiary" size="sm">No caret</ui-button>
    <div style="padding: 16px">Flush against the trigger</div>
  </ui-popover>
  <ui-popover drop-shadow="false" auto-close label="No shadow">
    <ui-button slot="trigger" kind="tertiary" size="sm">No shadow</ui-button>
    <div style="padding: 16px">No drop shadow</div>
  </ui-popover>
</div>

<script type="module">
  for (const popover of document.querySelectorAll('#popover-look ui-popover')) {
    popover.querySelector('[slot="trigger"]').addEventListener('click', () => (popover.open = !popover.open));
  }
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiPopover caret={false} autoClose label="No caret" …>…</UiPopover>
<UiPopover dropShadow={false} autoClose label="No shadow" …>…</UiPopover>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Popover caret={false} autoClose label="No caret" …>…</Popover>
<Popover dropShadow={false} autoClose label="No shadow" …>…</Popover>
```

## High contrast

`high-contrast` (`highContrast` in React) gives the box the inverse colours of a tooltip: dark in the light theme, light in the dark one.


HTML:

```html
<ui-popover id="popover-contrast" high-contrast auto-close label="Signing order">
  <ui-button slot="trigger" kind="tertiary">Signing order</ui-button>
  <div style="padding: 16px; width: 220px">Ananya signs first, then Somchai, then the customer.</div>
</ui-popover>

<script type="module">
  const popover = document.getElementById('popover-contrast');
  popover.querySelector('[slot="trigger"]').addEventListener('click', () => (popover.open = !popover.open));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiPopover highContrast autoClose label="Signing order" open={open} onUiToggle={(e) => setOpen(e.detail.open)}>
  <UiButton slot="trigger" kind="tertiary" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>Signing order</UiButton>
  <div style={{ padding: 16, width: 220 }}>Ananya signs first, then Somchai, then the customer.</div>
</UiPopover>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Popover highContrast autoClose label="Signing order" open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} trigger={<Button kind="tertiary" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>Signing order</Button>}>
  <div className="w-56 p-4">Ananya signs first, then Somchai, then the customer.</div>
</Popover>
```

## Tab tip

`tab-tip` (Carbon's `isTabTip`) makes a square box with no caret, flush under the trigger, as if the two were one piece. Use it for settings behind an icon button in a toolbar, usually with `placement="bottom-end"`.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; background: var(--ui-layer-1)">
  <ui-popover id="popover-settings" tab-tip placement="bottom-end" auto-close label="Table settings">
    <ui-icon-button slot="trigger" label="Table settings">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M13.5 8.4a5.4 5.4 0 0 0 0-.8l1.4-1.1-1.3-2.3-1.7.6a5 5 0 0 0-.7-.4L10.9 2.6H8.3L8 4.4l-.7.4-1.7-.6-1.3 2.3 1.4 1.1a5.4 5.4 0 0 0 0 .8L4.3 9.5l1.3 2.3 1.7-.6.7.4.3 1.8h2.6l.3-1.8.7-.4 1.7.6 1.3-2.3zM9.6 10a2 2 0 1 1 0-4 2 2 0 0 1 0 4Z"/></svg>
    </ui-icon-button>
    <div style="display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; width: 200px">
      <strong>Columns</strong>
      <ui-checkbox checked>Owner</ui-checkbox>
      <ui-checkbox checked>Expiry date</ui-checkbox>
      <ui-checkbox>Department</ui-checkbox>
    </div>
  </ui-popover>
</div>

<script type="module">
  const popover = document.getElementById('popover-settings');
  popover.querySelector('[slot="trigger"]').addEventListener('click', () => (popover.open = !popover.open));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
import { Settings as SettingsIcon } from '@carbon/icons-react';

<UiPopover tabTip placement="bottom-end" autoClose label="Table settings" open={open} onUiToggle={(e) => setOpen(e.detail.open)}>
  <UiIconButton slot="trigger" label="Table settings" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}><SettingsIcon /></UiIconButton>
  <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 8, padding: 16, width: 200 }}>…</div>
</UiPopover>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { Settings as SettingsIcon } from '@carbon/icons-react';

<Popover tabTip placement="bottom-end" autoClose label="Table settings" open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} trigger={<IconButton label="Table settings" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}><SettingsIcon /></IconButton>}>
  <div className="grid w-50 gap-2 p-4">…</div>
</Popover>
```

## A small form

A popover can hold a short form, such as renaming a record in place. Prevent the submit, use the values, close the popover and give focus back to the trigger.


HTML:

```html
<ui-popover id="popover-rename" label="Rename contract" auto-close placement="bottom-start">
  <ui-button slot="trigger" kind="ghost" size="sm">Rename</ui-button>
  <form id="popover-rename-form" style="display: grid; gap: 16px; padding: 16px; width: 280px">
    <ui-text-input label="Contract name" name="name" value="Lease, Silom office" required></ui-text-input>
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px">
      <ui-button type="submit" size="sm">Save</ui-button>
      <ui-button id="popover-rename-cancel" kind="secondary" size="sm">Cancel</ui-button>
    </div>
  </form>
</ui-popover>
<p style="margin: 0">Name: <output id="popover-rename-out">Lease, Silom office</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const popover = document.getElementById('popover-rename');
  const trigger = popover.querySelector('[slot="trigger"]');
  const form = document.getElementById('popover-rename-form');
  const close = () => {
    popover.open = false;
    trigger.focus();
  };
  trigger.addEventListener('click', () => (popover.open = !popover.open));
  document.getElementById('popover-rename-cancel').addEventListener('click', close);
  form.addEventListener('submit', (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    document.getElementById('popover-rename-out').value = new FormData(form).get('name');
    close();
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [name, setName] = useState('Lease, Silom office');
const save = (e: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  setName(String(new FormData(e.currentTarget).get('name')));
  setOpen(false);
};

<UiPopover label="Rename contract" autoClose placement="bottom-start" open={open} onUiToggle={(e) => setOpen(e.detail.open)}>
  <UiButton slot="trigger" kind="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>Rename</UiButton>
  <form onSubmit={save} style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 16, padding: 16, width: 280 }}>
    <UiTextInput label="Contract name" name="name" value={name} required />
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
      <UiButton type="submit" size="sm">Save</UiButton>
      <UiButton kind="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</UiButton>
    </div>
  </form>
</UiPopover>
<p>Name: <output>{name}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Popover label="Rename contract" autoClose placement="bottom-start" open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} trigger={<Button kind="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>Rename</Button>}>
  <form onSubmit={save} className="grid w-70 gap-4 p-4">
    <TextInput label="Contract name" name="name" defaultValue={name} required />
    <div className="flex gap-2">
      <Button type="submit" size="sm">Save</Button>
      <Button kind="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
    </div>
  </form>
</Popover>
<p>Name: <output>{name}</output></p>
```

`save` and `name` are the same in both React versions. In React, give focus back to the trigger after `setOpen(false)` (a ref on it) when focus was inside.

## Keep it open

With `auto-close`, Esc and a click outside first fire `ui-request-close` with `detail.reason` (`escape` or `outside`). It is cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps the box open, for example while a note isn't saved. `ui-toggle` fires after it opens or closes. Type a note below, then press Esc or click outside.


HTML:

```html
<ui-popover id="popover-note" label="Note for the signer" auto-close placement="bottom-start">
  <ui-button slot="trigger" kind="tertiary">Add a note</ui-button>
  <div style="display: grid; gap: 16px; padding: 16px; width: 280px">
    <ui-text-area id="popover-note-text" label="Note for the signer" rows="3"></ui-text-area>
    <div><ui-button id="popover-note-save" size="sm">Save note</ui-button></div>
  </div>
</ui-popover>
<p style="margin: 0">Last request: <output id="popover-note-out">none</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const popover = document.getElementById('popover-note');
  const trigger = popover.querySelector('[slot="trigger"]');
  const text = document.getElementById('popover-note-text');
  const out = document.getElementById('popover-note-out');
  trigger.addEventListener('click', () => (popover.open = !popover.open));
  popover.addEventListener('ui-request-close', (event) => {
    const unsaved = text.value.trim() !== '';
    out.value = unsaved ? `${event.detail.reason}, kept open: the note isn't saved` : event.detail.reason;
    if (unsaved) event.preventDefault();
  });
  document.getElementById('popover-note-save').addEventListener('click', () => {
    out.value = `saved "${text.value.trim()}"`;
    text.value = '';
    popover.open = false;
    trigger.focus();
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [note, setNote] = useState('');

<UiPopover
  label="Note for the signer"
  autoClose
  placement="bottom-start"
  open={open}
  onUiToggle={(e) => setOpen(e.detail.open)}
  onUiRequestClose={(e) => note.trim() && e.preventDefault()}
>
  <UiButton slot="trigger" kind="tertiary" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>Add a note</UiButton>
  <UiTextArea label="Note for the signer" rows={3} value={note} onInput={(e) => setNote((e.target as { value: string }).value)} />
  <UiButton size="sm" onClick={save}>Save note</UiButton>
</UiPopover>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
// open stays true unless you set it: ignore the request while the note isn't saved
<Popover
  label="Note for the signer"
  autoClose
  placement="bottom-start"
  open={open}
  onOpenChange={(next) => !note.trim() && setOpen(next)}
  trigger={<Button kind="tertiary" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>Add a note</Button>}
>
  <TextArea label="Note for the signer" rows={3} value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} />
  <Button size="sm" onClick={save}>Save note</Button>
</Popover>
```

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
|---|---|
| Tab | Moves through the trigger and the content in page order |
| Esc | With `auto-close`, from the trigger or the content: asks to close and gives focus back to the trigger. A control inside that uses Esc itself (an open dropdown) handles it first |
| Enter, Space on the trigger | Whatever your click handler does, usually toggles `open` |

## Accessibility

- The box has `role="group"` named by `label`. Give it a `label` that says what the content is.
- The popover sets `aria-expanded` on the trigger (`expanded` on a `<ui-button>` or `<ui-icon-button>`).
- Focus doesn't move into the box when it opens. Keep the content short and right after the trigger, so a keyboard user reaches it with the next Tab.
- For a task the user must finish before going on, use a modal instead.

Unstyled React parts with the same behaviour: [Headless Popover](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-popover/).

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-popover>` · React `UiPopover`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `align` |  |  |  | Carbon's name for `placement` (same values) |
| `open` | `open` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `placement` | `placement` | `Placement` | `'bottom'` |  |
| `caret` | `caret` | `boolean` | `true` | On by default; `caret="false"` hides it. |
| `drop-shadow` | `dropShadow` | `boolean` | `true` | On by default; `drop-shadow="false"` removes it. |
| `high-contrast` | `highContrast` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `tab-tip` | `tabTip` | `boolean` | `false` | Carbon `isTabTip`: square box flush against the trigger (toolbar settings panels). |
| `auto-close` | `autoClose` | `boolean` | `false` | Close on Escape and on clicks outside the trigger and the box. |
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible name of the box (`role=group`). |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-toggle` | `onUiToggle` | detail: { open } after it opens or closes |
| `ui-request-close` | `onUiRequestClose` | cancelable; `auto-close` fires it before closing on Escape / outside click |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `trigger` | The element the box is positioned against |
| (default) | Box content |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `content` | The floating box |
| `caret` | The arrow |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-menu-border` |  | / --ui-menu-radius - Border and corners of the bubble (the menu settings) |

# Toggletip

A toggletip is a small "i" button that opens an explanation when clicked. Unlike a [tooltip](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/tooltip/), it stays open until the user closes it, and it may hold links and buttons. Put it next to a label or a heading that needs more context.


HTML:

```html
<p style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0">
  Retention period
  <ui-toggletip label="About the retention period">
    Signed copies are kept for 10 years, then moved to the archive. <a href="#accessibility">Read the policy</a>
  </ui-toggletip>
</p>
```

React:

```tsx
<p style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
  Retention period
  <UiToggletip label="About the retention period">
    Signed copies are kept for 10 years, then moved to the archive. <a href="/policy">Read the policy</a>
  </UiToggletip>
</p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<p className="flex items-center gap-2">
  Retention period
  <Toggletip label="About the retention period">
    Signed copies are kept for 10 years, then moved to the archive. <a href="/policy">Read the policy</a>
  </Toggletip>
</p>
```

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/toggletip
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-popover
```

Manual:

```bash

#    to its target:

# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-popup, shared-align, shared-element, shared-events, shared-field, shared-localize, shared-position, tokens

# React + Tailwind
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install @purpurabog/ui@^1.4.3
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tw-popover.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/react-tw/popover.tsx
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-position, tw-floating, tw-i18n, tw-theme, tw-utils
```

npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Use it

Put the explanation inside the element and name the button with `label`.


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">import '@purpurabog/ui/toggletip';</script>

<ui-toggletip label="About the retention period">
  Signed copies are kept for 10 years.
</ui-toggletip>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiToggletip } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiToggletip label="About the retention period">
  Signed copies are kept for 10 years.
</UiToggletip>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { Toggletip } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/popover';

<Toggletip label="About the retention period">
  Signed copies are kept for 10 years.
</Toggletip>
```

React + Tailwind's `Toggletip` lives in the popover file, as both are built on the same parts.

## Toggletip or tooltip?

| | Tooltip | Toggletip |
|---|---|---|
| Opens on | Hover and keyboard focus | A click, Enter or Space on the "i" button |
| Closes on | The pointer or focus leaving, Esc | Another click, Esc, a click outside, focus leaving both the button and the bubble |
| Content | One line of plain text | Text, links and buttons |
| Trigger | The control it explains | Its own "i" button |

See the [tooltip page](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/tooltip/#tooltip-toggletip-definition-tooltip-or-popover) for the definition tooltip and the popover too.

## Beside a heading

The toggletip is an inline element that sits on the text's middle line. Put it right after the words it explains, so it reads as part of the same line.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px">
  <h3 style="margin: 0; font: var(--ui-font-heading-02)">Approval route</h3>
  <ui-toggletip label="About the approval route">
    Contracts go to the department head first. Above 5 million baht, Finance approves as well.
  </ui-toggletip>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
  <h3>Approval route</h3>
  <UiToggletip label="About the approval route">
    Contracts go to the department head first. Above 5 million baht, Finance approves as well.
  </UiToggletip>
</div>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<div className="flex items-center gap-1">
  <h3 className="type-heading-02">Approval route</h3>
  <Toggletip label="About the approval route">
    Contracts go to the department head first. Above 5 million baht, Finance approves as well.
  </Toggletip>
</div>
```

## Links and buttons inside

The content follows the button in the Tab order, so a keyboard user reaches a link or a button inside with the next Tab. A link put directly inside takes the primary colour.


HTML:

```html
<p style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0">
  e-Signature
  <ui-toggletip id="toggletip-esign" label="About e-signatures">
    An e-signature is valid under the Electronic Transactions Act B.E. 2544.
    <a href="#links-and-buttons-inside" style="display: block; margin-block: 8px">Which documents can be signed online?</a>
    <ui-button id="toggletip-esign-done" size="sm" kind="tertiary">Got it</ui-button>
  </ui-toggletip>
</p>

<script type="module">
  const tip = document.getElementById('toggletip-esign');
  document.getElementById('toggletip-esign-done').addEventListener('click', () => tip.hide());
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiToggletip label="About e-signatures" open={open} onUiToggle={(e) => setOpen(e.detail.open)}>
  An e-signature is valid under the Electronic Transactions Act B.E. 2544.
  <a href="/help/e-signature" style={{ display: 'block', marginBlock: 8 }}>Which documents can be signed online?</a>
  <UiButton size="sm" kind="tertiary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Got it</UiButton>
</UiToggletip>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Toggletip label="About e-signatures" open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
  <span className="grid gap-2">
    <span>An e-signature is valid under the Electronic Transactions Act B.E. 2544.</span>
    <a href="/help/e-signature">Which documents can be signed online?</a>
    <span><Button size="sm" kind="tertiary" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>Got it</Button></span>
  </span>
</Toggletip>
```

When the bubble closes while focus is inside it (the "Got it" button, Esc), focus goes back to the "i" button.

## Placement

The bubble opens below the button (`placement="bottom"`). `top`, `left`, `right` and the `-start` / `-end` forms move it; it flips when there is no room. `align` is Carbon's name for the same attribute.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 32px; align-items: center">
  <span style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px">Top <ui-toggletip placement="top" label="Opens above">Opens above the button.</ui-toggletip></span>
  <span style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px">Right <ui-toggletip placement="right" label="Opens on the right">Opens on the right of the button.</ui-toggletip></span>
  <span style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px">Bottom start <ui-toggletip placement="bottom-start" label="Opens below, start">Lined up with the start edge of the button.</ui-toggletip></span>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiToggletip placement="top" label="Opens above">Opens above the button.</UiToggletip>
<UiToggletip placement="right" label="Opens on the right">Opens on the right of the button.</UiToggletip>
<UiToggletip placement="bottom-start" label="Opens below, start">Lined up with the start edge of the button.</UiToggletip>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Toggletip placement="top" label="Opens above">Opens above the button.</Toggletip>
<Toggletip placement="right" label="Opens on the right">Opens on the right of the button.</Toggletip>
<Toggletip placement="bottom-start" label="Opens below, start">Lined up with the start edge of the button.</Toggletip>
```

## Another icon

The "i" is the default. Put another 16px icon in the `trigger` slot (`icon` in React + Tailwind), for example Carbon's `Help` (see [Icons](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/icons/)). It takes the button's colour.


HTML:

```html
<p style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0">
  Stamp duty
  <ui-toggletip label="How stamp duty is worked out">
    <svg slot="trigger" viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M16 2a14 14 0 1 0 14 14A14 14 0 0 0 16 2Zm0 26a12 12 0 1 1 12-12 12 12 0 0 1-12 12Z"/><circle cx="16" cy="23.5" r="1.5"/><path d="M17 8h-1.5a4.49 4.49 0 0 0-4.5 4.5v.5h2v-.5a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 2.5-2.5H17a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0 5h-2v4.5h2V17a4.5 4.5 0 0 0 0-9Z"/></svg>
    The duty is 0.1% of the rent for the whole term, paid within 15 days of signing.
  </ui-toggletip>
</p>
```

React:

```tsx
import { Help as HelpIcon } from '@carbon/icons-react';

<UiToggletip label="How stamp duty is worked out">
  <HelpIcon slot="trigger" aria-hidden="true" />
  The duty is 0.1% of the rent for the whole term, paid within 15 days of signing.
</UiToggletip>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { Help as HelpIcon } from '@carbon/icons-react';

<Toggletip label="How stamp duty is worked out" icon={<HelpIcon aria-hidden="true" />}>
  The duty is 0.1% of the rent for the whole term, paid within 15 days of signing.
</Toggletip>
```

## Open state and events

`open` is the state; `show()` and `hide()` set it. `ui-toggle` fires after the bubble opens or closes, with `detail.open`.


HTML:

```html
<p style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0">
  Deposit
  <ui-toggletip id="toggletip-deposit" label="About the deposit">The deposit is two months' rent, returned within 30 days after the lease ends.</ui-toggletip>
</p>
<p style="margin: 0">Open: <output id="toggletip-deposit-out">false</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const tip = document.getElementById('toggletip-deposit');
  const out = document.getElementById('toggletip-deposit-out');
  tip.addEventListener('ui-toggle', (event) => (out.value = String(event.detail.open)));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<UiToggletip label="About the deposit" open={open} onUiToggle={(e) => setOpen(e.detail.open)}>
  The deposit is two months' rent, returned within 30 days after the lease ends.
</UiToggletip>
<p>Open: <output>{String(open)}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<Toggletip label="About the deposit" open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
  The deposit is two months' rent, returned within 30 days after the lease ends.
</Toggletip>
<p>Open: <output>{String(open)}</output></p>
```

Leave `open` out in React + Tailwind and the toggletip keeps its own state.

## Keyboard

| Key | What it does |
|---|---|
| Enter, Space | On the button: open or close the bubble |
| Tab | From the button into the content; leaving both closes the bubble |
| Esc | Closes the bubble and gives focus back to the button when it was inside |

A click outside the button and the bubble closes it too.

## Accessibility

- The trigger is a real `<button>` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. Its name is `label`, else "More information" in the page language (Thai or English).
- The bubble has `role="group"` with the same name, so screen readers say what the content is about.
- Give `label` the topic ("About the deposit"), not "Info": a page with several toggletips needs a different name on each.

Unstyled React parts with the same behaviour: [Headless Popover](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-popover/#toggletip), with `closeOnFocusOut`.

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-toggletip>` · React `UiToggletip`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `align` |  |  |  | Carbon's name for `placement` (same values) |
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible name of the trigger, e.g. "More about retention". |
| `placement` | `placement` | `Placement` | `'bottom'` |  |
| `open` | `open` | `boolean` | `false` |  |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-toggle` | `onUiToggle` | detail: { open }, after it opens or closes |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Bubble content (text, links, buttons) |
| `trigger` | Custom trigger icon (default: an "i" information icon) |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `trigger` | The info button |
| `bubble` | The popover content box |
| `caret` | The arrow pointing at the trigger |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-menu-border` |  | / --ui-menu-radius - Border and corners of the bubble (the menu settings) |
| `--ui-icon-control-radius` |  | Corners of its small icon buttons, their hover fill and ring (default 0; Kanok: round) |
| `--ui-focus-offset` |  | `outline-offset` of its focus ring (default -2px: inside; Kanok: 2px outside) |

# Menu

A menu is a short list of actions that opens from a button. This page covers the three triggers Carbon ships (the menu button, the overflow menu "⋮" and the combo button), the items that go inside them, and the menu on its own.


HTML:

```html
<ui-menu-button label="Actions">
  <ui-menu-item label="Send for signature" shortcut="⌘↵"></ui-menu-item>
  <ui-menu-item label="Save as draft"></ui-menu-item>
  <ui-menu-item label="Export PDF" disabled></ui-menu-item>
  <ui-menu-divider></ui-menu-divider>
  <ui-menu-item label="Discard" kind="danger" danger-description="Deletes this request"></ui-menu-item>
</ui-menu-button>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiMenuButton label="Actions">
  <UiMenuItem label="Send for signature" shortcut="⌘↵" />
  <UiMenuItem label="Save as draft" />
  <UiMenuItem label="Export PDF" disabled />
  <UiMenuDivider />
  <UiMenuItem label="Discard" kind="danger" dangerDescription="Deletes this request" />
</UiMenuButton>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<MenuButton label="Actions">
  <MenuItem label="Send for signature" shortcut="⌘↵" />
  <MenuItem label="Save as draft" />
  <MenuItem label="Export PDF" disabled />
  <MenuItemDivider />
  <MenuItem label="Discard" kind="danger" dangerDescription="Deletes this request" />
</MenuButton>
```

## Use it

Import the trigger you use; each brings the menu and its items with it.


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">
  import '@purpurabog/ui/menu-button';
  import '@purpurabog/ui/overflow-menu';
  import '@purpurabog/ui/combo-button';
</script>

<ui-menu-button label="Actions">
  <ui-menu-item label="Send for signature"></ui-menu-item>
  <ui-menu-item label="Save as draft"></ui-menu-item>
</ui-menu-button>
<ui-overflow-menu label="Contract options">
  <ui-menu-item label="Edit"></ui-menu-item>
  <ui-menu-item label="Delete" kind="danger"></ui-menu-item>
</ui-overflow-menu>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiMenuButton, UiOverflowMenu, UiMenuItem } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiMenuButton label="Actions">
  <UiMenuItem label="Send for signature" />
  <UiMenuItem label="Save as draft" />
</UiMenuButton>
<UiOverflowMenu label="Contract options">
  <UiMenuItem label="Edit" />
  <UiMenuItem label="Delete" kind="danger" />
</UiOverflowMenu>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { MenuButton, OverflowMenu, MenuItem } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/menu';

<MenuButton label="Actions">
  <MenuItem label="Send for signature" />
  <MenuItem label="Save as draft" />
</MenuButton>
<OverflowMenu label="Contract options">
  <MenuItem label="Edit" />
  <MenuItem label="Delete" kind="danger" />
</OverflowMenu>
```

The combo button is its own file: `@purpurabog/ui/combo-button`, and `@kanok-ui/tw-combo-button` for React + Tailwind.

## Which trigger?

| Trigger | Use it when |
|---|---|
| Menu button (`ui-menu-button`) | A labelled button groups several actions of the same kind ("Actions", "Export"). |
| Overflow menu (`ui-overflow-menu`) | Space is tight: secondary actions of a table row, a card or a toolbar, behind "⋮". |
| Combo button (`ui-combo-button`) | One action is the usual one and others are close variants ("Save", then "Save as draft"). |
| Menu (`ui-menu`) | None of these fit and you bring your own trigger. |

## Menu button kinds

`kind` is `primary` (the default), `tertiary` or `ghost`, as Carbon's `MenuButton`. Primary and tertiary buttons are at least 192px wide; ghost fits its label.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
  <ui-menu-button label="Primary">
    <ui-menu-item label="Send for signature"></ui-menu-item>
    <ui-menu-item label="Save as draft"></ui-menu-item>
  </ui-menu-button>
  <ui-menu-button label="Tertiary" kind="tertiary">
    <ui-menu-item label="Send for signature"></ui-menu-item>
    <ui-menu-item label="Save as draft"></ui-menu-item>
  </ui-menu-button>
  <ui-menu-button label="Ghost" kind="ghost">
    <ui-menu-item label="Send for signature"></ui-menu-item>
    <ui-menu-item label="Save as draft"></ui-menu-item>
  </ui-menu-button>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiMenuButton label="Primary">…</UiMenuButton>
<UiMenuButton label="Tertiary" kind="tertiary">…</UiMenuButton>
<UiMenuButton label="Ghost" kind="ghost">…</UiMenuButton>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<MenuButton label="Primary">…</MenuButton>
<MenuButton label="Tertiary" kind="tertiary">…</MenuButton>
<MenuButton label="Ghost" kind="ghost">…</MenuButton>
```

## Sizes

`size` is `sm` 32px, `md` 40px or `lg` 48px (the default). The menu's rows take the same height as the button.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-start">
  <ui-menu-button label="Small" size="sm" kind="tertiary">
    <ui-menu-item label="Approve"></ui-menu-item>
    <ui-menu-item label="Reject"></ui-menu-item>
  </ui-menu-button>
  <ui-menu-button label="Medium" size="md" kind="tertiary">
    <ui-menu-item label="Approve"></ui-menu-item>
    <ui-menu-item label="Reject"></ui-menu-item>
  </ui-menu-button>
  <ui-menu-button label="Large" kind="tertiary">
    <ui-menu-item label="Approve"></ui-menu-item>
    <ui-menu-item label="Reject"></ui-menu-item>
  </ui-menu-button>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiMenuButton label="Small" size="sm" kind="tertiary">…</UiMenuButton>
<UiMenuButton label="Medium" size="md" kind="tertiary">…</UiMenuButton>
<UiMenuButton label="Large" kind="tertiary">…</UiMenuButton>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<MenuButton label="Small" size="sm" kind="tertiary">…</MenuButton>
<MenuButton label="Medium" size="md" kind="tertiary">…</MenuButton>
<MenuButton label="Large" kind="tertiary">…</MenuButton>
```

## Placement and width

The menu opens below the button. With `placement="bottom"` (the default) or `top`, it is as wide as the button. `bottom-start`, `bottom-end`, `top-start` and `top-end` line it up with one edge and let it be as wide as its items. It flips when there is no room. `align` is Carbon's name for the same attribute.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
  <ui-menu-button label="As wide as the button" kind="tertiary">
    <ui-menu-item label="Export PDF"></ui-menu-item>
    <ui-menu-item label="Export Word (.docx)"></ui-menu-item>
  </ui-menu-button>
  <ui-menu-button label="End edge" kind="ghost" placement="bottom-end">
    <ui-menu-item label="Export PDF"></ui-menu-item>
    <ui-menu-item label="Export Word (.docx) with comments"></ui-menu-item>
  </ui-menu-button>
  <ui-menu-button label="Opens above" kind="tertiary" placement="top">
    <ui-menu-item label="Export PDF"></ui-menu-item>
    <ui-menu-item label="Export Word (.docx)"></ui-menu-item>
  </ui-menu-button>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiMenuButton label="As wide as the button" kind="tertiary">…</UiMenuButton>
<UiMenuButton label="End edge" kind="ghost" placement="bottom-end">…</UiMenuButton>
<UiMenuButton label="Opens above" kind="tertiary" placement="top">…</UiMenuButton>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<MenuButton label="As wide as the button" kind="tertiary">…</MenuButton>
<MenuButton label="End edge" kind="ghost" placement="bottom-end">…</MenuButton>
<MenuButton label="Opens above" kind="tertiary" placement="top">…</MenuButton>
```

## Overflow menu

`<ui-overflow-menu>` is a ghost icon button with "⋮" that opens the menu (Carbon's `OverflowMenu`). `label` names the button and shows in its tooltip; it defaults to "Options". In a table row, use `placement="bottom-end"` so the menu stays inside the table. `ui-select` tells you which item was picked: `detail` has its `value` (else its label), `label` and `checked`.


HTML:

```html
<table id="menu-rows" style="border-collapse: collapse; font: var(--ui-font-body-sm)">
  <tbody>
    <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-hairline)">
      <td style="padding: 0 16px">Lease, Silom office</td>
      <td style="width: 40px"><ui-overflow-menu label="Actions for Lease, Silom office" placement="bottom-end" data-row="Lease, Silom office">
        <ui-menu-item label="Edit" value="edit"></ui-menu-item>
        <ui-menu-item label="Duplicate" value="duplicate"></ui-menu-item>
        <ui-menu-divider></ui-menu-divider>
        <ui-menu-item label="Delete" value="delete" kind="danger" danger-description="This cannot be undone"></ui-menu-item>
      </ui-overflow-menu></td>
    </tr>
    <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-hairline)">
      <td style="padding: 0 16px">NDA, Siam Trading</td>
      <td style="width: 40px"><ui-overflow-menu label="Actions for NDA, Siam Trading" placement="bottom-end" data-row="NDA, Siam Trading">
        <ui-menu-item label="Edit" value="edit"></ui-menu-item>
        <ui-menu-item label="Duplicate" value="duplicate"></ui-menu-item>
        <ui-menu-divider></ui-menu-divider>
        <ui-menu-item label="Delete" value="delete" kind="danger" danger-description="This cannot be undone"></ui-menu-item>
      </ui-overflow-menu></td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>
<p style="margin: 0">Picked: <output id="menu-rows-out">nothing yet</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const out = document.getElementById('menu-rows-out');
  document.getElementById('menu-rows').addEventListener('ui-select', (event) => {
    out.value = `${event.detail.value} on ${event.target.closest('ui-overflow-menu').dataset.row}`;
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiOverflowMenu label={`Actions for ${row.name}`} placement="bottom-end" onUiSelect={(e) => setPicked(`${e.detail.value} on ${row.name}`)}>
  <UiMenuItem label="Edit" value="edit" />
  <UiMenuItem label="Duplicate" value="duplicate" />
  <UiMenuDivider />
  <UiMenuItem label="Delete" value="delete" kind="danger" dangerDescription="This cannot be undone" />
</UiOverflowMenu>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
// each item has its own onClick
<OverflowMenu label={`Actions for ${row.name}`} placement="bottom-end">
  <MenuItem label="Edit" onClick={() => setPicked(`edit on ${row.name}`)} />
  <MenuItem label="Duplicate" onClick={() => setPicked(`duplicate on ${row.name}`)} />
  <MenuItemDivider />
  <MenuItem label="Delete" kind="danger" dangerDescription="This cannot be undone" onClick={() => setPicked(`delete on ${row.name}`)} />
</OverflowMenu>
```

`ui-select` bubbles, so one listener on the table hears every row. Give each overflow menu a `label` that names its row: a screen reader hears "Actions for Lease, Silom office", not five times "Options".

## Overflow menu sizes and icon

`size` is `sm` 32px, `md` 40px (the default) or `lg` 48px, for the button and the rows. `tooltip-placement` moves the tooltip (below by default). Another icon goes in the `icon` slot (`icon` in React + Tailwind), such as "⋯" for a horizontal toolbar.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
  <ui-overflow-menu size="sm" label="Options (small)">
    <ui-menu-item label="Rename"></ui-menu-item>
    <ui-menu-item label="Move"></ui-menu-item>

  <ui-overflow-menu label="Options (medium)">
    <ui-menu-item label="Rename"></ui-menu-item>
    <ui-menu-item label="Move"></ui-menu-item>
  </ui-overflow-menu>
  <ui-overflow-menu size="lg" label="Options (large)" tooltip-placement="right">
    <ui-menu-item label="Rename"></ui-menu-item>
    <ui-menu-item label="Move"></ui-menu-item>
  </ui-overflow-menu>
  <ui-overflow-menu label="More tools">
    <svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><circle cx="4" cy="8" r="1.5"/><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="1.5"/><circle cx="12" cy="8" r="1.5"/></svg>
    <ui-menu-item label="Rename"></ui-menu-item>
    <ui-menu-item label="Move"></ui-menu-item>
  </ui-overflow-menu>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx

<UiOverflowMenu size="sm" label="Options (small)">…</UiOverflowMenu>

  <OverflowMenuHorizontalIcon slot="icon" />
  …

```

React + Tailwind:

