### `<ui-table-toolbar-search>` · React `UiTableToolbarSearch`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `persistent` | `persistent` | `boolean` | `false` | Always open (Carbon `persistent`). |
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible name of the field (visually hidden, as in Carbon). |
| `placeholder` | `placeholder` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `value` | `value` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `name` | `name` | `string` | `''` | Reflected: form-associated elements submit under the `name` attribute. |
| `size` | `size` | `SearchSize` | `'md'` | Field height: sm 32px, md 40px, lg 48px (tokens `--ui-field-height-*`). |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control; a disabled `<fieldset>` ancestor does the same. |
| `autocomplete` | `autocomplete` | `string` | `'off'` |  |
| `inputmode` | `inputmode` | `string` | `''` | Passed to the text box: the virtual keyboard to show (`numeric`, `decimal`, `email`, `tel`, `url`, `search`…). |
| `enterkeyhint` | `enterkeyhint` | `string` | `''` | Passed to the text box: the label of the virtual keyboard's Enter key (`search`, `send`, `next`, `done`…). |
| `clear-label` | `clearLabel` | `string` | `''` | Accessible name of the clear button. |
| `required` | `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Constraint validation like `<input type="search">`: blocks submit and reports in the browser's bubble (Carbon Search has no error line). |
| `pattern` | `pattern` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `minlength` | `minlength` | `number \| undefined` |  |  |
| `maxlength` | `maxlength` | `number \| undefined` |  |  |
| `readonly` | `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Value can be selected and submitted but not changed; no clear button. |
| `fluid` | `fluid` | `boolean` | `false` | Carbon `FluidSearch`: the label inside a 64px box. `<ui-fluid-form>` sets it for every field inside. |
| `expandable` | `expandable` | `boolean` | `false` | Carbon `ExpandableSearch`: collapsed to its magnifier until opened. |
| `expanded` | `expanded` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether an expandable search is open. |

#### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `willValidate` |  | (read-only) Whether the field takes part in constraint validation (not while disabled), as natively. |
| `labels` |  | (read-only) The `<label>`s that point at this field. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `setCustomValidity(message)` | Like `<input>.setCustomValidity()`: a non-empty message makes the field invalid until cleared with ''. |
| `clear()` | Empties the field, keeps focus in it and announces the change (`input`, `change`, `ui-clear`). |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `change` | `onChange` | When the value is committed (blur / Enter) or cleared |
| `ui-toggle` | `onUiToggle` | detail: { expanded } when an expandable search opens or collapses |
| `input` | `onInput` | On every keystroke |
| `ui-clear` | `onUiClear` | After the clear button or Esc emptied the field |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `base` | The role=search wrapper |
| `input` | The native search input |
| `label` | The label (visually hidden, as in Carbon; shown inside the box when `fluid`) |
| `magnifier` | The search icon |
| `clear-button` | The clear button |
| `magnifier-button` | The magnifier of an expandable search |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-field-open-background` |  | The box's fill while a search is under way (default the layer's field fill) |
| `--ui-field-border` |  | Border on every side of the box (default none: Carbon's underline only; Kanok: a 1px outline) |
| `--ui-field-disabled-border-color` |  | Border colour when disabled (default: the underline transparent) |
| `--ui-field-readonly-border-color` |  | Border colour when read-only (default: a hairline underline) |
| `--ui-field-radius` |  | Corner radius of the box (default 0; Kanok: 6px) |
| `--ui-field-background` |  | Fill of the box (default `--ui-surface-1`; Kanok: transparent) |
| `--ui-label-font` |  | Font of the label (default `--ui-font-caption`; Kanok: 14px semibold) |
| `--ui-label-color` |  | Colour of the label (default `--ui-ink-muted`; Kanok: `--ui-ink`) |
| `--ui-icon-control-radius` |  | Corners of its small icon buttons, their hover fill and ring (default 0; Kanok: round) |

# Structured list

A structured list shows a few rows of text in columns, for example to compare plans or to show the terms of a contract. It is lighter than a [data table](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/data-table/): no sorting, no toolbar. With `selection`, the user picks one row.


HTML:

```html
<ui-structured-list label="Plans">
  <ui-structured-list-row head>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Plan</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Users</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Price</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Includes</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
  <ui-structured-list-row>
    <ui-structured-list-cell nowrap>Basic</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Up to 5</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Free</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Shared templates, 30-day audit log.</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
  <ui-structured-list-row>
    <ui-structured-list-cell nowrap>Team</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Up to 50</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>฿390 / user</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Approval workflows, SSO, 1-year audit log.</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
  <ui-structured-list-row>
    <ui-structured-list-cell nowrap>Enterprise</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Unlimited</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Contact us</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Dedicated region, custom retention, SLA.</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
</ui-structured-list>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiStructuredList label="Plans">
  <UiStructuredListRow head>
    <UiStructuredListCell>Plan</UiStructuredListCell>
    <UiStructuredListCell>Users</UiStructuredListCell>
    <UiStructuredListCell>Price</UiStructuredListCell>
    <UiStructuredListCell>Includes</UiStructuredListCell>
  </UiStructuredListRow>
  <UiStructuredListRow>
    <UiStructuredListCell nowrap>Basic</UiStructuredListCell>
    <UiStructuredListCell>Up to 5</UiStructuredListCell>
    <UiStructuredListCell>Free</UiStructuredListCell>
    <UiStructuredListCell>Shared templates, 30-day audit log.</UiStructuredListCell>
  </UiStructuredListRow>
  {/* … Team, Enterprise */}
</UiStructuredList>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<StructuredList label="Plans">
  <StructuredListRow head>
    <StructuredListCell>Plan</StructuredListCell>
    <StructuredListCell>Users</StructuredListCell>
    <StructuredListCell>Price</StructuredListCell>
    <StructuredListCell>Includes</StructuredListCell>
  </StructuredListRow>
  <StructuredListRow>
    <StructuredListCell nowrap>Basic</StructuredListCell>
    <StructuredListCell>Up to 5</StructuredListCell>
    <StructuredListCell>Free</StructuredListCell>
    <StructuredListCell>Shared templates, 30-day audit log.</StructuredListCell>
  </StructuredListRow>
  {/* … Team, Enterprise */}
</StructuredList>
```

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/structured-list
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-structured-list
```

Manual:

```bash
# Web component
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install lit@^3.3.0
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/structured-list.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/primitives/structured-list/structured-list-cell.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/structured-list/structured-list-row.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/structured-list/structured-list-skeleton.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/structured-list/structured-list.ts
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-roving, shared-element, shared-field, shared-localize, shared-skeleton, tokens

# React + Tailwind
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install @purpurabog/ui@^1.4.3
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tw-structured-list.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/react-tw/structured-list.tsx
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    tw-i18n, tw-refs, tw-theme, tw-utils
```

npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Structured list or data table?

| Component | Use it when |
|---|---|
| Structured list | A handful of rows to read or compare, or to pick one from. The cells wrap and hold any text. |
| [Data table](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/data-table/) | Many rows: the user sorts, searches, selects several rows or pages through them. |
| [Contained list](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/contained-list/) | One column of items with an action each, in a panel or a tile. |

## A header row

`head` on the first row makes its cells column headers (bold, `columnheader`). Leave it out for a list of label–value pairs where the first column already says what each row is.


HTML:

```html
<ui-structured-list label="Contract summary">
  <ui-structured-list-row>
    <ui-structured-list-cell nowrap>Counterparty</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Acme Co., Ltd.</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
  <ui-structured-list-row>
    <ui-structured-list-cell nowrap>Signed on</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>30 September 2026</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
  <ui-structured-list-row>
    <ui-structured-list-cell nowrap>Owner</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Legal department, Somchai K.</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
</ui-structured-list>
```

React:

## Long text and nowrap

Cells wrap their text, up to 576px wide each. `nowrap` keeps a cell on one line: use it on short cells such as names and amounts, so a long cell beside them wraps instead.


HTML:

```html
<ui-structured-list label="Clauses">
  <ui-structured-list-row head>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Clause</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Summary</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
  <ui-structured-list-row>
    <ui-structured-list-cell nowrap>5.1 Payment</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>The client pays each invoice within 30 days of receipt. Late payments carry interest of 1.25% a month on the unpaid amount.</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
  <ui-structured-list-row>
    <ui-structured-list-cell nowrap>9.2 Termination</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Either party may end the agreement with 60 days' written notice. Work done until then is paid at the agreed rates.</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
</ui-structured-list>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiStructuredList label="Clauses">
  <UiStructuredListRow head>
    <UiStructuredListCell>Clause</UiStructuredListCell>
    <UiStructuredListCell>Summary</UiStructuredListCell>
  </UiStructuredListRow>
  <UiStructuredListRow>
    <UiStructuredListCell nowrap>5.1 Payment</UiStructuredListCell>
    <UiStructuredListCell>The client pays each invoice within 30 days of receipt. …</UiStructuredListCell>
  </UiStructuredListRow>
  <UiStructuredListRow>
    <UiStructuredListCell nowrap>9.2 Termination</UiStructuredListCell>
    <UiStructuredListCell>Either party may end the agreement with 60 days' written notice. …</UiStructuredListCell>
  </UiStructuredListRow>
</UiStructuredList>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx

    <StructuredListCell>Clause</StructuredListCell>
    <StructuredListCell>Summary</StructuredListCell>
  </StructuredListRow>

    <StructuredListCell nowrap>5.1 Payment</StructuredListCell>

  </StructuredListRow>
```

```html
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Kanya S.</ui-structured-list-cell>
```

## Flush

`flush` removes the padding before the first column, so the text lines up with the heading or the text above the list. It has no effect with `selection`, whose radio column needs the padding.


HTML:

```html
<div>
  <p style="margin: 0 0 8px; font: var(--ui-font-body-emphasis)">Billing</p>
  <ui-structured-list label="Billing" flush>
    <ui-structured-list-row>
      <ui-structured-list-cell nowrap>Invoice to</ui-structured-list-cell>
      <ui-structured-list-cell>Accounts payable, Acme Co., Ltd.</ui-structured-list-cell>
    </ui-structured-list-row>
    <ui-structured-list-row>
      <ui-structured-list-cell nowrap>Tax ID</ui-structured-list-cell>
      <ui-structured-list-cell>0105556012345</ui-structured-list-cell>
    </ui-structured-list-row>
  </ui-structured-list>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<h3>Billing</h3>
<UiStructuredList label="Billing" flush>

    <UiStructuredListCell nowrap>Invoice to</UiStructuredListCell>
```

## Pick one row

`selection` turns the body rows into a single choice: each row gets a radio in a leading cell. A click anywhere on the row, Space or the arrow keys select it. Give each row a `value`; the list's `value` holds the chosen one, and `ui-change` (`onChange` in React + Tailwind) fires when the user picks another row.


HTML:

```html
<ui-structured-list id="structured-list-plan" label="Choose a plan" selection value="team">
  <ui-structured-list-row head>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Plan</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Users</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Price</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
  <ui-structured-list-row value="basic">
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Basic</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Up to 5</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Free</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
  <ui-structured-list-row value="team">
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Team</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Up to 50</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>฿390 / user</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
  <ui-structured-list-row value="enterprise">
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Enterprise</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Unlimited</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Contact us</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
</ui-structured-list>
<p>Value: <output id="structured-list-plan-out">team</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const list = document.getElementById('structured-list-plan');
  const out = document.getElementById('structured-list-plan-out');
  list.addEventListener('ui-change', (event) => (out.value = event.detail.value));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [plan, setPlan] = useState('team');

<UiStructuredList label="Choose a plan" selection value={plan} onUiChange={(e) => setPlan(e.detail.value)}>
  <UiStructuredListRow head>
    <UiStructuredListCell>Plan</UiStructuredListCell>
    <UiStructuredListCell>Users</UiStructuredListCell>
    <UiStructuredListCell>Price</UiStructuredListCell>
  </UiStructuredListRow>
  <UiStructuredListRow value="basic">
    <UiStructuredListCell>Basic</UiStructuredListCell>
    <UiStructuredListCell>Up to 5</UiStructuredListCell>
    <UiStructuredListCell>Free</UiStructuredListCell>
  </UiStructuredListRow>
  {/* … team, enterprise */}
</UiStructuredList>
<p>Value: <output>{plan}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [plan, setPlan] = useState('team');

<StructuredList label="Choose a plan" selection value={plan} onChange={setPlan}>
  <StructuredListRow head>
    <StructuredListCell>Plan</StructuredListCell>
    <StructuredListCell>Users</StructuredListCell>
    <StructuredListCell>Price</StructuredListCell>
  </StructuredListRow>
  <StructuredListRow value="basic">
    <StructuredListCell>Basic</StructuredListCell>
    <StructuredListCell>Up to 5</StructuredListCell>
    <StructuredListCell>Free</StructuredListCell>
  </StructuredListRow>
  {/* … team, enterprise */}
</StructuredList>
<p>Value: <output>{plan}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind also takes `defaultValue` for an uncontrolled list. Without a `value` (or with one no row has), no row is selected and Tab stops on the first row.

## Change the choice from your code

Set `value` to select a row from your own code, for example from a "Use the recommended plan" button. Setting it doesn't fire `ui-change`: that event is for the user's own picks.


HTML:

```html
<ui-structured-list id="structured-list-method" label="Delivery method" selection condensed>
  <ui-structured-list-row head>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Method</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Arrives</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
  <ui-structured-list-row value="email">
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Signed PDF by email</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Today</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
  <ui-structured-list-row value="post">
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Registered post</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>3–5 days</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
  <ui-structured-list-row value="courier">
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Courier</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Next day</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
</ui-structured-list>
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
  <ui-button id="structured-list-method-recommend" kind="tertiary" size="sm">Use the recommended method</ui-button>
  <ui-button id="structured-list-method-clear" kind="ghost" size="sm">Clear</ui-button>
</div>

<script type="module">
  const list = document.getElementById('structured-list-method');
  document.getElementById('structured-list-method-recommend').addEventListener('click', () => (list.value = 'email'));
  document.getElementById('structured-list-method-clear').addEventListener('click', () => (list.value = ''));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [method, setMethod] = useState('');

<UiStructuredList label="Delivery method" selection condensed value={method} onUiChange={(e) => setMethod(e.detail.value)}>
  {/* head row, then rows with value="email", "post", "courier" */}
</UiStructuredList>
<UiButton kind="tertiary" size="sm" onClick={() => setMethod('email')}>Use the recommended method</UiButton>
<UiButton kind="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setMethod('')}>Clear</UiButton>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [method, setMethod] = useState('');

<StructuredList label="Delivery method" selection condensed value={method} onChange={setMethod}>
  {/* head row, then rows with value="email", "post", "courier" */}
</StructuredList>
<Button kind="tertiary" size="sm" onClick={() => setMethod('email')}>Use the recommended method</Button>
<Button kind="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setMethod('')}>Clear</Button>
```

## Names for screen readers

`label` names the table (default: "Structured list section"). In a selection list, each row's radio is named by the row's text; when that text is long, give the row a short `aria-label`. `selection-label` (`selectionLabel` in React + Tailwind) names the radio column (default: "Select").


HTML:

```html
<ui-structured-list label="Signing order" selection selection-label="Sign first" value="md">
  <ui-structured-list-row head>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Signer</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Why</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
  <ui-structured-list-row value="md" aria-label="Managing director">
    <ui-structured-list-cell nowrap>Managing director</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Signs for the company; the other signers follow the director's copy.</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
  <ui-structured-list-row value="counsel" aria-label="Legal counsel">
    <ui-structured-list-cell nowrap>Legal counsel</ui-structured-list-cell>
    <ui-structured-list-cell>Checks the final wording before anyone signs, then initials every page.</ui-structured-list-cell>
  </ui-structured-list-row>
</ui-structured-list>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiStructuredList label="Signing order" selection selectionLabel="Sign first" value="md">
  {/* head row */}
  <UiStructuredListRow value="md" aria-label="Managing director">…</UiStructuredListRow>
  <UiStructuredListRow value="counsel" aria-label="Legal counsel">…</UiStructuredListRow>
</UiStructuredList>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<StructuredList label="Signing order" selection selectionLabel="Sign first" defaultValue="md">
  {/* head row */}
  <StructuredListRow value="md" aria-label="Managing director">…</StructuredListRow>
  <StructuredListRow value="counsel" aria-label="Legal counsel">…</StructuredListRow>
</StructuredList>
```

## Skeleton

While the rows load, show `ui-structured-list-skeleton`: a header of three bars and `rows` empty rows (default 5). It is hidden from screen readers, so say "loading" on the container (for example `aria-busy`).


HTML:

```html
<ui-structured-list-skeleton rows="3"></ui-structured-list-skeleton>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiStructuredListSkeleton } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiStructuredListSkeleton rows={3} />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { StructuredListSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/structured-list';

<StructuredListSkeleton rows={3} />
```

On the web component, import it from `@purpurabog/ui/structured-list-skeleton`.

## Accessibility

- The list is a `role="table"` with `row`, `cell` and `columnheader` roles; React + Tailwind renders a real `<table>`.
- In a selection list, the rows' radios form one group: Tab reaches the selected row (else the first), and the arrow keys move and select, wrapping at the ends. Each radio says "1 of 3".
- The selected row is `aria-selected`. Focus draws a 2px outline around the whole row.
- A selection list isn't a form field: read `value` and send it yourself.

Unstyled React parts with the same behaviour: [Headless Structured list](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-structured-list/).

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

# Pagination

Pagination splits a long list into pages: "Items per page", the range shown, a page select and previous / next buttons (Carbon `Pagination`). Put it under a table or a list. It only holds the page and the page size; showing the right rows is your code's.


HTML:

```html
<ui-pagination total-items="95"></ui-pagination>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiPagination totalItems={95} />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Pagination totalItems={95} />
```

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/pagination
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-pagination
```

Manual:

```bash
# Web component
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install lit@^3.3.0
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/pagination.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/primitives/pagination/pagination.ts
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-pagination, shared-element, shared-field, shared-localize, tokens

# React + Tailwind
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install @purpurabog/ui@^1.4.3
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tw-pagination.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/react-tw/pagination.tsx
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-i18n, core-pagination, tw-i18n, tw-theme, tw-utils
```

npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Use it


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">import '@purpurabog/ui/pagination';</script>

<ui-pagination total-items="95" page-size="25"></ui-pagination>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiPagination } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiPagination totalItems={95} pageSize={25} />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { Pagination } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/pagination';

<Pagination totalItems={95} defaultPageSize={25} />
```

## Pagination or pagination nav?

| Component | Use it when |
|---|---|
| Pagination | Under a table or a list of data: the user picks the page size and jumps to any page. The total may be unknown. |
| [Pagination nav](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/pagination-nav/) | Page numbers as links, for search results or an article list, where each page has its own URL. |

A [data table](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/data-table/#pages) has this pagination built in: set its `page-size`.

## Page and page size

`page` (from 1) and `page-size` set where the bar starts; `page-sizes` lists the page-size choices (default `10,25,50`). `ui-change` fires with `{ page, pageSize }` after the user changes either. A new page size goes back to page 1, as in Carbon.


HTML:

```html
<ui-pagination id="pagination-change" total-items="230" page="3" page-size="20" page-sizes="20,50,100"></ui-pagination>
<p>Page: <output id="pagination-change-page">3</output>, page size: <output id="pagination-change-size">20</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const bar = document.getElementById('pagination-change');
  bar.addEventListener('ui-change', (event) => {
    document.getElementById('pagination-change-page').value = event.detail.page;
    document.getElementById('pagination-change-size').value = event.detail.pageSize;
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [paging, setPaging] = useState({ page: 3, pageSize: 20 });

<UiPagination totalItems={230} page={paging.page} pageSize={paging.pageSize} pageSizes="20,50,100" onUiChange={(e) => setPaging(e.detail)} />
<p>Page: <output>{paging.page}</output>, page size: <output>{paging.pageSize}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [paging, setPaging] = useState({ page: 3, pageSize: 20 });

<Pagination totalItems={230} page={paging.page} pageSize={paging.pageSize} pageSizes={[20, 50, 100]} onChange={setPaging} />
<p>Page: <output>{paging.page}</output>, page size: <output>{paging.pageSize}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind takes `pageSizes` as an array of numbers, and `defaultPage` / `defaultPageSize` when the bar keeps the state itself.

## Show the rows of the page

Slice your rows with the page and the page size from `ui-change`. When the data comes from a server, ask it for that page instead and keep `total-items` at the server's count.


HTML:

```html
<ol id="pagination-list" style="margin: 0; padding-inline-start: 24px"></ol>
<ui-pagination id="pagination-list-bar" total-items="23" page-size="5" page-sizes="5,10"></ui-pagination>

<script type="module">
  const contracts = Array.from({ length: 23 }, (_, i) => `Contract ${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`);
  const list = document.getElementById('pagination-list');
  const bar = document.getElementById('pagination-list-bar');
  const show = ({ page, pageSize }) => {
    const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;
    list.start = start + 1;
    list.replaceChildren(...contracts.slice(start, start + pageSize).map((name) => Object.assign(document.createElement('li'), { textContent: name })));
  };
  show({ page: 1, pageSize: 5 });
  bar.addEventListener('ui-change', (event) => show(event.detail));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const contracts = Array.from({ length: 23 }, (_, i) => `Contract ${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`);
const [paging, setPaging] = useState({ page: 1, pageSize: 5 });
const start = (paging.page - 1) * paging.pageSize;

<ol start={start + 1}>
  {contracts.slice(start, start + paging.pageSize).map((name) => <li key={name}>{name}</li>)}
</ol>
<UiPagination totalItems={contracts.length} page={paging.page} pageSize={paging.pageSize} pageSizes="5,10" onUiChange={(e) => setPaging(e.detail)} />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const contracts = Array.from({ length: 23 }, (_, i) => `Contract ${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}`);
const [paging, setPaging] = useState({ page: 1, pageSize: 5 });
const start = (paging.page - 1) * paging.pageSize;

<ol start={start + 1}>
  {contracts.slice(start, start + paging.pageSize).map((name) => <li key={name}>{name}</li>)}
</ol>
<Pagination totalItems={contracts.length} page={paging.page} pageSize={paging.pageSize} pageSizes={[5, 10]} onChange={setPaging} />
```

## Sizes

`size`: `sm` 32px, `md` 40px (the default), `lg` 48px. Match the rows of the table above it.


HTML:

```html
<ui-pagination size="sm" total-items="40"></ui-pagination>
<ui-pagination total-items="40"></ui-pagination>
<ui-pagination size="lg" total-items="40"></ui-pagination>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiPagination size="sm" totalItems={40} />
<UiPagination totalItems={40} />
<UiPagination size="lg" totalItems={40} />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Pagination size="sm" totalItems={40} />
<Pagination totalItems={40} />
<Pagination size="lg" totalItems={40} />
```

## A fixed page size

An empty `page-sizes` hides "Items per page" when the page size is fixed, for example in a narrow panel.


HTML:

```html
<div style="max-width: 480px">
  <ui-pagination total-items="48" page-size="12" page-sizes=""></ui-pagination>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiPagination totalItems={48} pageSize={12} pageSizes="" />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Pagination totalItems={48} defaultPageSize={12} pageSizes={[]} />
```

## Total unknown

With `pages-unknown` the bar doesn't need `total-items`: the page select becomes plain text ("page 3") and the range has no total. Use it with cursor-based APIs that only say whether there is a next page. Set `is-last-page` when the server says there is none, so Next disables.


HTML:

```html
<ui-pagination id="pagination-cursor" pages-unknown page-size="25" page-sizes=""></ui-pagination>
<p>The demo's server has 4 pages.</p>

<script type="module">
  const bar = document.getElementById('pagination-cursor');
  bar.addEventListener('ui-change', (event) => {
    // ask the server for the page; here, page 4 is the last one
    bar.isLastPage = event.detail.page >= 4;
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
const [last, setLast] = useState(false);

<UiPagination pagesUnknown isLastPage={last} page={page} pageSize={25} pageSizes="" onUiChange={async (e) => {
  setPage(e.detail.page);
  setLast(!(await fetchPage(e.detail.page)).hasNext);
}} />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Pagination pagesUnknown isLastPage={last} page={page} defaultPageSize={25} pageSizes={[]} onChange={async ({ page }) => {
  setPage(page);
  setLast(!(await fetchPage(page)).hasNext);
}} />
```

## Texts

Every text can be replaced. The range and page texts are templates: `{min}`, `{max}`, `{total}` and `{page}` are filled in. Without them the bar uses its translation, in English or Thai from the page's `lang`. An empty text shows nothing, as in Carbon.


HTML:

```html
<ui-pagination
  total-items="57"
  items-per-page-text="Contracts per page:"
  item-range-text="{min}–{max} of {total} contracts"
  page-range-text="of {total}"
  page-text="Page {page}"
  page-select-label="Go to page"
  previous-label="Previous contracts"
  next-label="Next contracts"
></ui-pagination>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiPagination
  totalItems={57}
  itemsPerPageText="Contracts per page:"
  itemRangeText="{min}–{max} of {total} contracts"
  pageRangeText="of {total}"
  pageText="Page {page}"
  pageSelectLabel="Go to page"
  previousLabel="Previous contracts"
  nextLabel="Next contracts"
/>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Pagination
  totalItems={57}
  itemsPerPageText="Contracts per page:"
  itemRangeText="{min}–{max} of {total} contracts"
  pageRangeText="of {total}"
  pageText="Page {page}"
  pageSelectLabel="Go to page"
  previousLabel="Previous contracts"
  nextLabel="Next contracts"
/>
```

`item-text` is the range while the total is unknown (`{min}–{max} items`).

## Disabled

`disabled` turns off both selects and both buttons, for example while the next page loads.


HTML:

```html
<ui-pagination total-items="95" page="2" disabled></ui-pagination>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiPagination totalItems={95} page={2} disabled />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Pagination totalItems={95} defaultPage={2} disabled />
```

## Accessibility

- The page-size select has a visible label; the page select is named "Page number" (`page-select-label`).
- The arrows are named "Previous page" and "Next page" (`previous-label`, `next-label`). On the first or last page the pressed arrow disables, and focus moves to the other one instead of falling to the page.
- The selects are native, so the browser's own keys and the phone's picker work.
- Tell screen reader users that the rows changed, for example with a polite status line ("Showing 21–40 of 230").

Unstyled React parts with the same behaviour: [Headless Pagination](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-pagination/).

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-pagination>` · React `UiPagination`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | `page` | `number` | `1` | 1-based current page. |
| `page-size` | `pageSize` | `number` | `10` |  |
| `page-sizes` | `pageSizes` | `string` | `'10,25,50'` | Choices for the page-size select, e.g. "10,25,50". Empty hides the select. |
| `total-items` | `totalItems` | `number` | `0` |  |
| `pages-unknown` | `pagesUnknown` | `boolean` | `false` | Total unknown: no page select, next never disabled (Carbon `pagesUnknown`). |
| `is-last-page` | `isLastPage` | `boolean` | `false` | With `pages-unknown`: this is the last page, so Next is disabled (Carbon `isLastPage`; cursor-based APIs). |
| `size` | `size` | `PaginationSize` | `'md'` |  |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `items-per-page-text` | `itemsPerPageText` | `string \| undefined` |  |  |
| `item-range-text` | `itemRangeText` | `string \| undefined` |  |  |
| `item-text` | `itemText` | `string \| undefined` |  | Range text while the total is unknown. |
| `page-range-text` | `pageRangeText` | `string \| undefined` |  |  |
| `page-text` | `pageText` | `string \| undefined` |  | Label of each page option and the page text while unknown. |
| `page-select-label` | `pageSelectLabel` | `string \| undefined` |  |  |
| `previous-label` | `previousLabel` | `string \| undefined` |  |  |
| `next-label` | `nextLabel` | `string \| undefined` |  |  |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `focus(options)` | Focus the first control that shows (the page-size select; narrow, an arrow). |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-change` | `onUiChange` | detail: { page, pageSize } after the user changed either |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `base` | The bar |
| `page-size-select` | The items-per-page select |
| `range` | The item range text |
| `page-select` | The page select |
| `pages` | The "of N pages" text |
| `previous-button` | Previous page |
| `next-button` | Next page |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-pagination-border` |  | / --ui-pagination-background / --ui-pagination-divider - The bar's top rule, fill and the rules between its parts (default hairline, the layer, hairline; Kanok: open, undivided) |
| `--ui-pagination-gap` |  | / --ui-pagination-range-ink - Space within each side and the range text colour (default none, ink) |
| `--ui-pagination-select-border` |  | / --ui-pagination-select-radius / --ui-pagination-button-radius - The selects' outline and corners, the arrows' corners (default none, 0, 0; Kanok: outlined 6px selects, round arrows) |
| `--ui-focus-offset` |  | `outline-offset` of its focus ring (default -2px: inside; Kanok: 2px outside) |

# Contained list

A contained list is a titled list of rows separated by thin rules, for settings panels, side panels and tiles (Carbon `ContainedList`). A row can carry an icon and an action, or be a button itself.


HTML:

```html
<div style="max-width: 480px">
  <ui-contained-list label="Documents">
    <ui-icon-button slot="action" label="Add document">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M8.5 7.5V3h-1v4.5H3v1h4.5V13h1V8.5H13v-1z" /></svg>
    </ui-icon-button>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Service agreement.pdf</ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Appendix A – Price list.pdf</ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Power of attorney.pdf</ui-contained-list-item>
  </ui-contained-list>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiContainedList label="Documents">
  <UiIconButton slot="action" label="Add document">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M8.5 7.5V3h-1v4.5H3v1h4.5V13h1V8.5H13v-1z" /></svg>
  </UiIconButton>
  <UiContainedListItem>Service agreement.pdf</UiContainedListItem>
  <UiContainedListItem>Appendix A – Price list.pdf</UiContainedListItem>
  <UiContainedListItem>Power of attorney.pdf</UiContainedListItem>
</UiContainedList>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ContainedList
  label="Documents"
  action={<IconButton label="Add document"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M8.5 7.5V3h-1v4.5H3v1h4.5V13h1V8.5H13v-1z" /></svg></IconButton>}
>
  <ContainedListItem>Service agreement.pdf</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Appendix A – Price list.pdf</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Power of attorney.pdf</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/contained-list
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-contained-list
```

Manual:

```bash
# Web component
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install lit@^3.3.0
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/contained-list.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/primitives/contained-list/contained-list-item.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/contained-list/contained-list.ts
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    shared-element, shared-field, shared-slots, tokens

# React + Tailwind
# 1. Install the dependencies
# (none)
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tw-contained-list.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/react-tw/contained-list.tsx
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    tw-theme, tw-utils
```

npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Use it


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">import '@purpurabog/ui/contained-list';</script>

<ui-contained-list label="Documents">
  <ui-contained-list-item>Service agreement.pdf</ui-contained-list-item>
  <ui-contained-list-item>Power of attorney.pdf</ui-contained-list-item>
</ui-contained-list>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiContainedList, UiContainedListItem } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiContainedList label="Documents">
  <UiContainedListItem>Service agreement.pdf</UiContainedListItem>
  <UiContainedListItem>Power of attorney.pdf</UiContainedListItem>
</UiContainedList>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { ContainedList, ContainedListItem } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/contained-list';

<ContainedList label="Documents">
  <ContainedListItem>Service agreement.pdf</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Power of attorney.pdf</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

## On the page or in a layer

`kind="on-page"` (the default) has a 48px header in the heading style, on the page background. `kind="disclosed"` has a small 32px label on the layer: use it inside a tile, a side panel or under a disclosure. On-page lists that follow each other sit 16px apart.


HTML:

```html
<div style="max-width: 480px">
  <ui-contained-list label="Approvers">
    <ui-contained-list-item>Anan P., Managing director</ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Kanya S., Legal counsel</ui-contained-list-item>
  </ui-contained-list>
  <ui-contained-list label="Watchers">
    <ui-contained-list-item>Finance department</ui-contained-list-item>
  </ui-contained-list>
</div>
<div style="max-width: 480px; padding: 16px; background: var(--ui-layer-1)">
  <ui-contained-list label="Recent contracts" kind="disclosed">
    <ui-contained-list-item>Lease renewal – Initech</ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>NDA – Globex</ui-contained-list-item>
  </ui-contained-list>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiContainedList label="Approvers">
  <UiContainedListItem>Anan P., Managing director</UiContainedListItem>
  <UiContainedListItem>Kanya S., Legal counsel</UiContainedListItem>
</UiContainedList>
<UiContainedList label="Watchers">
  <UiContainedListItem>Finance department</UiContainedListItem>
</UiContainedList>

<UiContainedList label="Recent contracts" kind="disclosed">
  <UiContainedListItem>Lease renewal – Initech</UiContainedListItem>
  <UiContainedListItem>NDA – Globex</UiContainedListItem>
</UiContainedList>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ContainedList label="Approvers">
  <ContainedListItem>Anan P., Managing director</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Kanya S., Legal counsel</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
<ContainedList label="Watchers">
  <ContainedListItem>Finance department</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>

<ContainedList label="Recent contracts" kind="disclosed">
  <ContainedListItem>Lease renewal – Initech</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>NDA – Globex</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

## Sizes

`size` sets the row height: `sm` 32px, `md` 40px, `lg` 48px (the default), `xl` 64px. An on-page header takes the same height.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: grid; gap: 24px; max-width: 480px">
  <ui-contained-list label="Small" size="sm">
    <ui-contained-list-item>Service agreement.pdf</ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Appendix A.pdf</ui-contained-list-item>
  </ui-contained-list>
  <ui-contained-list label="Extra large" size="xl">
    <ui-contained-list-item>Service agreement.pdf</ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Appendix A.pdf</ui-contained-list-item>
  </ui-contained-list>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiContainedList label="Small" size="sm">…</UiContainedList>
<UiContainedList label="Extra large" size="xl">…</UiContainedList>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ContainedList label="Small" size="sm">…</ContainedList>
<ContainedList label="Extra large" size="xl">…</ContainedList>
```

## Icons

Put a 16px icon in a row's `icon` slot (`icon` in React + Tailwind). It sits before the text and takes Carbon's icon colour.


HTML:

```html
<div style="max-width: 480px">
  <ui-contained-list label="Contract folder">
    <ui-contained-list-item>
      <svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M13 3.6 10.4 1H3v14h10zM10 2.4 11.6 4H10zM4 14V2h5v3h3v9z" /></svg>
      Service agreement.pdf
    </ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>
      <svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M14 4H8.6L7.3 2.3A1 1 0 0 0 6.5 2H2a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h12a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V5a1 1 0 0 0-1-1ZM2 3h4.5l1.3 1.7A1 1 0 0 0 8.6 5H14v1H2Zm0 10V7h12v6Z" /></svg>
      Appendices
    </ui-contained-list-item>
  </ui-contained-list>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiContainedList label="Contract folder">
  <UiContainedListItem>
    <svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M13 3.6 10.4 1H3v14h10zM10 2.4 11.6 4H10zM4 14V2h5v3h3v9z" /></svg>
    Service agreement.pdf
  </UiContainedListItem>
  <UiContainedListItem>
    <svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16">{folderPath}</svg>
    Appendices
  </UiContainedListItem>
</UiContainedList>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ContainedList label="Contract folder">
  <ContainedListItem icon={<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M13 3.6 10.4 1H3v14h10zM10 2.4 11.6 4H10zM4 14V2h5v3h3v9z" /></svg>}>
    Service agreement.pdf
  </ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem icon={<svg viewBox="0 0 16 16">{folderPath}</svg>}>Appendices</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

## An action on each row

The `action` slot (`action` in React + Tailwind) holds a control at the row's end, such as a small icon button. It stays a control of its own: pressing it doesn't press the row. Here Remove takes the row out.


HTML:

```html
<div style="max-width: 480px">
  <ui-contained-list id="contained-list-files" label="Attachments">
    <ui-contained-list-item>
      Service agreement.pdf
      <ui-icon-button slot="action" label="Remove Service agreement.pdf" size="sm">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M6 6h1v6H6zm3 0h1v6H9z" /><path d="M2 3v1h1v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h8a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V4h1V3Zm2 11V4h8v10ZM6 1h4v1H6z" /></svg>
      </ui-icon-button>
    </ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>
      Appendix A.pdf
      <ui-icon-button slot="action" label="Remove Appendix A.pdf" size="sm">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M6 6h1v6H6zm3 0h1v6H9z" /><path d="M2 3v1h1v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h8a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V4h1V3Zm2 11V4h8v10ZM6 1h4v1H6z" /></svg>
      </ui-icon-button>
    </ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>
      Appendix B.pdf
      <ui-icon-button slot="action" label="Remove Appendix B.pdf" size="sm">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M6 6h1v6H6zm3 0h1v6H9z" /><path d="M2 3v1h1v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h8a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V4h1V3Zm2 11V4h8v10ZM6 1h4v1H6z" /></svg>
      </ui-icon-button>
    </ui-contained-list-item>
  </ui-contained-list>
</div>

<script type="module">
  const list = document.getElementById('contained-list-files');
  list.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    const button = event.target.closest('ui-icon-button');
    if (!button) return;
    const row = button.closest('ui-contained-list-item');
    // keep focus in the list: on the next row's button, else the previous one's
    const next = row.nextElementSibling ?? row.previousElementSibling;
    row.remove();
    next?.querySelector('ui-icon-button')?.focus();
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [files, setFiles] = useState(['Service agreement.pdf', 'Appendix A.pdf', 'Appendix B.pdf']);

<UiContainedList label="Attachments">
  {files.map((name) => (
    <UiContainedListItem key={name}>
      {name}
      <UiIconButton slot="action" label={`Remove ${name}`} size="sm" onClick={() => setFiles(files.filter((f) => f !== name))}>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16">{trashPaths}</svg>
      </UiIconButton>
    </UiContainedListItem>
  ))}
</UiContainedList>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [files, setFiles] = useState(['Service agreement.pdf', 'Appendix A.pdf', 'Appendix B.pdf']);

<ContainedList label="Attachments">
  {files.map((name) => (
    <ContainedListItem
      key={name}
      action={
        <IconButton label={`Remove ${name}`} size="sm" onClick={() => setFiles(files.filter((f) => f !== name))}>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16">{trashPaths}</svg>
        </IconButton>
      }
    >
      {name}
    </ContainedListItem>
  ))}
</ContainedList>
```

When a row goes away, move focus to a nearby row's control, as the demo does, so keyboard users don't land at the top of the page.

## Tags and other trailing content

The `action` slot also takes non-interactive content, such as a status tag. Give it a small margin so it lines up with the text.


HTML:

```html
<div style="max-width: 480px">
  <ui-contained-list label="Signers">
    <ui-contained-list-item>Anan P.<ui-tag slot="action" type="green" size="sm" style="margin: 8px 16px 0 0">Signed</ui-tag></ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Kanya S.<ui-tag slot="action" type="gray" size="sm" style="margin: 8px 16px 0 0">Pending</ui-tag></ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Somchai D.<ui-tag slot="action" type="red" size="sm" style="margin: 8px 16px 0 0">Declined</ui-tag></ui-contained-list-item>
  </ui-contained-list>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiContainedList label="Signers">
  <UiContainedListItem>Anan P.<UiTag slot="action" type="green" size="sm" style={{ margin: '8px 16px 0 0' }}>Signed</UiTag></UiContainedListItem>
  <UiContainedListItem>Kanya S.<UiTag slot="action" type="gray" size="sm" style={{ margin: '8px 16px 0 0' }}>Pending</UiTag></UiContainedListItem>
  <UiContainedListItem>Somchai D.<UiTag slot="action" type="red" size="sm" style={{ margin: '8px 16px 0 0' }}>Declined</UiTag></UiContainedListItem>
</UiContainedList>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ContainedList label="Signers">
  <ContainedListItem action={<Tag type="green" size="sm" className="me-4">Signed</Tag>}>Anan P.</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem action={<Tag type="gray" size="sm" className="me-4">Pending</Tag>}>Kanya S.</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem action={<Tag type="red" size="sm" className="me-4">Declined</Tag>}>Somchai D.</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

React + Tailwind centres the action in the row by itself, so the tag only needs the end margin.

## Clickable rows

`clickable` makes the whole row a button: it fires `ui-click` when pressed (`onClick` in React + Tailwind makes the row a button). `disabled` greys a clickable row out.


HTML:

```html
<div style="max-width: 480px">
  <ui-contained-list id="contained-list-open" label="Open a document">
    <ui-contained-list-item clickable>Service agreement.pdf</ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item clickable>Appendix A.pdf</ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item clickable disabled>Draft – being edited by Kanya S.</ui-contained-list-item>
  </ui-contained-list>
</div>
<p>Opened: <output id="contained-list-open-out"></output></p>

<script type="module">
  const list = document.getElementById('contained-list-open');
  const out = document.getElementById('contained-list-open-out');
  list.addEventListener('ui-click', (event) => (out.value = event.target.textContent.trim()));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [opened, setOpened] = useState('');

<UiContainedList label="Open a document">
  <UiContainedListItem clickable onUiClick={() => setOpened('Service agreement.pdf')}>Service agreement.pdf</UiContainedListItem>
  <UiContainedListItem clickable onUiClick={() => setOpened('Appendix A.pdf')}>Appendix A.pdf</UiContainedListItem>
  <UiContainedListItem clickable disabled>Draft – being edited by Kanya S.</UiContainedListItem>
</UiContainedList>
<p>Opened: <output>{opened}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [opened, setOpened] = useState('');

<ContainedList label="Open a document">
  <ContainedListItem onClick={() => setOpened('Service agreement.pdf')}>Service agreement.pdf</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem onClick={() => setOpened('Appendix A.pdf')}>Appendix A.pdf</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem onClick={() => setOpened('Draft')} disabled>Draft – being edited by Kanya S.</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
<p>Opened: <output>{opened}</output></p>
```

A clickable row can still have an `action`: the action stays a separate button beside it.

## Search in the header

The header's `action` slot also takes a search. An expandable search stays a magnifier until it is pressed. Filter the rows yourself as the user types.


HTML:

```html
<div style="max-width: 480px">
  <ui-contained-list id="contained-list-search" label="Departments">
    <ui-search slot="action" size="lg" expandable label="Filter departments" placeholder="Filter departments"></ui-search>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Sales</ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Legal</ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Finance</ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Human resources</ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Procurement</ui-contained-list-item>
  </ui-contained-list>
</div>

<script type="module">
  const list = document.getElementById('contained-list-search');
  const search = list.querySelector('ui-search');
  const filter = () => {
    const text = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    for (const row of list.querySelectorAll('ui-contained-list-item')) row.style.display = row.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(text) ? '' : 'none';
  };
  search.addEventListener('input', filter);
  search.addEventListener('ui-clear', filter);
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
import type { UiSearch as SearchElement } from '@purpurabog/ui';

const departments = ['Sales', 'Legal', 'Finance', 'Human resources', 'Procurement'];
const [text, setText] = useState('');

<UiContainedList label="Departments">
  <UiSearch slot="action" size="lg" expandable label="Filter departments" placeholder="Filter departments" value={text} onInput={(e) => setText((e.target as SearchElement).value)} onUiClear={() => setText('')} />
  {departments.filter((d) => d.toLowerCase().includes(text.trim().toLowerCase())).map((d) => (
    <UiContainedListItem key={d}>{d}</UiContainedListItem>
  ))}
</UiContainedList>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const departments = ['Sales', 'Legal', 'Finance', 'Human resources', 'Procurement'];
const [text, setText] = useState('');

<ContainedList
  label="Departments"
  action={<Search size="lg" expandable label="Filter departments" placeholder="Filter departments" value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} onClear={() => setText('')} />}
>
  {departments.filter((d) => d.toLowerCase().includes(text.trim().toLowerCase())).map((d) => (
    <ContainedListItem key={d}>{d}</ContainedListItem>
  ))}
</ContainedList>
```

## Inset rules

`inset` stops the rules between rows at the row padding instead of running edge to edge (Carbon `isInset`). It reads lighter in a tile.


HTML:

```html
<div style="max-width: 480px">
  <ui-contained-list label="Contract terms" inset>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Duration: 12 months</ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Notice period: 60 days</ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Payment: within 30 days</ui-contained-list-item>
  </ui-contained-list>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiContainedList label="Contract terms" inset>
  <UiContainedListItem>Duration: 12 months</UiContainedListItem>
  <UiContainedListItem>Notice period: 60 days</UiContainedListItem>
  <UiContainedListItem>Payment: within 30 days</UiContainedListItem>
</UiContainedList>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ContainedList label="Contract terms" inset>
  <ContainedListItem>Duration: 12 months</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Notice period: 60 days</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Payment: within 30 days</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

## A rich label

For markup in the header, such as a count, put it in the `label` slot instead of the `label` attribute. React + Tailwind takes markup in `label`.


HTML:

```html
<div style="max-width: 480px">
  <ui-contained-list>
    <span slot="label">Waiting for approval <span style="color: var(--ui-ink-muted); font-weight: 400">(2)</span></span>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Lease renewal – Initech</ui-contained-list-item>
    <ui-contained-list-item>Software licence – Hooli</ui-contained-list-item>
  </ui-contained-list>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiContainedList>
  <span slot="label">Waiting for approval <span className="count">(2)</span></span>
  <UiContainedListItem>Lease renewal – Initech</UiContainedListItem>
  <UiContainedListItem>Software licence – Hooli</UiContainedListItem>
</UiContainedList>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ContainedList label={<>Waiting for approval <span className="font-normal text-ink-muted">(2)</span></>}>
  <ContainedListItem>Lease renewal – Initech</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Software licence – Hooli</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

## Accessibility

- The rows are a `role="list"` of `listitem`s, named by the header label (`aria-labelledby`). React + Tailwind renders a real `<ul>` and `<li>`s.
- A clickable row is a native `<button>`: Tab reaches it, Enter and Space press it. A disabled row is skipped.
- Name every icon-only action with its row, for example "Remove Appendix A.pdf", so the buttons differ for screen reader users.
- The header stays at the top while the list scrolls in a box (`position: sticky`).

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-contained-list>` · React `UiContainedList`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `kind` | `kind` | `ContainedListKind` | `'on-page'` |  |
| `size` | `size` | `ContainedListSize` | `'lg'` |  |
| `inset` | `inset` | `boolean` | `false` | Rules stop at the row padding instead of running edge to edge (Carbon `isInset`). |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | `<ui-contained-list-item>` elements |
| `label` | Rich label |
| `action` | Header action (search, icon button) |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `header` | The sticky header row |
| `label` | The label |
| `action` | The header action wrapper |
| `list` | The `role=list` container |

### `<ui-contained-list-item>` · React `UiContainedListItem`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `clickable` | `clickable` | `boolean` | `false` | Render the row as a button. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-click` | `onUiClick` | Clickable rows, when activated |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Row content |
| `icon` | 16px icon |
| `action` | Trailing action |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `content` | The row body (a button when `clickable`) |
| `action` | The action wrapper |

# Tree view

A tree view shows nested items, such as folders, a chart of accounts or an organisation's departments (Carbon `TreeView`). Branches open and close; the user selects a node with a click or the keyboard.


HTML:

```html
<div style="max-width: 360px">
  <ui-tree-view label="Folders">
    <ui-tree-node label="Contracts" value="contracts" expanded>
      <ui-tree-node label="2026" value="2026" expanded>
        <ui-tree-node label="Service agreement – Acme" value="c1"></ui-tree-node>
```

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tree-view
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-tree-view
```

Manual:

```bash
# Web component
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install lit@^3.3.0
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tree-view.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/primitives/tree-view/tree-node.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tree-view/tree-view-shared.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tree-view/tree-view.ts
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-tree, core-typeahead, shared-element, shared-field, shared-localize, shared-navigate, shared-slots, tokens

# React + Tailwind
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install @purpurabog/ui@^1.4.3
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tw-tree-view.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/react-tw/tree-view.tsx
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-tree, tw-field, tw-i18n, tw-theme, tw-utils
```

npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Use it


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">import '@purpurabog/ui/tree-view';</script>

<ui-tree-view label="Folders">
  <ui-tree-node label="Contracts" value="contracts">
    <ui-tree-node label="Service agreement" value="c1"></ui-tree-node>
  </ui-tree-node>
</ui-tree-view>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiTreeView, UiTreeNode } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiTreeView label="Folders">
  <UiTreeNode label="Contracts" value="contracts">
    <UiTreeNode label="Service agreement" value="c1" />
  </UiTreeNode>
</UiTreeView>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { TreeView, TreeNode } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/tree-view';

<TreeView label="Folders">
  <TreeNode label="Contracts" value="contracts">
    <TreeNode label="Service agreement" value="c1" />
  </TreeNode>
</TreeView>
```

A node with child nodes is a branch. `value` identifies a node in the selection; without it the `label` does.

## Selection and the active node

A click, Space or Enter selects a node and makes it the active one (a 4px bar at its start). `ui-select` fires with `{ selected, value }` after the selection changes, `ui-activate` with `{ active }`. Set `selected` (a property: an array of values) and `active` to start with a node chosen; open its branches so it shows.


HTML:

```html
<div style="max-width: 360px">
  <ui-tree-view id="tree-view-select" label="Departments" active="legal">
    <ui-tree-node label="Head office" value="hq" expanded>
      <ui-tree-node label="Legal" value="legal"></ui-tree-node>
      <ui-tree-node label="Finance" value="finance"></ui-tree-node>
    </ui-tree-node>
    <ui-tree-node label="Branches" value="branches">
      <ui-tree-node label="Chiang Mai" value="cnx"></ui-tree-node>
      <ui-tree-node label="Phuket" value="hkt"></ui-tree-node>
    </ui-tree-node>
  </ui-tree-view>
</div>
<p>Selected: <output id="tree-view-select-out">legal</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const tree = document.getElementById('tree-view-select');
  tree.selected = ['legal'];
  tree.addEventListener('ui-select', (event) => {
    document.getElementById('tree-view-select-out').value = event.detail.selected.join(', ');
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [selected, setSelected] = useState(['legal']);

<UiTreeView label="Departments" selected={selected} active="legal" onUiSelect={(e) => setSelected(e.detail.selected)}>
  <UiTreeNode label="Head office" value="hq" expanded>
    <UiTreeNode label="Legal" value="legal" />
    <UiTreeNode label="Finance" value="finance" />
  </UiTreeNode>
  {/* … */}
</UiTreeView>
<p>Selected: <output>{selected.join(', ')}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string[]>(['legal']);

<TreeView label="Departments" selected={selected} defaultActive="legal" onSelect={(next) => setSelected(next)}>
  <TreeNode label="Head office" value="hq" defaultExpanded>
    <TreeNode label="Legal" value="legal" />
    <TreeNode label="Finance" value="finance" />
  </TreeNode>
  {/* … */}
</TreeView>
<p>Selected: <output>{selected.join(', ')}</output></p>
```

## Open and close branches from code

`expanded` opens a branch. Set it from your code, for example for an "Expand all" button; `ui-toggle` fires with `{ expanded, value }` each time a branch opens or closes (`onToggle` on a React + Tailwind `TreeNode`).


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
  <ui-button id="tree-view-expand-all" kind="ghost" size="sm">Expand all</ui-button>
  <ui-button id="tree-view-collapse-all" kind="ghost" size="sm">Collapse all</ui-button>
</div>
<div style="max-width: 360px">
  <ui-tree-view id="tree-view-toggle" label="Organisation">
    <ui-tree-node label="Head office" value="hq">
      <ui-tree-node label="Legal" value="legal">
        <ui-tree-node label="Contracts team" value="contracts"></ui-tree-node>
      </ui-tree-node>
      <ui-tree-node label="Finance" value="finance"></ui-tree-node>
    </ui-tree-node>
    <ui-tree-node label="Branches" value="branches">
      <ui-tree-node label="Chiang Mai" value="cnx"></ui-tree-node>
    </ui-tree-node>
  </ui-tree-view>
</div>
<p>Last change: <output id="tree-view-toggle-out"></output></p>

<script type="module">
  const tree = document.getElementById('tree-view-toggle');
  const branches = () => [...tree.querySelectorAll('ui-tree-node')].filter((node) => node.querySelector('ui-tree-node'));
  document.getElementById('tree-view-expand-all').addEventListener('click', () => branches().forEach((node) => (node.expanded = true)));
  document.getElementById('tree-view-collapse-all').addEventListener('click', () => branches().forEach((node) => (node.expanded = false)));
  tree.addEventListener('ui-toggle', (event) => {
    document.getElementById('tree-view-toggle-out').value = `${event.detail.value} ${event.detail.expanded ? 'opened' : 'closed'}`;
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState<string[]>([]);
const isOpen = (value: string) => open.includes(value);
const onToggle = (e: CustomEvent<{ expanded: boolean; value: string }>) =>
  setOpen((now) => (e.detail.expanded ? [...new Set([...now, e.detail.value])] : now.filter((v) => v !== e.detail.value)));

<UiButton kind="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(['hq', 'legal', 'branches'])}>Expand all</UiButton>
<UiButton kind="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen([])}>Collapse all</UiButton>
<UiTreeView label="Organisation">
  <UiTreeNode label="Head office" value="hq" expanded={isOpen('hq')} onUiToggle={onToggle}>
    <UiTreeNode label="Legal" value="legal" expanded={isOpen('legal')} onUiToggle={onToggle}>…</UiTreeNode>
    <UiTreeNode label="Finance" value="finance" />
  </UiTreeNode>
  {/* … */}
</UiTreeView>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState<string[]>([]);
const toggle = (value: string) => (expanded: boolean) => setOpen((now) => (expanded ? [...now, value] : now.filter((v) => v !== value)));

<Button kind="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(['hq', 'legal', 'branches'])}>Expand all</Button>
<Button kind="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen([])}>Collapse all</Button>
<TreeView label="Organisation">
  <TreeNode label="Head office" value="hq" expanded={open.includes('hq')} onToggle={toggle('hq')}>
    <TreeNode label="Legal" value="legal" expanded={open.includes('legal')} onToggle={toggle('legal')}>…</TreeNode>
    <TreeNode label="Finance" value="finance" />
  </TreeNode>
  {/* … */}
</TreeView>
```

`ui-toggle` bubbles, so one listener on the tree hears every node.

## Links

`href` turns a node's label into a link. Enter or a click follows it. In a single-page app, listen for `ui-navigate` (cancelable, `{ href }`) and route yourself.


HTML:

```html
<div style="max-width: 360px">
  <ui-tree-view id="tree-view-links" label="Policies">
    <ui-tree-node label="Retention policy" value="retention" href="#links"></ui-tree-node>
    <ui-tree-node label="Signing authority" value="signing" href="#links"></ui-tree-node>
  </ui-tree-view>
</div>
<p>Would open: <output id="tree-view-links-out"></output></p>

<script type="module">
  document.getElementById('tree-view-links').addEventListener('ui-navigate', (event) => {
    event.preventDefault(); // route in the app instead of loading the page
    document.getElementById('tree-view-links-out').value = event.detail.href;
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiTreeView label="Policies">
  <UiTreeNode label="Retention policy" value="retention" href="/policies/retention" onUiNavigate={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); navigate(e.detail.href); }} />
  <UiTreeNode label="Signing authority" value="signing" href="/policies/signing" onUiNavigate={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); navigate(e.detail.href); }} />
</UiTreeView>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<TreeView label="Policies">
  <TreeNode label="Retention policy" value="retention" href="/policies/retention" />
  <TreeNode label="Signing authority" value="signing" href="/policies/signing" />
</TreeView>
```

React + Tailwind renders a plain `<a>`; route clicks with your router's own link handling.

## Load children on demand

`lazy` makes a node a branch before it has children. The first time it opens, a spinner replaces the caret and `ui-lazy-load` fires with its `value`: fetch the children and append them as `<ui-tree-node>`s. With nothing to add, set `lazy = false` and it becomes a leaf; after a failed load, set `loading = false` and it closes so the user can try again.


HTML:

```html
<div style="max-width: 360px">
  <ui-tree-view id="tree-view-lazy" label="Case files on the server">
    <ui-tree-node label="Civil cases" value="civil" lazy></ui-tree-node>
    <ui-tree-node label="Criminal cases" value="criminal" lazy></ui-tree-node>
    <ui-tree-node label="Empty folder" value="empty" lazy></ui-tree-node>
  </ui-tree-view>
</div>

<script type="module">
  document.getElementById('tree-view-lazy').addEventListener('ui-lazy-load', (event) => {
    const node = event.target;
    setTimeout(() => {
      // a pretend server that answers after 800ms
      if (event.detail.value === 'empty') {
        node.lazy = false;
        return;
      }
      for (const n of [1, 2, 3]) {
        const child = document.createElement('ui-tree-node');
        child.label = `${node.label} ${n}`;
        child.value = `${event.detail.value}-${n}`;
        node.append(child);
      }
    }, 800);
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [children, setChildren] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({});
const load = async (e: CustomEvent<{ value: string }>) => {
  const node = e.target as TreeNodeElement;
  const names = await fetchFolder(e.detail.value);
  if (names.length === 0) node.lazy = false;
  else setChildren((now) => ({ ...now, [e.detail.value]: names }));
};

<UiTreeView label="Case files on the server" onUiLazyLoad={load}>
  {['civil', 'criminal', 'empty'].map((folder) => (
    <UiTreeNode key={folder} label={folder} value={folder} lazy>
      {children[folder]?.map((name) => <UiTreeNode key={name} label={name} value={`${folder}/${name}`} />)}
    </UiTreeNode>
  ))}
</UiTreeView>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [children, setChildren] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({});
// a resolved promise with no children makes the node a leaf; a rejected one closes it to retry
const load = async (folder: string) => {
  const names = await fetchFolder(folder);
  setChildren((now) => ({ ...now, [folder]: names }));
};

<TreeView label="Case files on the server">
  {['civil', 'criminal', 'empty'].map((folder) => (
    <TreeNode key={folder} label={folder} value={folder} lazy onLazyLoad={load}>
      {children[folder]?.map((name) => <TreeNode key={name} label={name} value={`${folder}/${name}`} />)}
    </TreeNode>
  ))}
</TreeView>
```

`TreeNodeElement` is `import type { UiTreeNode as TreeNodeElement } from '@purpurabog/ui'`.

## A hidden label
