npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Use it

Name the group with `aria-label`. The switcher fills the width it is given and shares it evenly between the items.


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">import '@purpurabog/ui/content-switcher';</script>

<ui-content-switcher aria-label="Requests">
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="all">All requests</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="mine">Assigned to me</ui-content-switcher-item>
</ui-content-switcher>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiContentSwitcher, UiContentSwitcherItem } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiContentSwitcher aria-label="Requests">
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="all">All requests</UiContentSwitcherItem>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="mine">Assigned to me</UiContentSwitcherItem>
</UiContentSwitcher>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { ContentSwitcher, ContentSwitcherItem } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/content-switcher';

<ContentSwitcher aria-label="Requests">
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="all">All requests</ContentSwitcherItem>
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="mine">Assigned to me</ContentSwitcherItem>
</ContentSwitcher>
```

When the items are different sections of one thing (a contract's terms, parties and history), use [Tabs](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/tabs/) instead.

## Switch the content

The switcher only reports the choice: `ui-change` fires with `detail.index` and `detail.name` of the item the user selected. Showing the matching content is yours. Put that content right after the switcher.


HTML:

```html
<ui-content-switcher id="content-switcher-filter" aria-label="Requests" style="max-width: 560px">
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="all">All requests</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="mine">Assigned to me</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="overdue">Overdue</ui-content-switcher-item>
</ui-content-switcher>
<ul id="content-switcher-list" style="margin: 0; padding-inline-start: 24px"></ul>

<script type="module">
  const requests = [
    { title: 'Renew the server lease', mine: true, overdue: false },
    { title: 'Approve the catering contract', mine: false, overdue: true },
    { title: 'Sign the NDA with Siam Office Supplies', mine: true, overdue: true },
    { title: 'Review the car rental terms', mine: false, overdue: false },
  ];
  const switcher = document.getElementById('content-switcher-filter');
  const list = document.getElementById('content-switcher-list');
  const show = (name) =>
    list.replaceChildren(...requests.filter((r) => name === 'all' || r[name]).map((r) => Object.assign(document.createElement('li'), { textContent: r.title })));
  show('all');
  switcher.addEventListener('ui-change', (event) => show(event.detail.name));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
// requests as in the HTML tab
const [filter, setFilter] = useState('all');

<UiContentSwitcher aria-label="Requests" onUiChange={(e) => setFilter(e.detail.name)}>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="all">All requests</UiContentSwitcherItem>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="mine">Assigned to me</UiContentSwitcherItem>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="overdue">Overdue</UiContentSwitcherItem>
</UiContentSwitcher>
<ul>
  {requests.filter((r) => filter === 'all' || r[filter as 'mine' | 'overdue']).map((r) => <li key={r.title}>{r.title}</li>)}
</ul>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
// requests as in the HTML tab
const [filter, setFilter] = useState('all');

<ContentSwitcher aria-label="Requests" onChange={({ name }) => setFilter(name)}>
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="all">All requests</ContentSwitcherItem>
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="mine">Assigned to me</ContentSwitcherItem>
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="overdue">Overdue</ContentSwitcherItem>
</ContentSwitcher>
<ul>
  {requests.filter((r) => filter === 'all' || r[filter as 'mine' | 'overdue']).map((r) => <li key={r.title}>{r.title}</li>)}
</ul>
```

## Starting item

`selected-index` (`selectedIndex`) is the selected item's position, from 0; the first item by default. The switcher updates it as the user chooses.


HTML:

```html
<ui-content-switcher id="content-switcher-start" aria-label="Period" selected-index="1" style="max-width: 560px">
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="week">This week</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="month">This month</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="year">This year</ui-content-switcher-item>
</ui-content-switcher>
<p>Selected: <output id="content-switcher-start-out"></output></p>

<script type="module">
  const switcher = document.getElementById('content-switcher-start');
  const out = document.getElementById('content-switcher-start-out');
  out.value = `index ${switcher.selectedIndex}`;
  switcher.addEventListener('ui-change', (event) => (out.value = `index ${event.detail.index}, name ${event.detail.name}`));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [index, setIndex] = useState(1);

<UiContentSwitcher aria-label="Period" selectedIndex={index} onUiChange={(e) => setIndex(e.detail.index)}>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="week">This week</UiContentSwitcherItem>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="month">This month</UiContentSwitcherItem>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="year">This year</UiContentSwitcherItem>
</UiContentSwitcher>
<p>Selected: <output>index {index}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [index, setIndex] = useState(1);

<ContentSwitcher aria-label="Period" selectedIndex={index} onChange={(change) => setIndex(change.index)}>
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="week">This week</ContentSwitcherItem>
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="month">This month</ContentSwitcherItem>
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="year">This year</ContentSwitcherItem>
</ContentSwitcher>
<p>Selected: <output>index {index}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind also takes `defaultSelectedIndex` for an uncontrolled start.

## With icons

A 16px icon in the item's `icon` slot (the `icon` prop in React + Tailwind) goes before the text, and takes the item's colours: grey at rest, white when selected.


HTML:

```html
<ui-content-switcher aria-label="Layout" style="max-width: 560px">
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="table"><svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M13 2H3a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h10a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V3a1 1 0 0 0-1-1ZM3 7h4v2H3Zm5 0h5v2H8Zm5-4v3H3V3ZM3 10h4v3H3Zm5 3v-3h5v3Z" /></svg>Table</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="grid"><svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 2H3a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v4a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h4a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V3a1 1 0 0 0-1-1Zm0 5H3V3h4Zm6-5H9a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v4a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h4a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V3a1 1 0 0 0-1-1Zm0 5H9V3h4ZM7 9H3a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v4a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h4a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-4a1 1 0 0 0-1-1Zm0 5H3v-4h4Zm6-5H9a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v4a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h4a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-4a1 1 0 0 0-1-1Zm0 5H9v-4h4Z" /></svg>Grid</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="list"><svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 4h12v1H2zm0 3.5h12v1H2zM2 11h12v1H2z" /></svg>List</ui-content-switcher-item>
</ui-content-switcher>
```

React:

```tsx
// tableIcon = <svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="…" /></svg>, the same for the others
<UiContentSwitcher aria-label="Layout">
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="table">{tableIcon}Table</UiContentSwitcherItem>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="grid">{gridIcon}Grid</UiContentSwitcherItem>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="list">{listIcon}List</UiContentSwitcherItem>
</UiContentSwitcher>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
// tableIcon = <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="…" /></svg>, the same for the others
<ContentSwitcher aria-label="Layout">
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="table" icon={tableIcon}>Table</ContentSwitcherItem>
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="grid" icon={gridIcon}>Grid</ContentSwitcherItem>
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="list" icon={listIcon}>List</ContentSwitcherItem>
</ContentSwitcher>
```

## Icon only

With `icon-only` (`iconOnly`) on every item, each item is a square button and the switcher shrinks to fit them. `label` is then required: it names the item and shows as its tooltip on hover and keyboard focus. `tooltip-placement` (`tooltipPlacement`) moves the tooltip; it shows above by default.


HTML:

```html
<ui-content-switcher aria-label="Layout">
  <ui-content-switcher-item icon-only label="Table" name="table"><svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M13 2H3a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h10a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V3a1 1 0 0 0-1-1ZM3 7h4v2H3Zm5 0h5v2H8Zm5-4v3H3V3ZM3 10h4v3H3Zm5 3v-3h5v3Z" /></svg></ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item icon-only label="Grid" name="grid"><svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 2H3a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v4a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h4a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V3a1 1 0 0 0-1-1Zm0 5H3V3h4Zm6-5H9a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v4a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h4a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V3a1 1 0 0 0-1-1Zm0 5H9V3h4ZM7 9H3a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v4a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h4a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-4a1 1 0 0 0-1-1Zm0 5H3v-4h4Zm6-5H9a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v4a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h4a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-4a1 1 0 0 0-1-1Zm0 5H9v-4h4Z" /></svg></ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item icon-only label="List" name="list" tooltip-placement="bottom"><svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 4h12v1H2zm0 3.5h12v1H2zM2 11h12v1H2z" /></svg></ui-content-switcher-item>
</ui-content-switcher>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiContentSwitcher aria-label="Layout">
  <UiContentSwitcherItem iconOnly label="Table" name="table">{tableIcon}</UiContentSwitcherItem>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem iconOnly label="Grid" name="grid">{gridIcon}</UiContentSwitcherItem>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem iconOnly label="List" name="list" tooltipPlacement="bottom">{listIcon}</UiContentSwitcherItem>
</UiContentSwitcher>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ContentSwitcher aria-label="Layout">
  <ContentSwitcherItem iconOnly label="Table" name="table" icon={tableIcon} />
  <ContentSwitcherItem iconOnly label="Grid" name="grid" icon={gridIcon} />
  <ContentSwitcherItem iconOnly label="List" name="list" icon={listIcon} tooltipPlacement="bottom" />
</ContentSwitcher>
```

## Sizes

`size`: `sm` 32px, `md` 40px (the default), `lg` 48px. Icons grow to 20px in `lg`. Match the height of the fields and buttons beside it.


HTML:

```html
<ui-content-switcher aria-label="Small" size="sm" style="max-width: 560px">
  <ui-content-switcher-item>All</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item>Mine</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item>Archived</ui-content-switcher-item>
</ui-content-switcher>
<ui-content-switcher aria-label="Medium" style="max-width: 560px">
  <ui-content-switcher-item>All</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item>Mine</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item>Archived</ui-content-switcher-item>
</ui-content-switcher>
<ui-content-switcher aria-label="Large" size="lg" style="max-width: 560px">
  <ui-content-switcher-item>All</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item>Mine</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item>Archived</ui-content-switcher-item>
</ui-content-switcher>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiContentSwitcher aria-label="Small" size="sm">…</UiContentSwitcher>
<UiContentSwitcher aria-label="Medium">…</UiContentSwitcher>
<UiContentSwitcher aria-label="Large" size="lg">…</UiContentSwitcher>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx

<ContentSwitcher aria-label="Medium">…</ContentSwitcher>

```

## Low contrast

`low-contrast` (`lowContrast`) is the quieter variant: a grey track, and the selected item a light pill with bold text instead of a dark fill. Use it where a dark selected item would draw too much attention.


HTML:

```html
<ui-content-switcher aria-label="Requests" low-contrast style="max-width: 560px">
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="all">All requests</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="mine">Assigned to me</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="archived">Archived</ui-content-switcher-item>
</ui-content-switcher>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiContentSwitcher aria-label="Requests" lowContrast>…</UiContentSwitcher>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ContentSwitcher aria-label="Requests" lowContrast>…</ContentSwitcher>
```

## Disabled item

`disabled` on an item greys it out; the arrow keys skip it and a click does nothing. While any item is disabled, the track's outline turns grey too, as in Carbon.


HTML:

```html
<ui-content-switcher aria-label="Requests" selected-index="1" style="max-width: 560px">
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="all">All requests</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="mine">Assigned to me</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="archived" disabled>Archived</ui-content-switcher-item>
</ui-content-switcher>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiContentSwitcher aria-label="Requests" selectedIndex={1}>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="all">All requests</UiContentSwitcherItem>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="mine">Assigned to me</UiContentSwitcherItem>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="archived" disabled>Archived</UiContentSwitcherItem>
</UiContentSwitcher>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ContentSwitcher aria-label="Requests" defaultSelectedIndex={1}>
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="all">All requests</ContentSwitcherItem>
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="mine">Assigned to me</ContentSwitcherItem>
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="archived" disabled>Archived</ContentSwitcherItem>
</ContentSwitcher>
```

## Manual selection

By default the arrow keys select as they move (`selection-mode="automatic"`). With `selection-mode="manual"` (`selectionMode`), they only move focus, and Enter or Space selects. Use it when switching loads data.


HTML:

```html
<ui-content-switcher aria-label="Report" selection-mode="manual" style="max-width: 560px">
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="summary">Summary</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="details">Details</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="audit">Audit trail</ui-content-switcher-item>
</ui-content-switcher>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiContentSwitcher aria-label="Report" selectionMode="manual">…</UiContentSwitcher>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ContentSwitcher aria-label="Report" selectionMode="manual">…</ContentSwitcher>
```

## Long labels

Items share the width evenly. A label longer than its share ends in an ellipsis, so keep labels short: one or two words.


HTML:

```html
<ui-content-switcher aria-label="Contracts" style="max-width: 360px">
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="draft">Drafts</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="waiting">Waiting for the counterparty's signature</ui-content-switcher-item>
  <ui-content-switcher-item name="signed">Signed</ui-content-switcher-item>
</ui-content-switcher>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiContentSwitcher aria-label="Contracts" style={{ maxWidth: 360 }}>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="draft">Drafts</UiContentSwitcherItem>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="waiting">Waiting for the counterparty's signature</UiContentSwitcherItem>
  <UiContentSwitcherItem name="signed">Signed</UiContentSwitcherItem>
</UiContentSwitcher>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ContentSwitcher aria-label="Contracts" className="max-w-[360px]">
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="draft">Drafts</ContentSwitcherItem>
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="waiting">Waiting for the counterparty's signature</ContentSwitcherItem>
  <ContentSwitcherItem name="signed">Signed</ContentSwitcherItem>
</ContentSwitcher>
```

## Accessibility

- The switcher is a `tablist` and each item a `tab` with `aria-selected`; name the group with `aria-label`.
- One Tab stop: the selected item (or the first enabled one). ← and → move and wrap, skipping disabled items (mirrored right-to-left); Home and End jump to the ends. Enter and Space select in manual mode.
- The items control no panel (`aria-controls`): put the content they change right after the switcher, so it is the next thing a keyboard or screen reader user reaches.
- Icon-only items need `label`: it is their name and their tooltip.

Unstyled React parts with the same behaviour: [Headless Content switcher](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-content-switcher/).

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-content-switcher>` · React `UiContentSwitcher`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `selected-index` | `selectedIndex` | `number` | `0` |  |
| `size` | `size` | `ContentSwitcherSize` | `'md'` |  |
| `selection-mode` | `selectionMode` | `ContentSwitcherSelectionMode` | `'automatic'` |  |
| `low-contrast` | `lowContrast` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `icon-only` | `iconOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Reflected by the switcher itself when every item is `icon-only`. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `focus(options)` | Focus the selected item (the tab stop). |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-change` | `onUiChange` | detail: { index, name } after the user selects a different item |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | `<ui-content-switcher-item>` elements |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-content-switcher-border` |  | / --ui-content-switcher-selected-fill / --ui-content-switcher-selected-ink - Border, selected fill and selected text of the default kind (default: Carbon's inverse; Kanok: hairline and brand indigo) |
| `--ui-content-switcher-track` |  | / --ui-content-switcher-padding / --ui-content-switcher-radius / --ui-content-switcher-outline - The track around the items (default transparent, 0, 4px, border-inverse: Carbon's outlined group; Kanok: the contained tabs' segmented track) |
| `--ui-content-switcher-item-radius` |  | / --ui-content-switcher-item-size / --ui-content-switcher-item-grow / --ui-content-switcher-divider / --ui-content-switcher-selected-shadow - Its items (on `<ui-content-switcher-item>`) |

### `<ui-content-switcher-item>` · React `UiContentSwitcherItem`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `name` | `string` | `''` | Identifies the item in `ui-change` (Carbon `name`). |
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` | Accessible name — required with `icon-only`. |
| `selected` | `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Set by the switcher from its `selected-index` (it overwrites any value you set): read it or style on `[selected]`; select an item with the switcher's `selected-index`. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `icon-only` | `iconOnly` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `tooltip-placement` | `tooltipPlacement` | `TooltipPlacement` | `'top'` | Where the `icon-only` tooltip shows (Carbon `align`, default top). |

#### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `focusable` | `boolean` | Set by the switcher: which item is the single tab stop (the selected one, or the first enabled one). |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Label text |
| `icon` | A 16px icon (20px in `size="lg"`) before the text, or alone with `icon-only` + `label` |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `label` | The label wrapper |
| `tooltip` | The `<ui-tooltip>` of an `icon-only` item |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-content-switcher-item-radius` |  | / --ui-content-switcher-item-size / --ui-content-switcher-item-grow - Corner radius, `inline-size` and `flex-grow` (default 4px, 100%, 0) |
| `--ui-content-switcher-divider` |  | / --ui-content-switcher-selected-shadow - The rule between items and the selected one's shadow (default hairline, none) |

# Accordion

An accordion is a vertical list of headings. Each heading shows or hides the content under it, so a long page shows only the parts the reader asks for. Several items can be open at once.


HTML:

```html
<ui-accordion>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Parties" open>Metro Property Co., Ltd. (the lessor) and Siam Retail Co., Ltd. (the lessee).</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Payment terms">Rent is due on the 5th of each month. Late payments accrue 1.5% per month.</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Confidentiality">Both parties keep the terms confidential for five years after the lease ends.</ui-accordion-item>
</ui-accordion>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiAccordion>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Parties" open>Metro Property Co., Ltd. (the lessor) and Siam Retail Co., Ltd. (the lessee).</UiAccordionItem>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Payment terms">Rent is due on the 5th of each month. Late payments accrue 1.5% per month.</UiAccordionItem>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Confidentiality">Both parties keep the terms confidential for five years after the lease ends.</UiAccordionItem>
</UiAccordion>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Accordion>
  <AccordionItem title="Parties" defaultOpen>Metro Property Co., Ltd. (the lessor) and Siam Retail Co., Ltd. (the lessee).</AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Payment terms">Rent is due on the 5th of each month. Late payments accrue 1.5% per month.</AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Confidentiality">Both parties keep the terms confidential for five years after the lease ends.</AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/accordion
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-accordion
```

Manual:

```bash
# Web component
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install lit@^3.3.0
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/accordion.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/primitives/accordion/accordion-item.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/accordion/accordion-skeleton.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/accordion/accordion.ts
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    shared-element, shared-events, shared-field, shared-skeleton, tokens

# React + Tailwind
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install @purpurabog/ui@^1.4.3
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tw-accordion.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/react-tw/accordion.tsx
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    tw-theme, tw-utils
```

npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

HTML:

```html
<script type="module">import '@purpurabog/ui/accordion';</script>

<ui-accordion>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Payment terms">Rent is due on the 5th of each month.</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Confidentiality">Both parties keep the terms confidential.</ui-accordion-item>
</ui-accordion>
```

```tsx
import { UiAccordion, UiAccordionItem } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

  <UiAccordionItem heading="Confidentiality">Both parties keep the terms confidential.</UiAccordionItem>
</UiAccordion>
```

```tsx
</Accordion>
```

## Open items

`open` shows an item's content when the page loads (`defaultOpen` in React + Tailwind). Opening one item doesn't close the others: each item is on its own, as in Carbon.


HTML:

```html
<ui-accordion>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Scope of work" open>Monthly cleaning of the lobby, the car park and the shared toilets.</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Service hours" open>Monday to Saturday, 6:00 to 9:00, before the building opens.</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Termination">Either party may end the contract with 30 days' written notice.</ui-accordion-item>
</ui-accordion>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiAccordion>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Scope of work" open>Monthly cleaning of the lobby, the car park and the shared toilets.</UiAccordionItem>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Service hours" open>Monday to Saturday, 6:00 to 9:00, before the building opens.</UiAccordionItem>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Termination">Either party may end the contract with 30 days' written notice.</UiAccordionItem>
</UiAccordion>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Accordion>
  <AccordionItem title="Scope of work" defaultOpen>Monthly cleaning of the lobby, the car park and the shared toilets.</AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Service hours" defaultOpen>Monday to Saturday, 6:00 to 9:00, before the building opens.</AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Termination">Either party may end the contract with 30 days' written notice.</AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

## Headings with markup

`heading` is plain text. When the heading needs markup (a count, a status, bold text), put it in the `title` slot instead. In React + Tailwind, `title` takes any React node.


HTML:

```html
<ui-accordion>
  <ui-accordion-item>
    <span slot="title">Attachments <strong>(3)</strong></span>
    Lease agreement.pdf, Floor plan.pdf, Company certificate.pdf
  </ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item>
    <span slot="title">Approvals <em>waiting for the finance team</em></span>
    The legal team approved on 2 October. Finance has not answered yet.
  </ui-accordion-item>
</ui-accordion>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiAccordion>
  <UiAccordionItem>
    <span slot="title">Attachments <strong>(3)</strong></span>
    Lease agreement.pdf, Floor plan.pdf, Company certificate.pdf
  </UiAccordionItem>
  <UiAccordionItem>
    <span slot="title">Approvals <em>waiting for the finance team</em></span>
    The legal team approved on 2 October. Finance has not answered yet.
  </UiAccordionItem>
</UiAccordion>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Accordion>
  <AccordionItem title={<>Attachments <strong>(3)</strong></>}>
    Lease agreement.pdf, Floor plan.pdf, Company certificate.pdf
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title={<>Approvals <em>waiting for the finance team</em></>}>
    The legal team approved on 2 October. Finance has not answered yet.
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

## Sizes

`size` sets the height of each heading: `sm` 32px, `md` 40px (the default), `lg` 48px. Set it on the accordion; every item follows.


HTML:

```html
<ui-accordion size="sm">
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Small, 32px">Content</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Second item">Content</ui-accordion-item>
</ui-accordion>
<ui-accordion>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Medium, 40px">Content</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Second item">Content</ui-accordion-item>
</ui-accordion>
<ui-accordion size="lg">
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Large, 48px">Content</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Second item">Content</ui-accordion-item>
</ui-accordion>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiAccordion size="sm">…</UiAccordion>
<UiAccordion>…</UiAccordion>
<UiAccordion size="lg">…</UiAccordion>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx

<Accordion>…</Accordion>
<Accordion size="lg">…</Accordion>
```

## Chevron at the start

`align="start"` puts the chevron before the heading text. The content then lines up with the text, not with the chevron.


HTML:

```html
<ui-accordion align="start">
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Head office" open>88 Sukhumvit Road, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Chiang Mai branch">25 Nimmanhaemin Road, Suthep, Chiang Mai 50200</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Phuket branch">12 Thepkrasattri Road, Ratsada, Phuket 83000</ui-accordion-item>
</ui-accordion>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiAccordion align="start">
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Head office" open>88 Sukhumvit Road, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110</UiAccordionItem>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Chiang Mai branch">25 Nimmanhaemin Road, Suthep, Chiang Mai 50200</UiAccordionItem>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Phuket branch">12 Thepkrasattri Road, Ratsada, Phuket 83000</UiAccordionItem>
</UiAccordion>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Accordion align="start">
  <AccordionItem title="Head office" defaultOpen>88 Sukhumvit Road, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110</AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Chiang Mai branch">25 Nimmanhaemin Road, Suthep, Chiang Mai 50200</AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Phuket branch">12 Thepkrasattri Road, Ratsada, Phuket 83000</AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

## Flush

`flush` removes the dividers at the outer edges and draws the lines between items 16px in from each side (Carbon's `isFlush`). Use it where the accordion sits inside a tile or a panel that already has an edge. It has no effect with `align="start"`.


HTML:

```html
<ui-accordion flush>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Who can sign?">A director listed on the company certificate, or a person with a power of attorney.</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Can I sign on paper?">Yes. Print the contract, sign every page and upload the scan.</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="How long does approval take?">Two working days for standard contracts.</ui-accordion-item>
</ui-accordion>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiAccordion flush>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Who can sign?">A director listed on the company certificate, or a person with a power of attorney.</UiAccordionItem>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Can I sign on paper?">Yes. Print the contract, sign every page and upload the scan.</UiAccordionItem>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="How long does approval take?">Two working days for standard contracts.</UiAccordionItem>
</UiAccordion>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Accordion flush>
  <AccordionItem title="Who can sign?">A director listed on the company certificate, or a person with a power of attorney.</AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Can I sign on paper?">Yes. Print the contract, sign every page and upload the scan.</AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="How long does approval take?">Two working days for standard contracts.</AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

## Disabled

`disabled` on an item greys out its heading; it can't be opened or closed and Tab skips it. `disabled` on the accordion disables every item; removing it enables them again, except items that have their own `disabled`.


HTML:

```html
<ui-accordion>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Draft" open>Version 3, edited today.</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Archive (after signing)" disabled>Signed copies appear here.</ui-accordion-item>
</ui-accordion>
<ui-accordion disabled>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Audit log">Locked while the audit runs.</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Change history">Locked while the audit runs.</ui-accordion-item>
</ui-accordion>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiAccordion>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Draft" open>Version 3, edited today.</UiAccordionItem>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Archive (after signing)" disabled>Signed copies appear here.</UiAccordionItem>
</UiAccordion>
<UiAccordion disabled>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Audit log">Locked while the audit runs.</UiAccordionItem>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Change history">Locked while the audit runs.</UiAccordionItem>
</UiAccordion>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Accordion>
  <AccordionItem title="Draft" defaultOpen>Version 3, edited today.</AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Archive (after signing)" disabled>Signed copies appear here.</AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
<Accordion disabled>
  <AccordionItem title="Audit log">Locked while the audit runs.</AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Change history">Locked while the audit runs.</AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

## Know when an item opens

`ui-toggle` fires on the item after the user opens or closes it, with `detail.open`. It bubbles, so one listener on the accordion hears every item. Use it to load an item's content the first time it opens, or to remember which items were open. In React + Tailwind, `onOpenChange` on the item gets the new state.


HTML:

```html
<ui-accordion id="accordion-events">
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Payment terms">Rent is due on the 5th of each month.</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Deposit">Three months' rent, returned within 30 days after the lease ends.</ui-accordion-item>
</ui-accordion>
<p>Last change: <output id="accordion-events-out">none</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const accordion = document.getElementById('accordion-events');
  const out = document.getElementById('accordion-events-out');
  accordion.addEventListener('ui-toggle', (event) => {
    out.value = `${event.target.heading} ${event.detail.open ? 'opened' : 'closed'}`;
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [last, setLast] = useState('none');

<UiAccordion>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Payment terms" onUiToggle={(e) => setLast(`Payment terms ${e.detail.open ? 'opened' : 'closed'}`)}>
    Rent is due on the 5th of each month.
  </UiAccordionItem>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Deposit" onUiToggle={(e) => setLast(`Deposit ${e.detail.open ? 'opened' : 'closed'}`)}>
    Three months' rent, returned within 30 days after the lease ends.
  </UiAccordionItem>
</UiAccordion>
<p>Last change: <output>{last}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [last, setLast] = useState('none');

<Accordion>
  <AccordionItem title="Payment terms" onOpenChange={(open) => setLast(`Payment terms ${open ? 'opened' : 'closed'}`)}>
    Rent is due on the 5th of each month.
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Deposit" onOpenChange={(open) => setLast(`Deposit ${open ? 'opened' : 'closed'}`)}>
    Three months' rent, returned within 30 days after the lease ends.
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
<p>Last change: <output>{last}</output></p>
```

## Expand all, collapse all

Set `open` on the items from your code to open or close them together (Carbon's "controlled" accordion). Setting `open` doesn't fire `ui-toggle`: the event is only for the user's own clicks. In React + Tailwind, hold each item's `open` in state.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
  <ui-button id="accordion-all-open" kind="tertiary" size="sm">Expand all</ui-button>
  <ui-button id="accordion-all-close" kind="tertiary" size="sm">Collapse all</ui-button>
</div>
<ui-accordion id="accordion-all">
  <ui-accordion-item heading="1. Definitions">The words in bold have the meaning given in this section.</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="2. Term">Three years from 1 January 2027.</ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="3. Rent">120,000 baht a month, raised 3% each year.</ui-accordion-item>
</ui-accordion>

<script type="module">
  const items = document.querySelectorAll('#accordion-all ui-accordion-item');
  const setAll = (open) => items.forEach((item) => (item.open = open));
  document.getElementById('accordion-all-open').addEventListener('click', () => setAll(true));
  document.getElementById('accordion-all-close').addEventListener('click', () => setAll(false));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const sections = [
  { heading: '1. Definitions', body: 'The words in bold have the meaning given in this section.' },
  { heading: '2. Term', body: 'Three years from 1 January 2027.' },
  { heading: '3. Rent', body: '120,000 baht a month, raised 3% each year.' },
];
const [open, setOpen] = useState(sections.map(() => false));

<UiButton kind="tertiary" size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(sections.map(() => true))}>Expand all</UiButton>
<UiButton kind="tertiary" size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(sections.map(() => false))}>Collapse all</UiButton>
<UiAccordion>
  {sections.map((s, i) => (
    <UiAccordionItem key={s.heading} heading={s.heading} open={open[i]} onUiToggle={(e) => setOpen((o) => o.map((v, j) => (j === i ? e.detail.open : v)))}>
      {s.body}
    </UiAccordionItem>
  ))}
</UiAccordion>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState(sections.map(() => false));

<Button kind="tertiary" size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(sections.map(() => true))}>Expand all</Button>
<Button kind="tertiary" size="sm" onClick={() => setOpen(sections.map(() => false))}>Collapse all</Button>
<Accordion>
  {sections.map((s, i) => (
    <AccordionItem key={s.heading} title={s.heading} open={open[i]} onOpenChange={(next) => setOpen((o) => o.map((v, j) => (j === i ? next : v)))}>
      {s.body}
    </AccordionItem>
  ))}
</Accordion>
```

`sections` is the same in both React versions.

## Fields inside an item

An item's content can hold anything, fields included. A filter panel is a common case: each group of filters in its own item, so the list stays short.


HTML:

```html
<ui-accordion>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Contract type" open>
    <ui-checkbox-group label="Show these types">
      <ui-checkbox name="type" value="lease" checked>Lease</ui-checkbox>
      <ui-checkbox name="type" value="sale">Sale</ui-checkbox>
      <ui-checkbox name="type" value="service">Service</ui-checkbox>
    </ui-checkbox-group>
  </ui-accordion-item>
  <ui-accordion-item heading="Status">
    <ui-radio-group label="Show this status" name="status" value="any">
      <ui-radio value="any">Any</ui-radio>
      <ui-radio value="draft">Draft</ui-radio>
      <ui-radio value="signed">Signed</ui-radio>
    </ui-radio-group>
  </ui-accordion-item>
</ui-accordion>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiAccordion>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Contract type" open>
    <UiCheckboxGroup label="Show these types">
      <UiCheckbox name="type" value="lease" checked>Lease</UiCheckbox>
      <UiCheckbox name="type" value="sale">Sale</UiCheckbox>
      <UiCheckbox name="type" value="service">Service</UiCheckbox>
    </UiCheckboxGroup>
  </UiAccordionItem>
  <UiAccordionItem heading="Status">
    <UiRadioGroup label="Show this status" name="status" value="any">
      <UiRadio value="any">Any</UiRadio>
      <UiRadio value="draft">Draft</UiRadio>
      <UiRadio value="signed">Signed</UiRadio>
    </UiRadioGroup>
  </UiAccordionItem>
</UiAccordion>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Accordion>
  <AccordionItem title="Contract type" defaultOpen>
    <FormGroup legend="Show these types">
      <Checkbox label="Lease" name="type" value="lease" defaultChecked />
      <Checkbox label="Sale" name="type" value="sale" />
      <Checkbox label="Service" name="type" value="service" />
    </FormGroup>
  </AccordionItem>
  <AccordionItem title="Status">
    <RadioGroup label="Show this status" name="status" defaultValue="any">
      <Radio value="any">Any</Radio>
      <Radio value="draft">Draft</Radio>
      <Radio value="signed">Signed</Radio>
    </RadioGroup>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>
```

## Skeleton

While the items load, show `ui-accordion-skeleton`: `count` headings (4 by default), the first one open with three lines. `open` set to false (in HTML, set the property) shows them all closed, and `alignment="start"` puts the chevron first. It is hidden from screen readers, so say "loading" on the container (for example `aria-busy`).


HTML:

```html
<ui-accordion-skeleton count="3"></ui-accordion-skeleton>
<ui-accordion-skeleton id="accordion-skeleton-closed" count="2" alignment="start"></ui-accordion-skeleton>

<script type="module">
  document.getElementById('accordion-skeleton-closed').open = false;
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiAccordionSkeleton } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiAccordionSkeleton count={3} />
<UiAccordionSkeleton count={2} open={false} alignment="start" />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { AccordionSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/accordion';

<AccordionSkeleton count={3} />
<AccordionSkeleton count={2} open={false} align="start" />
```

On the web component, import it from `@purpurabog/ui/accordion-skeleton`.

## Keyboard

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Moves between the headings (and into an open item's content); disabled headings are skipped |
| Enter, Space | Opens or closes the focused item |

There are no arrow keys between headings, as in Carbon.

## Accessibility

- Each heading is a `<button>` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` pointing at its content. The content is a `region` named by its heading.
- The accordion is a list (`role="list"`) and each item a list item, as Carbon's `<ul>` / `<li>`.
- The heading button isn't inside an `<h2>`–`<h6>`. If the items are sections of the page outline, say so in the text around the accordion.
- Don't hide the only copy of something the user must read (an error, a required step) in a closed item.

Unstyled React parts with the same behaviour: [Headless Accordion](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-accordion/).

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-accordion>` · React `UiAccordion`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | `size` | `AccordionSize` | `'md'` | Heading height: sm 32px, md 40px (default), lg 48px. |
| `align` | `align` | `'start' \| 'end'` | `'end'` | Chevron before the title instead of after it. |
| `flush` | `flush` | `boolean` | `false` | No outer dividers; an inset line between items (Carbon `isFlush`, ignored with `align="start"`). |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables every item; removing it again leaves disabled only the items that have their own `disabled`. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `focus(options)` | Focus the first enabled item's heading. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | `<ui-accordion-item>` elements |

### `<ui-accordion-item>` · React `UiAccordionItem`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` |  |  |  |  |
| `heading` | `heading` | `string` | `''` | Heading text; the `title` slot replaces it when markup is needed. (Before 0.5: the `title` attribute, still accepted.) |
| `open` | `open` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-toggle` | `onUiToggle` | detail: { open } after the user opened or closed it |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Content |
| `title` | Heading text with markup; the `heading` attribute is the plain-text fallback |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `heading` | The heading button |
| `arrow` | The chevron |
| `title` | The heading text |
| `content` | The content wrapper |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-accordion-focus-radius` |  | Corners of the heading's focus ring (default 0; Kanok: 6px) |

### `<ui-accordion-skeleton>` · React `UiAccordionSkeleton`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | `count` | `number` | `4` |  |
| `open` | `open` | `boolean` | `true` | The first item shows its content. |
| `alignment` | `alignment` | `'start' \| 'end'` | `'end'` |  |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `title` | Each title bar |
| `line` | Each line of the open item |

# Progress indicator

A progress indicator shows where the user is in a task of several steps: which steps are done, which one is current and what comes next. Use it above a multi-step form or a wizard.


HTML:

```html
<ui-progress-indicator current-index="1">
  <ui-progress-step label="Contract details"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Signers"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Review"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Send"></ui-progress-step>
</ui-progress-indicator>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiProgressIndicator currentIndex={1}>
  <UiProgressStep label="Contract details" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Signers" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Review" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Send" />
</UiProgressIndicator>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ProgressIndicator currentIndex={1}>
  <ProgressStep label="Contract details" />
  <ProgressStep label="Signers" />
  <ProgressStep label="Review" />
  <ProgressStep label="Send" />
</ProgressIndicator>
```

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/progress-indicator
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-progress-indicator
```

Manual:

```bash
# Web component
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install lit@^3.3.0
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/progress-indicator.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/primitives/progress-indicator/progress-indicator-skeleton.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/progress-indicator/progress-indicator.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/progress-indicator/progress-step.ts
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    shared-element, shared-localize, shared-skeleton, tokens

# React + Tailwind
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install @purpurabog/ui@^1.4.3
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tw-progress-indicator.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/react-tw/progress-indicator.tsx
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    tw-i18n, tw-theme, tw-utils
```

npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Use it


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">import '@purpurabog/ui/progress-indicator';</script>

<ui-progress-indicator current-index="0">
  <ui-progress-step label="Contract details"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Signers"></ui-progress-step>
</ui-progress-indicator>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiProgressIndicator, UiProgressStep } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiProgressIndicator currentIndex={0}>
  <UiProgressStep label="Contract details" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Signers" />
</UiProgressIndicator>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { ProgressIndicator, ProgressStep } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/progress-indicator';

<ProgressIndicator currentIndex={0}>
  <ProgressStep label="Contract details" />
  <ProgressStep label="Signers" />
</ProgressIndicator>
```

## Step states

`current-index` (0-based) decides each step's state: the steps before it are complete (a check mark), the step at it is current (a half-filled circle), the steps after it are incomplete (an empty circle). Two flags on a step add to that:

- `invalid` shows a warning icon in red: the step has an error to fix.
- `disabled` greys the step out. It can't be clicked, even in an interactive indicator.


HTML:

```html
<ui-progress-indicator current-index="1">
  <ui-progress-step label="Contract details"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Signers"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Review" invalid></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Send" disabled></ui-progress-step>
</ui-progress-indicator>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiProgressIndicator currentIndex={1}>
  <UiProgressStep label="Contract details" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Signers" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Review" invalid />
  <UiProgressStep label="Send" disabled />
</UiProgressIndicator>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ProgressIndicator currentIndex={1}>
  <ProgressStep label="Contract details" />
  <ProgressStep label="Signers" />
  <ProgressStep label="Review" invalid />
  <ProgressStep label="Send" disabled />
</ProgressIndicator>
```

## Secondary label

`secondary-label` adds a smaller line under the label: "Optional", a date, a count.


HTML:

```html
<ui-progress-indicator current-index="2">
  <ui-progress-step label="Request" secondary-label="1 Oct"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Legal review" secondary-label="3 Oct"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Attachments" secondary-label="Optional"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Approval"></ui-progress-step>
</ui-progress-indicator>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiProgressIndicator currentIndex={2}>
  <UiProgressStep label="Request" secondaryLabel="1 Oct" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Legal review" secondaryLabel="3 Oct" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Attachments" secondaryLabel="Optional" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Approval" />
</UiProgressIndicator>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ProgressIndicator currentIndex={2}>
  <ProgressStep label="Request" secondaryLabel="1 Oct" />
  <ProgressStep label="Legal review" secondaryLabel="3 Oct" />
  <ProgressStep label="Attachments" secondaryLabel="Optional" />
  <ProgressStep label="Approval" />
</ProgressIndicator>
```

## Complete out of order

`complete` on a step marks it done whatever `current-index` says. Use it when the user may fill the steps in any order: here the attachments are already in, while the user is still on the signers.


HTML:

```html
<ui-progress-indicator current-index="1">
  <ui-progress-step label="Contract details"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Signers"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Attachments" complete></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Send"></ui-progress-step>
</ui-progress-indicator>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiProgressIndicator currentIndex={1}>
  <UiProgressStep label="Contract details" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Signers" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Attachments" complete />
  <UiProgressStep label="Send" />
</UiProgressIndicator>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ProgressIndicator currentIndex={1}>
  <ProgressStep label="Contract details" />
  <ProgressStep label="Signers" />
  <ProgressStep label="Attachments" complete />
  <ProgressStep label="Send" />
</ProgressIndicator>
```

## Let the user jump between steps

`interactive` makes the steps buttons: a click on a step (not the current one, not a disabled one) makes it current and fires `ui-change` with `detail.index`. In React + Tailwind, `onChange` gets the index. Use it when going back to an earlier step is safe, for example to correct the details before sending.


HTML:

```html
<ui-progress-indicator id="progress-jump" current-index="2" interactive>
  <ui-progress-step label="Contract details"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Signers"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Review"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Send" disabled></ui-progress-step>
</ui-progress-indicator>
<p>Current step: <output id="progress-jump-out">2</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const steps = document.getElementById('progress-jump');
  const out = document.getElementById('progress-jump-out');
  steps.addEventListener('ui-change', (event) => (out.value = event.detail.index));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [step, setStep] = useState(2);

<UiProgressIndicator currentIndex={step} interactive onUiChange={(e) => setStep(e.detail.index)}>
  <UiProgressStep label="Contract details" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Signers" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Review" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Send" disabled />
</UiProgressIndicator>
<p>Current step: <output>{step}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [step, setStep] = useState(2);

<ProgressIndicator currentIndex={step} interactive onChange={setStep}>
  <ProgressStep label="Contract details" />
  <ProgressStep label="Signers" />
  <ProgressStep label="Review" />
  <ProgressStep label="Send" disabled />
</ProgressIndicator>
<p>Current step: <output>{step}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind also takes `defaultCurrentIndex` when you don't need to hold the step yourself.

## Back and Next buttons

Most often the page moves through the steps itself: set `current-index` from your Back and Next buttons. The indicator only shows the position; it doesn't change it on its own unless it is `interactive`.


HTML:

```html
<ui-progress-indicator id="progress-wizard" current-index="0">
  <ui-progress-step label="Contract details"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Signers"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Review"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Send"></ui-progress-step>
</ui-progress-indicator>
<p id="progress-wizard-text">Step 1 of 4: Contract details</p>
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
  <ui-button id="progress-wizard-back" kind="secondary" disabled>Back</ui-button>
  <ui-button id="progress-wizard-next">Next</ui-button>
</div>

<script type="module">
  const indicator = document.getElementById('progress-wizard');
  const text = document.getElementById('progress-wizard-text');
  const back = document.getElementById('progress-wizard-back');
  const next = document.getElementById('progress-wizard-next');
  const labels = [...indicator.querySelectorAll('ui-progress-step')].map((step) => step.label);
  const go = (index) => {
    indicator.currentIndex = index;
    text.textContent = `Step ${index + 1} of ${labels.length}: ${labels[index]}`;
    back.disabled = index === 0;
    next.disabled = index === labels.length - 1;
  };
  back.addEventListener('click', () => go(indicator.currentIndex - 1));
  next.addEventListener('click', () => go(indicator.currentIndex + 1));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const labels = ['Contract details', 'Signers', 'Review', 'Send'];
const [step, setStep] = useState(0);

<UiProgressIndicator currentIndex={step}>
  {labels.map((label) => <UiProgressStep key={label} label={label} />)}
</UiProgressIndicator>
<p>Step {step + 1} of {labels.length}: {labels[step]}</p>
<UiButton kind="secondary" disabled={step === 0} onClick={() => setStep(step - 1)}>Back</UiButton>
<UiButton disabled={step === labels.length - 1} onClick={() => setStep(step + 1)}>Next</UiButton>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const labels = ['Contract details', 'Signers', 'Review', 'Send'];
const [step, setStep] = useState(0);

<ProgressIndicator currentIndex={step}>
  {labels.map((label) => <ProgressStep key={label} label={label} />)}
</ProgressIndicator>
<p>Step {step + 1} of {labels.length}: {labels[step]}</p>
<Button kind="secondary" disabled={step === 0} onClick={() => setStep(step - 1)}>Back</Button>
<Button disabled={step === labels.length - 1} onClick={() => setStep(step + 1)}>Next</Button>
```

## Vertical

`vertical` stacks the steps. Use it in a narrow column beside the form, or when the labels are long.


HTML:

```html
<ui-progress-indicator current-index="1" vertical>
  <ui-progress-step label="Request submitted" secondary-label="1 Oct, 09:12"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Legal review" secondary-label="In progress"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Approval by the managing director"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Signing"></ui-progress-step>
</ui-progress-indicator>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiProgressIndicator currentIndex={1} vertical>
  <UiProgressStep label="Request submitted" secondaryLabel="1 Oct, 09:12" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Legal review" secondaryLabel="In progress" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Approval by the managing director" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Signing" />
</UiProgressIndicator>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ProgressIndicator currentIndex={1} vertical>
  <ProgressStep label="Request submitted" secondaryLabel="1 Oct, 09:12" />
  <ProgressStep label="Legal review" secondaryLabel="In progress" />
  <ProgressStep label="Approval by the managing director" />
  <ProgressStep label="Signing" />
</ProgressIndicator>
```

## Space equally

By default each step is 128px wide, and a longer label wraps at 88px (Carbon cuts it with an ellipsis; here no step name is hidden). `space-equally` stretches the steps to share the full width instead. It has no effect with `vertical`.


HTML:

```html
<ui-progress-indicator current-index="2" space-equally>
  <ui-progress-step label="Details"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Signers"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Review"></ui-progress-step>
  <ui-progress-step label="Send"></ui-progress-step>
</ui-progress-indicator>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiProgressIndicator currentIndex={2} spaceEqually>
  <UiProgressStep label="Details" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Signers" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Review" />
  <UiProgressStep label="Send" />
</UiProgressIndicator>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ProgressIndicator currentIndex={2} spaceEqually>
  <ProgressStep label="Details" />
  <ProgressStep label="Signers" />
  <ProgressStep label="Review" />
  <ProgressStep label="Send" />
</ProgressIndicator>
```

## Skeleton

While the steps load, show `ui-progress-indicator-skeleton`: `steps` empty steps (4 by default), in a row or stacked with `vertical`. It is hidden from screen readers, so say "loading" on the container (for example `aria-busy`).


HTML:

```html
<ui-progress-indicator-skeleton></ui-progress-indicator-skeleton>
<ui-progress-indicator-skeleton steps="3" vertical></ui-progress-indicator-skeleton>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiProgressIndicatorSkeleton } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiProgressIndicatorSkeleton />
<UiProgressIndicatorSkeleton steps={3} vertical />
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { ProgressIndicatorSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/progress-indicator';

<ProgressIndicatorSkeleton />
<ProgressIndicatorSkeleton steps={3} vertical />
```

On the web component, import it from `@purpurabog/ui/progress-indicator-skeleton`.

## Keyboard

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Tab / Shift+Tab | With `interactive`: moves between the steps (disabled steps are skipped). Without it the steps aren't Tab stops. |
| Enter, Space | With `interactive`: makes the focused step current (nothing on the current step) |

## Accessibility

- The indicator is a list and each step a list item, as Carbon's `<ul>` / `<li>`.
- The current step has `aria-current="step"`. After each label, screen readers hear the step's state: "Complete", "Current", "Incomplete" or "Invalid" (in Thai with `lang="th"`).
- A disabled step's button is disabled and `aria-disabled`.
- The indicator shows progress; it doesn't name the task. Put a heading above it, and repeat the current step in text (as "Step 2 of 4" above) for people who don't see the icons.

Unstyled React parts with the same behaviour: [Headless Progress indicator](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-progress-indicator/).

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-progress-indicator>` · React `UiProgressIndicator`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `current-index` | `currentIndex` | `number` | `0` | Index of the current step (0-based). |
| `vertical` | `vertical` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `space-equally` | `spaceEqually` | `boolean` | `false` | Stretch the steps to share the width (horizontal only). |
| `interactive` | `interactive` | `boolean` | `false` | Let the user jump between steps (fires `ui-change`). |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `focus(options)` | Interactive indicators: focus the current step. |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-change` | `onUiChange` | detail: { index } when the user picks another step |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | `<ui-progress-step>` elements |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `base` | The list |

### `<ui-progress-step>` · React `UiProgressStep`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `secondary-label` | `secondaryLabel` | `string` | `''` | Smaller text under the label (Carbon `secondaryLabel`). |
| `complete` | `complete` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the step done regardless of `current-index`. |
| `invalid` | `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `data-state` | `state` | `ProgressStepState` | `'incomplete'` | Set by the indicator: the resolved state. |

#### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `clickable` | `boolean` | Set by the indicator: whether steps are clickable. |
| `index` | `number` | Set by the indicator: this step's position. |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-step-click` | none (use a ref) |  |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Nothing; use `label` and `secondary-label` |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `button` | The clickable step |
| `icon` | The state icon |
| `label` | The label |
| `secondary-label` | The secondary label |
| `line` | The progress line |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-progress-step-flex` |  | / --ui-progress-step-min-width - A horizontal step's `flex` and least width (default `0 1 auto`, 112px: Carbon's 128px steps; Kanok: `1 1 0`, 120px) |
| `--ui-progress-label-max-width` |  | / --ui-progress-label-gap - Its label's `max-width` and end margin (default 88px, 0) |
| `--ui-progress-label-white-space` |  | / --ui-progress-label-overflow / --ui-progress-label-text-overflow - Its label on one line (default normal, visible, clip: it wraps; Kanok: one line, an ellipsis) |

### `<ui-progress-indicator-skeleton>` · React `UiProgressIndicatorSkeleton`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | `steps` | `number` | `4` |  |
| `vertical` | `vertical` | `boolean` | `false` |  |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `step` | Each step |
| `label` | Each label bar |

# UI shell

The UI shell is the frame of an application: a 48px header fixed at the top, a side navigation on the left and the content area beside them. The header holds the product name, the main menu bar and icon buttons for global actions; the side nav holds the sections of the product.

This site is built with these elements: the header above this page and the side nav on its left are the live example. The examples below run in framed boxes of their own; [Examples on this page](#examples-on-this-page) says why.


HTML:

```html
<div id="ui-shell-intro" style="transform: translateZ(0); position: relative; height: 400px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--ui-hairline)">
  <template>
    <ui-header label="Metro Contracts">
      <ui-skip-to-content href="#ui-shell-intro-main"></ui-skip-to-content>
      <ui-header-menu-button></ui-header-menu-button>
      <ui-header-name href="#home" prefix="Metro">Contracts</ui-header-name>
      <ui-header-nav label="Metro Contracts">
        <ui-header-menu-item href="#requests" current>Requests</ui-header-menu-item>
        <ui-header-menu-item href="#templates">Templates</ui-header-menu-item>
      </ui-header-nav>
      <ui-header-global-bar>
        <ui-header-global-action label="Notifications">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M17 14.3V13l-1.5-1.5V8a5.5 5.5 0 0 0-4.6-5.4V1.4H9.1v1.2A5.5 5.5 0 0 0 4.5 8v3.5L3 13v1.3h4.4a2.6 2.6 0 0 0 5.2 0ZM10 15.9a1.3 1.3 0 0 1-1.3-1.3h2.6a1.3 1.3 0 0 1-1.3 1.3Z" /></svg>
        </ui-header-global-action>
      </ui-header-global-bar>
    </ui-header>
    <ui-side-nav label="Sections">
      <ui-side-nav-items>
        <ui-side-nav-link href="#dashboard" current>Dashboard</ui-side-nav-link>
        <ui-side-nav-menu label="Requests">
          <ui-side-nav-menu-item href="#open">Open</ui-side-nav-menu-item>
          <ui-side-nav-menu-item href="#signing">Awaiting signature</ui-side-nav-menu-item>
        </ui-side-nav-menu>
        <ui-side-nav-link href="#settings">Settings</ui-side-nav-link>
      </ui-side-nav-items>
    </ui-side-nav>
    <ui-content id="ui-shell-intro-main">
      <p style="margin: 0; font: var(--ui-font-headline)">Dashboard</p>
      <p style="font: var(--ui-font-body); color: var(--ui-ink-muted)">12 contracts wait for your signature.</p>
    </ui-content>
  </template>
</div>

<script type="module">
  // docs only: the example gets a shadow root of its own (this page has its own shell)
  const box = document.getElementById('ui-shell-intro');
  const shell = box.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
  shell.append(document.importNode(box.querySelector('template').content, true));
  shell.addEventListener('ui-navigate', (event) => {
    event.preventDefault(); // stay on this page
    event.stopPropagation();
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
import { Notification as NotificationIcon } from '@carbon/icons-react';

<UiHeader label="Metro Contracts">
  <UiSkipToContent />
  <UiHeaderMenuButton />
  <UiHeaderName href="/" prefix="Metro">Contracts</UiHeaderName>
  <UiHeaderNav label="Metro Contracts">
    <UiHeaderMenuItem href="/requests" current>Requests</UiHeaderMenuItem>
    <UiHeaderMenuItem href="/templates">Templates</UiHeaderMenuItem>
  </UiHeaderNav>
  <UiHeaderGlobalBar>
    <UiHeaderGlobalAction label="Notifications"><NotificationIcon /></UiHeaderGlobalAction>
  </UiHeaderGlobalBar>
</UiHeader>
<UiSideNav label="Sections">
  <UiSideNavItems>
    <UiSideNavLink href="/" current>Dashboard</UiSideNavLink>
    <UiSideNavMenu label="Requests">
      <UiSideNavMenuItem href="/requests/open">Open</UiSideNavMenuItem>
      <UiSideNavMenuItem href="/requests/signing">Awaiting signature</UiSideNavMenuItem>
    </UiSideNavMenu>
    <UiSideNavLink href="/settings">Settings</UiSideNavLink>
  </UiSideNavItems>
</UiSideNav>
<UiContent>
  <h1>Dashboard</h1>
  <p>12 contracts wait for your signature.</p>
</UiContent>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx

<Header aria-label="Metro Contracts">
  <SkipToContent />

</Content>
```

The `…Icon` components on this page are Carbon's icons from `@carbon/icons-react`, imported with an `Icon` suffix (see [Icons](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/icons/)). The header shows them at 20px and the side nav at 16px; in the React tabs they pass `slot` on to their `<svg>`.

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/shell
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-header @kanok-ui/tw-side-nav
```

Manual:

```bash

#    components/ui/primitives/shell/header-panel.ts

#    components/ui/primitives/shell/shell-shared.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/shell/shell.ts

# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):

# React + Tailwind

# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
```
