# Tile

A tile is a plain box on the next layer colour: 16px padding, no border, no shadow. It groups content on a dashboard or a summary page. With `href` the whole tile becomes one link. Carbon has four more kinds; here they are `ui-expandable-tile`, `ui-selectable-tile` and `ui-radio-tile`.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 16px">
  <ui-tile>
    <p style="margin: 0 0 8px; font: var(--ui-font-caption); color: var(--ui-ink-muted)">Awaiting signature</p>
    <p style="margin: 0; font: var(--ui-font-heading-04)">12</p>
  </ui-tile>
  <ui-tile>
    <p style="margin: 0 0 8px; font: var(--ui-font-caption); color: var(--ui-ink-muted)">Signed this month</p>
    <p style="margin: 0; font: var(--ui-font-heading-04)">48</p>
  </ui-tile>
  <ui-tile>
    <p style="margin: 0 0 8px; font: var(--ui-font-caption); color: var(--ui-ink-muted)">Expiring in 30 days</p>
    <p style="margin: 0; font: var(--ui-font-heading-04)">5</p>
  </ui-tile>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: 16 }}>
  <UiTile>
    <p className="caption">Awaiting signature</p>
    <p className="figure">12</p>
  </UiTile>
  <UiTile>
    <p className="caption">Signed this month</p>
    <p className="figure">48</p>
  </UiTile>
  <UiTile>
    <p className="caption">Expiring in 30 days</p>
    <p className="figure">5</p>
  </UiTile>
</div>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<div className="grid grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fill,minmax(180px,1fr))] gap-4">
  <Tile>
    <p className="mb-2 type-caption text-ink-muted">Awaiting signature</p>
    <p className="type-heading-04">12</p>
  </Tile>
  <Tile>
    <p className="mb-2 type-caption text-ink-muted">Signed this month</p>
    <p className="type-heading-04">48</p>
  </Tile>
  <Tile>
    <p className="mb-2 type-caption text-ink-muted">Expiring in 30 days</p>
    <p className="type-heading-04">5</p>
  </Tile>
</div>
```

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tile
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-tile
```

Manual:

```bash
# Web component
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install lit@^3.3.0
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tile.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/expandable-tile.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/radio-tile.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/selectable-tile.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/selection-tiles-shared.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/selection-tiles.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/tile/tile.ts
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    checkbox, radio, shared-element, shared-events, shared-field, shared-localize, shared-navigate, tokens

# React + Tailwind
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install @purpurabog/ui@^1.4.3
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tw-tile.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/react-tw/tile.tsx
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    tw-field, tw-i18n, tw-radio-group, tw-theme, tw-utils
```

npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Use it

Each kind has its own module: `tile` for `ui-tile`, `expandable-tile`, and `selection-tiles` for the selectable and radio tiles.


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">
  import '@purpurabog/ui/tile';
  import '@purpurabog/ui/expandable-tile';
  import '@purpurabog/ui/selection-tiles';
</script>

<ui-tile>Contracts awaiting signature: 12</ui-tile>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiTile, UiExpandableTile, UiSelectableTile, UiRadioTile } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiTile>Contracts awaiting signature: 12</UiTile>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { Tile, ExpandableTile, SelectableTile, RadioTile } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/tile';

<Tile>Contracts awaiting signature: 12</Tile>
```

## Which tile?

| Tile | Element | Use it for |
|---|---|---|
| Tile | `ui-tile` | A box of content: a figure, a short summary. |
| Clickable tile | `ui-tile href` | The whole tile goes to one page. |
| Expandable tile | `ui-expandable-tile` | A summary that opens to show more. |
| Selectable tile | `ui-selectable-tile` | A checkbox with room for a title and a description. More on the [checkbox page](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/checkbox/#selectable-tiles). |
| Radio tile | `ui-radio-tile` | A radio option with room for a title and a description. More on the [radio page](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/radio/#radio-tiles). |

For a box with a header, media and actions, use a [Card](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/card/).

## Content

Put any content in a tile: headings, text, a small table. A tile is at least 64px tall and 128px wide and fills its column, so lay several out with CSS grid. The text inside is body-compact-01 unless you set another font.


HTML:

```html
<ui-tile style="max-width: 420px">
  <h3 style="margin: 0 0 8px; font: var(--ui-font-heading-02)">Office lease, Silom branch</h3>
  <p style="margin: 0 0 16px">Three-year lease from 1 January 2027. Rent is paid on the 5th of each month.</p>
  <p style="margin: 0; color: var(--ui-ink-muted)">Owner: Legal department</p>
</ui-tile>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiTile style={{ maxWidth: 420 }}>
  <h3>Office lease, Silom branch</h3>
  <p>Three-year lease from 1 January 2027. Rent is paid on the 5th of each month.</p>
  <p>Owner: Legal department</p>
</UiTile>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Tile className="max-w-[420px]">
  <h3 className="mb-2 type-heading-02">Office lease, Silom branch</h3>
  <p className="mb-4">Three-year lease from 1 January 2027. Rent is paid on the 5th of each month.</p>
  <p className="text-ink-muted">Owner: Legal department</p>
</Tile>
```

## Clickable tile

With `href` the whole tile is one link and a single tab stop; the pointer turns its fill to the hover colour. Its text is the link's name, so keep it short, and don't put other buttons or links inside. As in Carbon, a linked tile has no icon until you give it one in the `icon` slot (the `icon` prop in React + Tailwind): 20px, 12px from the bottom-end corner.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 16px">
  <ui-tile href="#accessibility">
    <h3 style="margin: 0 0 8px; font: var(--ui-font-heading-02)">Contracts awaiting signature</h3>
    <p style="margin: 0 0 24px">12 contracts, 3 overdue</p>
    <svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11.8 2.8-.9.9 5.6 5.7H1.7v1.2h14.8l-5.6 5.7.9.9 7.2-7.2z" /></svg>
  </ui-tile>
  <ui-tile href="#accessibility">
    <h3 style="margin: 0 0 8px; font: var(--ui-font-heading-02)">Approval requests</h3>
    <p style="margin: 0 0 24px">4 waiting for you</p>
    <svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11.8 2.8-.9.9 5.6 5.7H1.7v1.2h14.8l-5.6 5.7.9.9 7.2-7.2z" /></svg>
  </ui-tile>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
const arrow = <svg slot="icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11.8 2.8-.9.9 5.6 5.7H1.7v1.2h14.8l-5.6 5.7.9.9 7.2-7.2z" /></svg>;

<UiTile href="/contracts?status=awaiting">
  <h3>Contracts awaiting signature</h3>
  <p>12 contracts, 3 overdue</p>
  {arrow}
</UiTile>
<UiTile href="/approvals">
  <h3>Approval requests</h3>
  <p>4 waiting for you</p>
  {arrow}
</UiTile>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const arrow = <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m11.8 2.8-.9.9 5.6 5.7H1.7v1.2h14.8l-5.6 5.7.9.9 7.2-7.2z" /></svg>;

<Tile href="/contracts?status=awaiting" icon={arrow}>
  <h3 className="mb-2 type-heading-02">Contracts awaiting signature</h3>
  <p className="mb-6">12 contracts, 3 overdue</p>
</Tile>
<Tile href="/approvals" icon={arrow}>
  <h3 className="mb-2 type-heading-02">Approval requests</h3>
  <p className="mb-6">4 waiting for you</p>
</Tile>
```

`target="_blank"` opens the link in a new tab; the tile then adds "(opens in a new tab)" for screen readers and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.

## Disabled clickable tile

`disabled` on a linked tile turns it into plain greyed text with no link (Carbon's disabled `ClickableTile`), for a page the user can't open right now. Say why in the tile.


HTML:

```html
<ui-tile href="#accessibility" disabled style="max-width: 320px">
  <h3 style="margin: 0 0 8px; font: inherit; font-weight: 600">Annual report 2026</h3>
  <p style="margin: 0">Available after the books close on 31 January</p>
</ui-tile>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiTile href="/reports/2026" disabled style={{ maxWidth: 320 }}>
  <h3>Annual report 2026</h3>
  <p>Available after the books close on 31 January</p>
</UiTile>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Tile href="/reports/2026" disabled className="max-w-[320px]">
  <h3 className="mb-2 font-semibold">Annual report 2026</h3>
  <p>Available after the books close on 31 January</p>
</Tile>
```

## Route with your SPA router

A plain click on a linked tile first fires a cancelable `ui-navigate` with `{ href }`. Cancel it and let your router change the page; one listener on `document` covers every element, see [Frameworks](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/frameworks/#route-links-with-your-spa-router). The demo cancels it and shows the address instead.


HTML:

```html
<ui-tile id="tile-route" href="/contracts/C-2026-014" style="max-width: 320px">
  <h3 style="margin: 0 0 8px; font: var(--ui-font-heading-02)">C-2026-014</h3>
  <p style="margin: 0">Supply agreement, Chiang Mai plant</p>
</ui-tile>
<p>Router would open: <output id="tile-route-out">nothing yet</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const tile = document.getElementById('tile-route');
  const out = document.getElementById('tile-route-out');
  tile.addEventListener('ui-navigate', (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    out.value = event.detail.href;
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const navigate = useNavigate(); // your router

<UiTile
  href="/contracts/C-2026-014"
  onUiNavigate={(e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    navigate(e.detail.href);
  }}
>
  <h3>C-2026-014</h3>
  <p>Supply agreement, Chiang Mai plant</p>
</UiTile>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
// the tile is a real <a>: wrap it in your router's link, or handle the click
<Tile
  href="/contracts/C-2026-014"
  onClick={(e) => {
    if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.button !== 0) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    navigate('/contracts/C-2026-014');
  }}
>
  <h3 className="mb-2 type-heading-02">C-2026-014</h3>
  <p>Supply agreement, Chiang Mai plant</p>
</Tile>
```

## On a layer

A tile draws itself in the layer colour it sits on. Inside a `ui-layer` it takes the next one, so it still stands out from a grey panel.


HTML:

```html
<ui-layer level="1" with-background style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; padding: 16px">
  <ui-tile><b>On layer 1</b><br />The tile takes layer 2.</ui-tile>
  <ui-tile href="#accessibility"><b>Clickable</b><br />Its hover follows the layer too.</ui-tile>
</ui-layer>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiLayer level={1} withBackground style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: 16, padding: 16 }}>
  <UiTile><b>On layer 1</b><br />The tile takes layer 2.</UiTile>
  <UiTile href="/contracts"><b>Clickable</b><br />Its hover follows the layer too.</UiTile>
</UiLayer>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
// npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-layer
import { Layer } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/layer';

<Layer level={1} withBackground className="grid grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fill,minmax(180px,1fr))] gap-4 p-4">
  <Tile><b>On layer 1</b><br />The tile takes layer 2.</Tile>
  <Tile href="/contracts"><b>Clickable</b><br />Its hover follows the layer too.</Tile>
</Layer>
```

More on layers: [Layer](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/layer/).

## Expandable tile

`ui-expandable-tile` shows a summary and opens to show more. The summary (`slot="summary"`) sits inside the toggle button, so keep it to text; put links, fields and buttons in the revealed part. The chevron in the bottom-end corner turns when it opens.


HTML:

```html
<ui-expandable-tile style="max-width: 560px">
  <span slot="summary"><b>Signing options</b><br />Retention, watermark, signer records</span>
  <p style="margin: 16px 0 0">Signed copies are kept for 10 years. Every page carries a watermark with the contract number, and the signer's IP address is recorded.</p>
</ui-expandable-tile>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiExpandableTile style={{ maxWidth: 560 }}>
  <span slot="summary"><b>Signing options</b><br />Retention, watermark, signer records</span>
  <p>Signed copies are kept for 10 years. Every page carries a watermark with the contract number, and the signer's IP address is recorded.</p>
</UiExpandableTile>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<ExpandableTile className="max-w-[560px]" summary={<><b>Signing options</b><br />Retention, watermark, signer records</>}>
  <p className="mt-4">Signed copies are kept for 10 years. Every page carries a watermark with the contract number, and the signer's IP address is recorded.</p>
</ExpandableTile>
```

## Open state and events

`expanded` opens the tile (start it open by setting it). After each toggle `ui-toggle` fires with `detail.expanded`. `toggle()` on the element opens or closes it from your code; `toggle(true)` only opens.


HTML:

```html
<ui-expandable-tile id="tile-expand" expanded style="max-width: 560px">
  <span slot="summary"><b>Payment schedule</b><br />12 instalments</span>
  <p style="margin: 16px 0 0">5th of each month, 85,000 baht, by bank transfer.</p>
</ui-expandable-tile>
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: center">
  <ui-button id="tile-expand-open" kind="tertiary" size="sm">Open</ui-button>
  <span>Expanded: <output id="tile-expand-out"></output></span>
</div>

<script type="module">
  const tile = document.getElementById('tile-expand');
  const out = document.getElementById('tile-expand-out');
  out.value = tile.expanded;
  tile.addEventListener('ui-toggle', (event) => (out.value = event.detail.expanded));
  document.getElementById('tile-expand-open').addEventListener('click', () => tile.toggle(true));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true);

<UiExpandableTile expanded={expanded} onUiToggle={(e) => setExpanded(e.detail.expanded)}>
  <span slot="summary"><b>Payment schedule</b><br />12 instalments</span>
  <p>5th of each month, 85,000 baht, by bank transfer.</p>
</UiExpandableTile>
<UiButton kind="tertiary" size="sm" onClick={() => setExpanded(true)}>Open</UiButton>
<p>Expanded: <output>{String(expanded)}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true);

<ExpandableTile expanded={expanded} onToggle={setExpanded} summary={<><b>Payment schedule</b><br />12 instalments</>}>
  <p className="mt-4">5th of each month, 85,000 baht, by bank transfer.</p>
</ExpandableTile>
<Button kind="tertiary" size="sm" onClick={() => setExpanded(true)}>Open</Button>
<p>Expanded: <output>{String(expanded)}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind also takes `defaultExpanded` for a tile you don't control.

## Keep it open

Before it changes, the tile fires a cancelable `ui-before-toggle` with the state it is about to take. Cancel it to keep the tile as it is, for example while a note inside isn't saved. In React + Tailwind, return `false` from `onBeforeToggle`. Type a note, then try to close the tile.


HTML:

```html
<ui-expandable-tile id="tile-note" expanded style="max-width: 560px">
  <span slot="summary"><b>Note for the approver</b></span>
  <div style="display: grid; gap: 16px; margin-top: 16px">
    <ui-text-area id="tile-note-text" label="Note" rows="2"></ui-text-area>
    <div><ui-button id="tile-note-save" size="sm">Save note</ui-button></div>
  </div>
</ui-expandable-tile>
<p>Last attempt: <output id="tile-note-out">none</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const tile = document.getElementById('tile-note');
  const text = document.getElementById('tile-note-text');
  const out = document.getElementById('tile-note-out');
  tile.addEventListener('ui-before-toggle', (event) => {
    if (!event.detail.expanded && text.value.trim() !== '') {
      event.preventDefault();
      out.value = 'kept open: the note isn\'t saved';
    } else {
      out.value = event.detail.expanded ? 'opened' : 'closed';
    }
  });
  document.getElementById('tile-note-save').addEventListener('click', () => {
    out.value = `saved "${text.value.trim()}"`;
    text.value = '';
  });
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
import type { UiTextArea as TextAreaElement } from '@purpurabog/ui';

const [note, setNote] = useState('');
const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true);

<UiExpandableTile
  expanded={expanded}
  onUiBeforeToggle={(e) => {
    if (!e.detail.expanded && note.trim() !== '') e.preventDefault();
  }}
  onUiToggle={(e) => setExpanded(e.detail.expanded)}
>
  <span slot="summary"><b>Note for the approver</b></span>
  <UiTextArea label="Note" rows={2} value={note} onInput={(e) => setNote((e.target as TextAreaElement).value)} />
  <UiButton size="sm" onClick={() => save(note)}>Save note</UiButton>
</UiExpandableTile>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [note, setNote] = useState('');

<ExpandableTile defaultExpanded onBeforeToggle={(next) => next || note.trim() === ''} summary={<b>Note for the approver</b>}>
  <TextArea label="Note" rows={2} value={note} onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)} />
  <Button size="sm" onClick={() => save(note)}>Save note</Button>
</ExpandableTile>
```

## Selectable tile

`ui-selectable-tile` is a checkbox drawn as a tile, with the same API as `ui-checkbox`: `checked`, `name`, `value`, `change`, and it submits with its form. Alone, each tile is one yes/no choice. Groups, `required`, read-only and errors are on the [checkbox page](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/checkbox/#selectable-tiles).


HTML:

```html
<div id="tile-addons" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 16px">
  <ui-selectable-tile name="addons" value="stamp"><b>Stamp duty</b><br />Calculate and pay for me</ui-selectable-tile>
  <ui-selectable-tile name="addons" value="translate" checked><b>Translation</b><br />Thai and English copies</ui-selectable-tile>
  <ui-selectable-tile name="addons" value="courier" disabled><b>Courier</b><br />Not available in your area</ui-selectable-tile>
</div>
<p>Chosen: <output id="tile-addons-out"></output></p>

<script type="module">
  const row = document.getElementById('tile-addons');
  const out = document.getElementById('tile-addons-out');
  const show = () => (out.value = [...row.querySelectorAll('ui-selectable-tile')].filter((tile) => tile.checked).map((tile) => tile.value).join(', ') || 'none');
  show();
  row.addEventListener('change', show);
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
import type { UiSelectableTile as SelectableTileElement } from '@purpurabog/ui';

const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<string[]>(['translate']);
const toggle = (e: Event) => {
  const tile = e.target as SelectableTileElement;
  setChosen(tile.checked ? [...chosen, tile.value] : chosen.filter((v) => v !== tile.value));
};

<UiSelectableTile name="addons" value="stamp" checked={chosen.includes('stamp')} onChange={toggle}><b>Stamp duty</b><br />Calculate and pay for me</UiSelectableTile>
<UiSelectableTile name="addons" value="translate" checked={chosen.includes('translate')} onChange={toggle}><b>Translation</b><br />Thai and English copies</UiSelectableTile>
<UiSelectableTile name="addons" value="courier" disabled><b>Courier</b><br />Not available in your area</UiSelectableTile>
<p>Chosen: <output>{chosen.join(', ') || 'none'}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<string[]>(['translate']);
const toggle = (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) =>
  setChosen(e.target.checked ? [...chosen, e.target.value] : chosen.filter((v) => v !== e.target.value));

<SelectableTile name="addons" value="stamp" checked={chosen.includes('stamp')} onChange={toggle}><b>Stamp duty</b><br />Calculate and pay for me</SelectableTile>
<SelectableTile name="addons" value="translate" checked={chosen.includes('translate')} onChange={toggle}><b>Translation</b><br />Thai and English copies</SelectableTile>
<SelectableTile name="addons" value="courier" disabled><b>Courier</b><br />Not available in your area</SelectableTile>
<p>Chosen: <output>{chosen.join(', ') || 'none'}</output></p>
```

## Radio tiles

`ui-radio-tile` is one option of a `ui-radio-group`, drawn as a tile. The group gives the arrow keys, the value, `change` and the form; the check mark shows only on the chosen tile. Orientation, `required`, read-only and errors are on the [radio page](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/radio/#radio-tiles).


HTML:

```html
<ui-radio-group id="tile-method" label="Signing method" name="method" value="esign">
  <ui-radio-tile value="esign"><b>E-signature</b><br />Sign online in minutes</ui-radio-tile>
  <ui-radio-tile value="paper"><b>Paper</b><br />Print, sign and scan</ui-radio-tile>
  <ui-radio-tile value="branch"><b>At a branch</b><br />Sign with a witness from our staff</ui-radio-tile>
</ui-radio-group>
<p>Value: <output id="tile-method-out"></output></p>

<script type="module">
  const group = document.getElementById('tile-method');
  const out = document.getElementById('tile-method-out');
  out.value = group.value;
  group.addEventListener('change', () => (out.value = group.value));
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
import type { UiRadioGroup as RadioGroupElement } from '@purpurabog/ui';

const [method, setMethod] = useState('esign');

<UiRadioGroup label="Signing method" name="method" value={method} onChange={(e) => setMethod((e.target as RadioGroupElement).value)}>
  <UiRadioTile value="esign"><b>E-signature</b><br />Sign online in minutes</UiRadioTile>
  <UiRadioTile value="paper"><b>Paper</b><br />Print, sign and scan</UiRadioTile>
  <UiRadioTile value="branch"><b>At a branch</b><br />Sign with a witness from our staff</UiRadioTile>
</UiRadioGroup>
<p>Value: <output>{method}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
// npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-radio-group
import { RadioGroup } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/radio-group';

const [method, setMethod] = useState('esign');

<RadioGroup label="Signing method" name="method" value={method} onValueChange={setMethod}>
  <RadioTile value="esign"><b>E-signature</b><br />Sign online in minutes</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="paper"><b>Paper</b><br />Print, sign and scan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="branch"><b>At a branch</b><br />Sign with a witness from our staff</RadioTile>
</RadioGroup>
<p>Value: <output>{method}</output></p>
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Tab | Moves to a clickable tile, an expandable tile's toggle, a selectable tile, or the chosen radio tile. A plain tile isn't a tab stop. |
| Enter | Follows a clickable tile's link; opens or closes an expandable tile |
| Space | Opens or closes an expandable tile; checks or unchecks a selectable tile |
| Arrow keys | Move between radio tiles and choose |

## Accessibility

- A plain tile is a box with no role. Give its content real headings, so the page outline stays right.
- A clickable tile is one link, and its whole text is the link's name. Keep it short and put no other controls inside.
- An expandable tile's toggle is a button with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. Its summary is part of the button's name, which is why it holds text only.
- A selectable tile is a real checkbox and a radio tile a real radio, so screen readers announce their state and the tile text is their name.

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-tile>` · React `UiTile`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `href` | `href` | `string` | `''` | Makes the whole tile a link. |
| `target` | `target` | `'_self' \| '_blank'` | `'_self'` |  |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | A linked tile that can't be followed right now (Carbon `ClickableTile disabled`): plain text, no link. |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-navigate` | none (use a ref) | detail: { href } (cancelable) on a plain click of the link; cancel it to route client-side (README: SPA router) |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Tile content |
| `icon` | A linked tile's icon (e.g. an arrow), 20px, 12px from the bottom-end corner |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `base` | The container (`<div>` or `<a>`) |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-card-radius` |  | Corner radius (default 0; Kanok: 12px) |
| `--ui-card-border` |  | Border (default none; Kanok: a hairline) |
| `--ui-card-background` |  | Its fill (default `--ui-surface-1`; Kanok paper: a cool grey that sets it apart from the page, no border) |
| `--ui-focus-offset` |  | `outline-offset` of its focus ring (default -2px: inside; Kanok: 2px outside) |

### `<ui-expandable-tile>` · React `UiExpandableTile`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `expanded` | `expanded` | `boolean` | `false` |  |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-toggle` | `onUiToggle` | detail: { expanded } |
| `ui-before-toggle` | `onUiBeforeToggle` | Cancelable; detail: { expanded } — the state about to be applied |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| `summary` | Always visible (text only) |
| (default) | Revealed content |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `summary` | The always-visible button row |
| `chevron` | The arrow icon |
| `content` | The expandable body |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-card-border` |  | / --ui-card-radius - Border and corners, as the cards (default none and square; Kanok: a hairline, 12px) |
| `--ui-card-background` |  | Its fill (default `--ui-surface-1`; Kanok paper: a cool grey that sets it apart from the page, no border) |
| `--ui-focus-offset` |  | `outline-offset` of its focus ring (default -2px: inside; Kanok: 2px outside) |

### `<ui-selectable-tile>` · React `UiSelectableTile`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `checked` | `checked` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `indeterminate` | `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | Mixed state, e.g. a "select all" box with some children checked. Cleared on user toggle. |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control; a disabled `<fieldset>` ancestor does the same. |
| `required` | `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Blocks form submission while the field is empty. |
| `readonly` | `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows and submits the value but blocks changes. |
| `hide-label` | `hideLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep the label text for screen readers but don't show it. |
| `name` | `name` | `string` | `''` | Reflected: form-associated elements submit under the `name` attribute. |
| `value` | `value` | `string` | `'on'` |  |
| `helper-text` | `helperText` | `string` | `''` | Helper text under the field, shown while there is no error or warning. |
| `invalid-text` | `invalidText` | `string` | `''` | Error text shown while `invalid` or while the field fails validation. |
| `invalid` | `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Forces the error state, e.g. after server-side validation. |
| `warn` | `warn` | `boolean` | `false` | Non-blocking warning; shown when there is no error. |
| `warn-text` | `warnText` | `string` | `''` | Text of the warning shown while `warn`. |

#### Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `groupDisabled` | `boolean` | Set by ui-checkbox-group; kept apart from the author's own disabled / readonly. |
| `groupMessage` | `string` | Error text of the owning ui-checkbox-group while the group is invalid. The group shows it once below the boxes; each box repeats it as its own accessible description and reports aria-invalid, so a screen reader landing on the first box hears why (an IDREF cannot cross the group's shadow root). |
| `willValidate` |  | (read-only) Whether the field takes part in constraint validation (not while disabled), as natively. |
| `labels` |  | (read-only) The `<label>`s that point at this field. |

#### Methods

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `setCustomValidity(message)` | Like `<input>.setCustomValidity()`: a non-empty message makes the field invalid (and is shown as its error once touched) until cleared with ''. |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `change` | none (use a ref) | When the user toggles the box |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Tile content (title, description…) |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `base` | The clickable row (label element) |
| `control` | The native checkbox input |
| `box` | The drawn 16px box |
| `label` | The text beside the box |
| `status-icon` | The error / warning icon |
| `helper-text` | The helper line |
| `warning-text` | The warning line |
| `warn-text` | Same line as `warning-text` (named after the `warn-text` attribute / slot) |
| `error-text` | The error line |
| `invalid-text` | Same line as `error-text` (named after the `invalid-text` attribute / slot) |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-tile-border-color` |  | Border of an unchosen tile (default transparent; Kanok: a hairline); `--ui-card-radius` its corners |
| `--ui-card-background` |  | Its fill (default `--ui-surface-1`; Kanok paper: a cool grey that sets it apart from the page, no border) |
| `--ui-tile-selected-border` |  | Border of the chosen tile (default `--ui-layer-selected-inverse`; Kanok: primary blue); `--ui-tile-selected-mark` its check mark (default `--ui-icon-primary`) |
| `--ui-tile-selected-background` |  | Fill of the chosen tile (default `--ui-card-background`; Kanok: soft highlight wash) |
| `--ui-checkbox-border` |  | Border of the box (default `--ui-ink`; Kanok: `--ui-ink-subtle`) |
| `--ui-checkbox-checked` |  | Fill and border when checked or mixed (default `--ui-ink`; Kanok: `--ui-primary`) |
| `--ui-checkbox-mark` |  | Check mark colour (default `--ui-icon-inverse`; Kanok: `--ui-on-primary`) |

### `<ui-radio-tile>` · React `UiRadioTile`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `value` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `checked` | `checked` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control; a disabled `<fieldset>` ancestor does the same. |
| `label-position` | `labelPosition` | `RadioLabelPosition \| undefined` |  | Carbon `labelPosition`: `left` puts the text before the circle; unset, the group's `label-position` applies. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | Tile content (title, description…) |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `circle` | The drawn radio circle |
| `label` | The text beside it |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-tile-border-color` |  | Border of an unchosen tile (default transparent; Kanok: a hairline); `--ui-card-radius` its corners |
| `--ui-card-background` |  | Its fill (default `--ui-surface-1`; Kanok paper: a cool grey that sets it apart from the page, no border) |
| `--ui-tile-selected-border` |  | Border of the chosen tile (default `--ui-layer-selected-inverse`; Kanok: primary blue); `--ui-tile-selected-mark` its check mark (default `--ui-icon-primary`) |
| `--ui-tile-selected-background` |  | Fill of the chosen tile (default `--ui-card-background`; Kanok: soft highlight wash) |
| `--ui-radio-border` |  | Ring colour (default `--ui-ink`; Kanok: `--ui-ink-subtle`) |
| `--ui-radio-checked` |  | Ring and dot when chosen (default `--ui-ink`; Kanok: `--ui-primary`) |

# Card

A card is a box built from parts: media, a header with a title and its actions, a body and a footer. Use it for a set of things the user browses or picks from: projects, reports, documents. It is Carbon's `Card` (a preview in Carbon): square, no border, no shadow, on the next layer colour.


HTML:

```html
<ui-card style="max-width: 360px">
  <ui-card-media ratio="16x9">
    <img alt="" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 160 90'%3E%3Crect width='160' height='90' fill='%23d0e2ff'/%3E%3Cpath d='M66 20h22l10 10v40H66z' fill='%23ffffff'/%3E%3Cpath d='M72 42h20M72 50h20M72 58h12' stroke='%230f62fe' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3C/svg%3E" />
  </ui-card-media>
  <ui-card-header>
    <ui-card-title label="Contract" description="Updated 3 October 2026">Office lease, Silom branch</ui-card-title>
  </ui-card-header>
  <ui-card-body>Three-year lease from 1 January 2027. Waiting for the landlord's signature.</ui-card-body>
  <ui-card-footer>
    <ui-card-action><ui-button kind="ghost">Open contract</ui-button></ui-card-action>
  </ui-card-footer>
</ui-card>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiCard style={{ maxWidth: 360 }}>
  <UiCardMedia ratio="16x9"><img alt="" src={leaseImage} /></UiCardMedia>
  <UiCardHeader>
    <UiCardTitle label="Contract" description="Updated 3 October 2026">Office lease, Silom branch</UiCardTitle>
  </UiCardHeader>
  <UiCardBody>Three-year lease from 1 January 2027. Waiting for the landlord's signature.</UiCardBody>
  <UiCardFooter>
    <UiCardAction><UiButton kind="ghost">Open contract</UiButton></UiCardAction>
  </UiCardFooter>
</UiCard>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Card className="max-w-[360px]">
  <CardMedia ratio="16x9"><img alt="" src={leaseImage} /></CardMedia>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle label="Contract" description="Updated 3 October 2026">Office lease, Silom branch</CardTitle>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardBody>Three-year lease from 1 January 2027. Waiting for the landlord's signature.</CardBody>
  <CardFooter>
    <CardAction><Button kind="ghost">Open contract</Button></CardAction>
  </CardFooter>
</Card>
```

## Installation


npm:

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```

shadcn · Web component:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/card
```

shadcn · React + Tailwind:

```bash
npx shadcn@4 add @kanok-ui/tw-card
```

Manual:

```bash
# Web component
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install lit@^3.3.0
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/card.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/primitives/card/card-action.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/card/card-actions.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/card/card-body.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/card/card-footer.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/card/card-header-media.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/card/card-header.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/card/card-media.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/card/card-title-media.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/card/card-title.ts
#    components/ui/primitives/card/card.ts
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-overflow, menu, overflow-menu, shared-element, shared-field, shared-localize, shared-navigate, tokens

# React + Tailwind
# 1. Install the dependencies
npm install @purpurabog/ui@^1.4.3
# 2. Copy each file's "content" from
#    https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@purpurabog/ui@1.4.3/registry/tw-card.json
#    to its target:
#    components/ui/react-tw/card.tsx
# 3. Do the same for the items it needs (registry/<name>.json):
#    core-overflow, tw-i18n, tw-icon-button, tw-menu, tw-refs, tw-theme, tw-utils
```

npm gives you every component from the package. shadcn copies the source into your app instead: a copy pinned to this version that you can change. The shadcn commands need the `@kanok-ui` registry in your `components.json` once, see [Installation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/installation/#react-tailwind-with-shadcn).

## Use it

All the parts load from one module. In React, import a wrapper for each element (`UiCard`, `UiCardHeader`, `UiCardTitle` …) from `@purpurabog/ui/react`.


HTML:

```html
<script type="module">import '@purpurabog/ui/card';</script>

<ui-card>
  <ui-card-header><ui-card-title>Office lease</ui-card-title></ui-card-header>
  <ui-card-body>Waiting for the landlord's signature.</ui-card-body>
</ui-card>
```

React:

```tsx
import { UiCard, UiCardHeader, UiCardTitle, UiCardBody } from '@purpurabog/ui/react';

<UiCard>
  <UiCardHeader><UiCardTitle>Office lease</UiCardTitle></UiCardHeader>
  <UiCardBody>Waiting for the landlord's signature.</UiCardBody>
</UiCard>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardBody } from '@/components/ui/react-tw/card';

<Card>
  <CardHeader><CardTitle>Office lease</CardTitle></CardHeader>
  <CardBody>Waiting for the landlord's signature.</CardBody>
</Card>
```

## Card, tile or product card?

| Component | Use it when |
|---|---|
| [Tile](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/tile/) | A plain box of content, or one link. No header or footer of its own. |
| Card | Content with a title, media and actions, built from parts. The choice for new work. |
| [Product card](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/product-card/) | A screen must match IBM product UIs that use Carbon for IBM Products' `ProductiveCard` or `ExpressiveCard`. |

## The parts

Every part is optional; put them in this order.

| Part | Holds |
|---|---|
| `ui-card-media` | An image or video across the card, at `ratio` |
| `ui-card-header` | The header grid: `ui-card-header-media`, `ui-card-title-media`, `ui-card-title`, `ui-card-actions` |
| `ui-card-header-media` | A pictogram across the top of the header, at most 64px tall |
| `ui-card-title-media` | A logo before the title, 48–64px |
| `ui-card-title` | A label above, the title, a description below |
| `ui-card-actions` | Small buttons in the header's top-end corner |
| `ui-card-body` | The content, with 16px padding (none with `is-flush`) |
| `ui-card-footer` | Text, or a row of `ui-card-action`s |
| `ui-card-action` | One button in the footer or in `ui-card-actions` |


HTML:

```html
<ui-card style="max-width: 360px">
  <ui-card-header>
    <ui-card-header-media>
      <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 3h11l5 5v21H8zM19 3v5h5M12 14h8M12 18h8M12 22h5" /></svg>
    </ui-card-header-media>
    <ui-card-title label="Template" description="Used 128 times">Non-disclosure agreement</ui-card-title>
  </ui-card-header>
  <ui-card-body>Two-way NDA in Thai and English, approved by the legal department.</ui-card-body>
  <ui-card-footer>Last reviewed 1 September 2026</ui-card-footer>
</ui-card>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiCard style={{ maxWidth: 360 }}>
  <UiCardHeader>
    <UiCardHeaderMedia>{documentPictogram}</UiCardHeaderMedia>
    <UiCardTitle label="Template" description="Used 128 times">Non-disclosure agreement</UiCardTitle>
  </UiCardHeader>
  <UiCardBody>Two-way NDA in Thai and English, approved by the legal department.</UiCardBody>
  <UiCardFooter>Last reviewed 1 September 2026</UiCardFooter>
</UiCard>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Card className="max-w-[360px]">
  <CardHeader>
    <CardHeaderMedia>{documentPictogram}</CardHeaderMedia>
    <CardTitle label="Template" description="Used 128 times">Non-disclosure agreement</CardTitle>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardBody>Two-way NDA in Thai and English, approved by the legal department.</CardBody>
  <CardFooter>Last reviewed 1 September 2026</CardFooter>
</Card>
```

## Media

`ui-card-media` fills the card's width at `ratio`: `16x9`, `9x16`, `2x1`, `1x2`, `4x3`, `3x4`, `3x2`, `2x3` or `1x1`. The image covers the box and is cropped to fit. Without `ratio` it keeps the image's own shape.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; align-items: start">
  <ui-card>
    <ui-card-media ratio="16x9">
      <img alt="" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 160 90'%3E%3Crect width='160' height='90' fill='%23d0e2ff'/%3E%3Cpath d='M66 20h22l10 10v40H66z' fill='%23ffffff'/%3E%3Cpath d='M72 42h20M72 50h20M72 58h12' stroke='%230f62fe' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3C/svg%3E" />
    </ui-card-media>
    <ui-card-header><ui-card-title>16x9</ui-card-title></ui-card-header>
  </ui-card>
  <ui-card>
    <ui-card-media ratio="2x1">
      <img alt="" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 160 90'%3E%3Crect width='160' height='90' fill='%23d0e2ff'/%3E%3Cpath d='M66 20h22l10 10v40H66z' fill='%23ffffff'/%3E%3Cpath d='M72 42h20M72 50h20M72 58h12' stroke='%230f62fe' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3C/svg%3E" />
    </ui-card-media>
    <ui-card-header><ui-card-title>2x1</ui-card-title></ui-card-header>
  </ui-card>
  <ui-card>
    <ui-card-media ratio="1x1">
      <img alt="" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 160 90'%3E%3Crect width='160' height='90' fill='%23d0e2ff'/%3E%3Cpath d='M66 20h22l10 10v40H66z' fill='%23ffffff'/%3E%3Cpath d='M72 42h20M72 50h20M72 58h12' stroke='%230f62fe' stroke-width='2'/%3E%3C/svg%3E" />
    </ui-card-media>
    <ui-card-header><ui-card-title>1x1</ui-card-title></ui-card-header>
  </ui-card>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiCard>
  <UiCardMedia ratio="16x9"><img alt="" src={leaseImage} /></UiCardMedia>
  <UiCardHeader><UiCardTitle>16x9</UiCardTitle></UiCardHeader>
</UiCard>
<UiCard>
  <UiCardMedia ratio="2x1"><img alt="" src={leaseImage} /></UiCardMedia>
  <UiCardHeader><UiCardTitle>2x1</UiCardTitle></UiCardHeader>
</UiCard>
<UiCard>
  <UiCardMedia ratio="1x1"><img alt="" src={leaseImage} /></UiCardMedia>
  <UiCardHeader><UiCardTitle>1x1</UiCardTitle></UiCardHeader>
</UiCard>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Card>
  <CardMedia ratio="16x9"><img alt="" src={leaseImage} /></CardMedia>
  <CardHeader><CardTitle>16x9</CardTitle></CardHeader>
</Card>
<Card>
  <CardMedia ratio="2x1"><img alt="" src={leaseImage} /></CardMedia>
  <CardHeader><CardTitle>2x1</CardTitle></CardHeader>
</Card>
<Card>
  <CardMedia ratio="1x1"><img alt="" src={leaseImage} /></CardMedia>
  <CardHeader><CardTitle>1x1</CardTitle></CardHeader>
</Card>
```

Give the image `alt=""` when it only decorates, and a real `alt` when it carries information the text doesn't.

## Logo beside the title

`ui-card-title-media` puts a logo or an avatar before the title; the title moves over to make room.


HTML:

```html
<ui-card style="max-width: 360px">
  <ui-card-header>
    <ui-card-title-media>
      <svg width="48" height="48" viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="48" height="48" style="fill: var(--ui-primary)" /><text x="24" y="30" fill="#ffffff" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">SL</text></svg>
    </ui-card-title-media>
    <ui-card-title label="Supplier" description="Bangkok · since 2019">Siam Logistics Co., Ltd.</ui-card-title>
  </ui-card-header>
  <ui-card-body>Freight and warehousing. 14 active contracts.</ui-card-body>
</ui-card>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiCard style={{ maxWidth: 360 }}>
  <UiCardHeader>
    <UiCardTitleMedia>{supplierLogo}</UiCardTitleMedia>
    <UiCardTitle label="Supplier" description="Bangkok · since 2019">Siam Logistics Co., Ltd.</UiCardTitle>
  </UiCardHeader>
  <UiCardBody>Freight and warehousing. 14 active contracts.</UiCardBody>
</UiCard>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Card className="max-w-[360px]">
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitleMedia>{supplierLogo}</CardTitleMedia>
    <CardTitle label="Supplier" description="Bangkok · since 2019">Siam Logistics Co., Ltd.</CardTitle>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardBody>Freight and warehousing. 14 active contracts.</CardBody>
</Card>
```

## Title, label and description

`ui-card-title` holds the title text. `label` goes above it and `description` below, both in small muted text. For markup in them, use the `label` and `description` slots instead. Icons go before or after the title in the `title-start` and `title-end` slots (`titleStart` and `titleEnd` in React + Tailwind).


HTML:

```html
<ui-card style="max-width: 360px">
  <ui-card-header>
    <ui-card-title>
      Supply agreement C-2026-014
      <svg slot="title-end" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-label="Signed" role="img"><path d="M8 1a7 7 0 1 0 0 14A7 7 0 0 0 8 1ZM7 11 4.3 8.3l.9-.8L7 9.3l4-3.9.9.8L7 11Z" /></svg>
      <span slot="label">Chiang Mai plant</span>
      <span slot="description">Signed by <b>both parties</b> on 2 October 2026</span>
    </ui-card-title>
  </ui-card-header>
  <ui-card-body>Delivery of packaging materials, monthly, until December 2027.</ui-card-body>
</ui-card>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiCard style={{ maxWidth: 360 }}>
  <UiCardHeader>
    <UiCardTitle>
      Supply agreement C-2026-014
      <svg slot="title-end" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-label="Signed" role="img">…</svg>
      <span slot="label">Chiang Mai plant</span>
      <span slot="description">Signed by <b>both parties</b> on 2 October 2026</span>
    </UiCardTitle>
  </UiCardHeader>
  <UiCardBody>Delivery of packaging materials, monthly, until December 2027.</UiCardBody>
</UiCard>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Card className="max-w-[360px]">
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle
      label="Chiang Mai plant"
      description={<>Signed by <b>both parties</b> on 2 October 2026</>}
      titleEnd={<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="currentColor" aria-label="Signed" role="img">…</svg>}
    >
      Supply agreement C-2026-014
    </CardTitle>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardBody>Delivery of packaging materials, monthly, until December 2027.</CardBody>
</Card>
```

## Cut long text

Long titles wrap. `title-truncate` cuts the title instead: on its own to one line with an ellipsis, with a number to that many lines. `label-truncate` and `description-truncate` work the same. `max-width` limits how wide a cut title gets.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; align-items: start">
  <ui-card>
    <ui-card-header>
      <ui-card-title title-truncate description="Title and description on one line each" description-truncate>Memorandum of understanding on joint procurement between three provincial offices</ui-card-title>
    </ui-card-header>
  </ui-card>
  <ui-card>
    <ui-card-header>
      <ui-card-title title-truncate="2" description="The description is cut to one line when it is longer than the card is wide" description-truncate="1">Memorandum of understanding on joint procurement between three provincial offices</ui-card-title>
    </ui-card-header>
  </ui-card>
</div>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiCard>
  <UiCardHeader>
    <UiCardTitle titleTruncate="" description="Title and description on one line each" descriptionTruncate="">Memorandum of understanding on joint procurement between three provincial offices</UiCardTitle>
  </UiCardHeader>
</UiCard>
<UiCard>
  <UiCardHeader>
    <UiCardTitle titleTruncate="2" description="The description is cut to one line when it is longer than the card is wide" descriptionTruncate="1">Memorandum of understanding on joint procurement between three provincial offices</UiCardTitle>
  </UiCardHeader>
</UiCard>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle titleTruncate description="Title and description on one line each" descriptionTruncate>Memorandum of understanding on joint procurement between three provincial offices</CardTitle>
  </CardHeader>
</Card>
<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle titleTruncate={2} description="The description is cut to one line when it is longer than the card is wide" descriptionTruncate={1}>Memorandum of understanding on joint procurement between three provincial offices</CardTitle>
  </CardHeader>
</Card>
```

On the element these are attributes whose presence means one line (in React pass `""`, or the number of lines as a string). React + Tailwind takes `true` or a number.

## Header actions

`ui-card-actions` puts small buttons in the header's top-end corner, in at most half its width. Put each `ui-icon-button kind="ghost" size="sm"` in a `ui-card-action`. Buttons that don't fit move into an overflow menu; choosing an item clicks that button. The narrow card shows it.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: start">
  <ui-card id="card-actions" style="width: 360px">
    <ui-card-header>
      <ui-card-title label="Project" description="Due in 3 days">Branch renovation</ui-card-title>
      <ui-card-actions>
        <ui-card-action><ui-icon-button kind="ghost" size="sm" label="Edit"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M1 13h14v1H1zM12.7 4.5 10.5 2.3a1 1 0 0 0-1.4 0L3 8.4V11h2.6l6.1-6.1a1 1 0 0 0 0-1.4zM5.2 10H4V8.8l4-4 1.2 1.2zm4.7-4.7L8.7 4.1l1.1-1.1L11 4.2z" /></svg></ui-icon-button></ui-card-action>
        <ui-card-action><ui-icon-button kind="ghost" size="sm" label="Delete"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M6 6h1v6H6zm3 0h1v6H9zM2 3v1h1v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h8a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V4h1V3zm2 11V4h8v10zM6 1h4v1H6z" /></svg></ui-icon-button></ui-card-action>
      </ui-card-actions>
    </ui-card-header>
    <ui-card-body>Silom branch, second floor. Contractor starts on 1 November.</ui-card-body>
  </ui-card>
  <ui-card id="card-actions-narrow" style="width: 200px">
    <ui-card-header>
      <ui-card-title>Narrow</ui-card-title>
      <ui-card-actions>
        <ui-card-action><ui-icon-button kind="ghost" size="sm" label="Edit"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M1 13h14v1H1zM12.7 4.5 10.5 2.3a1 1 0 0 0-1.4 0L3 8.4V11h2.6l6.1-6.1a1 1 0 0 0 0-1.4zM5.2 10H4V8.8l4-4 1.2 1.2zm4.7-4.7L8.7 4.1l1.1-1.1L11 4.2z" /></svg></ui-icon-button></ui-card-action>
        <ui-card-action label="Duplicate"><ui-icon-button kind="ghost" size="sm" label="Duplicate"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M14 5v9H5V5h9m0-1H5a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v9a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h9a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V5a1 1 0 0 0-1-1ZM2 9H1V2a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h7v1H2Z" /></svg></ui-icon-button></ui-card-action>
        <ui-card-action><ui-icon-button kind="ghost" size="sm" label="Delete"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M6 6h1v6H6zm3 0h1v6H9zM2 3v1h1v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h8a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V4h1V3zm2 11V4h8v10zM6 1h4v1H6z" /></svg></ui-icon-button></ui-card-action>
      </ui-card-actions>
    </ui-card-header>
    <ui-card-body>Two buttons go to the menu.</ui-card-body>
  </ui-card>
</div>
<p>Pressed: <output id="card-actions-out">nothing yet</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const out = document.getElementById('card-actions-out');
  for (const button of document.querySelectorAll('#card-actions ui-icon-button, #card-actions-narrow ui-icon-button')) {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => (out.value = button.getAttribute('label')));
  }
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiCard style={{ width: 360 }}>
  <UiCardHeader>
    <UiCardTitle label="Project" description="Due in 3 days">Branch renovation</UiCardTitle>
    <UiCardActions>
      <UiCardAction><UiIconButton kind="ghost" size="sm" label="Edit" onClick={edit}>{editIcon}</UiIconButton></UiCardAction>
      <UiCardAction><UiIconButton kind="ghost" size="sm" label="Delete" onClick={remove}>{trashIcon}</UiIconButton></UiCardAction>
    </UiCardActions>
  </UiCardHeader>
  <UiCardBody>Silom branch, second floor. Contractor starts on 1 November.</UiCardBody>
</UiCard>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Card className="w-[360px]">
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle label="Project" description="Due in 3 days">Branch renovation</CardTitle>
    <CardActions>
      <CardAction><IconButton kind="ghost" size="sm" label="Edit" onClick={edit}>{editIcon}</IconButton></CardAction>
      <CardAction><IconButton kind="ghost" size="sm" label="Delete" onClick={remove}>{trashIcon}</IconButton></CardAction>
    </CardActions>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardBody>Silom branch, second floor. Contractor starts on 1 November.</CardBody>
</Card>
```

An item in the overflow menu is named by the action's `label`, else by its button's `label` or text. `overflow-menu-label` names the menu button ("More actions" by default, translated).

## Footer actions

A `ui-card-footer` with `ui-card-action`s becomes a row of buttons across the card under a thin line: a `ui-button` stretches to share the row, a `ui-icon-button` keeps its size at the end. A footer with plain content just pads it.


HTML:

```html
<ui-card id="card-footer" style="max-width: 360px">
  <ui-card-header>
    <ui-card-title label="Report" description="September 2026">Monthly contract summary</ui-card-title>
  </ui-card-header>
  <ui-card-body>48 contracts signed, 5 expiring in the next 30 days.</ui-card-body>
  <ui-card-footer>
    <ui-card-action><ui-button kind="ghost">View report</ui-button></ui-card-action>
    <ui-card-action><ui-icon-button kind="ghost" size="md" label="Download"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16"><path d="M13 12v2H3v-2H2v2a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h10a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-2zM13 7l-.7-.7-3.8 3.8V1h-1v9.1L3.7 6.3 3 7l5 5z" /></svg></ui-icon-button></ui-card-action>
  </ui-card-footer>
</ui-card>
<p>Pressed: <output id="card-footer-out">nothing yet</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const out = document.getElementById('card-footer-out');
  for (const button of document.querySelectorAll('#card-footer ui-card-action > *')) {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => (out.value = button.getAttribute('label') ?? button.textContent.trim()));
  }
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiCard style={{ maxWidth: 360 }}>
  <UiCardHeader>
    <UiCardTitle label="Report" description="September 2026">Monthly contract summary</UiCardTitle>
  </UiCardHeader>
  <UiCardBody>48 contracts signed, 5 expiring in the next 30 days.</UiCardBody>
  <UiCardFooter>
    <UiCardAction><UiButton kind="ghost" onClick={view}>View report</UiButton></UiCardAction>
    <UiCardAction><UiIconButton kind="ghost" size="md" label="Download" onClick={download}>{downloadIcon}</UiIconButton></UiCardAction>
  </UiCardFooter>
</UiCard>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Card className="max-w-[360px]">
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle label="Report" description="September 2026">Monthly contract summary</CardTitle>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardBody>48 contracts signed, 5 expiring in the next 30 days.</CardBody>
  <CardFooter>
    <CardAction><Button kind="ghost" onClick={view}>View report</Button></CardAction>
    <CardAction><IconButton kind="ghost" size="md" label="Download" onClick={download}>{downloadIcon}</IconButton></CardAction>
  </CardFooter>
</Card>
```

## Linked card

With `href` the whole card is one link and a single tab stop. Name it with `label`: the card's whole text would be a long link name. A linked card gets a border and the hover colour, and hides its footer: one link can't hold other controls, so leave out header actions too. They still show if you add them (as in Carbon, whose guidelines say a clickable card holds no interactive elements), inside the link. A plain click fires a cancelable `ui-navigate` first, for your [SPA router](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/frameworks/#route-links-with-your-spa-router).


HTML:

```html
<ui-card href="#accessibility" label="Open the procurement policy" style="max-width: 360px">
  <ui-card-header>
    <ui-card-title label="Policy" description="Version 4, 2026">Procurement policy</ui-card-title>
  </ui-card-header>
  <ui-card-body>Who can approve purchases, and up to what amount.</ui-card-body>
</ui-card>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiCard href="/policies/procurement" label="Open the procurement policy" style={{ maxWidth: 360 }}>
  <UiCardHeader>
    <UiCardTitle label="Policy" description="Version 4, 2026">Procurement policy</UiCardTitle>
  </UiCardHeader>
  <UiCardBody>Who can approve purchases, and up to what amount.</UiCardBody>
</UiCard>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
<Card href="/policies/procurement" aria-label="Open the procurement policy" className="max-w-[360px]">
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle label="Policy" description="Version 4, 2026">Procurement policy</CardTitle>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardBody>Who can approve purchases, and up to what amount.</CardBody>
</Card>
```

`target="_blank"` opens a new tab; the card adds "(opens in a new tab)" for screen readers and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.

## Clickable card

`clickable` makes the whole card one button: a click, or Enter or Space while the card has focus, fires `click`. An arrow in the bottom-end corner shows it can be pressed; replace it with the `footer-icon` slot (`footerIcon` in React + Tailwind). Name the card with `label`, and put no other controls in it.


HTML:

```html
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 16px">
  <ui-card id="card-pick-sale" clickable label="Start a sale contract">
    <ui-card-header><ui-card-title label="Template">Sale contract</ui-card-title></ui-card-header>
    <ui-card-body>Goods, price and delivery.</ui-card-body>
  </ui-card>
  <ui-card id="card-pick-lease" clickable label="Start a lease contract">
    <ui-card-header><ui-card-title label="Template">Lease contract</ui-card-title></ui-card-header>
    <ui-card-body>Property, rent and term.</ui-card-body>
  </ui-card>
</div>
<p>Chosen: <output id="card-pick-out">nothing yet</output></p>

<script type="module">
  const out = document.getElementById('card-pick-out');
  for (const id of ['card-pick-sale', 'card-pick-lease']) {
    const card = document.getElementById(id);
    card.addEventListener('click', () => (out.value = card.label));
  }
</script>
```

React:

```tsx
const [chosen, setChosen] = useState('');

<UiCard clickable label="Start a sale contract" onClick={() => setChosen('sale')}>
  <UiCardHeader><UiCardTitle label="Template">Sale contract</UiCardTitle></UiCardHeader>
  <UiCardBody>Goods, price and delivery.</UiCardBody>
</UiCard>
<UiCard clickable label="Start a lease contract" onClick={() => setChosen('lease')}>
  <UiCardHeader><UiCardTitle label="Template">Lease contract</UiCardTitle></UiCardHeader>
  <UiCardBody>Property, rent and term.</UiCardBody>
</UiCard>
<p>Chosen: <output>{chosen}</output></p>
```

React + Tailwind:

```tsx
const [chosen, setChosen] = useState('');

<Card clickable aria-label="Start a sale contract" onClick={() => setChosen('sale')}>
  <CardHeader><CardTitle label="Template">Sale contract</CardTitle></CardHeader>
  <CardBody>Goods, price and delivery.</CardBody>
</Card>
<Card clickable aria-label="Start a lease contract" onClick={() => setChosen('lease')}>
  <CardHeader><CardTitle label="Template">Lease contract</CardTitle></CardHeader>
  <CardBody>Property, rent and term.</CardBody>
</Card>
<p>Chosen: <output>{chosen}</output></p>
```

## Disabled

`disabled` greys the text and the arrow. A disabled clickable card fires no `click` and leaves the tab order; a disabled linked card is no longer a link. Say in the card why it can't be used.


HTML:

```html

  <ui-card-header><ui-card-title label="Template">Loan contract</ui-card-title></ui-card-header>
  <ui-card-body>Being revised by the legal department until 15 October.</ui-card-body>
</ui-card>
```

React:

```tsx

</UiCard>
```

## Horizontal

`horizontal` puts the media beside the content: at the start by default, at the end with `media-position="end"`. The media takes a third of the card; `media-width` on `ui-card-media` changes that.

## On a layer

A card draws itself in the layer colour it sits on. Inside a `ui-layer` it takes the next one, so cards on a grey panel still stand out.

```html
<ui-layer level="1" with-background style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; padding: 16px">
  <ui-card>
    <ui-card-header><ui-card-title label="Sales">12 open deals</ui-card-title></ui-card-header>
    <ui-card-body>Worth 3.4 million baht.</ui-card-body>
  </ui-card>
  <ui-card>
    <ui-card-header><ui-card-title label="Legal">5 reviews</ui-card-title></ui-card-header>
    <ui-card-body>2 due this week.</ui-card-body>
  </ui-card>
</ui-layer>
```

React:

```tsx
<UiLayer level={1} withBackground style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr))', gap: 16, padding: 16 }}>
```

## Keyboard

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Tab | Moves to a linked or clickable card, or to the buttons in a plain card's header and footer |
| Enter | Follows a linked card; presses a clickable card |
| Space | Presses a clickable card |

## Accessibility

- The title is not a heading element. When the cards form a list with headings on the page, wrap the title text in a heading of the right level, or name the list.
- A linked or clickable card is one control. Name it with `label`, since its whole text would make a long name, and don't put other controls inside.
- A clickable card is a `role="button"`; a disabled one has `aria-disabled` and leaves the tab order.
- The arrow of a clickable card and the media are decorative. Give an image a real `alt` only when it carries information.
- The header actions are separate buttons, each with its own `label`; those in the overflow menu keep their names.

Unstyled React parts with the same behaviour: [Headless Card](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-card/).

## API

Generated from the package. In React, pass a property as a prop of the same name; events are props too (the React column).

### `<ui-card>` · React `UiCard`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `href` | `href` | `string` | `''` | Makes the whole card one link. |
| `target` | `target` | `'_self' \| '_blank'` | `'_self'` |  |
| `clickable` | `clickable` | `boolean` | `false` | Makes the whole card one button (listen for `click`). |
| `disabled` | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` | The accessible name of a linked or clickable card (Carbon asks for one). |
| `density` | `density` | `CardDensity` | `'productive'` |  |
| `horizontal` | `horizontal` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `media-position` | `mediaPosition` | `'start' \| 'end'` | `'start'` | Where a horizontal card's media goes. |

#### Events

| Event | React | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ui-navigate` | none (use a ref) | detail: { href } (cancelable) on a plain click of a linked card; cancel it to route client-side (README: SPA router) |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The parts |
| `media` | (filled for you) the media of a horizontal card |
| `footer-icon` | Replaces the clickable card's arrow |

#### CSS parts

| Part | Description |
|---|---|
| `base` | The card (`<div>`, or `<a>` with `href`) |

#### CSS custom properties

| Custom property | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--ui-card-radius` |  | Corner radius (default 0; Kanok: 12px) |
| `--ui-card-border` |  | Border of every card, not only clickable ones (default none; Kanok: a hairline) |
| `--ui-card-background` |  | Its fill (default `--ui-surface-1`; Kanok paper: a cool grey that sets it apart from the page, no border) |
| `--ui-card-clickable-border` |  | Border of a clickable card (default 1px `--ui-border-tile-1`; Kanok: none) |
| `--ui-card-overflow` |  | `overflow` of the card (default visible; Kanok: clip, so media follow the rounded corners) |

### `<ui-card-media>` · React `UiCardMedia`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ratio` | `ratio` | `CardMediaRatio \| ''` | `''` |  |
| `media-width` | `mediaWidth` | `string` | `'33.33%'` | A horizontal card's media width (Carbon's default 33.33%). |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | An `<img>`, `<video>`, … |

### `<ui-card-header>` · React `UiCardHeader`

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | `<ui-card-header-media>`, `<ui-card-title-media>`, `<ui-card-title>`, `<ui-card-actions>` |

### `<ui-card-header-media>` · React `UiCardHeaderMedia`

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The media |

### `<ui-card-title-media>` · React `UiCardTitleMedia`

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The media |

### `<ui-card-title>` · React `UiCardTitle`

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `label` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `description` | `description` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `title-truncate` | `titleTruncate` | `string \| null` | `null` |  |
| `label-truncate` | `labelTruncate` | `string \| null` | `null` |  |
| `description-truncate` | `descriptionTruncate` | `string \| null` | `null` |  |
| `max-width` | `maxWidth` | `string` | `'100%'` | A truncated title's widest. |

#### Slots

| Slot | Description |
|---|---|
| (default) | The title text |
| `label` | Replaces `label` |
| `description` | Replaces `description` |
| `title-start` | An icon before the title |
| `title-end` | An icon after the title |

### `<ui-card-body>` · React `UiCardBody`

#### Attributes

|---|---|---|---|---|

#### Slots

|---|---|
