- You add the `<label>` (or `aria-label`), the `aria-describedby` to the helper or error text, and the error text itself.
- Give your arrow icon `aria-hidden="true"` and `pointer-events: none`, so a click on it still reaches the select.
- Options can't hold markup or a second line. If you need that, use a [Dropdown](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/dropdown/).


---

# Headless Dropdown

The `Dropdown` parts give you the behaviour of the styled [Dropdown](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/dropdown/) with no styles: a button with `role="combobox"` that opens a listbox in the top layer, the keyboard (arrows, Home / End, Page Up / Page Down, typing to jump), the highlight through `aria-activedescendant`, closing on a click outside, and a hidden input that submits the value.

You own the markup, the label text, any helper or error message, the "Loading…" row and every style. The parts show their state as `data-*` attributes for you to style on.

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { Dropdown } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Dropdown } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const types = [
  { value: 'sale', label: 'Sale' },
  { value: 'lease', label: 'Lease' },
];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <Dropdown.Root items={types} name="type">
        <Dropdown.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Contract type</Dropdown.Label>
        <Dropdown.Trigger className="group flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-open:outline-2 data-open:-outline-offset-2 data-open:outline-focus">
          <Dropdown.Value placeholder="Choose a type" className="data-placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
            <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
          </svg>
        </Dropdown.Trigger>
        <Dropdown.Popup className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {types.map((t) => (
            <Dropdown.Option key={t.value} value={t.value} className="cursor-pointer px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:text-ink">
              {t.label}
            </Dropdown.Option>
          ))}
        </Dropdown.Popup>
      </Dropdown.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`items` on `Root` is the data: the keys move through it and typing searches its labels. The `Option`s inside `Popup` are what people see and click. Render one `Option` for each option in `items`, with the same `value`.

## Anatomy

```tsx
<Dropdown.Root items={items}>
  <Dropdown.Label />
  <Dropdown.Trigger>
    <Dropdown.Value />
  </Dropdown.Trigger>
  <Dropdown.Popup>
    <Dropdown.Option value="…" />
    <Dropdown.Group>
      <Dropdown.GroupLabel />
      <Dropdown.GroupOptions>
        <Dropdown.Option value="…" />
      </Dropdown.GroupOptions>
    </Dropdown.Group>
  </Dropdown.Popup>
</Dropdown.Root>
```

## A second line

Put the second line inside the `Option`. Typing to jump only searches `label`, never `description`.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Dropdown } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const types = [
  { value: 'sale', label: 'Sale', description: 'The buyer owns the property' },
  { value: 'lease', label: 'Lease', description: 'Monthly rent, fixed term' },
  { value: 'mortgage', label: 'Mortgage', description: 'Property as security for a loan' },
];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <Dropdown.Root items={types} name="type">
        <Dropdown.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Contract type</Dropdown.Label>
        <Dropdown.Trigger className="group flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-open:outline-2 data-open:-outline-offset-2 data-open:outline-focus">
          <Dropdown.Value placeholder="Choose a type" className="data-placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
            <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
          </svg>
        </Dropdown.Trigger>
        <Dropdown.Popup className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {types.map((t) => (
            <Dropdown.Option key={t.value} value={t.value} className="flex cursor-pointer flex-col px-4 py-2 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:text-ink">
              {t.label}
              <small className="text-xs text-ink-helper">{t.description}</small>
            </Dropdown.Option>
          ))}
        </Dropdown.Popup>
      </Dropdown.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Groups and disabled options

`items` takes options `{ value, label, description?, disabled? }` and groups `{ label, options, disabled? }`. A disabled option is shown but skipped by the keys and can't be picked; a disabled group disables its options. `isGroup` tells a group from an option, and `flattenOptions` returns every option in order.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Dropdown, isGroup, type ListItem } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const branches: ListItem[] = [
  { label: 'Bangkok', options: [
    { value: 'silom', label: 'Silom', description: 'Mon–Fri, 9:00–17:00' },
    { value: 'asok', label: 'Asok', description: 'Every day, 10:00–20:00' },
  ] },
  { label: 'North', options: [
    { value: 'chiangmai', label: 'Chiang Mai' },
    { value: 'lampang', label: 'Lampang (closed)', disabled: true },
  ] },
];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <Dropdown.Root items={branches} name="branch">
        <Dropdown.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Branch</Dropdown.Label>
        <Dropdown.Trigger className="group flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-open:outline-2 data-open:-outline-offset-2 data-open:outline-focus">
          <Dropdown.Value placeholder="Choose a branch" className="data-placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
            <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
          </svg>
        </Dropdown.Trigger>
        <Dropdown.Popup className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {branches.filter(isGroup).map((group) => (
            <Dropdown.Group key={group.label}>
              <Dropdown.GroupLabel className="px-4 pt-3 pb-1 text-xs font-semibold text-ink-muted">{group.label}</Dropdown.GroupLabel>
              <Dropdown.GroupOptions>
                {group.options.map((o) => (
                  <Dropdown.Option key={o.value} value={o.value} className="flex cursor-pointer flex-col px-4 py-2 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:text-ink data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:bg-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled">
                    {o.label}
                    <small className="text-xs text-ink-helper">{o.description}</small>
                  </Dropdown.Option>
                ))}
              </Dropdown.GroupOptions>
            </Dropdown.Group>
          ))}
        </Dropdown.Popup>
      </Dropdown.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Value

Hold the value yourself with `value` and `onValueChange`, or give a starting `defaultValue` and let `Root` keep it. `onValueChange` fires only when the user picks a different option.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Dropdown } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const types = [
  { value: 'sale', label: 'Sale' },
  { value: 'lease', label: 'Lease' },
  { value: 'mortgage', label: 'Mortgage' },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [type, setType] = useState('lease');
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<Record<string, FormDataEntryValue>>();
  return (
    <form
      className="grid max-w-xs gap-2"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSent(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.currentTarget)));
      }}
    >
      <Dropdown.Root items={types} name="type" value={type} onValueChange={setType}>
        <Dropdown.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Contract type</Dropdown.Label>
        <Dropdown.Trigger className="group flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-open:outline-2 data-open:-outline-offset-2 data-open:outline-focus">
          <Dropdown.Value placeholder="Choose a type" className="data-placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
            <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
          </svg>
        </Dropdown.Trigger>
        <Dropdown.Popup className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {types.map((t) => (
            <Dropdown.Option key={t.value} value={t.value} className="cursor-pointer px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:text-ink">
              {t.label}
            </Dropdown.Option>
          ))}
        </Dropdown.Popup>
      </Dropdown.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Value: {type || '(none)'}</p>
      <div className="flex gap-px">
        <button type="submit" className="h-10 bg-interactive px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus">Submit</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setType('')} className="h-10 px-4 text-sm text-link hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">Clear</button>
      </div>
      {sent ? <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Sent: {JSON.stringify(sent)}</p> : null}
    </form>
  );
}
```

With `name`, a hidden input submits the value with the form. A form reset puts an uncontrolled value back to `defaultValue`; a controlled `value` is yours to set back.

## Open above

The list opens below the trigger and is as wide as it. `side="top"` on `Popup` prefers above. Either way it flips when there is no room, and `data-side` on the popup says where it went. There are no sizes: the height of the trigger and the rows is your CSS.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Dropdown } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const types = [
  { value: 'sale', label: 'Sale' },
  { value: 'lease', label: 'Lease' },
  { value: 'mortgage', label: 'Mortgage' },
];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <Dropdown.Root items={types} name="type">
        <Dropdown.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Contract type</Dropdown.Label>
        <Dropdown.Trigger className="group flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-open:outline-2 data-open:-outline-offset-2 data-open:outline-focus">
          <Dropdown.Value placeholder="Choose a type" className="data-placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
            <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
          </svg>
        </Dropdown.Trigger>
        {/* data-side says where the list went: the shadow falls away from the field */}
        <Dropdown.Popup side="top" className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg data-[side=top]:shadow-[0_-2px_6px_rgb(0_0_0/0.3)]">
          {types.map((t) => (
            <Dropdown.Option key={t.value} value={t.value} className="cursor-pointer px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:text-ink">
              {t.label}
            </Dropdown.Option>
          ))}
        </Dropdown.Popup>
      </Dropdown.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Load the options when the list opens

`onOpenChange` fires after the list opens or closes. While `loading` is true, the keys pick nothing and the popup has `aria-busy`. When `loading` ends with the list open, the highlight goes to the chosen option, else the first.

`Root` draws no "Loading…" row and announces nothing: render the row and a status text yourself.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Dropdown, type ListOption } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

// stands in for fetch('/api/branches'): answers after a second
const fetchBranches = () =>
  new Promise<ListOption[]>((resolve) => {
    setTimeout(() => resolve([
      { value: 'silom', label: 'Silom' },
      { value: 'asok', label: 'Asok' },
      { value: 'chiangmai', label: 'Chiang Mai' },
    ]), 1000);
  });

export default function Example() {
  const [branches, setBranches] = useState<ListOption[]>();
  const load = async (open: boolean) => {
    if (open && !branches) setBranches(await fetchBranches());
  };
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <Dropdown.Root items={branches ?? []} name="branch" loading={!branches} onOpenChange={load}>
        <Dropdown.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Branch</Dropdown.Label>
        <Dropdown.Trigger className="group flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-open:outline-2 data-open:-outline-offset-2 data-open:outline-focus">
          <Dropdown.Value placeholder="Choose a branch" className="data-placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
            <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
          </svg>
        </Dropdown.Trigger>
        <Dropdown.Popup className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {branches?.map((b) => (
            <Dropdown.Option key={b.value} value={b.value} className="cursor-pointer px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:text-ink">
              {b.label}
            </Dropdown.Option>
          ))}
          {branches ? null : <li role="option" aria-disabled="true" aria-selected="false" className="px-4 py-3 text-ink-placeholder">Loading…</li>}
        </Dropdown.Popup>
        <span role="status" className="sr-only">{branches ? '' : 'Loading…'}</span>
      </Dropdown.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Read-only and disabled

- `readOnly` shows the value, but the list doesn't open and the keys do nothing. The trigger gets `aria-readonly`.
- `disabled` disables the trigger.
- A disabled field renders no hidden input, so it isn't submitted (as a disabled native control).


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Dropdown } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const types = [
  { value: 'sale', label: 'Sale' },
  { value: 'lease', label: 'Lease' },
];

function TypeField({ label, ...props }: { label: string; defaultValue?: string; readOnly?: boolean; disabled?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <Dropdown.Root items={types} {...props}>
      <Dropdown.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted data-disabled:text-ink-disabled">{label}</Dropdown.Label>
      <Dropdown.Trigger className="group flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-readonly:cursor-default data-readonly:border-hairline data-readonly:bg-transparent data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:border-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-disabled:hover:bg-field-1">
        <Dropdown.Value placeholder="Choose a type" className="data-placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current group-data-readonly:opacity-25">
          <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
        </svg>
      </Dropdown.Trigger>
      <Dropdown.Popup className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
        {types.map((t) => (
          <Dropdown.Option key={t.value} value={t.value} className="px-4 py-3">{t.label}</Dropdown.Option>
        ))}
      </Dropdown.Popup>
    </Dropdown.Root>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <TypeField label="Contract type (read-only)" defaultValue="lease" readOnly />
      <TypeField label="Contract type (disabled)" disabled />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`required` and `invalid` only set `aria-required` and `aria-invalid` (and `data-invalid`). There is no built-in message: check the value and show the error yourself ([Forms and validation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/forms/)).

## Style it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Dropdown } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const types = [
  { value: 'sale', label: 'Sale' },
  { value: 'lease', label: 'Lease' },
  { value: 'mortgage', label: 'Mortgage (paused)', disabled: true },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [type, setType] = useState('');
  const invalid = type === '';
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <Dropdown.Root items={types} name="type" value={type} onValueChange={setType} invalid={invalid} required>
        <Dropdown.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Contract type</Dropdown.Label>
        <Dropdown.Trigger
          aria-describedby={invalid ? 'dropdown-style-error' : undefined}
          className="group flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-open:outline-2 data-open:-outline-offset-2 data-open:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:text-ink-disabled"
        >
          <Dropdown.Value placeholder="Choose a type" className="data-placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
            <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
          </svg>
        </Dropdown.Trigger>
        <Dropdown.Popup className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {types.map((t) => (
            <Dropdown.Option key={t.value} value={t.value} className="cursor-pointer px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:font-semibold data-selected:text-ink data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:bg-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled">
              {t.label}
            </Dropdown.Option>
          ))}
        </Dropdown.Popup>
      </Dropdown.Root>
      {invalid ? <p id="dropdown-style-error" className="text-xs text-error-text">Choose a contract type</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```
```css
/* className="trigger" on Trigger, "value" on Value, "option" on each Option */
.trigger[data-open] { outline: 2px solid; }
.trigger[data-invalid] { outline: 2px solid #da1e28; }
.value[data-placeholder] { color: #6f6f6f; }
.option[data-highlighted] { background: #e8e8e8; }
.option[data-selected] { font-weight: 600; }
.option[data-disabled] { color: #a8a8a8; }
```

## Parts

### Dropdown.Root

Renders no element of its own: its children, then the hidden input when `name` is set and `disabled` isn't.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `ListItem[]` | | Options and groups `{ label, options }`: what the keys move through and typing searches |
| `value` | `string` | | The chosen value (controlled) |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | `''` | The starting value (uncontrolled) |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | | After the user picks another option |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | | After the list opens or closes |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the trigger |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | The list doesn't open |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | `aria-required` on the trigger |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid` on the trigger |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | The keys pick nothing; the popup is `aria-busy` |
| `name` | `string` | | Submits the value with the form (a hidden input), unless disabled |
| `id` | `string` | generated | Base of the ids: `<id>-label`, `<id>-value`, `<id>-list`, `<id>-opt-<n>` |

`Dropdown.useDropdownContext()` returns the `Root`'s state (`open`, `value`, `selected`, `active`, `loading` …) to any component inside it, for example to turn a chevron.

### Dropdown.Label

A `<span>` with the id `<id>-label`. It names the trigger (with `Value`) and the popup.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-disabled` | `Root` is disabled |

### Dropdown.Trigger

A `<button type="button" role="combobox">`. Its `aria-labelledby` is `<id>-label <id>-value` unless you pass your own. It takes every button prop except `type`, `role` and `disabled`.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | The list is open |
| `data-disabled` | Disabled |
| `data-readonly` | Read-only |
| `data-invalid` | `invalid` is set |
| `data-placeholder` | Nothing is chosen |

### Dropdown.Value

A `<span>` with the id `<id>-value`: the chosen option's label, else `placeholder`. `children` replaces both.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `placeholder` | `ReactNode` | | Shown while nothing is chosen |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-placeholder` | Nothing is chosen |

### Dropdown.Popup

A `<ul role="listbox" popover="manual">` in the top layer, as wide as the trigger. Its children render only while the list is open. A press inside it keeps focus on the trigger; a press outside closes it. Its `aria-labelledby` is `<id>-label` unless you pass your own.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `side` | `'bottom' \| 'top'` | `'bottom'` | Where the list opens; it flips when there is no room |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | The list is open |
| `data-side` | `bottom` or `top`: where the list went |

### Dropdown.Option

An `<li role="option">` with the id `<id>-opt-<n>`. A click on an enabled option picks it and closes the list.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` | | The value of an option in `items` (required) |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-highlighted` | The keyboard highlight is on it |
| `data-selected` | It is the chosen option |
| `data-disabled` | The option (or its group) is disabled |

### Dropdown.Group, GroupLabel, GroupOptions

`Group` is a `<div role="group">` inside a presentational `<li>`, named by its `GroupLabel` (a `<div>`). `GroupOptions` is a presentational `<ul>` that holds the group's `Option`s. They add no props and no data attributes.

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | List closed | List open |
|---|---|---|
| ↓, Enter, Space | Open on the chosen option (else the first) | ↓ moves down; Enter and Space pick the highlighted option and close |
| ↑ | Does nothing | Moves up (no wrap) |
| Home / End | Open on the first / last option | First / last option |
| Page Up / Page Down | | Move by 10 |
| Letters | Open on the next option that starts with them | Jump to the next option that starts with them |
| Alt+↑ | | Picks the highlighted option and closes |
| Esc | | Closes without a change |
| Tab | Moves on | Closes without a change and moves on |

The parts set `role="combobox"`, `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-activedescendant`, `aria-readonly`, `aria-required` and `aria-invalid` on the trigger, and `role="listbox"`, `role="option"`, `aria-selected` and `aria-disabled` on the list. Focus stays on the trigger the whole time.

You add:

- The label text in `Label`, or your own `aria-labelledby` on the trigger and the popup.
- Helper and error text, linked with `aria-describedby` on the trigger.
- A `role="status"` text for "Loading…", as in the example above.


---

# Headless Combobox

The `Combobox` parts give you the behaviour of the styled [Combobox](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/combobox/) with no styles: a text box with `role="combobox"`, a listbox in the top layer that typing narrows or only highlights, the keyboard, the rule for what leaving the field keeps, a clear button and a chevron that are not Tab stops, and a hidden input that submits the value.

You own the markup, the `<label>`, any helper or error message, the "Searching…" and "No matching items" text, and every style. The parts show their state as `data-*` attributes for you to style on.

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { Combobox } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Combobox } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const provinces = [
  { value: 'bkk', label: 'Bangkok' },
  { value: 'cnx', label: 'Chiang Mai' },
  { value: 'cei', label: 'Chiang Rai' },
  { value: 'kkc', label: 'Khon Kaen' },
  { value: 'hkt', label: 'Phuket' },
];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <Combobox.Root items={provinces} name="province" filter="contains">
        <label htmlFor="province" className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Province</label>
        <Combobox.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-within:outline-2 focus-within:-outline-offset-2 focus-within:outline-focus">
          <Combobox.Input id="province" placeholder="Type a province" className="h-full min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent ps-4 text-sm text-ink outline-none placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
          <Combobox.Toggle aria-label="Open" className="group grid h-full w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center text-ink">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
              <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
            </svg>
          </Combobox.Toggle>
        </Combobox.Anchor>
        <Combobox.Popup aria-label="Province" className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {(items) => items.map((p) => ('options' in p ? null : (
            <Combobox.Option key={p.value} value={p.value} className="cursor-pointer px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:text-ink">
              {p.label}
            </Combobox.Option>
          )))}
        </Combobox.Popup>
      </Combobox.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`items` on `Root` is every option. `Popup` calls its children function with the items the typed text keeps (groups kept), so you render only those.

## Anatomy

```tsx
<Combobox.Root items={items}>
  <label />
  <Combobox.Anchor>
    <Combobox.Input />
    <Combobox.Clear />
    <Combobox.Toggle />
  </Combobox.Anchor>
  <Combobox.Popup>
    {(items) => (
      <>
        <Combobox.Option value="…" />
        <Combobox.Group>
          <Combobox.GroupLabel />
          <Combobox.GroupOptions>
            <Combobox.Option value="…" />
          </Combobox.GroupOptions>
        </Combobox.Group>
      </>
    )}
  </Combobox.Popup>
</Combobox.Root>
```

## How typing narrows the list

Typing opens the list and highlights the first enabled option whose label contains the text. `filter` decides whether the other options stay:

| `filter` | The list while typing |
|---|---|
| `none` (default) | Every option stays; only the highlight moves |
| `contains` | Only options whose label contains the text |
| `starts-with` | Only options whose label starts with the text |

While the text still equals the chosen option's label, the list shows every option.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Combobox } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

type Filter = 'none' | 'contains' | 'starts-with';

const provinces = [
  { value: 'cnx', label: 'Chiang Mai' },
  { value: 'cei', label: 'Chiang Rai' },
  { value: 'msn', label: 'Mae Hong Son' },
  { value: 'lpn', label: 'Lamphun' },
  { value: 'nan', label: 'Nan' },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>('starts-with');
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-4">
      <label className="grid gap-2 text-xs text-ink-muted">
        filter
        <select
          value={filter}
          onChange={(e) => setFilter(e.target.value as Filter)}
          className="h-8 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-2 text-sm text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus"
        >
          <option value="none">none</option>
          <option value="contains">contains</option>
          <option value="starts-with">starts-with</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <Combobox.Root items={provinces} filter={filter}>
          <label htmlFor="province-filter" className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Province</label>
          <Combobox.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-within:outline-2 focus-within:-outline-offset-2 focus-within:outline-focus">
            <Combobox.Input id="province-filter" placeholder="Try “ma” or “n”" className="h-full min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent ps-4 text-sm text-ink outline-none placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
            <Combobox.Toggle aria-label="Open" className="group grid h-full w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center text-ink">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
                <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
              </svg>
            </Combobox.Toggle>
          </Combobox.Anchor>
          <Combobox.Popup aria-label="Province" className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
            {(items) => items.map((p) => ('options' in p ? null : (
              <Combobox.Option key={p.value} value={p.value} className="cursor-pointer px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:text-ink">
                {p.label}
              </Combobox.Option>
            )))}
          </Combobox.Popup>
        </Combobox.Root>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Free text or a listed option

When the user leaves the field, text that exactly matches an enabled option's label picks that option. Other text snaps back to the option chosen before. With `allowCustomValue`, the typed text becomes the value instead.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Combobox } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const titles = [
  { value: 'Lawyer', label: 'Lawyer' },
  { value: 'Paralegal', label: 'Paralegal' },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <Combobox.Root items={titles} name="title" allowCustomValue onValueChange={setTitle}>
        <label htmlFor="job-title" className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Job title</label>
        <Combobox.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-within:outline-2 focus-within:-outline-offset-2 focus-within:outline-focus">
          <Combobox.Input id="job-title" placeholder="Pick one or type your own" className="h-full min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent ps-4 text-sm text-ink outline-none placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
          <Combobox.Toggle aria-label="Open" className="group grid h-full w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center text-ink">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
              <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
            </svg>
          </Combobox.Toggle>
        </Combobox.Anchor>
        <Combobox.Popup aria-label="Job title" className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {(items) => items.map((t) => ('options' in t ? null : (
            <Combobox.Option key={t.value} value={t.value} className="cursor-pointer px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:text-ink">
              {t.label}
            </Combobox.Option>
          )))}
        </Combobox.Popup>
      </Combobox.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Value: {title || '(none)'}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Value

Hold the value yourself with `value` and `onValueChange`, or give a starting `defaultValue`. `onValueChange` fires when the value changes: a pick, a committed text, a clear. When `value` changes from outside, the text box shows the new choice's label.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Combobox } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const provinces = [
  { value: 'bkk', label: 'Bangkok' },
  { value: 'cnx', label: 'Chiang Mai' },
  { value: 'hkt', label: 'Phuket' },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [province, setProvince] = useState('bkk');
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <Combobox.Root items={provinces} name="province" value={province} onValueChange={setProvince}>
        <label htmlFor="province-value" className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Province</label>
        <Combobox.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-within:outline-2 focus-within:-outline-offset-2 focus-within:outline-focus">
          <Combobox.Input id="province-value" className="h-full min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent ps-4 text-sm text-ink outline-none placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
          <Combobox.Toggle aria-label="Open" className="group grid h-full w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center text-ink">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
              <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
            </svg>
          </Combobox.Toggle>
        </Combobox.Anchor>
        <Combobox.Popup aria-label="Province" className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {(items) => items.map((p) => ('options' in p ? null : (
            <Combobox.Option key={p.value} value={p.value} className="cursor-pointer px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:text-ink">
              {p.label}
            </Combobox.Option>
          )))}
        </Combobox.Popup>
      </Combobox.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Value: {province || '(none)'}</p>
      {/* a change from outside: the text box shows the new choice's label */}
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setProvince('hkt')} className="h-8 justify-self-start px-4 text-sm text-link hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
        Set to Phuket
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Search on a server

`onInputValueChange` gets the text each time the user types. Fetch the matches, replace `items`, and set `loading` while the request runs: the popup then has `aria-busy`. Keep `filter="none"` (the default), as the server has already filtered.

The parts draw no "Searching…" or "No matching items" text. `Combobox.useComboboxContext()` gives you `open`, `loading` and `listed` (the options the text keeps) to render them:


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Combobox, type ListOption } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const all = ['Bangkok', 'Chiang Mai', 'Chiang Rai', 'Khon Kaen', 'Nakhon Ratchasima', 'Phuket', 'Songkhla', 'Udon Thani'];

// stands in for the server: the cities containing the text, after 600 ms
const search = (text: string) =>
  new Promise<ListOption[]>((resolve) => {
    const found = all.filter((city) => city.toLowerCase().includes(text.trim().toLowerCase()));
    setTimeout(() => resolve(found.map((city) => ({ value: city, label: city }))), 600);
  });

function statusText(loading: boolean, count: number) {
  if (loading) return 'Searching…';
  return count === 0 ? 'No matching items' : '';
}

function ListStatus() {
  const { open, loading, listed } = Combobox.useComboboxContext();
  return <p role="status" className="min-h-4 text-xs text-ink-muted">{open ? statusText(loading, listed.length) : ''}</p>;
}

export default function Example() {
  const [cities, setCities] = useState<ListOption[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const latest = useRef('');
  const onText = async (text: string) => {
    latest.current = text;
    setLoading(true);
    const found = await search(text);
    if (latest.current !== text) return; // a newer search is on its way
    setCities(found);
    setLoading(false);
  };
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <Combobox.Root items={cities} name="city" loading={loading} onInputValueChange={onText}>
        <label htmlFor="city" className="text-xs text-ink-muted">City</label>
        <Combobox.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-within:outline-2 focus-within:-outline-offset-2 focus-within:outline-focus">
          <Combobox.Input id="city" placeholder="Type to search" className="h-full min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent px-4 text-sm text-ink outline-none placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
        </Combobox.Anchor>
        <Combobox.Popup aria-label="City" className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {(items) => items.map((c) => ('options' in c ? null : (
            <Combobox.Option key={c.value} value={c.value} className="cursor-pointer px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:text-ink">
              {c.label}
            </Combobox.Option>
          )))}
        </Combobox.Popup>
        <ListStatus />
      </Combobox.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Here `search()` stands in for the server and answers after a short wait; in your app it fetches the matches, as on [Combobox](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/combobox/#search-on-a-server).

## Groups and descriptions

Groups are `{ label, options }` in `items`, and options take `description` and `disabled`. Typing only searches the labels. `isGroup` tells a group from an option in the `Popup` function:


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Combobox, isGroup, type ListItem } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const branches: ListItem[] = [
  { label: 'Bangkok', options: [
    { value: 'silom', label: 'Silom', description: 'Mon–Fri, 9:00–17:00' },
    { value: 'asok', label: 'Asok', description: 'Every day, 10:00–20:00' },
  ] },
  { label: 'North', options: [
    { value: 'chiangmai', label: 'Chiang Mai' },
    { value: 'lampang', label: 'Lampang (closed)', disabled: true },
  ] },
];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <Combobox.Root items={branches} name="branch" filter="contains">
        <label htmlFor="branch" className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Branch</label>
        <Combobox.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-within:outline-2 focus-within:-outline-offset-2 focus-within:outline-focus">
          <Combobox.Input id="branch" placeholder="Type a branch" className="h-full min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent ps-4 text-sm text-ink outline-none placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
          <Combobox.Toggle aria-label="Open" className="group grid h-full w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center text-ink">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
              <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
            </svg>
          </Combobox.Toggle>
        </Combobox.Anchor>
        <Combobox.Popup aria-label="Branch" className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {(items) => items.filter(isGroup).map((group) => (
            <Combobox.Group key={group.label}>
              <Combobox.GroupLabel className="px-4 pt-3 pb-1 text-xs font-semibold text-ink-muted">{group.label}</Combobox.GroupLabel>
              <Combobox.GroupOptions>
                {group.options.map((o) => (
                  <Combobox.Option key={o.value} value={o.value} className="flex cursor-pointer flex-col px-4 py-2 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:text-ink data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:bg-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled">
                    {o.label}
                    <small className="text-xs text-ink-helper">{o.description}</small>
                  </Combobox.Option>
                ))}
              </Combobox.GroupOptions>
            </Combobox.Group>
          ))}
        </Combobox.Popup>
      </Combobox.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Clear

`Combobox.Clear` empties the text and the value and keeps focus in the input. Leave it out to have none. It is disabled while `Root` is disabled or read-only; the styled Combobox goes further and shows it only while the field can change and holds text:


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Combobox } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const provinces = [
  { value: 'bkk', label: 'Bangkok' },
  { value: 'cnx', label: 'Chiang Mai' },
  { value: 'hkt', label: 'Phuket' },
];

function ClearButton() {
  const { interactive, text } = Combobox.useComboboxContext();
  return interactive && text !== '' ? (
    <Combobox.Clear aria-label="Clear" className="grid h-full w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center text-ink hover:bg-field-hover-1">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current">
        <path d="M12 4.7 11.3 4 8 7.3 4.7 4 4 4.7 7.3 8 4 11.3l.7.7L8 8.7l3.3 3.3.7-.7L8.7 8z" />
      </svg>
    </Combobox.Clear>
  ) : null;
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <Combobox.Root items={provinces} name="province" defaultValue="bkk">
        <label htmlFor="province-clear" className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Province</label>
        <Combobox.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-within:outline-2 focus-within:-outline-offset-2 focus-within:outline-focus">
          <Combobox.Input id="province-clear" placeholder="Type a province" className="h-full min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent ps-4 text-sm text-ink outline-none placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
          <ClearButton />
          <Combobox.Toggle aria-label="Open" className="group grid h-full w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center text-ink">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
              <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
            </svg>
          </Combobox.Toggle>
        </Combobox.Anchor>
        <Combobox.Popup aria-label="Province" className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {(items) => items.map((p) => ('options' in p ? null : (
            <Combobox.Option key={p.value} value={p.value} className="cursor-pointer px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:text-ink">
              {p.label}
            </Combobox.Option>
          )))}
        </Combobox.Popup>
      </Combobox.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Esc on a closed list also clears.

## Open above, read-only and disabled

- `side="top"` on `Popup` prefers opening above; it flips when there is no room. The list lines up with `Anchor` and is as wide as it (the `Input` when there is no `Anchor`).
- `readOnly` makes the input read-only: the keys and clicks don't open the list, and `Toggle` and `Clear` are disabled.
- `disabled` disables the input, `Toggle` and `Clear`.
- A disabled field renders no hidden input, so it isn't submitted (as a disabled native control). A form reset puts an uncontrolled value and its text back.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Combobox } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const provinces = [
  { value: 'bkk', label: 'Bangkok' },
  { value: 'cnx', label: 'Chiang Mai' },
  { value: 'hkt', label: 'Phuket' },
];

interface FieldProps {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  side?: 'bottom' | 'top';
  defaultValue?: string;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

function ProvinceField({ id, label, side, ...props }: FieldProps) {
  return (
    <Combobox.Root items={provinces} {...props}>
      <label htmlFor={id} className="text-xs text-ink-muted">{label}</label>
      <Combobox.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-within:outline-2 focus-within:-outline-offset-2 focus-within:outline-focus has-data-readonly:border-hairline has-data-readonly:bg-transparent has-data-disabled:border-transparent has-data-disabled:hover:bg-field-1">
        <Combobox.Input id={id} placeholder="Type a province" className="h-full min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent ps-4 text-sm text-ink outline-none placeholder:text-ink-placeholder data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled" />
        <Combobox.Toggle aria-label="Open" className="group grid h-full w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center text-ink disabled:text-ink-disabled">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
            <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
          </svg>
        </Combobox.Toggle>
      </Combobox.Anchor>
      <Combobox.Popup aria-label={label} side={side} className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
        {(items) => items.map((p) => ('options' in p ? null : (
          <Combobox.Option key={p.value} value={p.value} className="cursor-pointer px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:text-ink">
            {p.label}
          </Combobox.Option>
        )))}
      </Combobox.Popup>
    </Combobox.Root>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <ProvinceField id="province-top" label="Province (opens above)" side="top" />
      <ProvinceField id="province-readonly" label="Province (read-only)" defaultValue="bkk" readOnly />
      <ProvinceField id="province-disabled" label="Province (disabled)" disabled />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`required` and `invalid` only set `aria-required` and `aria-invalid` (and `data-invalid`): check the value and show the error yourself ([Forms and validation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/forms/)). There are no sizes; the height is your CSS.

## Style it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Combobox } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const provinces = [
  { value: 'bkk', label: 'Bangkok' },
  { value: 'cnx', label: 'Chiang Mai' },
  { value: 'hkt', label: 'Phuket (no branch)', disabled: true },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [province, setProvince] = useState('');
  const invalid = province === '';
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <Combobox.Root items={provinces} name="province" value={province} onValueChange={setProvince} invalid={invalid} required>
        <label htmlFor="province-style" className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Province</label>
        <Combobox.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-within:outline-2 focus-within:-outline-offset-2 focus-within:outline-focus has-data-invalid:outline-2 has-data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 has-data-invalid:outline-error">
          <Combobox.Input
            id="province-style"
            placeholder="Type a province"
            aria-describedby={invalid ? 'province-style-error' : undefined}
            className="h-full min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent ps-4 text-sm text-ink outline-none placeholder:text-ink-placeholder"
          />
          <Combobox.Toggle aria-label="Open" className="grid h-full w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center text-ink data-open:rotate-180">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current">
              <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
            </svg>
          </Combobox.Toggle>
        </Combobox.Anchor>
        <Combobox.Popup aria-label="Province" className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {(items) => items.map((p) => ('options' in p ? null : (
            <Combobox.Option key={p.value} value={p.value} className="cursor-pointer px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:font-semibold data-selected:text-ink data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:bg-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled">
              {p.label}
            </Combobox.Option>
          )))}
        </Combobox.Popup>
      </Combobox.Root>
      {invalid ? <p id="province-style-error" className="text-xs text-error-text">Choose a province from the list</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```
```css
/* className="input" on Input, "toggle" on Toggle, "option" on each Option */
.input[data-open] { outline: 2px solid; }
.input[data-invalid] { outline: 2px solid #da1e28; }
.toggle[data-open] { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.option[data-highlighted] { background: #e8e8e8; }
.option[data-selected] { font-weight: 600; }
```

## Parts

### Combobox.Root

Renders no element of its own: its children, then the hidden input when `name` is set and `disabled` isn't.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `ListItem[]` | | Options and groups `{ label, options }` |
| `value` | `string` | | The chosen value (controlled) |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | `''` | The starting value (uncontrolled) |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | | After the value changes: a pick, a committed text, a clear |
| `onInputValueChange` | `(text: string) => void` | | Each time the user types |
| `filter` | `'none' \| 'contains' \| 'starts-with'` | `'none'` | How typed text narrows the list |
| `allowCustomValue` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep text that matches no option as the value |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | The popup is `aria-busy` |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | | After the list opens or closes |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the input, `Toggle` and `Clear` |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | The text and the value can't change |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | `aria-required` on the input |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid` on the input |
| `name` | `string` | | Submits the value with the form (a hidden input), unless disabled |
| `id` | `string` | generated | The input's id, and the base of the other ids: `<id>-list`, `<id>-opt-<n>`. The popup's `aria-labelledby` points at `<id>-label`, an id only your own `<label>` can carry (see `Combobox.Popup`) |

`Combobox.useComboboxContext()` returns the `Root`'s state (`text`, `value`, `open`, `listed`, `loading`, `interactive` …) to any component inside it.

### Combobox.Input

An `<input type="text" role="combobox" autocomplete="off">`. Its id is `Root`'s `id` unless you pass one. It takes every input prop except `type`, `role`, `value`, `defaultValue`, `disabled` and `readOnly`, which come from `Root`.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | The list is open |
| `data-disabled` | Disabled |
| `data-readonly` | Read-only |
| `data-invalid` | `invalid` is set |

### Combobox.Anchor

A `<div>` around the input and its buttons. The popup lines up with it and matches its width. No props, no data attributes.

### Combobox.Clear

A `<button type="button">` with `tabIndex={-1}` (pass your own to change it). A click empties the text and the value, closes the list and keeps focus in the input. It is disabled while `Root` is disabled or read-only. Give it an `aria-label`.

### Combobox.Toggle

A `<button type="button">` with `tabIndex={-1}`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. A click opens or closes the list; focus stays in the input. It is disabled while `Root` is disabled or read-only. Give it an `aria-label`.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | The list is open |

### Combobox.Popup

A `<ul role="listbox" popover="manual">` in the top layer. Its rows render only while the list is open. Its `aria-labelledby` is `<id>-label` unless you pass your own; there is no label part, so give it an `aria-label` or give your `<label>` that id.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode \| ((items: ListItem[]) => ReactNode)` | | The rows, or a function of the items the typed text keeps |
| `side` | `'bottom' \| 'top'` | `'bottom'` | Where the list opens; it flips when there is no room |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | The list is open |
| `data-side` | `bottom` or `top`: where the list went |

### Combobox.Option, Group, GroupLabel, GroupOptions

The same parts as in [Headless Dropdown](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-dropdown/#parts): `Option` is an `<li role="option">` with a required `value` and `data-highlighted`, `data-selected` and `data-disabled`. A click on an enabled option picks it, puts its label in the text box and closes the list.

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Typing | Opens the list and highlights the first option containing the text |
| ↓ / ↑ | Opens the list on the chosen option (else the first / last); then moves the highlight (no wrap) |
| Alt+↓ | Opens the list without a highlight |
| Alt+↑ | Picks the highlighted option and closes |
| Enter | Picks the highlighted option. With no highlight, picks the first option containing the text (or keeps the text with `allowCustomValue`) |
| Esc | Closes the list; on a closed list, clears the text and the value |
| Tab | Moves on without picking the highlight; the text is committed or snaps back |

The parts set `role="combobox"`, `aria-autocomplete="list"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-activedescendant`, `aria-required` and `aria-invalid` on the input, and the listbox and option roles on the list. Focus stays in the input.

You add:

- A `<label htmlFor>` for the input, and a name for the popup (`aria-label`, or a `<label>` with the id `<id>-label`).
- `aria-label` on `Clear` and `Toggle`.
- Helper and error text, linked with `aria-describedby` on the input.
- A `role="status"` text for "Searching…" and "No matching items", as in the example above.


---

# Headless Multi-select

The `MultiSelect` parts give you the behaviour of the styled [Multi-select](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/multi-select/) with no styles: a field that opens a listbox in the top layer and stays open while people toggle options, chosen options moving to the top, an optional "Select all" row, a filterable text box, the keyboard, and one hidden input per chosen value.

You own the markup, the label text, the count, the check boxes in the rows, any helper or error message, the "Loading…" text and every style. The parts show their state as `data-*` attributes for you to style on.

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { MultiSelect, type ListOption } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { MultiSelect, type ListOption } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const people = [
  { value: 'owner', label: 'Contract owner' },
  { value: 'legal', label: 'Legal team' },
  { value: 'finance', label: 'Finance team' },
];

// a row with a check box drawn from its data-selected
function Row({ value, label }: ListOption) {
  return (
    <MultiSelect.Option value={value} className="group flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:text-ink">
      <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xs border border-ink text-transparent group-data-selected:bg-ink group-data-selected:text-icon-inverse">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-3.5 fill-current"><path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" /></svg>
      </span>
      {label}
    </MultiSelect.Option>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <MultiSelect.Root items={people} name="notify">
        <MultiSelect.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Notify</MultiSelect.Label>
        <MultiSelect.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 has-focus-visible:outline-2 has-focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 has-focus-visible:outline-focus has-data-open:outline-2 has-data-open:-outline-offset-2 has-data-open:outline-focus">
          <MultiSelect.Trigger className="group flex h-full min-w-0 flex-1 items-center justify-between gap-2 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink outline-none">
            <MultiSelect.Value placeholder="Choose people" className="truncate data-placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
              <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
            </svg>
          </MultiSelect.Trigger>
        </MultiSelect.Anchor>
        <MultiSelect.Popup className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {(items) => items.map((p) => ('options' in p ? null : <Row key={p.value} {...p} />))}
        </MultiSelect.Popup>
      </MultiSelect.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`items` on `Root` is every option. `Popup` calls its children function with the rows to show, in order: filtered by the typed text, chosen ones first, groups kept.

## Anatomy

```tsx
<MultiSelect.Root items={items}>
  <MultiSelect.Label />
  <MultiSelect.Anchor>
    <MultiSelect.Trigger>
      <MultiSelect.Value />
    </MultiSelect.Trigger>
    {/* or, with filterable: */}
    <MultiSelect.Input />
    <MultiSelect.ClearText />
    <MultiSelect.Toggle />
    <MultiSelect.Clear />
  </MultiSelect.Anchor>
  <MultiSelect.Popup>
    {(items) => (
      <>
        <MultiSelect.SelectAll />
        <MultiSelect.Option value="…" />
        <MultiSelect.Group>
          <MultiSelect.GroupLabel />
          <MultiSelect.GroupOptions>
            <MultiSelect.Option value="…" />
          </MultiSelect.GroupOptions>
        </MultiSelect.Group>
      </>
    )}
  </MultiSelect.Popup>
</MultiSelect.Root>
```

## The count, clear and descriptions

`Value` shows its `children`, else the placeholder: it doesn't count. Read `count` from `MultiSelect.useMultiSelectContext()` to show how many are chosen. `Clear` empties the choice and keeps focus in the field; it is disabled while `Root` is disabled or read-only. The example below also leaves it out then, as the styled MultiSelect does.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { MultiSelect, type ListOption } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const people = [
  { value: 'owner', label: 'Contract owner' },
  { value: 'legal', label: 'Legal team' },
  { value: 'finance', label: 'Finance team' },
  { value: 'signer', label: 'Signers', description: 'Only after both parties sign' },
];

function CountAndClear() {
  const { count, interactive } = MultiSelect.useMultiSelectContext();
  if (count === 0) return null;
  return (
    <span className="ms-2 inline-flex h-6 shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-inverse-canvas ps-2 text-xs text-inverse-ink">
      {count}
      {interactive ? (
        <MultiSelect.Clear aria-label="Clear all" className="grid size-6 place-items-center rounded-full hover:bg-inverse-hover">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-3.5 fill-current">
            <path d="M12 4.7 11.3 4 8 7.3 4.7 4 4 4.7 7.3 8 4 11.3l.7.7L8 8.7l3.3 3.3.7-.7L8.7 8z" />
          </svg>
        </MultiSelect.Clear>
      ) : null}
    </span>
  );
}

function Row({ value, label, description }: ListOption) {
  return (
    <MultiSelect.Option value={value} className="group flex cursor-pointer items-start gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:text-ink">
      <span aria-hidden="true" className="mt-0.5 grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xs border border-ink text-transparent group-data-selected:bg-ink group-data-selected:text-icon-inverse">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-3.5 fill-current"><path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" /></svg>
      </span>
      <span className="flex flex-col">
        {label}
        <small className="text-xs text-ink-helper">{description}</small>
      </span>
    </MultiSelect.Option>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <MultiSelect.Root items={people} name="notify" defaultValue={['owner']}>
        <MultiSelect.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Notify</MultiSelect.Label>
        <MultiSelect.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 has-focus-visible:outline-2 has-focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 has-focus-visible:outline-focus has-data-open:outline-2 has-data-open:-outline-offset-2 has-data-open:outline-focus">
          <CountAndClear />
          <MultiSelect.Trigger className="group flex h-full min-w-0 flex-1 items-center justify-between gap-2 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink outline-none">
            <MultiSelect.Value placeholder="Choose people" className="truncate data-placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
              <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
            </svg>
          </MultiSelect.Trigger>
        </MultiSelect.Anchor>
        <MultiSelect.Popup className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {(items) => items.map((p) => ('options' in p ? null : <Row key={p.value} {...p} />))}
        </MultiSelect.Popup>
      </MultiSelect.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Value

`value` is an array. Hold it yourself with `value` and `onValueChange`, or give a starting `defaultValue`. With `name`, `Root` renders one hidden input per chosen value, so read them with `FormData.getAll()`.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { MultiSelect, type ListOption } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const people = [
  { value: 'owner', label: 'Contract owner' },
  { value: 'legal', label: 'Legal team' },
  { value: 'finance', label: 'Finance team' },
];

function Row({ value, label }: ListOption) {
  return (
    <MultiSelect.Option value={value} className="group flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:text-ink">
      <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xs border border-ink text-transparent group-data-selected:bg-ink group-data-selected:text-icon-inverse">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-3.5 fill-current"><path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" /></svg>
      </span>
      {label}
    </MultiSelect.Option>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  const [notify, setNotify] = useState(['legal']);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<FormDataEntryValue[]>();
  return (
    <form
      className="grid max-w-xs gap-2"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSent(new FormData(e.currentTarget).getAll('notify'));
      }}
    >
      <MultiSelect.Root items={people} name="notify" value={notify} onValueChange={setNotify}>
        <MultiSelect.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Notify</MultiSelect.Label>
        <MultiSelect.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 has-focus-visible:outline-2 has-focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 has-focus-visible:outline-focus has-data-open:outline-2 has-data-open:-outline-offset-2 has-data-open:outline-focus">
          <MultiSelect.Trigger className="group flex h-full min-w-0 flex-1 items-center justify-between gap-2 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink outline-none">
            <MultiSelect.Value placeholder="Choose people" className="truncate data-placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
              <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
            </svg>
          </MultiSelect.Trigger>
        </MultiSelect.Anchor>
        <MultiSelect.Popup className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {(items) => items.map((p) => ('options' in p ? null : <Row key={p.value} {...p} />))}
        </MultiSelect.Popup>
      </MultiSelect.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Value: {JSON.stringify(notify)}</p>
      <button type="submit" className="h-10 justify-self-start bg-interactive px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus">Submit</button>
      {sent ? <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Sent: notify = {JSON.stringify(sent)}</p> : null}
    </form>
  );
}
```

## Select all

`selectAll` offers a "Select all" row. Put `SelectAll` first in the popup: it renders only while offered and something can be chosen. It chooses every enabled option shown, or none when all are chosen. While only some are, it has `data-mixed` and `aria-checked="mixed"`.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { MultiSelect, type ListOption } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const people = [
  { value: 'owner', label: 'Contract owner' },
  { value: 'legal', label: 'Legal team' },
  { value: 'finance', label: 'Finance team' },
];

const box = 'grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xs border border-ink text-transparent group-data-selected:bg-ink group-data-selected:text-icon-inverse';
const check = <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-3.5 fill-current"><path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" /></svg>;

function Row({ value, label }: ListOption) {
  return (
    <MultiSelect.Option value={value} className="group flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:text-ink">
      <span aria-hidden="true" className={box}>{check}</span>
      {label}
    </MultiSelect.Option>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <MultiSelect.Root items={people} name="notify" selectAll>
        <MultiSelect.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Notify</MultiSelect.Label>
        <MultiSelect.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 has-focus-visible:outline-2 has-focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 has-focus-visible:outline-focus has-data-open:outline-2 has-data-open:-outline-offset-2 has-data-open:outline-focus">
          <MultiSelect.Trigger className="group flex h-full min-w-0 flex-1 items-center justify-between gap-2 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink outline-none">
            <MultiSelect.Value placeholder="Choose people" className="truncate data-placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
              <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
            </svg>
          </MultiSelect.Trigger>
        </MultiSelect.Anchor>
        <MultiSelect.Popup className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {(items) => (
            <>
              <MultiSelect.SelectAll className="group flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:text-ink">
                {/* mixed: a filled box with a dash instead of the check */}
                <span aria-hidden="true" className={`${box} relative after:absolute after:top-[6px] after:left-[3px] after:hidden after:h-0.5 after:w-2 after:bg-icon-inverse group-data-mixed:bg-ink group-data-mixed:after:block`}>{check}</span>
                Select all
              </MultiSelect.SelectAll>
              {items.map((p) => ('options' in p ? null : <Row key={p.value} {...p} />))}
            </>
          )}
        </MultiSelect.Popup>
      </MultiSelect.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Where chosen options go

`selectionFeedback` decides when chosen rows move to the top of the rows `Popup` hands you:

| `selectionFeedback` | Chosen rows |
|---|---|
| `top-after-reopen` (default) | Move to the top the next time the list opens |
| `top` | Move to the top at once |
| `fixed` | Stay where they are |

With groups in `items`, nothing moves.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { MultiSelect, type ListOption } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

type Feedback = 'top-after-reopen' | 'top' | 'fixed';

const people = [
  { value: 'owner', label: 'Contract owner' },
  { value: 'legal', label: 'Legal team' },
  { value: 'finance', label: 'Finance team' },
  { value: 'signer', label: 'Signers' },
];

function Row({ value, label }: ListOption) {
  return (
    <MultiSelect.Option value={value} className="group flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:text-ink">
      <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xs border border-ink text-transparent group-data-selected:bg-ink group-data-selected:text-icon-inverse">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-3.5 fill-current"><path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" /></svg>
      </span>
      {label}
    </MultiSelect.Option>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<Feedback>('top-after-reopen');
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-4">
      <label className="grid gap-2 text-xs text-ink-muted">
        selectionFeedback
        <select
          value={feedback}
          onChange={(e) => setFeedback(e.target.value as Feedback)}
          className="h-8 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-2 text-sm text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus"
        >
          <option value="top-after-reopen">top-after-reopen</option>
          <option value="top">top</option>
          <option value="fixed">fixed</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <MultiSelect.Root items={people} selectionFeedback={feedback}>
          <MultiSelect.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Notify</MultiSelect.Label>
          <MultiSelect.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 has-focus-visible:outline-2 has-focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 has-focus-visible:outline-focus has-data-open:outline-2 has-data-open:-outline-offset-2 has-data-open:outline-focus">
            <MultiSelect.Trigger className="group flex h-full min-w-0 flex-1 items-center justify-between gap-2 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink outline-none">
              <MultiSelect.Value placeholder="Choose people" className="truncate data-placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
              <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
                <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
              </svg>
            </MultiSelect.Trigger>
          </MultiSelect.Anchor>
          <MultiSelect.Popup className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
            {(items) => items.map((p) => ('options' in p ? null : <Row key={p.value} {...p} />))}
          </MultiSelect.Popup>
        </MultiSelect.Root>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Filterable

`filterable` makes the field a text box: use `Input` instead of `Trigger` and `Value`, and add `ClearText` and `Toggle` if you want them. `filter` is `contains` (the default) or `starts-with`. Choosing keeps the text and the list open; focus leaving `Anchor` or a press outside closes the list and empties the text. "Select all" then acts on the rows shown.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { MultiSelect, type ListOption } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const provinces = [
  { value: 'bkk', label: 'Bangkok' },
  { value: 'cnx', label: 'Chiang Mai' },
  { value: 'cei', label: 'Chiang Rai' },
  { value: 'kkc', label: 'Khon Kaen' },
  { value: 'hkt', label: 'Phuket' },
  { value: 'skh', label: 'Songkhla' },
];

function Row({ value, label }: ListOption) {
  return (
    <MultiSelect.Option value={value} className="group flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:text-ink">
      <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xs border border-ink text-transparent group-data-selected:bg-ink group-data-selected:text-icon-inverse">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-3.5 fill-current"><path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" /></svg>
      </span>
      {label}
    </MultiSelect.Option>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <MultiSelect.Root items={provinces} name="provinces" filterable>
        <MultiSelect.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Provinces</MultiSelect.Label>
        <MultiSelect.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-within:outline-2 focus-within:-outline-offset-2 focus-within:outline-focus">
          <MultiSelect.Input placeholder="Type to filter" className="h-full min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent ps-4 text-sm text-ink outline-none placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
          <MultiSelect.ClearText aria-label="Clear text" className="grid h-full w-8 shrink-0 place-items-center text-ink hover:bg-field-hover-1">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current">
              <path d="M12 4.7 11.3 4 8 7.3 4.7 4 4 4.7 7.3 8 4 11.3l.7.7L8 8.7l3.3 3.3.7-.7L8.7 8z" />
            </svg>
          </MultiSelect.ClearText>
          <MultiSelect.Toggle aria-label="Open" className="group grid h-full w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center text-ink">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
              <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
            </svg>
          </MultiSelect.Toggle>
        </MultiSelect.Anchor>
        <MultiSelect.Popup className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {(items) => items.map((p) => ('options' in p ? null : <Row key={p.value} {...p} />))}
        </MultiSelect.Popup>
      </MultiSelect.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

For a server search, set `filter="none"`, get the typed text from `onInputValueChange`, replace `items` and set `loading`. Keep the chosen options in `items` so their rows stay.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { MultiSelect, type ListOption } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const everyone: ListOption[] = [
  { value: 'somchai', label: 'Somchai Jaidee' },
  { value: 'suda', label: 'Suda Rakthai' },
  { value: 'anan', label: 'Anan Srisuk' },
  { value: 'malee', label: 'Malee Wongsa' },
  { value: 'prasert', label: 'Prasert Chaiyo' },
  { value: 'ratana', label: 'Ratana Boonmee' },
];

// stands in for the server: the people whose name contains the text, after 500 ms
const search = (text: string) =>
  new Promise<ListOption[]>((resolve) => {
    const found = everyone.filter((p) => p.label.toLowerCase().includes(text.trim().toLowerCase()));
    setTimeout(() => resolve(found), 500);
  });

function Row({ value, label }: ListOption) {
  return (
    <MultiSelect.Option value={value} className="group flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:text-ink">
      <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xs border border-ink text-transparent group-data-selected:bg-ink group-data-selected:text-icon-inverse">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-3.5 fill-current"><path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" /></svg>
      </span>
      {label}
    </MultiSelect.Option>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [found, setFound] = useState(everyone);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const latest = useRef('');
  const onText = async (text: string) => {
    latest.current = text;
    setLoading(true);
    const result = await search(text);
    if (latest.current !== text) return; // a newer search is on its way
    setFound(result);
    setLoading(false);
  };
```
