```tsx
  // the chosen options stay in items, so their rows stay
  const rows = [...everyone.filter((p) => value.includes(p.value) && !found.includes(p)), ...found];
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <MultiSelect.Root items={rows} name="people" value={value} onValueChange={setValue} filterable filter="none" loading={loading} onInputValueChange={onText}>
        <MultiSelect.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted">People</MultiSelect.Label>
        <MultiSelect.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 focus-within:outline-2 focus-within:-outline-offset-2 focus-within:outline-focus">
          <MultiSelect.Input placeholder="Type a name" className="h-full min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent ps-4 text-sm text-ink outline-none placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
          <MultiSelect.Toggle aria-label="Open" className="group grid h-full w-10 shrink-0 place-items-center text-ink">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
              <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
            </svg>
          </MultiSelect.Toggle>
        </MultiSelect.Anchor>
        <MultiSelect.Popup className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {(items) => (
            <>
              {/* while loading, items is empty */}
              {loading ? <li role="option" aria-disabled="true" aria-selected="false" className="px-4 py-3 text-ink-placeholder">Searching…</li> : null}
              {items.map((p) => ('options' in p ? null : <Row key={p.value} {...p} />))}
            </>
          )}
        </MultiSelect.Popup>
        <span role="status" className="sr-only">{loading ? 'Searching…' : ''}</span>
      </MultiSelect.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Value: {JSON.stringify(value)}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`onText` sets `loading`, searches (here a stand-in that answers after a short wait), and puts the result in `rows` together with the chosen options, as on [Multi-select](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/multi-select/#search-on-a-server).

## Load the options when the list opens

`onOpenChange` fires after the list opens or closes. While `loading` is true, `Popup` hands you no rows, "Select all" is hidden, the keys pick nothing and the popup has `aria-busy`. Render a "Loading…" row and a `role="status"` text yourself, as on [Headless Dropdown](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-dropdown/#load-the-options-when-the-list-opens).

## Read-only and disabled

- `readOnly` shows the choice, but the list doesn't open and the keys do nothing. The field gets `aria-readonly` (or the input `readOnly`, filterable), and `Toggle` and `Clear` are disabled.
- `disabled` disables the field, `Toggle` and `Clear`.
- A disabled field renders no hidden inputs, so it isn't submitted (as a disabled native control). A form reset puts an uncontrolled choice back.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { MultiSelect } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const people = [
  { value: 'owner', label: 'Contract owner' },
  { value: 'legal', label: 'Legal team' },
];

// the chosen labels, read from the Root's state
function ChosenValue() {
  const { value } = MultiSelect.useMultiSelectContext();
  const labels = people.filter((p) => value.includes(p.value)).map((p) => p.label).join(', ');
  return <MultiSelect.Value placeholder="Choose people" className="truncate data-placeholder:text-ink-placeholder">{labels || undefined}</MultiSelect.Value>;
}

function NotifyField({ label, ...props }: { label: string; defaultValue?: string[]; readOnly?: boolean; disabled?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <MultiSelect.Root items={people} {...props}>
      <MultiSelect.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted data-disabled:text-ink-disabled">{label}</MultiSelect.Label>
      <MultiSelect.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 has-focus-visible:outline-2 has-focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 has-focus-visible:outline-focus has-data-readonly:border-hairline has-data-readonly:bg-transparent has-data-disabled:border-transparent">
        <MultiSelect.Trigger className="group flex h-full min-w-0 flex-1 items-center justify-between gap-2 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink outline-none data-readonly:cursor-default data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled">
          <ChosenValue />
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current group-data-readonly:opacity-25">
            <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
          </svg>
        </MultiSelect.Trigger>
      </MultiSelect.Anchor>
      <MultiSelect.Popup className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
        {(items) => items.map((p) => ('options' in p ? null : <MultiSelect.Option key={p.value} value={p.value} className="px-4 py-3">{p.label}</MultiSelect.Option>))}
      </MultiSelect.Popup>
    </MultiSelect.Root>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <NotifyField label="Notify (read-only)" defaultValue={['owner', 'legal']} readOnly />
      <NotifyField label="Notify (disabled)" disabled />
    </div>
  );
}
```

`required` and `invalid` only set `aria-required` and `aria-invalid` (and `data-invalid`): check the value and show the error yourself ([Forms and validation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/forms/)). There are no sizes; the height is your CSS.

## Style it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { MultiSelect, type ListOption } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const people = [
  { value: 'owner', label: 'Contract owner' },
  { value: 'legal', label: 'Legal team' },
  { value: 'board', label: 'Board (on leave)', disabled: true },
];

function Row({ value, label }: ListOption) {
  return (
    <MultiSelect.Option value={value} className="group flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 data-highlighted:bg-layer-hover-1 data-selected:text-ink data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:bg-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled">
      <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xs border border-ink text-transparent group-data-selected:bg-ink group-data-selected:text-icon-inverse group-data-disabled:border-ink-disabled">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-3.5 fill-current"><path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" /></svg>
      </span>
      {label}
    </MultiSelect.Option>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  const [notify, setNotify] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const invalid = notify.length === 0;
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <MultiSelect.Root items={people} name="notify" value={notify} onValueChange={setNotify} invalid={invalid} required>
        <MultiSelect.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Notify</MultiSelect.Label>
        <MultiSelect.Anchor className="flex h-10 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 hover:bg-field-hover-1 has-focus-visible:outline-2 has-focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 has-focus-visible:outline-focus has-data-open:outline-2 has-data-open:-outline-offset-2 has-data-open:outline-focus has-data-invalid:outline-2 has-data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 has-data-invalid:outline-error">
          <MultiSelect.Trigger
            aria-describedby={invalid ? 'notify-style-error' : undefined}
            className="group flex h-full min-w-0 flex-1 items-center justify-between gap-2 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink outline-none"
          >
            <MultiSelect.Value placeholder="Choose people" className="truncate data-placeholder:text-ink-placeholder" />
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
              <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
            </svg>
          </MultiSelect.Trigger>
        </MultiSelect.Anchor>
        <MultiSelect.Popup className="bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink shadow-lg">
          {(items) => items.map((p) => ('options' in p ? null : <Row key={p.value} {...p} />))}
        </MultiSelect.Popup>
      </MultiSelect.Root>
      {invalid ? <p id="notify-style-error" className="text-xs text-error-text">Choose at least one person</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```
```css
/* className="trigger" on Trigger, "option" on each Option, "select-all" on SelectAll, "box" on the drawn check boxes */
.trigger[data-open] { outline: 2px solid; }

.option[data-highlighted] { background: #e8e8e8; }
```

## Parts

### MultiSelect.Root

Renders no element of its own: its children, then one hidden input per chosen value when `name` is set and `disabled` isn't.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `ListItem[]` | | Options and groups `{ label, options }` |
| `value` | `string[]` | | The chosen values (controlled) |
| `defaultValue` | `string[]` | `[]` | The starting values (uncontrolled) |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string[]) => void` | | After the choice changes |
| `onInputValueChange` | `(text: string) => void` | | Filterable: each change of the typed text |
| `selectionFeedback` | `'top-after-reopen' \| 'top' \| 'fixed'` | `'top-after-reopen'` | When chosen options move to the top |
| `selectAll` | `boolean` | `false` | Offer the `SelectAll` row |
| `filterable` | `boolean` | `false` | The field is a text box (`Input`) that narrows the list |
| `filter` | `'contains' \| 'starts-with' \| 'none'` | `'contains'` | How typed text narrows the list (filterable) |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | No rows, the keys pick nothing, the popup is `aria-busy` |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | | After the list opens or closes |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the field, `Toggle` and `Clear` |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | The choice can't change |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | `aria-required` on the field |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid` on the field |
| `name` | `string` | | Submits each chosen value with the form (hidden inputs), unless disabled |
| `id` | `string` | generated | The input's id (filterable), and the base of the ids: `<id>-label`, `<id>-value`, `<id>-list`, `<id>-opt-<n>`, `<id>-opt-all` |

`MultiSelect.useMultiSelectContext()` returns the `Root`'s state (`value`, `count`, `open`, `text`, `rows`, `allState`, `interactive` …) to any component inside it.

### MultiSelect.Label

A `<span>` with the id `<id>-label`. It names the field and the popup.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-disabled` | `Root` is disabled |

### MultiSelect.Anchor

A `<div>` around the field, the count and the buttons. The popup lines up with it and matches its width. With `filterable`, focus leaving it closes the list and empties the text. No props, no data attributes.

### MultiSelect.Trigger

A `<button type="button" role="combobox">`, for a field that isn't filterable. Its `aria-labelledby` is `<id>-label <id>-value` unless you pass your own. It takes every button prop except `type`, `role` and `disabled`.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | The list is open |
| `data-disabled` | Disabled |
| `data-readonly` | Read-only |
| `data-invalid` | `invalid` is set |
| `data-placeholder` | Nothing is chosen |

### MultiSelect.Value

A `<span>` with the id `<id>-value`: its `children`, else `placeholder`.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `placeholder` | `ReactNode` | | Shown when there are no children |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-placeholder` | Nothing is chosen |

### MultiSelect.Input

Filterable: an `<input type="text" role="combobox" autocomplete="off">` that narrows the list. Its id is `Root`'s `id` and its `aria-labelledby` is `<id>-label`, unless you pass your own. It takes every input prop except `type`, `role`, `value`, `defaultValue`, `disabled` and `readOnly`. It has the same data attributes as `Trigger`.

### MultiSelect.Clear

A `<button type="button">` with `tabIndex={-1}`. A click empties the choice and puts focus in the field. It is disabled while `Root` is disabled or read-only. Give it an `aria-label`.

### MultiSelect.ClearText

Filterable: a `<button type="button">` with `tabIndex={-1}`. A click empties the typed text and puts focus in the input. Give it an `aria-label`.

### MultiSelect.Toggle

Filterable: a `<button type="button">` with `tabIndex={-1}`, `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. A click opens or closes the list; focus stays in the input. It is disabled while `Root` is disabled or read-only. Give it an `aria-label`.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | The list is open |

### MultiSelect.Popup

A `<ul role="listbox" aria-multiselectable="true" popover="manual">` in the top layer. Its rows render only while the list is open. A press outside closes it and empties the text.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode \| ((items: ListItem[]) => ReactNode)` | | The rows, or a function of the rows to show |
| `side` | `'bottom' \| 'top'` | `'bottom'` | Where the list opens; it flips when there is no room |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | The list is open |
| `data-side` | `bottom` or `top`: where the list went |

### MultiSelect.SelectAll

An `<li role="option">` with the id `<id>-opt-all`, rendered only while `selectAll` is set, nothing is loading and an enabled option is shown. A click chooses every enabled option shown, or none when all are chosen.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-highlighted` | The keyboard highlight is on it |
| `data-selected` | Every shown option is chosen |
| `data-mixed` | Some are chosen |

### MultiSelect.Option, Group, GroupLabel, GroupOptions

The same parts as in [Headless Dropdown](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-dropdown/#parts): `Option` is an `<li role="option">` with a required `value` and `data-highlighted`, `data-selected` and `data-disabled`. A click on an enabled option toggles it and keeps the list open.

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | List closed | List open |
|---|---|---|
| ↓, Enter, Space | Open the list | Enter and Space toggle the highlighted row; the list stays open |
| ↓ / ↑, Page Down / Page Up, Home / End | ↑ does nothing; Home / End open on the first / last row | Move the highlight |
| Letters | Open on the next option that starts with them | Jump to the next option that starts with them |
| Delete, Backspace, Esc | Clear every choice | Esc closes |
| Tab | Moves on | Closes and moves on |

With `filterable`, letters, Space, Home, End, Delete and Backspace edit the text. ↓ or Enter open the list, Enter toggles the highlighted row (or closes with nothing highlighted), and Esc on a closed list clears the choices and the text.

The parts set `role="combobox"`, `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-activedescendant`, `aria-readonly`, `aria-required` and `aria-invalid` on the field, and `aria-multiselectable`, `aria-selected` and `aria-checked="mixed"` on the list. Focus stays on the field.

You add:

- The label text in `Label`.
- `aria-label` on `Clear`, `ClearText` and `Toggle`.
- The count, if you show one, and a check box drawn in each row (hidden from screen readers; `aria-selected` already says it).
- Helper and error text, linked with `aria-describedby` on the field.
- A `role="status"` text for "Loading…", "Searching…" and "No matching items".


---

# Headless Checkbox

`Checkbox.Root` is the native `<input type="checkbox">` with no styles, so form submission, `required`, Space, labels and screen readers come from the browser. On top of that it adds `indeterminate` as a prop, a read-only state, `onCheckedChange`, and `data-*` attributes for you to style on.

You own the `<label>`, the box you draw, any group around the boxes, any helper or error message, and every style. For the styled version, see [Checkbox](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/checkbox/).

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { Checkbox } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it

Hide the input over a box you draw beside it, and wrap both in a `<label>` so the whole row is clickable:


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <label className="relative flex w-fit cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink">
      <Checkbox.Root name="terms" required className="peer sr-only" />
      <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xs border border-ink text-transparent peer-focus-visible:outline-2 peer-focus-visible:outline-offset-1 peer-focus-visible:outline-focus peer-data-checked:bg-ink peer-data-checked:text-icon-inverse">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-3.5 fill-current"><path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" /></svg>
      </span>
      I accept the terms
    </label>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

```tsx
<label>
  <Checkbox.Root />
  {/* your box and text */}
</label>
```

## Checked state

Hold the state yourself with `checked` and `onCheckedChange` (or `onChange`), or give a starting `defaultChecked`. A checked box submits `value` (`on` by default) under `name`; an unchecked box submits nothing. A form reset puts an uncontrolled box back to `defaultChecked`, and `data-checked` follows.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Checkbox } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

// the box drawn after the hidden input (a peer of it)
function Box() {
  return (
    <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xs border border-ink text-transparent peer-focus-visible:outline-2 peer-focus-visible:outline-offset-1 peer-focus-visible:outline-focus peer-data-checked:bg-ink peer-data-checked:text-icon-inverse">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-3.5 fill-current"><path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" /></svg>
    </span>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(false);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<Record<string, FormDataEntryValue>>();
  return (
    <form
      className="grid justify-items-start gap-3"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSent(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.currentTarget)));
      }}
    >
      <label className="relative flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink">
        <Checkbox.Root name="newsletter" value="yes" checked={on} onCheckedChange={setOn} className="peer sr-only" />
        <Box />
        Send me the newsletter
      </label>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Checked: {String(on)}</p>
      <button type="submit" className="h-10 bg-interactive px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus">Submit</button>
      {sent ? <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Sent: {JSON.stringify(sent)}</p> : null}
    </form>
  );
}
```

## A group of checkboxes

There is no group part. Use a `<fieldset>` and `<legend>`, lay the boxes out yourself, and check "at least one" in your own validation. Each box submits its own `name` and `value`, so read them with `FormData.getAll()`.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Checkbox } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const docs = [
  { value: 'id', label: 'ID card' },
  { value: 'house', label: 'House registration' },
  { value: 'bank', label: 'Bank book' },
];

function Box() {
  return (
    <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xs border border-ink text-transparent peer-focus-visible:outline-2 peer-focus-visible:outline-offset-1 peer-focus-visible:outline-focus peer-data-checked:bg-ink peer-data-checked:text-icon-inverse">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-3.5 fill-current"><path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" /></svg>
    </span>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<FormDataEntryValue[]>();
  return (
    <form
      className="grid justify-items-start gap-3"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSent(new FormData(e.currentTarget).getAll('docs'));
      }}
    >
      <fieldset className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-6 gap-y-2">
        <legend className="mb-2 text-xs text-ink-muted">Documents received</legend>
        {docs.map((d) => (
          <label key={d.value} className="relative flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink">
            <Checkbox.Root name="docs" value={d.value} className="peer sr-only" />
            <Box />
            {d.label}
          </label>
        ))}
      </fieldset>
      <button type="submit" className="h-10 bg-interactive px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus">Submit</button>
      {sent ? <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Sent: docs = {JSON.stringify(sent)}</p> : null}
    </form>
  );
}
```

## Indeterminate

`indeterminate` shows the mixed state of a parent box whose children are partly checked. It is set as the DOM property, so screen readers hear "mixed". Keep the parent in step with its children in your code:


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Checkbox } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

// checked: a check; indeterminate: a dash (its ::after)
function Box() {
  return (
    <span aria-hidden="true" className="relative grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xs border border-ink text-transparent after:absolute after:top-[6px] after:left-[3px] after:hidden after:h-0.5 after:w-2 after:bg-icon-inverse peer-focus-visible:outline-2 peer-focus-visible:outline-offset-1 peer-focus-visible:outline-focus peer-data-checked:bg-ink peer-data-checked:text-icon-inverse peer-data-indeterminate:bg-ink peer-data-indeterminate:after:block">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-3.5 fill-current"><path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" /></svg>
    </span>
  );
}

const row = 'relative flex w-fit cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink';
const all = ['email', 'sms'];

export default function Example() {
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState(['email']);
  const some = chosen.length > 0 && chosen.length < all.length;
  const pick = (value: string, on: boolean) => setChosen((c) => (on ? [...c, value] : c.filter((v) => v !== value)));
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-2">
      <label className={row}>
        <Checkbox.Root checked={chosen.length === all.length} indeterminate={some} onCheckedChange={(on) => setChosen(on ? all : [])} className="peer sr-only" />
        <Box />
        All channels
      </label>
      <div className="grid gap-2 ps-6">
        <label className={row}>
          <Checkbox.Root checked={chosen.includes('email')} onCheckedChange={(on) => pick('email', on)} className="peer sr-only" />
          <Box />
          Email
        </label>
        <label className={row}>
          <Checkbox.Root checked={chosen.includes('sms')} onCheckedChange={(on) => pick('sms', on)} className="peer sr-only" />
          <Box />
          SMS
        </label>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## No visible label

When the context already names the box, such as a checkbox in a table row, give it an `aria-label` instead of label text:


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const contracts = ['Lease, Silom', 'Sale, Asok', 'Mortgage, Chiang Mai'];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <table className="w-full max-w-sm text-sm text-ink">
      <tbody>
        {contracts.map((contract, i) => (
          <tr key={contract} className="border-b border-border-subtle-1">
            <td className="w-10 p-3">
              <label className="relative flex w-fit cursor-pointer">
                <Checkbox.Root aria-label={`Select row ${i + 1}`} className="peer sr-only" />
                <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xs border border-ink text-transparent peer-focus-visible:outline-2 peer-focus-visible:outline-offset-1 peer-focus-visible:outline-focus peer-data-checked:bg-ink peer-data-checked:text-icon-inverse">
                  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-3.5 fill-current"><path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" /></svg>
                </span>
              </label>
            </td>
            <td className="p-3">{contract}</td>
          </tr>
        ))}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );
}
```

## Read-only and disabled

- `readOnly` keeps the state and still submits it, but a click or Space changes nothing. The input gets `aria-readonly`. The click is blocked before your `onClick` runs, so your handler sees `event.defaultPrevented`.
- `disabled` is the native attribute: the box can't be used and isn't submitted.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

// read-only: a grey frame and a dark check; disabled: everything greyed
function Box() {
  return (
    <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xs border border-ink text-transparent peer-focus-visible:outline-2 peer-focus-visible:outline-offset-1 peer-focus-visible:outline-focus peer-data-checked:bg-ink peer-data-checked:text-icon-inverse peer-data-readonly:border-ink-subtle peer-data-readonly:peer-data-checked:bg-transparent peer-data-readonly:peer-data-checked:text-ink peer-data-disabled:border-ink-disabled peer-data-disabled:peer-data-checked:bg-ink-disabled">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-3.5 fill-current"><path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" /></svg>
    </span>
  );
}

const row = 'relative flex w-fit cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink has-data-readonly:cursor-default has-data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed has-data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-2">
      <label className={row}>
        <Checkbox.Root defaultChecked readOnly className="peer sr-only" />
        <Box />
        Signed by both parties
      </label>
      <label className={row}>
        <Checkbox.Root disabled className="peer sr-only" />
        <Box />
        Archived
      </label>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`invalid` sets `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid`. The error text is yours ([Forms and validation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/forms/)).

## Style it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Checkbox } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

function Box() {
  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden="true"
      className="relative grid size-4 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xs border border-ink text-transparent after:absolute after:top-[6px] after:left-[3px] after:hidden after:h-0.5 after:w-2 after:bg-icon-inverse peer-focus-visible:outline-2 peer-focus-visible:outline-offset-1 peer-focus-visible:outline-focus peer-data-checked:bg-ink peer-data-checked:text-icon-inverse peer-data-indeterminate:bg-ink peer-data-indeterminate:after:block peer-data-invalid:border-2 peer-data-invalid:border-error peer-data-readonly:border-ink-subtle peer-data-disabled:border-ink-disabled peer-data-disabled:peer-data-checked:bg-ink-disabled"
    >
      <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-3.5 fill-current"><path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" /></svg>
    </span>
  );
}

const row = 'relative flex w-fit cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink has-data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed has-data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';

export default function Example() {
  const [accepted, setAccepted] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-2">
      <label className={row}>
        <Checkbox.Root checked={accepted} onCheckedChange={setAccepted} invalid={!accepted} aria-describedby={accepted ? undefined : 'terms-style-error'} className="peer sr-only" />
        <Box />
        I accept the terms
      </label>
      {accepted ? null : <p id="terms-style-error" className="ps-6 text-xs text-error-text">Accept the terms to go on</p>}
      <label className={row}>
        <Checkbox.Root defaultChecked disabled className="peer sr-only" />
        <Box />
        Email me (disabled)
      </label>
    </div>
  );
}
```
```css
/* className="box" on the span you draw after the input */
input[data-checked] + .box { background: #161616; }
input[data-indeterminate] + .box { background: #6f6f6f; }
input[data-invalid] + .box { border-color: #da1e28; }
input[data-readonly] + .box { border-color: #c6c6c6; }
input:focus-visible + .box { outline: 2px solid #0f62fe; }
```

## Parts

### Checkbox.Root

An `<input type="checkbox">`. It takes every input prop except `type`.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | The mixed state, set as the DOM property |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the state: a click or Space changes nothing (`aria-readonly`) |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | | `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid` |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean, event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void` | | After the user checks or unchecks it |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-checked` | Checked |
| `data-indeterminate` | `indeterminate` is set |
| `data-disabled` | Disabled |
| `data-readonly` | Read-only |
| `data-invalid` | `invalid` is set |

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Space | Checks or unchecks the focused box |
| Tab | Moves to the next box: each checkbox is its own Tab stop |

The browser gives the role, the checked and mixed state, focus and Space. The part adds `aria-readonly` and `aria-invalid`.

You add:

- A label: wrap the input in a `<label>`, or give it `aria-label`.
- A `<fieldset>` and `<legend>` around a group.
- Helper and error text, linked with `aria-describedby`.
- A visible focus style on the box you draw (the input itself is hidden).


---

# Headless Radio button

`RadioGroup.Root` is a `role="radiogroup"` around native `<input type="radio">` items that share one `name`, so the browser gives the single Tab stop, the arrow keys and form submission. The parts add the group's value, a read-only state, `onValueChange`, and `data-*` attributes for you to style on.

You own each item's `<label>`, the circle you draw, the group's label, any helper or error message, the layout and every style. For the styled version, see [Radio button](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/radio/).

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { RadioGroup } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it

Hide each input over a circle you draw beside it, and wrap both in a `<label>`:


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { RadioGroup } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <RadioGroup.Root aria-label="Payment" name="payment" className="grid gap-2">
      <label className="relative flex w-fit cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink">
        <RadioGroup.Item value="transfer" className="peer sr-only" />
        <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-[18px] shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-ink after:size-2 after:rounded-full after:bg-ink after:opacity-0 peer-focus-visible:outline-2 peer-focus-visible:outline-offset-1 peer-focus-visible:outline-focus peer-data-checked:after:opacity-100" />
        Bank transfer
      </label>
      <label className="relative flex w-fit cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink">
        <RadioGroup.Item value="card" className="peer sr-only" />
        <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-[18px] shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-ink after:size-2 after:rounded-full after:bg-ink after:opacity-0 peer-focus-visible:outline-2 peer-focus-visible:outline-offset-1 peer-focus-visible:outline-focus peer-data-checked:after:opacity-100" />
        Credit card
      </label>
    </RadioGroup.Root>
  );
}
```

Give the group a `name` when it is in a form: without one, `Root` makes up a name so the items still form one group.

## Anatomy

```tsx
<RadioGroup.Root>
  <label>
    <RadioGroup.Item value="…" />
    {/* your circle and text */}
  </label>
</RadioGroup.Root>
```

## Value

Hold the value yourself with `value` and `onValueChange`, or give a starting `defaultValue`. With neither, nothing is checked; `''` also checks none. The form submits the checked item's `value` under `name`.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { RadioGroup } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const methods = [
  { value: 'transfer', label: 'Bank transfer' },
  { value: 'card', label: 'Credit card' },
  { value: 'cash', label: 'Cash at the branch' },
];

// the circle drawn after the hidden input (a peer of it), with a dot while checked
function Circle() {
  return <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-[18px] shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-ink after:size-2 after:rounded-full after:bg-ink after:opacity-0 peer-focus-visible:outline-2 peer-focus-visible:outline-offset-1 peer-focus-visible:outline-focus peer-data-checked:after:opacity-100" />;
}

export default function Example() {
  const [payment, setPayment] = useState('card');
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<Record<string, FormDataEntryValue>>();
  return (
    <form
      className="grid justify-items-start gap-3"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSent(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.currentTarget)));
      }}
    >
      <span id="payment-value-label" className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Payment</span>
      <RadioGroup.Root aria-labelledby="payment-value-label" name="payment" value={payment} onValueChange={setPayment} className="grid gap-2">
        {methods.map((m) => (
          <label key={m.value} className="relative flex w-fit cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink">
            <RadioGroup.Item value={m.value} className="peer sr-only" />
            <Circle />
            {m.label}
          </label>
        ))}
      </RadioGroup.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Value: {payment || '(none)'}</p>
      <div className="flex gap-px">
        <button type="submit" className="h-10 bg-interactive px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus">Submit</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setPayment('')} className="h-10 px-4 text-sm text-link hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">Clear</button>
      </div>
      {sent ? <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Sent: {JSON.stringify(sent)}</p> : null}
    </form>
  );
}
```

## Orientation and label position

`orientation` only sets `data-orientation`: the browser's arrow keys go both ways, and the layout is your CSS. For the text before the circle, put it before the `Item` in its `<label>`.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { RadioGroup } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const lengths = [
  { value: '6', label: '6 months' },
  { value: '12', label: '1 year' },
  { value: '36', label: '3 years' },
];

function Circle() {
  return <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-[18px] shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-ink after:size-2 after:rounded-full after:bg-ink after:opacity-0 peer-focus-visible:outline-2 peer-focus-visible:outline-offset-1 peer-focus-visible:outline-focus peer-data-checked:after:opacity-100" />;
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <RadioGroup.Root aria-label="Contract length" name="length" orientation="horizontal" defaultValue="12" className="flex flex-wrap gap-6">
        {lengths.map((l) => (
          <label key={l.value} className="relative flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink">
            <RadioGroup.Item value={l.value} className="peer sr-only" />
            <Circle />
            {l.label}
          </label>
        ))}
      </RadioGroup.Root>
      {/* the text before the circle: put it before the Item */}
      <RadioGroup.Root aria-label="Contract length, text first" name="length-text-first" orientation="horizontal" defaultValue="12" className="flex flex-wrap gap-6">
        {lengths.map((l) => (
          <label key={l.value} className="relative flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink">
            {l.label}
            <RadioGroup.Item value={l.value} className="peer sr-only" />
            <Circle />
          </label>
        ))}
      </RadioGroup.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Read-only and disabled

- `disabled` on an `Item` disables that one; on `Root`, it disables every item, so none is submitted.
- `readOnly` keeps the value and still submits it. Clicks and arrow keys change nothing, but the arrows still move focus so people can read the options (as Carbon React). The group gets `aria-readonly`.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { RadioGroup } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

// read-only: a grey ring; disabled: everything greyed
function Circle() {
  return <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-[18px] shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-ink after:size-2 after:rounded-full after:bg-ink after:opacity-0 peer-focus-visible:outline-2 peer-focus-visible:outline-offset-1 peer-focus-visible:outline-focus peer-data-checked:after:opacity-100 peer-data-readonly:border-ink-subtle peer-data-disabled:border-ink-disabled peer-data-disabled:after:bg-ink-disabled" />;
}

const row = 'relative flex w-fit cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink has-data-readonly:cursor-default has-data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed has-data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <RadioGroup.Root aria-label="Payment" defaultValue="transfer" readOnly className="grid gap-2">
      <label className={row}>
        <RadioGroup.Item value="transfer" className="peer sr-only" />
        <Circle />
        Bank transfer
      </label>
      <label className={row}>
        <RadioGroup.Item value="cash" disabled className="peer sr-only" />
        <Circle />
        Cash at the branch
      </label>
    </RadioGroup.Root>
  );
}
```

`required` only sets `aria-required` on the group, and `invalid` sets `aria-invalid` on it and `data-invalid` on it and its items. Check the value and show the error yourself ([Forms and validation](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/forms/)). Give the message an id and put it in the group's `aria-describedby`: every item gets the same `aria-describedby`, so a screen reader hears it on the item it lands on.

## Style it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { RadioGroup } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const methods = [
  { value: 'transfer', label: 'Bank transfer' },
  { value: 'card', label: 'Credit card' },
  { value: 'cash', label: 'Cash (closed today)', disabled: true },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [payment, setPayment] = useState('');
  const invalid = payment === '';
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-2">
      <span id="payment-style-label" className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Payment</span>
      <RadioGroup.Root
        aria-labelledby="payment-style-label"
        aria-describedby={invalid ? 'payment-style-error' : undefined}
        value={payment}
        onValueChange={setPayment}
        invalid={invalid}
        required
        orientation="horizontal"
        className="flex flex-col gap-2 data-[orientation=horizontal]:flex-row data-[orientation=horizontal]:gap-6"
      >
        {methods.map((m) => (
          <label key={m.value} className="relative flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink has-data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed has-data-disabled:text-ink-disabled">
            <RadioGroup.Item value={m.value} disabled={m.disabled} className="peer sr-only" />
            <span
              aria-hidden="true"
              className="grid size-[18px] shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-full border border-ink after:size-2 after:rounded-full after:bg-ink after:opacity-0 peer-focus-visible:outline-2 peer-focus-visible:outline-offset-1 peer-focus-visible:outline-focus peer-data-checked:after:opacity-100 peer-data-invalid:border-error peer-data-disabled:border-ink-disabled"
            />
            {m.label}
          </label>
        ))}
      </RadioGroup.Root>
      {invalid ? <p id="payment-style-error" className="text-xs text-error-text">Choose how to pay</p> : null}
    </div>
  );
}
```
```css
/* className="circle" on the span you draw after each input */
[role="radiogroup"][data-orientation="horizontal"] { display: flex; gap: 24px; }
input[data-checked] + .circle { border-width: 4px; }
input[data-invalid] + .circle { border-color: #da1e28; }
input[data-readonly] + .circle { border-color: #c6c6c6; }
input:focus-visible + .circle { outline: 2px solid #0f62fe; }
```

## Parts

### RadioGroup.Root

A `<div role="radiogroup">`. It takes every div prop except `defaultValue` and `role`.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | generated | The submitted name, shared by every item |
| `value` | `string` | | The checked item's value (controlled); `''` checks none |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | `''` | The starting value (uncontrolled) |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string, event: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void` | | After the user checks another item |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | `'vertical'` | Only sets `data-orientation` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables every item (`aria-disabled` on the group) |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the value: clicks and arrow keys change nothing (`aria-readonly`) |
| `required` | `boolean` | | `aria-required` on the group |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | | `aria-invalid` on the group; `data-invalid` on it and its items |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-orientation` | Always: `vertical` or `horizontal` |
| `data-disabled` | Disabled |
| `data-readonly` | Read-only |
| `data-invalid` | `invalid` is set |

`RadioGroup.useRadioGroupContext()` returns the group's state (`name`, `value`, `disabled`, `readOnly`, `invalid`, `select` …), for building other kinds of item.

### RadioGroup.Item

An `<input type="radio">`, checked when its `value` is the group's. It takes every input prop except `type`, `name`, `checked` and `defaultChecked`. Its `aria-describedby` is the group's unless you pass your own.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` | | This item's value (required) |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | | This item alone; a disabled group disables every item |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-checked` | Checked |
| `data-disabled` | This item or the group is disabled |
| `data-readonly` | The group is read-only |
| `data-invalid` | The group is invalid |

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Tab | Enters the group on the checked item (else the first), and leaves it on the next Tab |
| ↓ / → | Moves to the next item and checks it; wraps from the last to the first |
| ↑ / ← | Moves to the previous item and checks it; wraps from the first to the last |
| Space | Checks the focused item |

The browser gives the radio role, the checked state, the single Tab stop and the arrow keys; disabled items are skipped. The parts add `role="radiogroup"`, `aria-required`, `aria-readonly`, `aria-disabled` and `aria-invalid` on the group.

You add:

- A name for the group: `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby` pointing at your visible label.
- A `<label>` for each item.
- Helper and error text, linked with `aria-describedby` on `Root`.
- A visible focus style on the circle you draw (the input itself is hidden).


---

# Headless Toggle

The headless part is named `Switch`, as in Base UI, where "Toggle" means a pressed button. `Switch.Root` is a `<button role="switch">` with `aria-checked`, so Space and Enter flip it. A click focuses it in every browser, Safari included. It adds a read-only state, `onCheckedChange`, form submission through a hidden input, and `data-*` attributes for you to style on.

You own the track and knob styles, the label, the "On" / "Off" text and every style. For the styled version, see [Toggle](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/toggle/).

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { Switch } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Switch } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Switch.Root aria-label="Email alerts" className="relative h-6 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-toggle-off transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus data-checked:bg-success">
      <Switch.Thumb className="absolute start-[3px] top-[3px] size-[18px] rounded-full bg-on-primary transition-transform data-checked:translate-x-6 rtl:data-checked:-translate-x-6" />
    </Switch.Root>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

```tsx
<Switch.Root>
  <Switch.Thumb />
</Switch.Root>
```

## On and off

Hold the state yourself with `checked` and `onCheckedChange`, or give a starting `defaultChecked`. `onCheckedChange` fires after the user flips it.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Switch } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="grid justify-items-start gap-3">
      <Switch.Root aria-label="Email alerts" checked={on} onCheckedChange={setOn} className="relative h-6 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-toggle-off transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus data-checked:bg-success">
        <Switch.Thumb className="absolute start-[3px] top-[3px] size-[18px] rounded-full bg-on-primary transition-transform data-checked:translate-x-6 rtl:data-checked:-translate-x-6" />
      </Switch.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Checked: {String(on)}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Label and state text

`Switch` draws no text. Name it with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, and render the state text yourself. Screen readers hear "on" or "off" from the role, so hide the state text from them.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Switch } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(true);
  return (
    <div className="grid justify-items-start gap-3">
      <span id="toggle-visibility" className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Visibility</span>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <Switch.Root aria-labelledby="toggle-visibility" checked={on} onCheckedChange={setOn} className="relative h-6 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-toggle-off transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus data-checked:bg-success">
          <Switch.Thumb className="absolute start-[3px] top-[3px] size-[18px] rounded-full bg-on-primary transition-transform data-checked:translate-x-6 rtl:data-checked:-translate-x-6" />
        </Switch.Root>
        <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-sm text-ink">{on ? 'Public' : 'Private'}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

A `<label htmlFor>` pointing at the switch's `id` also works: a click on the label clicks the switch.

## In a form

With a `name`, a checked switch submits `value` (`on` by default) through a hidden input after the button. Off or disabled, it submits nothing. A form reset puts an uncontrolled switch back to `defaultChecked`.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Switch } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<Record<string, FormDataEntryValue>>();
  return (
    <form
      className="grid justify-items-start gap-3"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSent(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.currentTarget)));
      }}
    >
      <Switch.Root aria-label="Auto-renew" name="autoRenew" value="yes" className="relative h-6 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-toggle-off transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus data-checked:bg-success">
        <Switch.Thumb className="absolute start-[3px] top-[3px] size-[18px] rounded-full bg-on-primary transition-transform data-checked:translate-x-6 rtl:data-checked:-translate-x-6" />
      </Switch.Root>
      <button type="submit" className="h-10 bg-interactive px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus">Submit</button>
      {sent ? <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Sent: {JSON.stringify(sent)}</p> : null}
    </form>
  );
}
```

## Read-only and disabled

- `readOnly` keeps the state and still submits it, but clicks, Space and Enter don't flip it. The switch gets `aria-readonly`.
- `disabled` is the button's own attribute: the switch can't be used and isn't submitted.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Switch } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const track = 'relative h-6 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-toggle-off transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus data-checked:bg-success data-readonly:cursor-default data-readonly:border data-readonly:border-ink-disabled data-readonly:bg-transparent data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:bg-button-disabled';
const knob = 'absolute start-[3px] top-[3px] size-[18px] rounded-full bg-on-primary transition-transform data-checked:translate-x-6 rtl:data-checked:-translate-x-6 data-readonly:start-[2px] data-readonly:top-[2px] data-readonly:bg-ink data-disabled:bg-on-color-disabled';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex gap-6">
      <Switch.Root aria-label="Auto-renew" defaultChecked readOnly className={track}><Switch.Thumb className={knob} /></Switch.Root>
      <Switch.Root aria-label="Auto-renew" disabled className={track}><Switch.Thumb className={knob} /></Switch.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

There are no sizes: the track and the knob are your CSS.

## Style it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useId, useState } from 'react';
import { Switch } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

function EmailAlerts({ label, ...props }: { label: string; readOnly?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; defaultChecked?: boolean }) {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(!!props.defaultChecked);
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
      <Switch.Root
        {...props}
        aria-labelledby={id}
        onCheckedChange={setOn}
        className="relative h-6 w-12 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-toggle-off transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus data-checked:bg-success data-readonly:cursor-default data-readonly:border data-readonly:border-ink-disabled data-readonly:bg-transparent data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:bg-button-disabled"
      >
        <Switch.Thumb className="absolute start-[3px] top-[3px] size-[18px] rounded-full bg-on-primary transition-transform data-checked:translate-x-6 rtl:data-checked:-translate-x-6 data-readonly:start-[2px] data-readonly:top-[2px] data-readonly:bg-ink data-disabled:bg-on-color-disabled" />
      </Switch.Root>
      <span id={id} className="text-sm text-ink">{label}</span>
      <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-sm text-ink-muted">{on ? 'On' : 'Off'}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3">
      <EmailAlerts label="Email alerts" />
      <EmailAlerts label="Email alerts (read-only)" defaultChecked readOnly />
      <EmailAlerts label="Email alerts (disabled)" disabled />
    </div>
  );
}
```
```css
/* className="track" on Root, "knob" on Thumb */
.track { width: 48px; height: 24px; border-radius: 12px; background: #8d8d8d; }
.track[data-checked] { background: #24a148; }
.track[data-readonly] { background: #e0e0e0; }
.knob { display: block; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; transition: translate 70ms; }
.knob[data-checked] { translate: 24px; }
```

## Parts

### Switch.Root

A `<button type="button" role="switch">`, then a hidden input when `name` is set and the switch is checked and enabled. It takes every button prop except `type`, `role`, `value` and `defaultChecked`.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checked` | `boolean` | | The state (controlled) |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | `false` | The starting state (uncontrolled) |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean, event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void` | | After the user flips it |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the state: a click, Space or Enter changes nothing (`aria-readonly`) |
| `name` | `string` | | A checked switch submits `value` with its form |
| `value` | `string` | `'on'` | Submitted while checked |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-checked` | On |
| `data-disabled` | Disabled |
| `data-readonly` | Read-only |

`Switch.useSwitchContext()` returns `checked`, `disabled` and `readOnly` to any component inside `Root`.

### Switch.Thumb

A `<span aria-hidden="true">` inside `Root`, for the knob. It has the same `data-checked`, `data-disabled` and `data-readonly` as `Root`.

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Space, Enter | Flips the switch |
| Tab | Moves to the next control |

The part sets `role="switch"`, `aria-checked` and `aria-readonly`, and focuses the switch on a click.

You add:

- A name: `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, or a `<label htmlFor>`.
- The state text, hidden from screen readers.
- A visible focus style.
- Write the label as the setting ("Email alerts"), not as an action ("Turn on email alerts").


---

# Headless Date picker

`DatePicker` and `Calendar` give you the date picker's behaviour with no classes. The parts read what users type (Thai digits too), open the calendar when the box gets focus, move focus between the box and the calendar, check the date against `min`, `max` and `isDateDisabled`, block the form while the date is wrong, and submit an ISO date.

You own the markup, the label, the placeholder, the error text, the icons and every style. The parts render no text of their own apart from month and day names. The styled version is [Date picker](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/date-picker/).

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { Calendar, DatePicker } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Calendar, DatePicker } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const label = 'text-xs text-ink-muted';
const group = 'flex w-72 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 data-disabled:border-transparent has-data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 has-data-readonly:bg-transparent';
const input = 'h-10 min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent px-4 text-sm text-ink placeholder:text-ink-placeholder focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const popup = 'border border-border-subtle-1 bg-layer-1 shadow-lg';
const note = 'text-xs text-ink-muted';

export default function Example() {
  const [start, setStart] = useState('');
  return (
    <DatePicker.Root id="start" name="start" value={start} onValueChange={setStart}>
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <label htmlFor="start" className={label}>Contract start</label>
        <DatePicker.Group className={group}>
          <DatePicker.Input placeholder="dd/mm/yyyy" className={input} />
        </DatePicker.Group>
        <p className={note}>Value: "{start}"</p>
      </div>
      <DatePicker.Popup aria-label="Choose date" className={popup}>
        <MonthGrid />
      </DatePicker.Popup>
    </DatePicker.Root>
  );
}

// The calendar parts. Each example on this page is a whole module, so each repeats this <MonthGrid />.
function MonthGrid({ children, ...props }: Readonly<Calendar.RootProps>) {
  const nav = 'grid size-10 place-items-center text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-ink-disabled focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus';
  return (
    <Calendar.Root className="w-72 p-2" {...props}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Calendar.PrevButton aria-label="Previous month" className={nav}>‹</Calendar.PrevButton>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-semibold text-ink">
          <Calendar.MonthName />
          <Calendar.YearInput aria-label="Year" className="h-7 w-16 bg-transparent px-1 hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus" />
        </div>
        <Calendar.NextButton aria-label="Next month" className={nav}>›</Calendar.NextButton>
      </div>
      <Calendar.Heading className="sr-only" />
      <Calendar.Grid className="w-full table-fixed border-collapse text-sm">
        <Calendar.GridHeader>{(d) => <Calendar.HeaderCell date={d} className="h-10 font-normal text-ink" />}</Calendar.GridHeader>
        <Calendar.GridBody>
          {(d) => (
            <Calendar.Cell date={d} className="p-0 text-center">
              <Calendar.Day className="h-10 w-full text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-outside-month:text-ink-muted data-today:font-semibold data-today:underline data-today:decoration-link data-today:underline-offset-4 data-in-range:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:bg-interactive data-selected:text-on-primary data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-disabled:line-through" />
            </Calendar.Cell>
          )}
        </Calendar.GridBody>
      </Calendar.Grid>
      {children}
    </Calendar.Root>
  );
}
```

`Root` calls `onValueChange` with the ISO string (`yyyy-mm-dd`, Gregorian year) whenever a committed date changes: a commit on blur or Enter (a full date typed is the value at once and is reported then), a pick, a clear. With `name`, a hidden input submits the same string. A `Calendar.Root` inside `Popup` takes the picker's state by itself.

## Anatomy

```tsx
<DatePicker.Root>
  <label />
  <DatePicker.Group>
    <DatePicker.Input />
    <DatePicker.NativeInput />
    <DatePicker.Clear />
    <DatePicker.Trigger />
  </DatePicker.Group>
  <DatePicker.Popup>
    <Calendar.Root>
      <Calendar.PrevButton />
      <Calendar.MonthName />
      <Calendar.YearInput />
      <Calendar.YearStep delta={1} />
      <Calendar.NextButton />
      <Calendar.Heading />
      <Calendar.Grid>
        <Calendar.GridHeader>{(d) => <Calendar.HeaderCell date={d} />}</Calendar.GridHeader>
        <Calendar.GridBody>
          {(d) => <Calendar.Cell date={d}><Calendar.Day /></Calendar.Cell>}
        </Calendar.GridBody>
      </Calendar.Grid>
      <Calendar.TodayButton />
    </Calendar.Root>
  </DatePicker.Popup>
</DatePicker.Root>
```

Keep the boxes, `Clear` and `Trigger` inside `Group`: focus and presses there don't count as leaving the picker. A range adds a second `<DatePicker.Input field="end" />`.

## Language, era and format

`Root` follows the page's language: without `locale` it uses `<html lang>`, else the browser's, so a Thai page gets Thai messages and month names. `locale` overrides it. For Thai, `era` defaults to `be` (พ.ศ.); set `era="ce"` for ค.ศ. `format` sets the order users see and type; `value` stays ISO.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Calendar, DatePicker } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const label = 'text-xs text-ink-muted';
const group = 'flex w-72 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 data-disabled:border-transparent has-data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 has-data-readonly:bg-transparent';
const input = 'h-10 min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent px-4 text-sm text-ink placeholder:text-ink-placeholder focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const popup = 'border border-border-subtle-1 bg-layer-1 shadow-lg';
const note = 'text-xs text-ink-muted';

export default function Example() {
  const [start, setStart] = useState('2026-10-10');
  const [due, setDue] = useState('2026-10-10');
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <DatePicker.Root id="th-start" locale="th" value={start} onValueChange={setStart}>
        <div className="grid gap-2">
          <label htmlFor="th-start" className={label}>วันที่เริ่มสัญญา</label>
          <DatePicker.Group className={group}>
            <DatePicker.Input placeholder="วว/ดด/ปปปป" className={input} />
          </DatePicker.Group>
          <p className={note}>Value: "{start}"</p>
        </div>
        <DatePicker.Popup aria-label="เลือกวันที่" className={popup}>
          <MonthGrid />
        </DatePicker.Popup>
      </DatePicker.Root>

      <DatePicker.Root id="due" format="yyyy-mm-dd" value={due} onValueChange={setDue}>
        <div className="grid gap-2">
          <label htmlFor="due" className={label}>Due date</label>
          <DatePicker.Group className={group}>
            <DatePicker.Input placeholder="yyyy-mm-dd" className={input} />
          </DatePicker.Group>
          <p className={note}>Value: "{due}"</p>
        </div>
        <DatePicker.Popup aria-label="Choose date" className={popup}>
          <MonthGrid />
        </DatePicker.Popup>
      </DatePicker.Root>
    </div>
  );
}

// MonthGrid: the calendar parts from "Use it".
function MonthGrid({ children, ...props }: Readonly<Calendar.RootProps>) {
  const nav = 'grid size-10 place-items-center text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-ink-disabled focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus';
  return (
    <Calendar.Root className="w-72 p-2" {...props}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Calendar.PrevButton aria-label="Previous month" className={nav}>‹</Calendar.PrevButton>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-semibold text-ink">
          <Calendar.MonthName />
          <Calendar.YearInput aria-label="Year" className="h-7 w-16 bg-transparent px-1 hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus" />
        </div>
        <Calendar.NextButton aria-label="Next month" className={nav}>›</Calendar.NextButton>
      </div>
      <Calendar.Heading className="sr-only" />
      <Calendar.Grid className="w-full table-fixed border-collapse text-sm">
        <Calendar.GridHeader>{(d) => <Calendar.HeaderCell date={d} className="h-10 font-normal text-ink" />}</Calendar.GridHeader>
        <Calendar.GridBody>
          {(d) => (
            <Calendar.Cell date={d} className="p-0 text-center">
              <Calendar.Day className="h-10 w-full text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-outside-month:text-ink-muted data-today:font-semibold data-today:underline data-today:decoration-link data-today:underline-offset-4 data-in-range:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:bg-interactive data-selected:text-on-primary data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-disabled:line-through" />
            </Calendar.Cell>
          )}
        </Calendar.GridBody>
      </Calendar.Grid>
      {children}
    </Calendar.Root>
  );
}
```

The placeholder is yours: write the format in the page's language.

## Pick a range

`range` gives two boxes sharing one calendar. The start box's id is `Root`'s `id`, the end box's `<id>-end`; point each `<label>` at them.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Calendar, DatePicker } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const label = 'text-xs text-ink-muted';
const note = 'text-xs text-ink-muted';
const popup = 'border border-border-subtle-1 bg-layer-1 shadow-lg';
const box = 'h-10 w-36 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-4 text-sm text-ink placeholder:text-ink-placeholder focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-open:border-interactive data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error';

export default function Example() {
  const [from, setFrom] = useState('');
  const [to, setTo] = useState('');
  return (
    <DatePicker.Root range id="stay" name="from" endName="to"
      value={from} onValueChange={setFrom} endValue={to} onEndValueChange={setTo}>
      <DatePicker.Group className="flex w-fit gap-px">
        <div className="grid gap-2">
          <label htmlFor="stay" className={label}>Check-in</label>
          <DatePicker.Input field="start" placeholder="dd/mm/yyyy" className={box} />
        </div>
        <div className="grid gap-2">
          <label htmlFor="stay-end" className={label}>Check-out</label>
          <DatePicker.Input field="end" placeholder="dd/mm/yyyy" className={box} />
        </div>
      </DatePicker.Group>
      <p className={`mt-2 ${note}`}>from: "{from}", to: "{to}"</p>
      <DatePicker.Popup aria-label="Choose date" className={popup}>
        <MonthGrid />
      </DatePicker.Popup>
    </DatePicker.Root>
  );
}

// MonthGrid: the calendar parts from "Use it".
function MonthGrid({ children, ...props }: Readonly<Calendar.RootProps>) {
  const nav = 'grid size-10 place-items-center text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-ink-disabled focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus';
  return (
    <Calendar.Root className="w-72 p-2" {...props}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Calendar.PrevButton aria-label="Previous month" className={nav}>‹</Calendar.PrevButton>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-semibold text-ink">
          <Calendar.MonthName />
          <Calendar.YearInput aria-label="Year" className="h-7 w-16 bg-transparent px-1 hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus" />
        </div>
        <Calendar.NextButton aria-label="Next month" className={nav}>›</Calendar.NextButton>
      </div>
      <Calendar.Heading className="sr-only" />
      <Calendar.Grid className="w-full table-fixed border-collapse text-sm">
        <Calendar.GridHeader>{(d) => <Calendar.HeaderCell date={d} className="h-10 font-normal text-ink" />}</Calendar.GridHeader>
        <Calendar.GridBody>
          {(d) => (
            <Calendar.Cell date={d} className="p-0 text-center">
              <Calendar.Day className="h-10 w-full text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-outside-month:text-ink-muted data-today:font-semibold data-today:underline data-today:decoration-link data-today:underline-offset-4 data-in-range:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:bg-interactive data-selected:text-on-primary data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-disabled:line-through" />
            </Calendar.Cell>
          )}
        </Calendar.GridBody>
      </Calendar.Grid>
      {children}
    </Calendar.Root>
  );
}
```

A pick for the start keeps the calendar open for the end, and the days in between get `data-in-range`. Picking an end before the start swaps the two.

## Limit the dates


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Calendar, DatePicker } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const label = 'text-xs text-ink-muted';
const group = 'flex w-72 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 data-disabled:border-transparent has-data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 has-data-readonly:bg-transparent';
const input = 'h-10 min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent px-4 text-sm text-ink placeholder:text-ink-placeholder focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const popup = 'border border-border-subtle-1 bg-layer-1 shadow-lg';

const weekend = (date: Date) =>
  date.getDay() === 0 || date.getDay() === 6 ? 'We don’t deliver at the weekend.' : false;

// The box's problem, once it shows (try a Saturday or a date in 2027).
function Problem({ id }: Readonly<{ id: string }>) {
  const { errors, showsError } = DatePicker.useDatePickerContext();
  return <p id={id} className="text-xs text-error-text">{showsError('start') ? errors.start : null}</p>;
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <DatePicker.Root id="delivery" min="2026-01-01" max="2026-12-31" isDateDisabled={weekend}>
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <label htmlFor="delivery" className={label}>Delivery date</label>
        <DatePicker.Group className={group}>
          <DatePicker.Input placeholder="dd/mm/yyyy" aria-describedby="delivery-problem" className={input} />
        </DatePicker.Group>
        <Problem id="delivery-problem" />
      </div>
      <DatePicker.Popup aria-label="Choose date" className={popup}>
        <MonthGrid />
      </DatePicker.Popup>
    </DatePicker.Root>
  );
}

// MonthGrid: the calendar parts from "Use it".
function MonthGrid({ children, ...props }: Readonly<Calendar.RootProps>) {
  const nav = 'grid size-10 place-items-center text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-ink-disabled focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus';
  return (
    <Calendar.Root className="w-72 p-2" {...props}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Calendar.PrevButton aria-label="Previous month" className={nav}>‹</Calendar.PrevButton>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-semibold text-ink">
          <Calendar.MonthName />
          <Calendar.YearInput aria-label="Year" className="h-7 w-16 bg-transparent px-1 hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus" />
        </div>
        <Calendar.NextButton aria-label="Next month" className={nav}>›</Calendar.NextButton>
      </div>
      <Calendar.Heading className="sr-only" />
      <Calendar.Grid className="w-full table-fixed border-collapse text-sm">
        <Calendar.GridHeader>{(d) => <Calendar.HeaderCell date={d} className="h-10 font-normal text-ink" />}</Calendar.GridHeader>
        <Calendar.GridBody>
          {(d) => (
            <Calendar.Cell date={d} className="p-0 text-center">
              <Calendar.Day className="h-10 w-full text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-outside-month:text-ink-muted data-today:font-semibold data-today:underline data-today:decoration-link data-today:underline-offset-4 data-in-range:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:bg-interactive data-selected:text-on-primary data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-disabled:line-through" />
            </Calendar.Cell>
          )}
        </Calendar.GridBody>
      </Calendar.Grid>
      {children}
    </Calendar.Root>
  );
}
```

Refused days get `data-disabled` and `aria-disabled`, and `PrevButton` / `NextButton` turn off at `min` / `max`. A refused date that is typed stays in the box with its problem, and the form won't submit.

## Clear button and Today

`Clear` empties its box and keeps focus there without opening the calendar. `Calendar.TodayButton` picks today. `firstDay` on the calendar sets the first day of the week (`0` Sunday … `6` Saturday).


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Calendar, DatePicker } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const label = 'text-xs text-ink-muted';
const group = 'flex w-72 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 data-disabled:border-transparent has-data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 has-data-readonly:bg-transparent';
const input = 'h-10 min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent px-4 text-sm text-ink placeholder:text-ink-placeholder focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const popup = 'border border-border-subtle-1 bg-layer-1 shadow-lg';
const note = 'text-xs text-ink-muted';

// × only while the box has text.
function ClearDate() {
  const { state } = DatePicker.useDatePickerContext();
  const look = 'grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center text-ink hover:bg-field-hover-1';
  return (
    <DatePicker.Clear aria-label="Clear date" className={state.text.start ? look : 'hidden'}>×</DatePicker.Clear>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  const [meeting, setMeeting] = useState('');
  return (
    <DatePicker.Root id="meeting" value={meeting} onValueChange={setMeeting}>
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <label htmlFor="meeting" className={label}>Meeting date</label>
        <DatePicker.Group className={group}>
          <DatePicker.Input placeholder="dd/mm/yyyy" className={input} />
          <ClearDate />
        </DatePicker.Group>
        <p className={note}>Value: "{meeting}"</p>
      </div>
      <DatePicker.Popup aria-label="Choose date" className={popup}>
        <MonthGrid firstDay={1}>
          <Calendar.TodayButton className="mt-1 h-10 w-full border-t border-hairline text-sm text-link hover:bg-layer-hover-1 disabled:text-ink-disabled focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
            Today
          </Calendar.TodayButton>
        </MonthGrid>
      </DatePicker.Popup>
    </DatePicker.Root>
  );
}

// MonthGrid: the calendar parts from "Use it".
function MonthGrid({ children, ...props }: Readonly<Calendar.RootProps>) {
  const nav = 'grid size-10 place-items-center text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-ink-disabled focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus';
  return (
    <Calendar.Root className="w-72 p-2" {...props}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Calendar.PrevButton aria-label="Previous month" className={nav}>‹</Calendar.PrevButton>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-semibold text-ink">
          <Calendar.MonthName />
          <Calendar.YearInput aria-label="Year" className="h-7 w-16 bg-transparent px-1 hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus" />
        </div>
        <Calendar.NextButton aria-label="Next month" className={nav}>›</Calendar.NextButton>
      </div>
      <Calendar.Heading className="sr-only" />
      <Calendar.Grid className="w-full table-fixed border-collapse text-sm">
        <Calendar.GridHeader>{(d) => <Calendar.HeaderCell date={d} className="h-10 font-normal text-ink" />}</Calendar.GridHeader>
        <Calendar.GridBody>
          {(d) => (
            <Calendar.Cell date={d} className="p-0 text-center">
              <Calendar.Day className="h-10 w-full text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-outside-month:text-ink-muted data-today:font-semibold data-today:underline data-today:decoration-link data-today:underline-offset-4 data-in-range:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:bg-interactive data-selected:text-on-primary data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-disabled:line-through" />
            </Calendar.Cell>
          )}
        </Calendar.GridBody>
      </Calendar.Grid>
      {children}
    </Calendar.Root>
  );
}
```

`Clear` is always rendered; hide it yourself while the box is empty if you want, as the example does with the context's `state.text`.

## Read-only and disabled

