`readOnly` keeps and submits the value but blocks typing and the calendar. `disabled` disables the boxes and `Trigger`; nothing is submitted or validated. `Clear` and `Trigger` are disabled in both.

## Phones and tablets

On a phone (a touch screen narrower than 42rem), `picker="auto"` (the default) opens the calendar in a bottom sheet: `Popup` renders inside a modal `<dialog data-sheet>` (the page behind inert and held still, focus kept inside). Esc, a `DatePicker.SheetClose`, a swipe down on a `DatePicker.SheetGrip` or a tap on the scrim closes it, and focus alone doesn't open it, so the box can still be typed in. Style the dialog with `sheetClassName` (its scrim with `backdrop:`) and the box on `data-sheet`; keep its padding clear of `env(safe-area-inset-*)`. `SheetGrip` and `SheetClose` render only in the sheet.

`picker="custom"` keeps the calendar under the box on phones, `picker="sheet"` uses the sheet everywhere, and `picker="native"` opens the OS date picker from a `DatePicker.NativeInput`: put one over each box, invisible and without pointer events.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Calendar, DatePicker } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const label = 'text-xs text-ink-muted';
const group = 'flex w-72 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 data-disabled:border-transparent has-data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 has-data-readonly:bg-transparent';
const input = 'h-10 min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent px-4 text-sm text-ink placeholder:text-ink-placeholder focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const popup = 'border border-border-subtle-1 bg-layer-1 shadow-lg';
const note = 'text-xs text-ink-muted';

export default function Example() {
  const [visit, setVisit] = useState('');
  return (
    <DatePicker.Root id="visit" value={visit} onValueChange={setVisit}>
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <label htmlFor="visit" className={label}>Visit date</label>
        <DatePicker.Group className={`relative ${group}`}>
          <DatePicker.Input placeholder="dd/mm/yyyy" className={input} />
          <DatePicker.NativeInput className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 opacity-0" />
        </DatePicker.Group>
        <p className={note}>Value: "{visit}"</p>
      </div>
      <DatePicker.Popup
        aria-label="Choose date"
        className={`${popup} data-sheet:w-full data-sheet:pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]`}
        sheetClassName="fixed inset-x-0 top-auto bottom-0 m-0 w-full max-w-none border-0 bg-transparent p-0 backdrop:bg-black/50"
      >
        <DatePicker.SheetGrip className="relative flex h-12 justify-center">
          <span aria-hidden="true" className="mt-2 h-1 w-8 rounded-full bg-icon-secondary" />
          <DatePicker.SheetClose aria-label="Close" className="absolute end-0 top-0 size-12 text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1">×</DatePicker.SheetClose>
        </DatePicker.SheetGrip>
        <MonthGrid />
      </DatePicker.Popup>
    </DatePicker.Root>
  );
}

// MonthGrid: the calendar parts from "Use it".
function MonthGrid({ children, ...props }: Readonly<Calendar.RootProps>) {
  const nav = 'grid size-10 place-items-center text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-ink-disabled focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus';
  return (
    <Calendar.Root className="w-72 p-2" {...props}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Calendar.PrevButton aria-label="Previous month" className={nav}>‹</Calendar.PrevButton>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-semibold text-ink">
          <Calendar.MonthName />
          <Calendar.YearInput aria-label="Year" className="h-7 w-16 bg-transparent px-1 hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus" />
        </div>
        <Calendar.NextButton aria-label="Next month" className={nav}>›</Calendar.NextButton>
      </div>
      <Calendar.Heading className="sr-only" />
      <Calendar.Grid className="w-full table-fixed border-collapse text-sm">
        <Calendar.GridHeader>{(d) => <Calendar.HeaderCell date={d} className="h-10 font-normal text-ink" />}</Calendar.GridHeader>
        <Calendar.GridBody>
          {(d) => (
            <Calendar.Cell date={d} className="p-0 text-center">
              <Calendar.Day className="h-10 w-full text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-outside-month:text-ink-muted data-today:font-semibold data-today:underline data-today:decoration-link data-today:underline-offset-4 data-in-range:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:bg-interactive data-selected:text-on-primary data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-disabled:line-through" />
            </Calendar.Cell>
          )}
        </Calendar.GridBody>
      </Calendar.Grid>
      {children}
    </Calendar.Root>
  );
}
```

On a phone the example above opens the bottom sheet; elsewhere, the calendar under the box. The OS picker (`picker="native"`) can't grey out `isDateDisabled` days, so its pick is checked like typed text.

## The calendar on its own

`Calendar.Root` works outside a picker too. On its own it holds the month shown and the chosen day; pass `value` or `focusDate` (with `onFocusDateChange`) to control them. `onPick` hears every pick.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Calendar } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<Date | null>(null);
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-2">
      <MonthGrid onPick={setPicked} className="w-72 border border-border-subtle-1 bg-layer-1 p-2">
        <Calendar.TodayButton className="mt-1 h-10 w-full border-t border-hairline text-sm text-link hover:bg-layer-hover-1 disabled:text-ink-disabled focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
          Today
        </Calendar.TodayButton>
      </MonthGrid>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Picked: {picked?.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { dateStyle: 'long' })}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

// MonthGrid: the calendar parts from "Use it".
function MonthGrid({ children, ...props }: Readonly<Calendar.RootProps>) {
  const nav = 'grid size-10 place-items-center text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-ink-disabled focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus';
  return (
    <Calendar.Root className="w-72 p-2" {...props}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Calendar.PrevButton aria-label="Previous month" className={nav}>‹</Calendar.PrevButton>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-semibold text-ink">
          <Calendar.MonthName />
          <Calendar.YearInput aria-label="Year" className="h-7 w-16 bg-transparent px-1 hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus" />
        </div>
        <Calendar.NextButton aria-label="Next month" className={nav}>›</Calendar.NextButton>
      </div>
      <Calendar.Heading className="sr-only" />
      <Calendar.Grid className="w-full table-fixed border-collapse text-sm">
        <Calendar.GridHeader>{(d) => <Calendar.HeaderCell date={d} className="h-10 font-normal text-ink" />}</Calendar.GridHeader>
        <Calendar.GridBody>
          {(d) => (
            <Calendar.Cell date={d} className="p-0 text-center">
              <Calendar.Day className="h-10 w-full text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-outside-month:text-ink-muted data-today:font-semibold data-today:underline data-today:decoration-link data-today:underline-offset-4 data-in-range:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:bg-interactive data-selected:text-on-primary data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-disabled:line-through" />
            </Calendar.Cell>
          )}
        </Calendar.GridBody>
      </Calendar.Grid>
      {children}
    </Calendar.Root>
  );
}
```

A range (`range`, `value`, `endValue`, `activeField`) is yours to hold on a calendar on its own. Its `era` defaults to `ce` whatever the `locale`: set `locale="th"` and `era="be"` for Thai.

## Style it

```tsx
import { Calendar, DatePicker } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Parts

### DatePicker.Root

Renders no element of its own: its children, plus an `<input type="hidden">` for `name` and one for `endName` (none while disabled).

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` | | The ISO date, controlled (the start in a range) |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | `''` | |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | | After the date changes |
| `range` | `boolean` | `false` | Two boxes, one calendar |
| `endValue` | `string` | | The end, controlled |
| `defaultEndValue` | `string` | `''` | |
| `onEndValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | | |
| `name` | `string` | | Submits the (start) date |
| `endName` | `string` | | Submits the end date |
| `min`, `max` | `string` | `''` | ISO dates |
| `isDateDisabled` | `(date: Date) => boolean \| string` | | Refuses a day; a string is its message |
| `format` | `'dd/mm/yyyy' \| 'mm/dd/yyyy' \| 'yyyy-mm-dd'` | `'dd/mm/yyyy'` | |
| `era` | `'be' \| 'ce'` | `'be'` for a Thai `locale`, else `'ce'` | |
| `locale` | `string` | `<html lang>`, else the browser's | Language of the messages and the calendar's names |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Forces the error state; the form won't submit |
| `invalidMessage` | `string` | `''` | With `invalid`: the form's validity message |
| `picker` | `'auto' \| 'custom' \| 'sheet' \| 'native'` | `'auto'` | `auto`: the calendar, in a bottom sheet on a phone; `custom`: under the box everywhere; `sheet`: the sheet everywhere; `native`: the OS picker |
| `id` | `string` | generated | The start box's id; the end box gets `<id>-end`, the popup `<id>-calendar` |

### DatePicker.Group

Renders a `<div>` around the boxes.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | The calendar is open |
| `data-disabled` | `disabled` |

### DatePicker.Input

Renders an `<input type="text" role="combobox">`. Its value, `disabled`, `readOnly` and `required` come from `Root`; its id from `Root`'s `id`.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `field` | `'start' \| 'end'` | `'start'` | Which date the box holds |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | The calendar is open and picks for this box |
| `data-invalid` | The box shows its error |
| `data-disabled` | `disabled` |
| `data-readonly` | `readOnly` |

### DatePicker.NativeInput

Renders an `<input type="date">` with `tabIndex={-1}` and `aria-hidden="true"`; its value, `min` and `max` come from `Root`.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `field` | `'start' \| 'end'` | `'start'` | Which date it picks |

### DatePicker.Clear

Renders a `<button type="button">` with `tabIndex={-1}`, disabled while `Root` is disabled or read-only.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `field` | `'start' \| 'end'` | `'start'` | Which box it empties |

### DatePicker.Trigger

Renders a `<button type="button">` with `tabIndex={-1}`, `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and `aria-expanded`. It opens the calendar with focus in the grid, or closes it, and is disabled while `Root` is disabled or read-only.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | The calendar is open |

### DatePicker.Popup

Renders a `<div role="dialog" popover="manual">` in the top layer, under the start box (above it when there's no room below). Its children render only while it is open. In the bottom sheet it renders the same `<div>`, without `popover` and `role`, inside a modal `<dialog data-sheet>` that takes `aria-label`.

| Prop | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `sheetClassName`, `sheetStyle` | `string`, `CSSProperties` | The bottom sheet's `<dialog>` |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | Open |
| `data-side` | Where it ended up: `bottom` or `top` |
| `data-sheet` | In the bottom sheet (on the `<dialog>` and the box) |

### DatePicker.SheetGrip

Renders a `<div>` with `touch-action: none` in the bottom sheet only: a swipe down on it closes the sheet (64px, or a flick), shorter it springs back. While a finger drags it, the dialog has `data-dragging` and a `translate`. Put a grip mark and a `SheetClose` in it.

### DatePicker.SheetClose

Renders a `<button type="button">` in the bottom sheet only; it closes the sheet like Esc. Give it an `aria-label`.

## Calendar parts

### Calendar.Root

Renders a `<div>`. Inside a `DatePicker.Popup` it takes the picker's value, range, focus, limits, `locale` and `era`; a prop you pass still wins.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` | | The chosen day, ISO, controlled (the start in a range) |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | `''` | The first chosen day (single date) |
| `endValue` | `string` | `''` | The range's end |
| `range` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `activeField` | `'start' \| 'end'` | `'start'` | Which end a pick sets (drives the preview) |
| `focusDate` | `Date` | | The day with the tab stop, whose month shows (controlled) |
| `defaultFocusDate` | `Date` | the value, else today | |
| `onFocusDateChange` | `(date: Date) => void` | | |
| `onPick` | `(date: Date) => void` | | An available day was picked |
| `min`, `max` | `string` | `''` | |
| `isDateDisabled` | `(date: Date) => boolean \| string` | | |
| `locale` | `string` | `<html lang>`, else the browser's | BCP 47 locale for the names |
| `era` | `'be' \| 'ce'` | `'be'` for a Thai `locale`, else `'ce'` | |
| `firstDay` | `number` | `0` | `0` Sunday … `6` Saturday |
| `handle` | `Ref<CalendarHandle>` | | `focusDay()` moves focus to the tab-stop day |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-range` | `range` |

### Calendar.PrevButton, Calendar.NextButton

Each renders a `<button type="button">` that shows the month before or after. It is disabled when that whole month lies outside `min` / `max`.

### Calendar.MonthName

Renders a `<span aria-hidden="true">` with the month's name; children replace it.

### Calendar.Heading

Renders a `<div aria-live="polite">` with the month and year. It names the grid, so keep it (hide it visually if you like); children replace the text.

### Calendar.YearInput

Renders an `<input type="number">` with the year shown, in the calendar's era. A typed four-digit year shows that year; leaving the box puts the shown year back.

### Calendar.YearStep

Renders a `<button type="button">` with `tabIndex={-1}` that steps the shown year. It is disabled past the years `min` / `max` allow.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `delta` | `number` | | Years to step, e.g. `1` or `-1` (required) |

### Calendar.Grid

Renders a `<table role="grid">` named by `Heading`. It handles the keys.

### Calendar.GridHeader, Calendar.HeaderCell

`GridHeader` renders a `<thead>` with one row and calls its `children` function for each weekday. `HeaderCell` renders a `<th scope="col">` with the short weekday name and the full one as `abbr`.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` (GridHeader) | `(date: Date) => ReactNode` | | Renders one weekday (required) |
| `date` (HeaderCell) | `Date` | | The weekday (required) |

### Calendar.GridBody, Calendar.Cell

`GridBody` renders a `<tbody>` with six weeks and calls its `children` function for each day. `Cell` renders a `<td role="gridcell" aria-selected>`.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` (GridBody) | `(date: Date) => ReactNode` | | Renders one day (required) |
| `date` (Cell) | `Date` | | The day (required) |

### Calendar.Day

Renders a `<button type="button">` with the day's number (children replace it). It goes inside a `Cell`. Only the tab-stop day has `tabIndex={0}`.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-selected` | The chosen day (either end of a range) |
| `data-today` | Today |
| `data-outside-month` | A day of the month before or after |
| `data-disabled` | Refused: outside `min` / `max`, or by `isDateDisabled` |
| `data-in-range` | Between the range's start and its end (chosen or previewed) |
| `data-range-start` | The range's start |
| `data-range-end` | The range's end, chosen or previewed |

### Calendar.TodayButton

Renders a `<button type="button">` that picks today. It is disabled when today is refused.

### Hooks

`DatePicker.useDatePickerContext()` inside `Root` gives the picker's state: `state` (text, values, open), `problems`, `errors` (the messages in `locale`'s words) and `showsError(field)`. `Calendar.useCalendarContext()` gives the month shown and its names; `Calendar.useCellContext()` inside a `Cell` gives that day's state as values.

## Keyboard and accessibility

In the box:

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Typing | Enters the date; Thai digits become 0–9 |
| ↓ | Opens the calendar and moves focus into it |
| Tab | With the calendar open: moves into it |
| Shift + Tab | From the start box: closes the calendar |
| Enter | Commits the typed text, closes the calendar; the form's own Enter submit follows |
| Esc | Closes the calendar |

In the calendar grid:

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| ← / → | Previous / next day |
| ↑ / ↓ | Same day of the previous / next week |
| Home / End | First / last day of the week |
| Page Up / Page Down | Previous / next month |
| Shift + Page Up / Page Down | Previous / next year |
| Enter, Space | Picks the day; in a picker the calendar closes (in a range, after the end) |
| Esc | Closes, focus back in the box |
| Tab | In a range, from the start: to the end box. Otherwise focus goes back to the box, the calendar closes and Tab carries on |
| Shift + Tab | Back to the box |

The parts handle:

- `role="combobox"`, `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and `aria-invalid` on each box; `role="dialog"` on `Popup`.
- A grid of day buttons with one roving tab stop. Each day is named by its full date, with `aria-current="date"` on today, `aria-pressed` on chosen days and `aria-disabled` on refused ones.
- The month change, announced by `Heading`.
- The form's validation: the first wrong box carries the message, the browser's bubble is suppressed, and a blocked submit moves focus to that box.

You add:

- A `<label htmlFor>` for each box, and an `aria-label` on `Popup` ("Choose date"), `PrevButton`, `NextButton`, `YearInput`, `YearStep`, `Clear` and `Trigger`.
- The error text and the format hint, linked to the box with `aria-describedby`:


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Calendar, DatePicker } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const label = 'text-xs text-ink-muted';
const group = 'flex w-72 items-center border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 data-disabled:border-transparent has-data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 has-data-readonly:bg-transparent';
const input = 'h-10 min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent px-4 text-sm text-ink placeholder:text-ink-placeholder focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const popup = 'border border-border-subtle-1 bg-layer-1 shadow-lg';
const note = 'text-xs text-ink-muted';

function DateError({ id }: Readonly<{ id: string }>) {
  const { errors, showsError } = DatePicker.useDatePickerContext();
  return <p id={id} className="text-xs text-error-text">{showsError('start') ? errors.start : null}</p>;
}

export default function Example() {
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<Record<string, FormDataEntryValue>>();
  return (
    <form
      className="grid gap-4"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSent(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.currentTarget)));
      }}
    >
      <DatePicker.Root id="contract-start" name="start" required>
        <div className="grid gap-2">
          <label htmlFor="contract-start" className={label}>Contract start</label>
          <DatePicker.Group className={group}>
            <DatePicker.Input aria-describedby="contract-start-error" placeholder="dd/mm/yyyy" className={input} />
          </DatePicker.Group>
          <DateError id="contract-start-error" />
        </div>
        <DatePicker.Popup aria-label="Choose date" className={popup}>
          <MonthGrid />
        </DatePicker.Popup>
      </DatePicker.Root>
      <button type="submit" className="h-10 w-fit bg-primary px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus">
        Send
      </button>
      {sent && <p className={note}>Sent: {JSON.stringify(sent)}</p>}
    </form>
  );
}

// MonthGrid: the calendar parts from "Use it".
function MonthGrid({ children, ...props }: Readonly<Calendar.RootProps>) {
  const nav = 'grid size-10 place-items-center text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:text-ink-disabled focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus';
  return (
    <Calendar.Root className="w-72 p-2" {...props}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Calendar.PrevButton aria-label="Previous month" className={nav}>‹</Calendar.PrevButton>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-semibold text-ink">
          <Calendar.MonthName />
          <Calendar.YearInput aria-label="Year" className="h-7 w-16 bg-transparent px-1 hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus" />
        </div>
        <Calendar.NextButton aria-label="Next month" className={nav}>›</Calendar.NextButton>
      </div>
      <Calendar.Heading className="sr-only" />
      <Calendar.Grid className="w-full table-fixed border-collapse text-sm">
        <Calendar.GridHeader>{(d) => <Calendar.HeaderCell date={d} className="h-10 font-normal text-ink" />}</Calendar.GridHeader>
        <Calendar.GridBody>
          {(d) => (
            <Calendar.Cell date={d} className="p-0 text-center">
              <Calendar.Day className="h-10 w-full text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-outside-month:text-ink-muted data-today:font-semibold data-today:underline data-today:decoration-link data-today:underline-offset-4 data-in-range:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:bg-interactive data-selected:text-on-primary data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-disabled:line-through" />
            </Calendar.Cell>
          )}
        </Calendar.GridBody>
      </Calendar.Grid>
      {children}
    </Calendar.Root>
  );
}
```

# Headless Time picker

`TimePicker` gives you the time picker's behaviour with no classes: a short text box for `hh:mm` that takes part in the form's own validation through `pattern`, and native selects beside it for AM / PM or the time zone. `Root` passes `disabled`, `readOnly` and `invalid` to every part; a read-only select still takes focus but doesn't open or change.

You own the label, the error text, the layout and every style. Validation is yours too, as in Carbon React: set `invalid` when your check fails. The styled version is [Time picker](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/time-picker/).

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { TimePicker } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { TimePicker } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const label = 'text-xs text-ink-muted';
const input = 'h-10 w-24 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-4 text-sm text-ink placeholder:text-ink-placeholder focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:border-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 data-readonly:bg-transparent';
const select = 'h-10 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-2 text-sm text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:border-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 data-readonly:bg-transparent';
const button = 'h-10 w-fit bg-primary px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus';

export default function Example() {
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<Record<string, FormDataEntryValue>>();
  return (
    <form
      className="grid gap-4"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSent(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.currentTarget)));
      }}
    >
      <TimePicker.Root>
        <div className="grid gap-2">
          <label htmlFor="time" className={label}>Start time</label>
          <div className="flex gap-0.5">
            <TimePicker.Input id="time" name="time" placeholder="hh:mm" className={input} />
            <TimePicker.Select aria-label="AM or PM" name="period" className={select}>
              <option value="AM">AM</option>
              <option value="PM">PM</option>
            </TimePicker.Select>
            <TimePicker.Select aria-label="Time zone" name="zone" className={select}>
              <option value="ict">Bangkok (ICT)</option>
              <option value="utc">UTC</option>
            </TimePicker.Select>
          </div>
        </div>
      </TimePicker.Root>
      <button type="submit" className={button}>Send</button>
      {sent && <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Sent: {JSON.stringify(sent)}</p>}
    </form>
  );
}
```

Each part submits on its own under its `name`: the time as typed, and each select's `<option>` value. Nothing is converted.

## Anatomy

```tsx
<TimePicker.Root>
  <label />
  <TimePicker.Input />
  <TimePicker.Select />
</TimePicker.Root>
```

A `Select` also works on its own, outside a `Root`.

## 12-hour or 24-hour

`Input` takes 12-hour time by default: `h:mm` or `hh:mm`, at most 5 characters (`TimePicker.TWELVE_HOUR_PATTERN`). For 24-hour time, set your own `pattern` and leave out the AM / PM select:


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { TimePicker } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const label = 'text-xs text-ink-muted';
const input = 'h-10 w-24 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-4 text-sm text-ink placeholder:text-ink-placeholder focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:border-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 data-readonly:bg-transparent';
const button = 'h-10 w-fit bg-primary px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus';

export default function Example() {
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<Record<string, FormDataEntryValue>>();
  // Send 7:5 or 25:00: the browser stops the form at the pattern.
  return (
    <form
      className="grid gap-4"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSent(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.currentTarget)));
      }}
    >
      <TimePicker.Root>
        <div className="grid gap-2">
          <label htmlFor="departure" className={label}>Departure</label>
          <TimePicker.Input id="departure" name="departure" placeholder="hh:mm" pattern="([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]" className={input} />
        </div>
      </TimePicker.Root>
      <button type="submit" className={button}>Send</button>
      {sent && <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Sent: {JSON.stringify(sent)}</p>}
    </form>
  );
}
```

`maxLength` changes the length limit.

## Errors

`pattern` takes part in the form's validation, but no message shows by itself. Set `invalid` on `Root` when your check fails: the box gets `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid`. The message is your markup; link it with `aria-describedby`.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { TimePicker } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const label = 'text-xs text-ink-muted';
const input = 'h-10 w-24 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-4 text-sm text-ink placeholder:text-ink-placeholder focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:border-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 data-readonly:bg-transparent';

// Your own check: the shop closes at 12:00.
function afterClosing(time: string) {
  const [hours, minutes] = time.split(':').map(Number);
  return hours * 60 + minutes > 12 * 60;
}

export default function Example() {
  const [pickup, setPickup] = useState('13:30');
  const late = afterClosing(pickup);
  return (
    <TimePicker.Root invalid={late}>
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <label htmlFor="pickup" className={label}>Pick-up</label>
        <TimePicker.Input
          id="pickup"
          value={pickup}
          onChange={(e) => setPickup(e.target.value)}
          pattern="([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]"
          aria-describedby="pickup-error"
          className={input}
        />
        <p id="pickup-error" className="text-xs text-error-text">{late ? 'The shop closes at 12:00.' : ''}</p>
      </div>
    </TimePicker.Root>
  );
}
```

There is no warning state; a warning is your markup too.

## Read-only and disabled


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { TimePicker } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const input = 'h-10 w-24 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-4 text-sm text-ink placeholder:text-ink-placeholder focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:border-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 data-readonly:bg-transparent';
const select = 'h-10 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-2 text-sm text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:border-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 data-readonly:bg-transparent';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <TimePicker.Root readOnly>
        <div className="grid gap-2">
          <label htmlFor="start" className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Start time</label>
          <div className="flex gap-0.5">
            <TimePicker.Input id="start" defaultValue="9:30" className={input} />
            <TimePicker.Select aria-label="AM or PM" className={select}>
              <option value="AM">AM</option>
              <option value="PM">PM</option>
            </TimePicker.Select>
          </div>
        </div>
      </TimePicker.Root>

      <TimePicker.Root disabled>
        <div className="grid gap-2">
          <label htmlFor="end" className="text-xs text-ink-disabled">End time</label>
          <div className="flex gap-0.5">
            <TimePicker.Input id="end" defaultValue="5:00" className={input} />
            <TimePicker.Select aria-label="AM or PM" defaultValue="PM" className={select}>
              <option value="AM">AM</option>
              <option value="PM">PM</option>
            </TimePicker.Select>
          </div>
        </div>
      </TimePicker.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`readOnly` keeps every value and submits it: the box is read-only, and a select takes focus but doesn't open or change (`aria-readonly`). `disabled` disables the box and every select.

## Style it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { TimePicker } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  const [invalid, setInvalid] = useState(true);
  const [disabled, setDisabled] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <TimePicker.Root invalid={invalid} disabled={disabled}>
        <div className="flex gap-0.5">
          <TimePicker.Input aria-label="Time" defaultValue="13:30" className="h-10 w-24 bg-field-1 px-4 text-sm text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:text-ink-disabled" />
          <TimePicker.Select aria-label="AM or PM" className="h-10 bg-field-1 px-2 text-sm text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-readonly:bg-transparent">
            <option value="AM">AM</option>
            <option value="PM">PM</option>
          </TimePicker.Select>
        </div>
      </TimePicker.Root>
      <div className="flex gap-4 text-sm text-ink">
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={invalid} onChange={(e) => setInvalid(e.target.checked)} /> invalid
        </label>
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={disabled} onChange={(e) => setDisabled(e.target.checked)} /> disabled
        </label>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
```css
.time-input[data-invalid] { outline: 2px solid #da1e28; }
.time-input[data-disabled],
.time-select[data-disabled] { color: #c6c6c6; }
.time-select[data-readonly] { background: transparent; }
```

## Parts

### TimePicker.Root

Renders no element: it holds `disabled`, `readOnly` and `invalid` for its parts.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the box and every select |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps every value |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the box `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid` |

### TimePicker.Input

Renders an `<input type="text" autocomplete="off">`. Its `disabled` and `readOnly` come from `Root`.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pattern` | `string` | `TWELVE_HOUR_PATTERN` | 12-hour `h:mm` / `hh:mm`, an optional space after |
| `maxLength` | `number` | `5` | |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-invalid` | `invalid` on `Root` |
| `data-disabled` | `disabled` on `Root` |
| `data-readonly` | `readOnly` on `Root` |

### TimePicker.Select

Renders a native `<select>`. It is disabled with `Root` or by its own `disabled`.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-disabled` | Disabled |
| `data-readonly` | `readOnly` on `Root` |

`TimePicker.useTimePickerContext()` inside `Root` gives `disabled`, `readOnly` and `invalid`.

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Enter (in the box) | Submits the form it's in, as a native input does |
| ↑ / ↓, Space, Enter (on a select) | The browser's own select keys; ignored while read-only |

The parts handle:

- Native elements throughout: a text input and `<select>`s.
- `aria-invalid` on the box while `invalid`, and `aria-readonly` on a read-only select.
- A read-only select keeps focus on a mouse press without opening its list.

You add:

- A `<label htmlFor>` for the box, and an `aria-label` for each select (nothing names them for you).
- The error text, linked to the box with `aria-describedby`.

# Headless Slider

`Slider` gives you the slider's behaviour with no classes: one thumb, or two for a range. Each thumb is a `role="slider"` Tab stop that moves with the arrow keys; a press on the track moves the nearer thumb and starts a drag that follows the pointer anywhere on the page. A number box beside the track applies typed numbers, and a hidden input submits each value.

You own the markup, the end labels, the messages and every style, including where the thumbs sit: `Control` gives you the positions as CSS variables. The styled version is [Slider](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/slider/).

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { Slider } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Slider } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const label = 'text-xs text-ink-muted data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const box = 'h-10 w-16 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-2 text-center text-sm text-ink [appearance:textfield] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:border-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 data-readonly:bg-transparent';

export default function Example() {
  const [volume, setVolume] = useState(50);
  const [committed, setCommitted] = useState(50);
  return (
    <Slider.Root value={[volume]} onValueChange={([v]) => setVolume(v)} onValueCommit={([v]) => setCommitted(v)}>
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <Slider.Label className={label}>Volume</Slider.Label>
        <Slider.Group className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Rails />
          <Slider.Input aria-label="Volume" className={box} />
        </Slider.Group>
        <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">onValueChange: {volume} · onValueCommit: {committed}</p>
      </div>
      <Slider.HiddenInput name="volume" />
    </Slider.Root>
  );
}

// The track and thumbs. Each example on this page is a whole module, so each repeats this <Rails />.
function Rails({ range = false }: Readonly<{ range?: boolean }>) {
  const thumb = 'absolute top-2.5 size-3.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-layer-selected-inverse hover:scale-125 focus-visible:bg-interactive focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-dragging:scale-125 data-disabled:bg-border-disabled data-disabled:hover:scale-100';
  return (
    <Slider.Control className="relative h-8 w-64 cursor-pointer touch-none data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-readonly:cursor-default">
      <Slider.Track className="absolute inset-x-0 top-4 h-0.5 bg-hairline data-disabled:bg-border-disabled" />
      <Slider.Indicator className="absolute top-4 h-0.5 bg-layer-selected-inverse start-[calc(var(--slider-range-start)*100%)] end-[calc((1-var(--slider-range-end))*100%)] data-invalid:bg-error data-disabled:bg-border-disabled" />
      {range && <Slider.Thumb index={0} aria-label="Lower bound" className={`${thumb} start-[calc(var(--slider-range-start)*100%)]`} />}
      <Slider.Thumb index={range ? 1 : 0} aria-label={range ? 'Upper bound' : undefined} className={`${thumb} start-[calc(var(--slider-range-end)*100%)]`} />
    </Slider.Control>
  );
}
```

Values are arrays, one entry per thumb: `[value]`, or `[lower, upper]`. `onValueChange` follows every change (dragging, keys, typing); `onValueCommit` hears the committed ones: the pointer released, a key handled, a number box committed. An entry of `value` left `undefined` keeps that thumb uncontrolled.

## Anatomy

```tsx
<Slider.Root>
  <Slider.Label />
  <Slider.Group>
    <Slider.Input index={0} />
    <Slider.Control>
      <Slider.Track />
      <Slider.Indicator />
      <Slider.Thumb index={0} />
      <Slider.Thumb index={1} />
    </Slider.Control>
    <Slider.Input index={1} />
  </Slider.Group>
  <Slider.HiddenInput index={0} />
  <Slider.HiddenInput index={1} />
</Slider.Root>
```

With one thumb, leave out the parts with `index={1}`.

## Scale and step

`min` and `max` set the ends (0 and 100) and `step` the increment (1). Arrow keys move one step; with Shift they move `stepMultiplier` steps (4). The end labels are your markup.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Slider } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const label = 'text-xs text-ink-muted data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const box = 'h-10 w-16 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-2 text-center text-sm text-ink [appearance:textfield] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:border-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 data-readonly:bg-transparent';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Slider.Root min={0} max={50} step={5} defaultValue={[10]}>
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <Slider.Label className={label}>Discount</Slider.Label>
        <Slider.Group className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm text-ink">
          <span>0%</span>
          <Rails />
          <span>50%</span>
          <Slider.Input aria-label="Discount" className={box} />
        </Slider.Group>
      </div>
    </Slider.Root>
  );
}

// Rails: the track and thumbs from "Use it".
function Rails({ range = false }: Readonly<{ range?: boolean }>) {
  const thumb = 'absolute top-2.5 size-3.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-layer-selected-inverse hover:scale-125 focus-visible:bg-interactive focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-dragging:scale-125 data-disabled:bg-border-disabled data-disabled:hover:scale-100';
  return (
    <Slider.Control className="relative h-8 w-64 cursor-pointer touch-none data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-readonly:cursor-default">
      <Slider.Track className="absolute inset-x-0 top-4 h-0.5 bg-hairline data-disabled:bg-border-disabled" />
      <Slider.Indicator className="absolute top-4 h-0.5 bg-layer-selected-inverse start-[calc(var(--slider-range-start)*100%)] end-[calc((1-var(--slider-range-end))*100%)] data-invalid:bg-error data-disabled:bg-border-disabled" />
      {range && <Slider.Thumb index={0} aria-label="Lower bound" className={`${thumb} start-[calc(var(--slider-range-start)*100%)]`} />}
      <Slider.Thumb index={range ? 1 : 0} aria-label={range ? 'Upper bound' : undefined} className={`${thumb} start-[calc(var(--slider-range-end)*100%)]`} />
    </Slider.Control>
  );
}
```

For a formatted value, give the thumb `aria-valuetext` (say, `"10%"`); screen readers read it instead of the number.

## Two thumbs: a range

Give two values and two thumbs. The thumbs never pass each other: each one's bounds stop at the other, and a press on the track moves the nearer one.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Slider } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const label = 'text-xs text-ink-muted data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const box = 'h-10 w-16 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-2 text-center text-sm text-ink [appearance:textfield] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:border-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 data-readonly:bg-transparent';

export default function Example() {
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<Record<string, FormDataEntryValue>>();
  return (
    <form
      className="grid gap-4"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSent(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(e.currentTarget)));
      }}
    >
      <Slider.Root min={0} max={1000} step={10} defaultValue={[200, 600]}>
        <div className="grid gap-2">
          <Slider.Label className={label}>Price</Slider.Label>
          <Slider.Group className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Slider.Input index={0} aria-label="Lower bound" className={box} />
            <Rails range />
            <Slider.Input index={1} aria-label="Upper bound" className={box} />
          </Slider.Group>
        </div>
        <Slider.HiddenInput index={0} name="min-price" />
        <Slider.HiddenInput index={1} name="max-price" />
      </Slider.Root>
      <button type="submit" className="h-10 w-fit bg-primary px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus">
        Send
      </button>
      {sent && <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Sent: {JSON.stringify(sent)}</p>}
    </form>
  );
}

// Rails: the track and thumbs from "Use it".
function Rails({ range = false }: Readonly<{ range?: boolean }>) {
  const thumb = 'absolute top-2.5 size-3.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-layer-selected-inverse hover:scale-125 focus-visible:bg-interactive focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-dragging:scale-125 data-disabled:bg-border-disabled data-disabled:hover:scale-100';
  return (
    <Slider.Control className="relative h-8 w-64 cursor-pointer touch-none data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-readonly:cursor-default">
      <Slider.Track className="absolute inset-x-0 top-4 h-0.5 bg-hairline data-disabled:bg-border-disabled" />
      <Slider.Indicator className="absolute top-4 h-0.5 bg-layer-selected-inverse start-[calc(var(--slider-range-start)*100%)] end-[calc((1-var(--slider-range-end))*100%)] data-invalid:bg-error data-disabled:bg-border-disabled" />
      {range && <Slider.Thumb index={0} aria-label="Lower bound" className={`${thumb} start-[calc(var(--slider-range-start)*100%)]`} />}
      <Slider.Thumb index={range ? 1 : 0} aria-label={range ? 'Upper bound' : undefined} className={`${thumb} start-[calc(var(--slider-range-end)*100%)]`} />
    </Slider.Control>
  );
}
```

## The number box

`Input` mirrors its thumb's value. A number within its bounds applies while typing, snapped to the nearest step. On blur or Enter, a number outside the bounds is clamped, and text that isn't a number makes the slider invalid. The context's `corrected` holds the typed number after a clamp, for you to announce:


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Slider } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const label = 'text-xs text-ink-muted data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const box = 'h-10 w-16 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-2 text-center text-sm text-ink [appearance:textfield] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:border-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 data-readonly:bg-transparent';

function Corrected() {
  const { corrected } = Slider.useSliderContext();
  return (
    <span role="status" className="text-xs text-ink-muted">
      {corrected === undefined ? '' : `${corrected} was corrected.`}
    </span>
  );
}

// Type 250 or "abc" in the box, then press Enter.
export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Slider.Root min={0} max={200} defaultValue={[120]}>
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <Slider.Label className={label}>Width (px)</Slider.Label>
        <Slider.Group className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Rails />
          <Slider.Input aria-label="Width" className={box} />
        </Slider.Group>
        <Corrected />
      </div>
    </Slider.Root>
  );
}

// Rails: the track and thumbs from "Use it".
function Rails({ range = false }: Readonly<{ range?: boolean }>) {
  const thumb = 'absolute top-2.5 size-3.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-layer-selected-inverse hover:scale-125 focus-visible:bg-interactive focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-dragging:scale-125 data-disabled:bg-border-disabled data-disabled:hover:scale-100';
  return (
    <Slider.Control className="relative h-8 w-64 cursor-pointer touch-none data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-readonly:cursor-default">
      <Slider.Track className="absolute inset-x-0 top-4 h-0.5 bg-hairline data-disabled:bg-border-disabled" />
      <Slider.Indicator className="absolute top-4 h-0.5 bg-layer-selected-inverse start-[calc(var(--slider-range-start)*100%)] end-[calc((1-var(--slider-range-end))*100%)] data-invalid:bg-error data-disabled:bg-border-disabled" />
      {range && <Slider.Thumb index={0} aria-label="Lower bound" className={`${thumb} start-[calc(var(--slider-range-start)*100%)]`} />}
      <Slider.Thumb index={range ? 1 : 0} aria-label={range ? 'Upper bound' : undefined} className={`${thumb} start-[calc(var(--slider-range-end)*100%)]`} />
    </Slider.Control>
  );
}
```

Without a number box, leave out `Slider.Input`. A value tooltip on the thumb, if you want one, is your markup:


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Slider } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

// Rails with a tooltip: the thumb shows its value from the context.
function TooltipRails() {
  const { values } = Slider.useSliderContext();
  return (
    <Slider.Control className="relative mt-8 h-8 w-64 cursor-pointer touch-none">
      <Slider.Track className="absolute inset-x-0 top-4 h-0.5 bg-hairline" />
      <Slider.Indicator className="absolute top-4 h-0.5 bg-layer-selected-inverse start-0 end-[calc((1-var(--slider-range-end))*100%)]" />
      <Slider.Thumb aria-valuetext={`${values[0]}%`} className="group absolute top-2.5 size-3.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-layer-selected-inverse start-[calc(var(--slider-range-end)*100%)] focus-visible:bg-interactive focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
        <span className="absolute bottom-full left-1/2 mb-2 hidden -translate-x-1/2 bg-inverse-canvas px-2 py-1 text-xs whitespace-nowrap text-inverse-ink group-hover:block group-focus-visible:block group-data-dragging:block">
          {values[0]}%
        </span>
      </Slider.Thumb>
    </Slider.Control>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Slider.Root defaultValue={[70]}>
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <Slider.Label className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Brightness</Slider.Label>
        <Slider.Group>
          <TooltipRails />
        </Slider.Group>
      </div>
    </Slider.Root>
  );
}
```

## Errors and warnings

`invalid` on `Root` shows the error: `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid` on the thumbs and the boxes, and `data-invalid` on `Group`, `Control`, `Track` and `Indicator`. A disabled or read-only slider shows no error. There is no warning state: a warning is your markup.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Slider } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const label = 'text-xs text-ink-muted data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const box = 'h-10 w-16 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-2 text-center text-sm text-ink [appearance:textfield] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:border-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 data-readonly:bg-transparent';

export default function Example() {
  const [size, setSize] = useState(18);
  const tooMany = size > 15;
  return (
    <Slider.Root min={1} max={20} value={[size]} onValueChange={([v]) => setSize(v)} invalid={tooMany}>
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        <Slider.Label className={label}>Team size</Slider.Label>
        <Slider.Group className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Rails />
          <Slider.Input aria-label="Team size" aria-describedby="team-size-error" className={box} />
        </Slider.Group>
        <p id="team-size-error" className="text-xs text-error-text">{tooMany ? 'Rooms hold 15 people.' : ''}</p>
      </div>
    </Slider.Root>
  );
}

// Rails: the track and thumbs from "Use it".
function Rails({ range = false }: Readonly<{ range?: boolean }>) {
  const thumb = 'absolute top-2.5 size-3.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-layer-selected-inverse hover:scale-125 focus-visible:bg-interactive focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-dragging:scale-125 data-disabled:bg-border-disabled data-disabled:hover:scale-100';
  return (
    <Slider.Control className="relative h-8 w-64 cursor-pointer touch-none data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-readonly:cursor-default">
      <Slider.Track className="absolute inset-x-0 top-4 h-0.5 bg-hairline data-disabled:bg-border-disabled" />
      <Slider.Indicator className="absolute top-4 h-0.5 bg-layer-selected-inverse start-[calc(var(--slider-range-start)*100%)] end-[calc((1-var(--slider-range-end))*100%)] data-invalid:bg-error data-disabled:bg-border-disabled" />
      {range && <Slider.Thumb index={0} aria-label="Lower bound" className={`${thumb} start-[calc(var(--slider-range-start)*100%)]`} />}
      <Slider.Thumb index={range ? 1 : 0} aria-label={range ? 'Upper bound' : undefined} className={`${thumb} start-[calc(var(--slider-range-end)*100%)]`} />
    </Slider.Control>
  );
}
```

## Read-only and disabled


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Slider } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const label = 'text-xs text-ink-muted data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const box = 'h-10 w-16 border-b border-border-strong-1 bg-field-1 px-2 text-center text-sm text-ink [appearance:textfield] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error data-disabled:border-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-readonly:border-border-subtle-1 data-readonly:bg-transparent';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <Slider.Root defaultValue={[30]} readOnly>
        <div className="grid gap-2">
          <Slider.Label className={label}>Limit</Slider.Label>
          <Slider.Group className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Rails />
            <Slider.Input aria-label="Limit" className={box} />
          </Slider.Group>
        </div>
      </Slider.Root>

      <Slider.Root defaultValue={[60]} disabled>
        <div className="grid gap-2">
          <Slider.Label className={label}>Overdraft</Slider.Label>
          <Slider.Group className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Rails />
            <Slider.Input aria-label="Overdraft" className={box} />
          </Slider.Group>
        </div>
      </Slider.Root>
    </div>
  );
}

// Rails: the track and thumbs from "Use it".
function Rails({ range = false }: Readonly<{ range?: boolean }>) {
  const thumb = 'absolute top-2.5 size-3.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-layer-selected-inverse hover:scale-125 focus-visible:bg-interactive focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-dragging:scale-125 data-disabled:bg-border-disabled data-disabled:hover:scale-100';
  return (
    <Slider.Control className="relative h-8 w-64 cursor-pointer touch-none data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-readonly:cursor-default">
      <Slider.Track className="absolute inset-x-0 top-4 h-0.5 bg-hairline data-disabled:bg-border-disabled" />
      <Slider.Indicator className="absolute top-4 h-0.5 bg-layer-selected-inverse start-[calc(var(--slider-range-start)*100%)] end-[calc((1-var(--slider-range-end))*100%)] data-invalid:bg-error data-disabled:bg-border-disabled" />
      {range && <Slider.Thumb index={0} aria-label="Lower bound" className={`${thumb} start-[calc(var(--slider-range-start)*100%)]`} />}
      <Slider.Thumb index={range ? 1 : 0} aria-label={range ? 'Upper bound' : undefined} className={`${thumb} start-[calc(var(--slider-range-end)*100%)]`} />
    </Slider.Control>
  );
}
```

`readOnly` keeps the values and submits them; nothing moves and the boxes can't be edited. A read-only thumb leaves the Tab order unless you give it `tabIndex={0}`. `disabled` changes nothing either, and `HiddenInput` submits nothing.

An uncontrolled slider goes back to `defaultValue` when its form is reset.

## Style it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Slider } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  const [invalid, setInvalid] = useState(false);
  const [disabled, setDisabled] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <Slider.Root defaultValue={[40]} invalid={invalid} disabled={disabled}>
        <Slider.Label className="sr-only">Opacity</Slider.Label>
        <Slider.Group>
          <Slider.Control className="relative h-8 w-64">
            <Slider.Track className="absolute inset-x-0 top-4 h-0.5 bg-hairline" />
            <Slider.Indicator className="absolute top-4 h-0.5 bg-layer-selected-inverse start-[calc(var(--slider-range-start)*100%)] end-[calc((1-var(--slider-range-end))*100%)] data-invalid:bg-error data-disabled:bg-border-disabled" />
            <Slider.Thumb className="absolute top-2.5 size-3.5 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-layer-selected-inverse start-[calc(var(--slider-range-end)*100%)] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-dragging:scale-125 data-disabled:bg-border-disabled" />
          </Slider.Control>
        </Slider.Group>
      </Slider.Root>
      <div className="flex gap-4 text-sm text-ink">
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={invalid} onChange={(e) => setInvalid(e.target.checked)} /> invalid
        </label>
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={disabled} onChange={(e) => setDisabled(e.target.checked)} /> disabled
        </label>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
```css
.slider-control { position: relative; height: 2rem; }
.slider-indicator {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: calc(var(--slider-range-start) * 100%);
  inset-inline-end: calc((1 - var(--slider-range-end)) * 100%);
}
.slider-indicator[data-invalid] { background: #da1e28; }
.slider-thumb {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline-start: calc(var(--slider-range-end) * 100%);
  translate: -50% 0;
}
.slider-thumb[data-dragging] { scale: 1.25; }
.slider-thumb[data-disabled] { background: #c6c6c6; }
```

`--slider-range-start` is where the filled part starts (0 with one thumb) and `--slider-range-end` where it ends, as 0…1 of the track. Place the lower thumb at the start and the upper (or only) thumb at the end.

## Parts

### Slider.Root

Renders no element: it holds the values for its parts.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `readonly (number \| undefined)[]` | | One entry per thumb, controlled; an `undefined` entry keeps that thumb uncontrolled |
| `defaultValue` | `readonly number[]` | `[min]` | |
| `onValueChange` | `(values: number[]) => void` | | Every change |
| `onValueCommit` | `(values: number[]) => void` | | Committed changes: pointer released, a key, a box committed |
| `min` | `number` | `0` | |
| `max` | `number` | `100` | |
| `step` | `number` | `1` | |
| `stepMultiplier` | `number` | `4` | Shift + arrow moves `step × stepMultiplier` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the values; thumbs leave the Tab order |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows the error |

### Slider.Label

Renders a `<label>` that names the group and the thumbs. A click on it focuses the first thumb. Its `htmlFor` defaults to the first thumb's id.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-disabled` | `disabled` |

### Slider.Group, Slider.Control, Slider.Track, Slider.Indicator

Each renders a `<div>`. `Group` is a `role="group"` named by `Label`, around the track, your end labels and the boxes. `Control` is the pointer area: a press there moves the nearer thumb (or the one pressed) and starts a drag. It sets `--slider-range-start` and `--slider-range-end`. `Track` is the rail and `Indicator` the filled part.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-disabled` | `disabled` |
| `data-readonly` | `readOnly` |
| `data-invalid` | The error shows |
| `data-dragging` | A thumb is being dragged |
| `data-orientation` | Always `horizontal` (`Group` and `Control` only) |

### Slider.Thumb

Renders a `<div role="slider">` with `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and `aria-valuenow`, named by `Label` unless you give it `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `index` | `number` | `0` | Which value it moves |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-index` | Always: its `index` |
| `data-disabled` | `disabled` |
| `data-readonly` | `readOnly` |
| `data-invalid` | The error shows |
| `data-dragging` | This thumb is being dragged |

### Slider.Input

Renders an `<input type="number">` whose `min` / `max` are the thumb's bounds and whose `step` is `Root`'s.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `index` | `number` | `0` | Which value it edits |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-index` | Always: its `index` |
| `data-disabled` | `disabled` |
| `data-readonly` | `readOnly` |
| `data-invalid` | The error shows |

### Slider.HiddenInput

Renders an `<input type="hidden">` with the value; give it a `name`. It is disabled (submits nothing) while `Root` is disabled.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `index` | `number` | `0` | Which value it submits |

`Slider.useSliderContext()` inside `Root` gives `values`, `dragging`, `invalid`, `notANumber`, `corrected` and the rest of the state.

## Keyboard and accessibility

On a thumb:

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| ← / ↓ | One step down |
| → / ↑ | One step up |
| Shift + arrow | `stepMultiplier` steps |
| Home / End | To `min` / `max` (in a range, as far as the other thumb allows) |

In a number box, Enter commits the typed number.

The parts handle:

- `role="slider"` with `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and `aria-valuenow` on each thumb; in a range each thumb's bounds stop at the other.
- `aria-disabled`, `aria-readonly` and `aria-invalid` on the thumbs; `aria-invalid` on the boxes.
- A `role="group"` named by `Label`; a click on the label focuses the first thumb.
- Focus moves to the thumb a press on the track moved.

You add:

- An `aria-label` for each thumb in a range ("Lower bound", "Upper bound") and for each number box.
- `aria-valuetext` for a formatted value.
- The error message (link it with `aria-describedby`) and the announcement of a clamped number.


---

# Headless File uploader

`FileUploader` gives you the file uploader's behaviour with no classes: a `Trigger` that opens the file dialog, a `DropZone` that takes dropped files (not folders), the limits on type, size and count, the list of chosen files, focus that moves on as rows go, and the valid files submitted with the form.

You own the rows, the icons, the messages, the progress bar and every style. Nothing uploads by itself: you send the files and update their status. The styled version is [File uploader](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/file-uploader/).

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { FileUploader } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { FileUploader } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const button = 'h-10 w-fit bg-primary px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-button-disabled disabled:text-on-color-disabled';

export default function Example() {
  const [change, setChange] = useState<FileUploader.FileChange>();
  return (
    <FileUploader.Root name="attachments" multiple onChange={setChange}>
      <div className="grid gap-4">
        <FileUploader.Group aria-label="Attachments">
          <FileUploader.DropZone>
            <FileUploader.Trigger className={button}>Add file</FileUploader.Trigger>
            <FileUploader.Label hidden>Attachments</FileUploader.Label>
            <FileUploader.Input hidden />
            <FileUploader.FormValue />
          </FileUploader.DropZone>
        </FileUploader.Group>
        <Files />
        {change && (
          <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">
            onChange: {change.action}, currentFiles: {change.currentFiles.length}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </FileUploader.Root>
  );
}

// The rows. Each example on this page is a whole module, so the ones with a list repeat this <Files />.
function Files() {
  const { files, remove } = FileUploader.useFileUploaderContext();
  return (
    <FileUploader.List className="grid w-80 gap-2">
      {files.map((f) => (
        <FileUploader.Item
          key={f.uuid}
          uuid={f.uuid}
          name={f.name}
          status={f.status}
          invalid={f.invalid}
          onDelete={remove}
          className="group bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error"
        >
          <FileUploader.ItemRow className="flex min-h-12 items-center ps-4">
            <span className="flex-1 truncate">{f.name}</span>
            <FileUploader.Remove
              aria-label={`Remove file - ${f.name}`}
              className="hidden size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus group-data-removable:grid"
            >
              ×
            </FileUploader.Remove>
          </FileUploader.ItemRow>
          {f.errorSubject && <p role="alert" className="border-t border-hairline px-4 py-2 text-xs text-error-text">{f.errorSubject}</p>}
        </FileUploader.Item>
      ))}
    </FileUploader.List>
  );
}
```

- Each file is a `FileItem`: `uuid`, `name`, the `File` itself, and its `status`, `invalid`, `errorSubject`, `errorBody`, `progress` and `retryable`.
- `Root` calls `onAdd` right after a pick (refused files included), before the list updates (as Carbon's `onAddFiles`), `onChange` with `addedFiles`, `removedFiles`, `currentFiles` and `action` (`add`, `remove` or `clear`), and `onDelete` when a file is removed.
- Without `multiple`, a new pick replaces the list.

## Anatomy

```tsx
<FileUploader.Root>
  <FileUploader.Group>
    <FileUploader.Title />
    <FileUploader.DropZone>
      <FileUploader.Trigger />
      <FileUploader.Label />
      <FileUploader.Input />
    </FileUploader.DropZone>
    <FileUploader.FormValue />
  </FileUploader.Group>
  <FileUploader.List>
    <FileUploader.Item>
      <FileUploader.ItemRow>
        <FileUploader.Retry />
        <FileUploader.Remove />
        <FileUploader.ItemStatus />
      </FileUploader.ItemRow>
    </FileUploader.Item>
  </FileUploader.List>
</FileUploader.Root>
```

## Button or drop zone

`DropZone` takes files dropped on it; `Trigger` is your button, or the whole zone. `openOnKeyDown` opens the dialog on the Enter / Space key press itself, as Carbon's drop container does.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { FileUploader } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

// The names of the last pick or drop, from the context.
function Picked() {
  const { picked } = FileUploader.useFileUploaderContext();
  return <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">picked: {picked.join(', ')}</p>;
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <FileUploader.Root multiple>
      <div className="grid gap-4">
        <FileUploader.DropZone className="w-80 border border-dashed border-border-strong-1 data-drag-over:border-interactive data-drag-over:bg-layer-selected-1">
          <FileUploader.Trigger openOnKeyDown className="w-full p-4 text-start text-sm text-link focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
            Drop the files or click to choose them
          </FileUploader.Trigger>
          <FileUploader.Label hidden>Floor plans</FileUploader.Label>
          <FileUploader.Input hidden />
        </FileUploader.DropZone>
        <Picked />
        <Files />
      </div>
    </FileUploader.Root>
  );
}

// Files: the rows from "Use it".
function Files() {
  const { files, remove } = FileUploader.useFileUploaderContext();
  return (
    <FileUploader.List className="grid w-80 gap-2">
      {files.map((f) => (
        <FileUploader.Item
          key={f.uuid}
          uuid={f.uuid}
          name={f.name}
          status={f.status}
          invalid={f.invalid}
          onDelete={remove}
          className="group bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error"
        >
          <FileUploader.ItemRow className="flex min-h-12 items-center ps-4">
            <span className="flex-1 truncate">{f.name}</span>
            <FileUploader.Remove
              aria-label={`Remove file - ${f.name}`}
              className="hidden size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus group-data-removable:grid"
            >
              ×
            </FileUploader.Remove>
          </FileUploader.ItemRow>
          {f.errorSubject && <p role="alert" className="border-t border-hairline px-4 py-2 text-xs text-error-text">{f.errorSubject}</p>}
        </FileUploader.Item>
      ))}
    </FileUploader.List>
  );
}
```

`Trigger`'s `render` prop renders your own button (a styled one, say) with the props it would put on its `<button>`. The context's `picked` holds the names of the last pick, if your button should show the file name or "3 files".

## Limit the files

`accept`, `maxFileSize`, `maxFiles` and `maxTotalSize` mark refused files invalid. A refused file stays in the list but isn't submitted. `describeRejection` gives its error text from the reason: `'invalid-type'`, `'too-large'`, `'too-many'` or `'total-too-large'`. Without it, a refused file has no error text.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { FileUploader } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const button = 'h-10 w-fit bg-primary px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-button-disabled disabled:text-on-color-disabled';

const describeRejection = (rejection: FileUploader.Rejection) => ({
  errorSubject: rejection === 'invalid-type' ? 'Only JPG or PNG photos' : `File refused (${rejection})`,
});

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <FileUploader.Root accept=".jpg,.png" maxFileSize={2_000_000} maxFiles={2} multiple describeRejection={describeRejection}>
      <div className="grid gap-4">
        <FileUploader.Group aria-label="Photos">
          <FileUploader.DropZone>
            <FileUploader.Trigger className={button}>Add photos</FileUploader.Trigger>
            <FileUploader.Label hidden>Photos</FileUploader.Label>
            <FileUploader.Input hidden />
          </FileUploader.DropZone>
        </FileUploader.Group>
        <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">JPG or PNG, up to 2 MB each, at most 2 photos.</p>
        <Files />
      </div>
    </FileUploader.Root>
  );
}

// Files: the rows from "Use it".
function Files() {
  const { files, remove } = FileUploader.useFileUploaderContext();
  return (
    <FileUploader.List className="grid w-80 gap-2">
      {files.map((f) => (
        <FileUploader.Item
          key={f.uuid}
          uuid={f.uuid}
          name={f.name}
          status={f.status}
          invalid={f.invalid}
          onDelete={remove}
          className="group bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error"
        >
          <FileUploader.ItemRow className="flex min-h-12 items-center ps-4">
            <span className="flex-1 truncate">{f.name}</span>
            <FileUploader.Remove
              aria-label={`Remove file - ${f.name}`}
              className="hidden size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus group-data-removable:grid"
            >
              ×
            </FileUploader.Remove>
          </FileUploader.ItemRow>
          {f.errorSubject && <p role="alert" className="border-t border-hairline px-4 py-2 text-xs text-error-text">{f.errorSubject}</p>}
        </FileUploader.Item>
      ))}
    </FileUploader.List>
  );
}
```

`accept` also filters the file dialog, and a dropped file is checked against it too.

## Upload the files

Hold the list yourself with `files` and replace it as each upload moves on. Pass `progress` and `retryable` on to each `Item`. The example sends nothing: a timer stands in for the uploads, and a file over 1 MB fails once so you can retry it.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { FileUploader } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

type FileItem = FileUploader.FileItem;

const button = 'h-10 w-fit bg-primary px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-button-disabled disabled:text-on-color-disabled';
const icon = 'size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus';

// No server here: a pretend upload moves 10% a tick, and a file over 1 MB fails at 60% the first time.
function tick(f: FileItem, retried: ReadonlySet<string>): FileItem {
  if (f.status !== 'uploading') return f;
  const progress = Math.min(100, (f.progress ?? 0) + 10);
  if (progress === 60 && f.file.size > 1_000_000 && !retried.has(f.uuid)) {
    return { ...f, status: 'edit', invalid: true, retryable: true, errorSubject: 'Upload failed', errorBody: 'Check your connection and try again.' };
  }
  return progress === 100 ? { ...f, status: 'complete', progress } : { ...f, progress };
}

function UploadList() {
  const { files, remove, retry } = FileUploader.useFileUploaderContext();
  return (
    <FileUploader.List className="grid w-80 gap-2">
      {files.map((f) => (
        <FileUploader.Item
          key={f.uuid}
          uuid={f.uuid}
          name={f.name}
          status={f.status}
          invalid={f.invalid}
          retryable={f.retryable}
          progress={f.progress}
          onDelete={remove}
          onRetry={retry}
          className="group bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error"
        >
          <FileUploader.ItemRow className="flex min-h-12 items-center ps-4">
            <span className="flex-1 truncate">{f.name}</span>
            {f.status === 'complete' && <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-12 place-items-center text-success">✓</span>}
            <FileUploader.Retry aria-label={`Retry upload - ${f.name}`} className={`grid ${icon}`}>↻</FileUploader.Retry>
            <FileUploader.Remove aria-label={`Remove file - ${f.name}`} className={`hidden group-data-removable:grid ${icon}`}>×</FileUploader.Remove>
            <FileUploader.ItemStatus className="sr-only">Uploaded: {f.name}</FileUploader.ItemStatus>
          </FileUploader.ItemRow>
          {f.status === 'uploading' && (
            <div role="progressbar" aria-label={`Uploading ${f.name}`} aria-valuenow={f.progress} className="h-0.5 bg-border-subtle-1">
              <div className="h-full bg-interactive" style={{ width: `${f.progress ?? 0}%` }} />
            </div>
          )}
          {f.invalid && (
            <div role="alert" className="border-t border-hairline px-4 py-2 text-xs">
              <p className="text-error-text">{f.errorSubject}</p>
              <p className="text-ink-muted">{f.errorBody}</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </FileUploader.Item>
      ))}
    </FileUploader.List>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<FileItem[]>([]);
  const [deleted, setDeleted] = useState('');
  const retried = useRef(new Set<string>());
  const update = (uuid: string, changes: Partial<FileItem>) =>
    setFiles((list) => list.map((f) => (f.uuid === uuid ? { ...f, ...changes } : f)));
  const upload = (item: FileItem) =>
    update(item.uuid, { status: 'uploading', progress: 0, invalid: false, retryable: false, errorSubject: undefined, errorBody: undefined });

  // The pretend uploads move on while any file is uploading; a removed file simply leaves the list.
  const uploading = files.some((f) => f.status === 'uploading');
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!uploading) return;
    const timer = setInterval(() => setFiles((list) => list.map((f) => tick(f, retried.current))), 300);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [uploading]);

  return (
    <FileUploader.Root
      multiple
      files={files}
      onChange={(change) => {
        setFiles(change.currentFiles);
        if (change.action === 'add') change.addedFiles.filter((f) => !f.invalid).forEach(upload);
      }}
      onRetry={(item) => {
        retried.current.add(item.uuid);
        upload(item);
      }}
      onDelete={({ deletedFile }) => setDeleted(`${deletedFile.name} (${deletedFile.status})`)}
    >
      <div className="grid gap-4">
        <FileUploader.Group aria-label="Attachments">
          <FileUploader.DropZone>
            <FileUploader.Trigger className={button}>Add file</FileUploader.Trigger>
            <FileUploader.Label hidden>Attachments</FileUploader.Label>
            <FileUploader.Input hidden />
          </FileUploader.DropZone>
        </FileUploader.Group>
        <UploadList />
        {deleted && <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">onDelete: {deleted}</p>}
      </div>
    </FileUploader.Root>
  );
}
```

- `status` on `Root` sets the state new files start in (`edit` by default).
- An `uploading` item with a `progress` can be removed: that cancels the upload, and `onDelete` tells you to stop sending it.
- `onRetry` hears the retry of a failed upload (an `invalid`, `retryable` file). Refused files aren't retryable.

## File states

The state shows as `data-status`, `data-invalid` and `data-removable` on the `Item`. An `Item` also works on its own, for files already on the server: it calls `onDelete` and `onRetry` with its `uuid` (its `name` when you leave `uuid` out), and removing it is up to you.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { FileUploader } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const icon = 'size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus';
const name = 'inspection-report.pdf';

export default function Example() {
  // A file already on the server: failed → uploading (no progress, so no ×) → complete.
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<'failed' | 'uploading' | 'complete' | 'removed'>('failed');
  useEffect(() => {
    if (stage !== 'uploading') return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setStage('complete'), 1500);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [stage]);

  if (stage === 'removed') {
    return (
```
