```tsx
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setStage('failed')} className="text-sm text-link hover:underline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
        Removed. Put it back
      </button>
    );
  }
  const failed = stage === 'failed';
  return (
    <div className="grid w-80 gap-2">
      <FileUploader.Item
        name={name}
        status={failed ? 'edit' : stage}
        invalid={failed}
        retryable
        onDelete={() => setStage('removed')}
        onRetry={() => setStage('uploading')}
        className="group bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error"
      >
        <FileUploader.ItemRow className="flex min-h-12 items-center ps-4">
          <span className="flex-1 truncate">{name}</span>
          {failed && <span role="alert" className="pe-2 text-xs text-error-text">Upload failed</span>}
          {stage === 'complete' && <span aria-hidden="true" className="grid size-12 place-items-center text-success">✓</span>}
          <FileUploader.Retry aria-label={`Retry upload - ${name}`} className={`grid ${icon}`}>↻</FileUploader.Retry>
          <FileUploader.Remove aria-label={`Remove file - ${name}`} className={`hidden group-data-removable:grid ${icon}`}>×</FileUploader.Remove>
          <FileUploader.ItemStatus className="sr-only">Uploaded: {name}</FileUploader.ItemStatus>
        </FileUploader.ItemRow>
      </FileUploader.Item>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">stage: {stage}</p>
      {stage === 'complete' && (
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setStage('failed')} className="w-fit text-sm text-link hover:underline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
          Start again
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

- `edit` can be removed; `uploading` can be removed only with a `progress`; `complete` can't. `Remove` renders nothing on a row that can't be removed, and is disabled with the item.
- `Retry` renders only on an `invalid`, `retryable` row.
- `ItemStatus` shows its children once an upload goes from `uploading` to `complete`.

## In a form


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { FileUploader } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const button = 'h-10 w-fit bg-primary px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-button-disabled disabled:text-on-color-disabled';

const onlyPdf = () => ({ errorSubject: 'Only PDF files' });

export default function Example() {
  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<string[]>();
  return (
    <form
      className="grid gap-4"
      onSubmit={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setSent(new FormData(e.currentTarget).getAll('contract').map((v) => (typeof v === 'string' ? v : v.name)));
      }}
      onReset={() => {
        setSent(undefined);
        setMissing(false);
      }}
    >
      <FileUploader.Root name="contract" accept=".pdf" required requiredText="Attach the signed contract" describeRejection={onlyPdf} onChange={() => setMissing(false)}>
        <FileUploader.Group aria-label="Signed contract" className="grid gap-2">
          <FileUploader.DropZone>
            <FileUploader.Trigger className={button}>Add file</FileUploader.Trigger>
            <FileUploader.Label hidden>Signed contract</FileUploader.Label>
            {/* The browser shows no bubble: show your own message when the form is blocked. */}
            <FileUploader.Input hidden onInvalid={() => setMissing(true)} />
          </FileUploader.DropZone>
          {missing && <p className="text-xs text-error-text">Attach the signed contract</p>}
          <FileUploader.FormValue />
        </FileUploader.Group>
        <Files />
      </FileUploader.Root>
      <div className="flex gap-px">
        <button type="submit" className={button}>Send</button>
        <button type="reset" className="h-10 bg-secondary px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-secondary-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus">
          Reset
        </button>
      </div>
      {sent && <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Sent: {JSON.stringify(sent)}</p>}
    </form>
  );
}

// Files: the rows from "Use it".
function Files() {
  const { files, remove } = FileUploader.useFileUploaderContext();
  return (
    <FileUploader.List className="grid w-80 gap-2">
      {files.map((f) => (
        <FileUploader.Item
          key={f.uuid}
          uuid={f.uuid}
          name={f.name}
          status={f.status}
          invalid={f.invalid}
          onDelete={remove}
          className="group bg-layer-1 text-sm text-ink data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error"
        >
          <FileUploader.ItemRow className="flex min-h-12 items-center ps-4">
            <span className="flex-1 truncate">{f.name}</span>
            <FileUploader.Remove
              aria-label={`Remove file - ${f.name}`}
              className="hidden size-12 shrink-0 place-items-center hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus group-data-removable:grid"
            >
              ×
            </FileUploader.Remove>
          </FileUploader.ItemRow>
          {f.errorSubject && <p role="alert" className="border-t border-hairline px-4 py-2 text-xs text-error-text">{f.errorSubject}</p>}
        </FileUploader.Item>
      ))}
    </FileUploader.List>
  );
}
```

- With a `name`, `FormValue` submits every valid file under it, like `<input type="file" multiple>`. Refused files are left out.
- `required` blocks the submit until there is a valid file, with `requiredText` as the message (without one, the English translation's: "Add at least one file."). The browser's bubble doesn't show; focus goes to `Trigger`. The example shows its own message from `Input`'s `onInvalid`.
- A form reset empties an uncontrolled list. `disabled` turns off `Trigger`, `DropZone`, `Input`, `FormValue` and every `Item` inside the `Root`.

## Style it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { FileUploader } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

function StyledFiles() {
  const { files, remove } = FileUploader.useFileUploaderContext();
  return (
    <FileUploader.List className="grid w-80 gap-2">
      {files.map(({ uuid, name, status, invalid }) => (
        <FileUploader.Item key={uuid} uuid={uuid} name={name} status={status} invalid={invalid} onDelete={remove}
          className="group flex min-h-12 items-center bg-layer-1 ps-4 text-sm text-ink data-invalid:outline-2 data-invalid:-outline-offset-2 data-invalid:outline-error">
          <FileUploader.ItemRow className="flex flex-1 items-center">
            <span className="flex-1 truncate">{name}</span>
            <FileUploader.Remove className="hidden size-12 place-items-center hover:bg-layer-hover-1 group-data-removable:grid" aria-label={`Remove file - ${name}`}>×</FileUploader.Remove>
          </FileUploader.ItemRow>
        </FileUploader.Item>
      ))}
    </FileUploader.List>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  const [disabled, setDisabled] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <FileUploader.Root multiple accept=".pdf" disabled={disabled}>
        <FileUploader.DropZone className="w-80 border border-dashed border-border-strong-1 p-4 data-drag-over:border-interactive data-disabled:opacity-50">
          <FileUploader.Trigger className="text-sm text-link focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus disabled:cursor-not-allowed">
            Drop PDF files here or click
          </FileUploader.Trigger>
          <FileUploader.Label hidden>Documents</FileUploader.Label>
          <FileUploader.Input hidden />
        </FileUploader.DropZone>
        <StyledFiles />
      </FileUploader.Root>
      <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink">
        <input type="checkbox" checked={disabled} onChange={(e) => setDisabled(e.target.checked)} /> disabled
      </label>
    </div>
  );
}
```
```css
.drop-zone { border: 1px dashed #8d8d8d; }
.drop-zone[data-drag-over] { border-color: #0f62fe; }
.drop-zone[data-disabled] { opacity: 0.5; }
[data-file-item][data-invalid] { outline: 2px solid #da1e28; }
[data-file-item]:not([data-removable]) [data-file-remove] { display: none; }
```

## Parts

### FileUploader.Root

Renders no element: it holds the list, the limits and the focus rules.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accept` | `string` | `''` | Extensions and MIME types, comma-separated |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` | Without it, a pick replaces the list |
| `maxFileSize` | `number` | `0` | Bytes; larger files are added as invalid (0 = no limit) |
| `maxFiles` | `number` | `0` | Most valid files; the ones past it are invalid (0 = no limit) |
| `maxTotalSize` | `number` | `0` | Bytes the valid files may add up to (0 = no limit) |
| `describeRejection` | `(rejection: Rejection) => { errorSubject?: string; errorBody?: string }` | | The error text of a refused file |
| `name` | `string` | | Submitted name of `FormValue` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `status` | `'edit' \| 'uploading' \| 'complete'` | `'edit'` | The state new files start in |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | At least one valid file before the form submits |
| `requiredText` | `string` | `''` | The validity message while `required` and no valid file; empty: the English translation's |
| `files` | `FileItem[]` | | The list, controlled |
| `defaultFiles` | `FileItem[]` | `[]` | |
| `onAdd` | `(addedFiles: FileItem[]) => void` | | Right after a pick or drop |
| `onChange` | `(change: FileChange) => void` | | Every change of the list |
| `onDelete` | `({ deletedFile, remainingFiles }) => void` | | A file was removed |
| `onRetry` | `(retriedFile: FileItem) => void` | | A failed upload was retried |

### FileUploader.Group

Renders a `<div role="group">`; name it with `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby` with the context's `titleId`.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-disabled` | `disabled` |

### FileUploader.Title

Renders a `<p>` whose id is the context's `titleId`.

### FileUploader.DropZone

Renders a `<div>` that takes dropped files. Folders are skipped.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-drag-over` | Files are dragged over it |
| `data-disabled` | `disabled` |

### FileUploader.Trigger

Renders a `<button type="button">` that opens the file dialog; disabled while `disabled`. Focus comes back to it when the list empties under it.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `openOnKeyDown` | `boolean` | `false` | Enter / Space open the dialog on key down |
| `render` | `(props) => ReactElement` | | Renders your own button with these props |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-drag-over` | Files are dragged over the drop zone |
| `data-disabled` | `disabled` |

### FileUploader.Label, FileUploader.Input

`Label` renders a `<label>` for `Input`; hide it visually. `Input` renders the `<input type="file">` that `Trigger` clicks, with `tabIndex={-1}`; its `multiple`, `accept` and `disabled` come from `Root`. Hide it.

### FileUploader.FormValue

With `Root`'s `name`, renders a hidden `<input type="file" multiple>` that holds every valid file. Renders nothing without a `name`.

### FileUploader.List

Renders a `<div>` around the items; focus moves within it as rows go.

### FileUploader.Item

Renders a `<div>` for one file.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | | The file's name (required) |
| `uuid` | `string` | `name` | Identifies it in `onDelete` / `onRetry` |
| `status` | `'edit' \| 'uploading' \| 'complete'` | `'edit'` | |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `retryable` | `boolean` | `false` | On an invalid row: `Retry` shows |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Also on while its `Root` is disabled |
| `progress` | `number` | | 0–100 while uploading; `Remove` then cancels |
| `onDelete` | `(uuid: string) => void` | | |
| `onRetry` | `(uuid: string) => void` | | |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-file-item` | Always |
| `data-status` | Always: `edit`, `uploading` or `complete` |
| `data-invalid` | `invalid` |
| `data-removable` | The file can be removed: `edit`, or `uploading` with a `progress`, and not disabled |

### FileUploader.ItemRow

Renders a `<div>` with `aria-disabled` while the item is disabled. Focus lands on it when its last button goes with focus.

### FileUploader.Remove

Renders a `<button type="button">` that removes the file (`onDelete`), or cancels its upload; disabled with the item. Renders nothing on a `complete` row or one `uploading` without a `progress`.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-file-remove` | Always |

### FileUploader.Retry

Renders a `<button type="button">` that retries a failed upload (`onRetry`), only on an `invalid`, `retryable` row; disabled with the item.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-file-retry` | Always |

### FileUploader.ItemStatus

Renders a `<span role="status">`: its children show once the upload finished.

`FileUploader.useFileUploaderContext()` inside `Root` gives `files`, `picked`, `dragOver`, `titleId`, `remove`, `retry`, `browse` and more. `FileUploader.useItemContext()` inside an `Item` gives its `status`, `percent` (the progress while uploading) and `finished`.

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Enter or Space on `Trigger` | Opens the file dialog |
| Enter or Space on `Remove` | Removes the file, or cancels its upload; focus moves to the next row's `Remove`, else the previous one's, else `Trigger` |
| Enter or Space on `Retry` | Calls `onRetry`; when the button goes away, focus stays on the row's `Remove`, else the row |

The parts handle:

- `role="group"` and `aria-disabled` on `Group`; the file input labelled by `Label` and out of the Tab order.
- Focus after a row or a retry button goes, so it never falls to the page.
- `required`: the form's validity, with no browser bubble, and focus on `Trigger` when the submit is blocked.
- A polite live region in `ItemStatus`.

You add:

- A name for `Group` and the text of `Label`.
- An `aria-label` on each `Remove` and `Retry` with the file's name: "Remove file - contract.pdf", "Retry upload - contract.pdf".
- The error text (an alert, as `role="alert"`), the `ItemStatus` text, and a progress bar if you show one.


---

# Headless Tabs

`Tabs` is the behaviour of the styled [Tabs](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/tabs/) as unstyled React parts: one Tab stop on the strip (a roving tabindex), the arrow keys, Home and End, automatic or manual activation, Delete and close buttons for dismissable tabs, and the `tablist` / `tab` / `tabpanel` roles with their ids wired together. State shows as `data-*` attributes to style on.

You own the markup and every style: the underline or the contained look, the sizes, the icons, the scroll buttons of a long strip, and the layout of a vertical column.

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { Tabs } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Tabs } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const tab =
  'h-10 cursor-pointer border-0 border-b-2 border-solid border-hairline bg-transparent px-4 text-sm text-ink-muted hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-selected:border-border-interactive data-selected:font-semibold data-selected:text-ink data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const panel = 'p-4 text-sm text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Tabs.Root>
      <Tabs.List aria-label="Contract details" className="flex gap-px">
        <Tabs.Tab value="overview" className={tab}>Overview</Tabs.Tab>
        <Tabs.Tab value="parties" className={tab}>Parties</Tabs.Tab>
        <Tabs.Tab value="history" className={tab}>History</Tabs.Tab>
        <Tabs.Tab value="archive" disabled className={tab}>Archive</Tabs.Tab>
      </Tabs.List>
      <Tabs.Panel value="overview" className={panel}>Summary of the contract terms.</Tabs.Panel>
      <Tabs.Panel value="parties" className={panel}>Signers and counterparties.</Tabs.Panel>
      <Tabs.Panel value="history" className={panel}>Every change, newest first.</Tabs.Panel>
      <Tabs.Panel value="archive" className={panel}>Archived copies.</Tabs.Panel>
    </Tabs.Root>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

```tsx
<Tabs.Root>
  <Tabs.List>
    <Tabs.Tab value="a" />
    <Tabs.Close value="a" />
  </Tabs.List>
  <Tabs.Panel value="a" />
</Tabs.Root>
```

A `Tab` and its `Panel` share a `value`. `Close` is only for dismissable tabs; put it beside its `Tab`, never inside it (a button can't hold a button).

## Starting tab and changes

Without `value` or `defaultValue`, the first enabled `Tab` is selected. `Root` finds it among its children, inside `List` and fragments; when your tabs sit in other wrappers, set `defaultValue`. Use `value` with `onValueChange` for a controlled strip.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Tabs } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const tab =
  'h-10 cursor-pointer border-0 border-b-2 border-solid border-hairline bg-transparent px-4 text-sm text-ink-muted hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-selected:border-border-interactive data-selected:font-semibold data-selected:text-ink';
const panel = 'p-4 text-sm text-ink';

export default function Example() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState('review');
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-2">
      <Tabs.Root value={step} onValueChange={setStep}>
        <Tabs.List aria-label="Approval steps" className="flex gap-px">
          <Tabs.Tab value="draft" className={tab}>Draft</Tabs.Tab>
          <Tabs.Tab value="review" className={tab}>Legal review</Tabs.Tab>
          <Tabs.Tab value="sign" className={tab}>Signing</Tabs.Tab>
        </Tabs.List>
        <Tabs.Panel value="draft" className={panel}>The requester fills in the contract form.</Tabs.Panel>
        <Tabs.Panel value="review" className={panel}>Legal checks the terms and the counterparty.</Tabs.Panel>
        <Tabs.Panel value="sign" className={panel}>Both parties sign, and the contract is filed.</Tabs.Panel>
      </Tabs.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Selected: {step}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Manual activation

`activation="manual"`: the arrow keys only move focus, and Enter or Space selects. Use it when a panel is slow to render or loads data.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Tabs } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const tab =
  'h-10 cursor-pointer border-0 border-b-2 border-solid border-hairline bg-transparent px-4 text-sm text-ink-muted hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-selected:border-border-interactive data-selected:font-semibold data-selected:text-ink';

export default function Example() {
  const [report, setReport] = useState('month');
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-2">
      <Tabs.Root activation="manual" value={report} onValueChange={setReport}>
        <Tabs.List aria-label="Reports" className="flex gap-px">
          <Tabs.Tab value="month" className={tab}>This month</Tabs.Tab>
          <Tabs.Tab value="quarter" className={tab}>This quarter</Tabs.Tab>
          <Tabs.Tab value="year" className={tab}>This year</Tabs.Tab>
        </Tabs.List>
        <Tabs.Panel value="month" className="p-4 text-sm text-ink">Focus a tab, move with the arrow keys, then press Enter or Space.</Tabs.Panel>
        <Tabs.Panel value="quarter" className="p-4 text-sm text-ink">The quarter's report.</Tabs.Panel>
        <Tabs.Panel value="year" className="p-4 text-sm text-ink">The year's report.</Tabs.Panel>
      </Tabs.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Loaded: {report}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Keep the current tab

`onValueChange` reports the tab the user chose. In a controlled strip, keep `value` as it is to stay on the current tab, for example while a form in it has unsaved changes.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Tabs } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const tab =
  'h-10 cursor-pointer border-0 border-b-2 border-solid border-hairline bg-transparent px-4 text-sm text-ink-muted hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-selected:border-border-interactive data-selected:font-semibold data-selected:text-ink';

export default function Example() {
  const [tabValue, setTabValue] = useState('form');
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(true);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-2">
      <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink">
        <input type="checkbox" checked={dirty} onChange={(e) => setDirty(e.target.checked)} />
        The contract form has unsaved changes
      </label>
      <Tabs.Root
        value={tabValue}
        onValueChange={(next) => {
          setMessage(dirty ? `Save the form before you open "${next}".` : '');
          if (!dirty) setTabValue(next);
        }}
      >
        <Tabs.List aria-label="Contract" className="flex gap-px">
          <Tabs.Tab value="form" className={tab}>Form</Tabs.Tab>
          <Tabs.Tab value="preview" className={tab}>Preview</Tabs.Tab>
        </Tabs.List>
        <Tabs.Panel value="form" className="p-4 text-sm text-ink">Edit the contract here.</Tabs.Panel>
        <Tabs.Panel value="preview" className="p-4 text-sm text-ink">The contract as the counterparty will see it.</Tabs.Panel>
      </Tabs.Root>
      <p role="status" className="text-xs text-error-text">{message}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Vertical tabs

`orientation="vertical"` makes ↑ and ↓ the keys that move, sets `aria-orientation="vertical"` on the list, and `data-orientation="vertical"` on `Root` and `List`. The column layout is yours.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Tabs } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const tab =
  'box-border h-12 w-full cursor-pointer border-0 border-b border-s-[3px] border-solid border-b-hairline border-s-hairline bg-transparent px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-selected:border-s-border-interactive data-selected:bg-layer-1 data-selected:font-semibold data-selected:text-ink data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const panel = 'p-4 text-sm text-ink';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Tabs.Root orientation="vertical" className="flex min-h-48 max-w-xl border border-solid border-hairline">
      <Tabs.List aria-label="Settings" className="flex w-44 shrink-0 flex-col">
        <Tabs.Tab value="profile" className={tab}>Profile</Tabs.Tab>
        <Tabs.Tab value="notifications" className={tab}>Notifications</Tabs.Tab>
        <Tabs.Tab value="signatures" className={tab}>Signatures</Tabs.Tab>
        <Tabs.Tab value="audit" disabled className={tab}>Audit log</Tabs.Tab>
      </Tabs.List>
      <Tabs.Panel value="profile" className={panel}>Your name and department.</Tabs.Panel>
      <Tabs.Panel value="notifications" className={panel}>Email and in-app alerts.</Tabs.Panel>
      <Tabs.Panel value="signatures" className={panel}>Your saved signature.</Tabs.Panel>
      <Tabs.Panel value="audit" className={panel}>Who changed what.</Tabs.Panel>
    </Tabs.Root>
  );
}
```

## Dismissable tabs

With `dismissable`, Delete on a focused tab and a click on its `Close` call `onTabCloseRequest` with the tab's value. Remove the tab from your list to close it. A closed selected tab passes the selection to the first enabled tab (`onValueChange`), and focus moves to the tab now in its place, else the one before.

These tabs sit in a wrapper with their `Close`, so `Root` gets a `defaultValue`.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Tabs } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const files = [
  { value: 'contract', label: 'Contract.pdf' },
  { value: 'memo', label: 'Memo.docx' },
  { value: 'notes', label: 'Notes' },
];
const tab =
  'h-10 cursor-pointer border-0 border-b-2 border-solid border-hairline bg-transparent ps-4 pe-10 text-sm text-ink-muted hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-selected:border-border-interactive data-selected:font-semibold data-selected:text-ink';

export default function Example() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(files);
  return (
    <Tabs.Root dismissable defaultValue="contract" onTabCloseRequest={(value) => setOpen((list) => list.filter((file) => file.value !== value))}>
      <Tabs.List aria-label="Open documents" className="flex gap-px">
        {open.map((file) => (
          <span key={file.value} className="relative flex">
            <Tabs.Tab value={file.value} className={tab}>{file.label}</Tabs.Tab>
            <Tabs.Close
              value={file.value}
              title={`Close ${file.label}`}
              className="absolute inset-y-0 end-2 my-auto grid size-6 cursor-pointer place-items-center border-0 bg-transparent p-1 text-ink-muted hover:bg-ghost-hover hover:text-ink"
            >
              <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current">
                <path d="m12 4.7-.7-.7L8 7.3 4.7 4l-.7.7L7.3 8 4 11.3l.7.7L8 8.7l3.3 3.3.7-.7L8.7 8z" />
              </svg>
            </Tabs.Close>
          </span>
        ))}
      </Tabs.List>
      {open.map((file) => (
        <Tabs.Panel key={file.value} value={file.value} className="p-4 text-sm text-ink">
          {file.label}: the × or Delete on the focused tab closes it.
        </Tabs.Panel>
      ))}
      {open.length === 0 ? (
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(files)} className="mt-4 h-8 cursor-pointer border-0 bg-interactive px-4 text-sm text-on-primary">
          Open them again
        </button>
      ) : null}
    </Tabs.Root>
  );
}
```

## Style it

The contained look: tabs on the accent layer, the selected one on the layer with a blue top edge, and dividers that come from your CSS.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Tabs } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const tab =
  'h-12 cursor-pointer border-0 bg-layer-accent-1 px-4 text-sm text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-accent-hover-1 hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-selected:bg-layer-1 data-selected:font-semibold data-selected:text-ink data-selected:shadow-[inset_0_2px_0_0_var(--ui-border-interactive)] data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:bg-button-disabled data-disabled:text-on-color-disabled';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Tabs.Root>
      <Tabs.List aria-label="Contract details" className="flex">
        <Tabs.Tab value="overview" className={tab}>Overview</Tabs.Tab>
        <Tabs.Tab value="parties" className={tab}>Parties</Tabs.Tab>
        <Tabs.Tab value="history" className={tab}>History</Tabs.Tab>
        <Tabs.Tab value="archive" disabled className={tab}>Archive</Tabs.Tab>
      </Tabs.List>
      <Tabs.Panel value="overview" className="bg-layer-1 p-4 text-sm text-ink">Summary of the contract terms.</Tabs.Panel>
      <Tabs.Panel value="parties" className="bg-layer-1 p-4 text-sm text-ink">Signers and counterparties.</Tabs.Panel>
      <Tabs.Panel value="history" className="bg-layer-1 p-4 text-sm text-ink">Every change, newest first.</Tabs.Panel>
      <Tabs.Panel value="archive" className="bg-layer-1 p-4 text-sm text-ink">Archived copies.</Tabs.Panel>
    </Tabs.Root>
  );
}
```
```css
[role='tab'] { border-bottom: 2px solid #e0e0e0; color: #525252; }
[role='tab'][data-selected] { border-bottom-color: #0f62fe; color: #161616; font-weight: 600; }
[role='tab'][data-disabled] { color: #a8a8a8; cursor: not-allowed; }
[role='tablist'][data-orientation='vertical'] { flex-direction: column; }
[role='tabpanel']:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f62fe; outline-offset: -2px; }
```

## Parts

### Tabs.Root

Renders a `<div>` that holds the state. It takes every `<div>` prop.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` | — | The selected tab's value (controlled) |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | the first enabled `Tab` | The starting tab (uncontrolled). Found inside `List` and fragments only |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | — | After the user selects another tab, or a closed selected tab passed the selection on |
| `activation` | `'automatic' \| 'manual'` | `'automatic'` | `automatic` selects as focus moves; `manual` selects on Enter or Space |
| `orientation` | `'horizontal' \| 'vertical'` | `'horizontal'` | ← / → or ↑ / ↓ move |
| `dismissable` | `boolean` | `false` | Delete and `Close` ask to close a tab |
| `onTabCloseRequest` | `(value: string) => void` | — | A tab asked to close: drop it from your children to close it |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-orientation` | Always: `horizontal` or `vertical` |

### Tabs.List

Renders a `<div role="tablist">` (with `aria-orientation="vertical"` in a vertical strip). It handles the keys and the clicks of its tabs, and takes every `<div>` prop; name it with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-orientation` | Always: `horizontal` or `vertical` |

### Tabs.Tab

Renders a `<button type="button" role="tab">` with `aria-selected`, `aria-controls` (its panel) and an id from `Root`. Only the tab stop has `tabIndex={0}`.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` | — | Matches the `value` of its `Panel` (required) |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | `aria-disabled`: stays visible and announced, but can't be selected or reached with the arrows |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-selected` | It is the selected tab |
| `data-disabled` | `disabled` is set |
| `data-value` | Always: its `value` |

In dismissable tabs each enabled tab gets `aria-keyshortcuts="Delete"`, unless you pass your own.

### Tabs.Close

Renders a `<button type="button">` with `tabIndex={-1}` and `aria-hidden="true"`: Delete on the tab does the same for keyboard and screen reader users. Name it with `title` for the mouse.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` | — | The tab it closes (required) |

### Tabs.Panel

Renders a `<div role="tabpanel">`, labelled by its tab and `hidden` unless its tab is selected. It is a Tab stop (`tabIndex={0}`) only when nothing inside it can take focus.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` | — | Matches the `value` of its `Tab` (required) |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-selected` | Its tab is selected |

`Tabs.useTabsContext()` gives the enclosing `Root`'s state (`value`, `orientation`, `activation`, `dismissable` …) to your own parts, and `Tabs.tabIds(id, value)` the ids of a tab and its panel.

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| ← / → | Previous / next enabled tab, wrapping (mirrored right-to-left); with `automatic` it also selects |
| ↑ / ↓ | The same with `orientation="vertical"` |
| Home / End | First / last enabled tab |
| Enter, Space | Select the focused tab |
| Delete | Asks to close the focused tab (`dismissable`) |
| Tab | Leaves the strip; the next stop is the panel, or the first thing inside it |

The parts set the roles, `aria-selected`, `aria-controls`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-orientation` and the roving `tabIndex`.

You add:

- A name for the strip: `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` on `List`.
- `aria-label` on a tab that shows only an icon, and a tooltip for sighted users.
- Scroll buttons when the tabs overflow; keep them out of the Tab order, as the styled Tabs do.


---

# Headless Pagination nav

`PaginationNav` is the behaviour of the styled [Pagination nav](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/pagination-nav/) as unstyled React parts. `Root` holds the page (0-based, as in Carbon) and lays out the row: which page numbers show, and which pages fold into the "…" menus at either end, following the current page as Carbon's do. `Prev`, `Next`, `Page` and `Overflow` move between pages, and `Status` announces the change.

You own the markup and every style: the list, the icons, the underline of the current page, the "…" over each menu, and the words screen readers hear.

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { PaginationNav } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it

`Root` doesn't render the row itself: read `items` from `PaginationNav.usePaginationNavContext()` in a component inside it, and render each item as a `Page` or an `Overflow`.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { PaginationNav } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const pageClass =
  'relative h-10 min-w-10 cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent px-1 text-sm text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-current:font-semibold data-current:after:absolute data-current:after:bottom-0 data-current:after:start-[calc(50%-8px)] data-current:after:h-1 data-current:after:w-4 data-current:after:bg-border-interactive';
const stepClass =
  'grid size-10 cursor-pointer place-items-center border-0 bg-transparent text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:bg-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const overflowClass =
  'h-10 w-10 cursor-pointer appearance-none border-0 bg-transparent text-transparent hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&>option]:bg-layer-1 [&>option]:text-ink';

function Row() {
  const { items, page, total } = PaginationNav.usePaginationNavContext();
  return (
    <>
      <ul className="m-0 flex list-none items-center p-0">
        <li>
          <PaginationNav.Prev aria-label="Previous" className={stepClass}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current"><path d="M20 24 10 16 20 8z" /></svg>
          </PaginationNav.Prev>
        </li>
        {items.map((item) =>
          item.kind === 'page' ? (
            <li key={`page-${item.page}`}>
              <PaginationNav.Page page={item.page} className={pageClass}>
                <span className="sr-only">Page </span>
                {item.page + 1}
              </PaginationNav.Page>
            </li>
          ) : (
            <li key={`overflow-${item.from}`} className="relative">
              <PaginationNav.Overflow from={item.from} count={item.count} aria-label="Select page number" className={overflowClass} />
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center text-ink">…</span>
            </li>
          ),
        )}
        <li>
          <PaginationNav.Next aria-label="Next" className={stepClass}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current"><path d="M12 8 22 16 12 24z" /></svg>
          </PaginationNav.Next>
        </li>
      </ul>
      <PaginationNav.Status className="sr-only">Page {page + 1} of {total}</PaginationNav.Status>
    </>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <PaginationNav.Root totalItems={25} aria-label="Pagination">
      <Row />
    </PaginationNav.Root>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

```tsx
<PaginationNav.Root>
  <PaginationNav.Prev />
  <PaginationNav.Page />
  <PaginationNav.Overflow />
  <PaginationNav.Next />
  <PaginationNav.Status />
</PaginationNav.Root>
```

`items` (from `usePaginationNavContext()`) is the row in order: the first page, a front overflow, the pages around the current one, a back overflow and the last page. Each item is `{ kind: 'page', page, active }` or `{ kind: 'overflow', from, count }`.

## Controlled page

Use `page` with `onChange` for a controlled row (both 0-based), or `defaultPage` for an uncontrolled one.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { PaginationNav } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const pageClass =
  'relative h-10 min-w-10 cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent px-1 text-sm text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-current:font-semibold data-current:after:absolute data-current:after:bottom-0 data-current:after:start-[calc(50%-8px)] data-current:after:h-1 data-current:after:w-4 data-current:after:bg-border-interactive';
const stepClass =
  'grid size-10 cursor-pointer place-items-center border-0 bg-transparent text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:bg-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const overflowClass =
  'h-10 w-10 cursor-pointer appearance-none border-0 bg-transparent text-transparent hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&>option]:bg-layer-1 [&>option]:text-ink';

function Row() {
  const { items, page, total } = PaginationNav.usePaginationNavContext();
  return (
    <>
      <ul className="m-0 flex list-none items-center p-0">
        <li>
          <PaginationNav.Prev aria-label="Previous" className={stepClass}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current"><path d="M20 24 10 16 20 8z" /></svg>
          </PaginationNav.Prev>
        </li>
        {items.map((item) =>
          item.kind === 'page' ? (
            <li key={`page-${item.page}`}>
              <PaginationNav.Page page={item.page} className={pageClass}>
                <span className="sr-only">Page </span>
                {item.page + 1}
              </PaginationNav.Page>
            </li>
          ) : (
            <li key={`overflow-${item.from}`} className="relative">
              <PaginationNav.Overflow from={item.from} count={item.count} aria-label="Select page number" className={overflowClass} />
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center text-ink">…</span>
            </li>
          ),
        )}
        <li>
          <PaginationNav.Next aria-label="Next" className={stepClass}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current"><path d="M12 8 22 16 12 24z" /></svg>
          </PaginationNav.Next>
        </li>
      </ul>
      <PaginationNav.Status className="sr-only">Page {page + 1} of {total}</PaginationNav.Status>
    </>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(3);
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-2">
      <PaginationNav.Root totalItems={25} page={page} onChange={setPage} aria-label="Pagination">
        <Row />
      </PaginationNav.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Page {page + 1} of 25</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Wrap around

With `loop`, `Prev` on the first page goes to the last, and `Next` on the last page to the first. Without it they are disabled at the ends (`disabled` and `data-disabled`).


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { PaginationNav } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const pageClass =
  'relative h-10 min-w-10 cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent px-1 text-sm text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-current:font-semibold data-current:after:absolute data-current:after:bottom-0 data-current:after:start-[calc(50%-8px)] data-current:after:h-1 data-current:after:w-4 data-current:after:bg-border-interactive';
const stepClass =
  'grid size-10 cursor-pointer place-items-center border-0 bg-transparent text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:bg-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const overflowClass =
  'h-10 w-10 cursor-pointer appearance-none border-0 bg-transparent text-transparent hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&>option]:bg-layer-1 [&>option]:text-ink';

function Row() {
  const { items, page, total } = PaginationNav.usePaginationNavContext();
  return (
    <>
      <ul className="m-0 flex list-none items-center p-0">
        <li>
          <PaginationNav.Prev aria-label="Previous" className={stepClass}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current"><path d="M20 24 10 16 20 8z" /></svg>
          </PaginationNav.Prev>
        </li>
        {items.map((item) =>
          item.kind === 'page' ? (
            <li key={`page-${item.page}`}>
              <PaginationNav.Page page={item.page} className={pageClass}>
                <span className="sr-only">Page </span>
                {item.page + 1}
              </PaginationNav.Page>
            </li>
          ) : (
            <li key={`overflow-${item.from}`} className="relative">
              <PaginationNav.Overflow from={item.from} count={item.count} aria-label="Select page number" className={overflowClass} />
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center text-ink">…</span>
            </li>
          ),
        )}
        <li>
          <PaginationNav.Next aria-label="Next" className={stepClass}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current"><path d="M12 8 22 16 12 24z" /></svg>
          </PaginationNav.Next>
        </li>
      </ul>
      <PaginationNav.Status className="sr-only">Page {page + 1} of {total}</PaginationNav.Status>
    </>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <PaginationNav.Root totalItems={8} loop aria-label="Pagination">
      <Row />
    </PaginationNav.Root>
  );
}
```

## Fewer items, or no menus

`itemsShown` is how many items the row holds, the overflows included (10 by default, at least 4); below 320px the row holds fewer by itself. `disableOverflow` keeps the overflows in the row but disables them.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { PaginationNav } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const pageClass =
  'relative h-10 min-w-10 cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent px-1 text-sm text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-current:font-semibold data-current:after:absolute data-current:after:bottom-0 data-current:after:start-[calc(50%-8px)] data-current:after:h-1 data-current:after:w-4 data-current:after:bg-border-interactive';
const stepClass =
  'grid size-10 cursor-pointer place-items-center border-0 bg-transparent text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:bg-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const overflowClass =
  'h-10 w-10 cursor-pointer appearance-none border-0 bg-transparent text-transparent hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&>option]:bg-layer-1 [&>option]:text-ink';

function Row() {
  const { items, page, total } = PaginationNav.usePaginationNavContext();
  return (
    <>
      <ul className="m-0 flex list-none items-center p-0">
        <li>
          <PaginationNav.Prev aria-label="Previous" className={stepClass}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current"><path d="M20 24 10 16 20 8z" /></svg>
          </PaginationNav.Prev>
        </li>
        {items.map((item) =>
          item.kind === 'page' ? (
            <li key={`page-${item.page}`}>
              <PaginationNav.Page page={item.page} className={pageClass}>
                <span className="sr-only">Page </span>
                {item.page + 1}
              </PaginationNav.Page>
            </li>
          ) : (
            <li key={`overflow-${item.from}`} className="relative">
              <PaginationNav.Overflow from={item.from} count={item.count} aria-label="Select page number" className={overflowClass} />
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center text-ink">…</span>
            </li>
          ),
        )}
        <li>
          <PaginationNav.Next aria-label="Next" className={stepClass}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current"><path d="M12 8 22 16 12 24z" /></svg>
          </PaginationNav.Next>
        </li>
      </ul>
      <PaginationNav.Status className="sr-only">Page {page + 1} of {total}</PaginationNav.Status>
    </>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <PaginationNav.Root totalItems={25} itemsShown={5} defaultPage={12} aria-label="Pagination, five items">
        <Row />
      </PaginationNav.Root>
      <PaginationNav.Root totalItems={25} defaultPage={12} disableOverflow aria-label="Pagination, no menus">
        <Row />
      </PaginationNav.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Name the hidden pages

`renderPage` sets the text of each option in an `Overflow` (the 1-based number by default).


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { PaginationNav } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const pageClass =
  'relative h-10 min-w-10 cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent px-1 text-sm text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-current:font-semibold data-current:after:absolute data-current:after:bottom-0 data-current:after:start-[calc(50%-8px)] data-current:after:h-1 data-current:after:w-4 data-current:after:bg-border-interactive';
const stepClass =
  'grid size-10 cursor-pointer place-items-center border-0 bg-transparent text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:bg-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';
const overflowClass =
  'h-10 w-10 cursor-pointer appearance-none border-0 bg-transparent text-transparent hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed [&>option]:bg-layer-1 [&>option]:text-ink';

function Row() {
  const { items, page, total } = PaginationNav.usePaginationNavContext();
  return (
    <>
      <ul className="m-0 flex list-none items-center p-0">
        <li>
          <PaginationNav.Prev aria-label="Previous" className={stepClass}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current"><path d="M20 24 10 16 20 8z" /></svg>
          </PaginationNav.Prev>
        </li>
        {items.map((item) =>
          item.kind === 'page' ? (
            <li key={`page-${item.page}`}>
              <PaginationNav.Page page={item.page} className={pageClass}>
                <span className="sr-only">Page </span>
                {item.page + 1}
              </PaginationNav.Page>
            </li>
          ) : (
            <li key={`overflow-${item.from}`} className="relative">
              <PaginationNav.Overflow from={item.from} count={item.count} aria-label="Select page number" renderPage={(page) => `Page ${page + 1}`} className={overflowClass} />
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center text-ink">…</span>
            </li>
          ),
        )}
        <li>
          <PaginationNav.Next aria-label="Next" className={stepClass}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current"><path d="M12 8 22 16 12 24z" /></svg>
          </PaginationNav.Next>
        </li>
      </ul>
      <PaginationNav.Status className="sr-only">Page {page + 1} of {total}</PaginationNav.Status>
    </>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <PaginationNav.Root totalItems={40} defaultPage={20} aria-label="Pagination">
      <Row />
    </PaginationNav.Root>
  );
}
```

## Your own row

The parts don't need the "…" menus: render only the `Page` items, and text buttons for `Prev` and `Next`. Here a list of 12 contracts shows three per page.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { PaginationNav } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const contracts = [
  'Office supplies', 'Cleaning services', 'Server lease', 'Car rental',
  'Printer maintenance', 'Security guards', 'Catering', 'Software licences',
  'Office lease', 'Legal advice', 'Translation', 'Courier services',
];
const perPage = 3;
const pageClass =
  'h-8 min-w-8 cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent px-1 text-sm text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-current:bg-interactive data-current:text-on-primary';
const stepClass =
  'h-8 cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent px-3 text-sm text-link hover:underline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-disabled:no-underline';

function Pages() {
  const { items } = PaginationNav.usePaginationNavContext();
  return items.map((item) =>
    item.kind === 'page' ? (
      <li key={item.page}>
        <PaginationNav.Page page={item.page} className={pageClass}>
          {item.page + 1}
        </PaginationNav.Page>
      </li>
    ) : null,
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <ol start={page * perPage + 1} className="m-0 ps-6 text-sm text-ink">
        {contracts.slice(page * perPage, (page + 1) * perPage).map((name) => (
          <li key={name}>{name}</li>
        ))}
      </ol>
      <PaginationNav.Root totalItems={Math.ceil(contracts.length / perPage)} page={page} onChange={setPage} aria-label="Contract pages">
        <ul className="m-0 flex list-none items-center gap-1 p-0">
          <li><PaginationNav.Prev className={stepClass}>Previous</PaginationNav.Prev></li>
          <Pages />
          <li><PaginationNav.Next className={stepClass}>Next</PaginationNav.Next></li>
        </ul>
        <PaginationNav.Status className="sr-only">Page {page + 1} of {Math.ceil(contracts.length / perPage)}</PaginationNav.Status>
      </PaginationNav.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Style it

The current `Page` has `data-current` (and `aria-current="page"`); `Prev`, `Next` and a disabled `Overflow` have `data-disabled`. Here they give round pages, the current one filled, and faded ends.

```tsx
              </PaginationNav.Page>
            </li>
          ) : (

              <span aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center text-ink">…</span>
            </li>
          ),
        )}
        <li>
          <PaginationNav.Next aria-label="Next" className={stepClass}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 32 32" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current"><path d="M12 8 22 16 12 24z" /></svg>
          </PaginationNav.Next>
        </li>
      </ul>
```
