
## Parts

### Popover.Root

Renders no element of its own: it holds the open state, places the popup and closes it on Esc and on a press outside.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | | Shown (controlled) |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | Shown at first (uncontrolled) |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean, reason: PopoverChangeReason) => void` | | After it opens or closes (changes only), with why |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | `true` | Esc on the trigger or in the popup, and a press outside both, close it |
| `closeOnFocusOut` | `boolean` | `false` | Focus moving out of the trigger and the popup closes it (toggletip) |
| `placement` | `Placement` | `'bottom'` | `top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`, each with `-start` / `-end` |
| `gap` | `number` | `8` | Space between the trigger and the popup, in px |
| `caret` | `boolean` | `false` | Writes `--_caret-start` on the popup |

`Popover.usePopoverContext()` returns the `Root`'s state to any component inside it: `open`, `popupId`, `triggerProps`, `setOpen(open, reason)` and `dismiss(reason)` (closes, and gives focus back to the trigger when it was inside, except after a press outside).

### Popover.Trigger

A `<button type="button">` that toggles the popup (reason `trigger`), with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. The popup sits beside it. It takes every button prop except `type`.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | The popup is open |

### Popover.Anchor

A `<span>` around a trigger of your own, used in place of `Trigger`. The popup sits beside its first element child; a press anywhere inside it is not outside; after Esc focus goes back to that child (or the first focusable element in it).

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | The popup is open |

### Popover.Popup

A `<div role="group" popover="manual">` in the top layer, with the id the trigger's `aria-controls` points to. Your `role` wins. Its content stays rendered while closed. It takes every div prop except `popover` and `id`.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | Open |
| `data-side` | `top`, `bottom`, `left` or `right`: where it went |

With `caret` on `Root`, it also gets the CSS variable `--_caret-start`.

### Popover.Close

A `<button type="button">` that closes the popup (reason `close`) and gives focus back to the trigger. It takes every button prop except `type`, and has no data attributes.

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | What it does |
|---|---|
| Enter, Space | On the trigger: open or close |
| Tab | Moves through the trigger and the content in page order; with `closeOnFocusOut`, leaving both closes it |
| Esc | With `dismissible`, from the trigger or the popup: closes the popup, unless something else handled the key first (it checks `defaultPrevented`), and gives focus back to the trigger |

The parts set `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` on the trigger and `role="group"` on the popup. Focus doesn't move into the popup when it opens.

You add:

- A name for the popup (`aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`), and for an icon-only trigger.
- The popup right after the trigger in the DOM, so the next Tab reaches its content.
- For a task the user must finish before going on, a modal instead.


---

# Headless Menu

The `Menu` parts give you the behaviour of the styled [Menu](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/menu/) with no styles, in the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern: a trigger that opens a `role="menu"` popup in the top layer, focus moved to the first item (or the last), ↑ / ↓ that wrap past disabled items, Home / End, typing to jump, and Esc, Tab, a press outside or a picked item closing it with focus given back. Items can be actions, check boxes or radios, and open submenus.

You own the trigger's look, every row, the check marks and chevrons, and every style. The parts show their state as `data-*` attributes; the highlighted item is the focused one, so style it with `focus:`.

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { Menu } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Menu } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const item = 'flex h-8 cursor-pointer items-center px-4 text-sm text-ink-muted outline-none hover:bg-ghost-hover hover:text-ink focus:bg-ghost-hover focus:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:bg-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';

export default function Example() {
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState('nothing yet');
  return (
    <div className="grid justify-items-start gap-2">
      <Menu.Root>
        <Menu.Trigger className="group flex h-10 min-w-48 items-center justify-between gap-2 bg-interactive px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus">
          Actions
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current transition-transform group-data-popup-open:rotate-180">
            <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
          </svg>
        </Menu.Trigger>
        <Menu.Popup className="min-w-48 bg-layer-1 py-1 shadow-lg">
          <Menu.Item className={item} onClick={() => setPicked('Send for signature')}>Send for signature</Menu.Item>
          <Menu.Item className={item} onClick={() => setPicked('Save as draft')}>Save as draft</Menu.Item>
          <Menu.Item className={item} disabled>Export PDF</Menu.Item>
          <Menu.Separator className="my-1 h-px border-0 bg-hairline" />
          <Menu.Item className={`${item} hover:bg-button-danger hover:text-on-primary focus:bg-button-danger focus:text-on-primary`} onClick={() => setPicked('Discard')}>
            Discard
          </Menu.Item>
        </Menu.Popup>
      </Menu.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Picked: {picked}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

The popup is named by the trigger (`aria-labelledby`) unless you give it an `aria-label`. `onClick` on an item runs on a click and on Enter or Space, then every level of the menu closes.

## Anatomy

```tsx
<Menu.Root>
  <Menu.Trigger />
  <Menu.Popup>
    <Menu.Item />
    <Menu.CheckboxItem />
    <Menu.Separator />
    <Menu.Group>
      <Menu.GroupLabel />
      <Menu.Item />
    </Menu.Group>
    <Menu.RadioGroup>
      <Menu.RadioItem value="…" />
    </Menu.RadioGroup>
    <Menu.SubmenuRoot>
      <Menu.SubmenuTrigger>
        <Menu.Popup>
          <Menu.Item />
        </Menu.Popup>
      </Menu.SubmenuTrigger>
    </Menu.SubmenuRoot>
  </Menu.Popup>
</Menu.Root>
```

## Placement and width

The popup opens below the trigger, lined up with its start edge (`placement="bottom-start"` on `Popup`). Any placement works, and it flips when there is no room; `data-side` says where it went. `matchWidth` makes it as wide as the trigger, as Carbon's menu button with `bottom`.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Menu } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const item = 'flex h-10 cursor-pointer items-center px-4 text-sm text-ink-muted outline-none hover:bg-ghost-hover hover:text-ink focus:bg-ghost-hover focus:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus';
const trigger = 'h-10 border border-interactive px-4 text-sm text-interactive hover:bg-interactive hover:text-on-primary focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus data-popup-open:bg-interactive data-popup-open:text-on-primary';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
      <Menu.Root>
        <Menu.Trigger className={`${trigger} min-w-48 text-start`}>As wide as the button</Menu.Trigger>
        <Menu.Popup matchWidth className="bg-layer-1 py-1 shadow-lg">
          <Menu.Item className={item}>Export PDF</Menu.Item>
          <Menu.Item className={item}>Export Word (.docx)</Menu.Item>
        </Menu.Popup>
      </Menu.Root>
      <Menu.Root>
        <Menu.Trigger className={trigger}>End edge, above</Menu.Trigger>
        <Menu.Popup placement="top-end" className="bg-layer-1 py-1 shadow-lg data-[side=top]:shadow-[0_-2px_6px_rgb(0_0_0/0.3)]">
          <Menu.Item className={item}>Export PDF</Menu.Item>
          <Menu.Item className={item}>Export Word (.docx) with comments</Menu.Item>
        </Menu.Popup>
      </Menu.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Check boxes and radio groups

- `CheckboxItem` is an on / off item (`menuitemcheckbox`): `checked` and `onCheckedChange`, or `defaultChecked`.
- `RadioGroup` holds `RadioItem`s (`menuitemradio`), exactly one checked: `value` and `onValueChange`, or `defaultValue`.
- Both get `aria-checked` and `data-checked` to draw a check mark on. `Menu.useMenuItemContext()` gives `checked` to a component inside the item.
- `Group` with a `GroupLabel` names a set of items. `RadioGroup` is a `Group` too.
- Every item closes the menu when picked; `closeOnClick={false}` keeps it open, handy for check boxes.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Menu } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const item = 'group flex h-8 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 px-4 text-sm text-ink-muted outline-none hover:bg-ghost-hover hover:text-ink focus:bg-ghost-hover focus:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus';

function Check() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="invisible size-4 fill-current group-data-checked:visible">
      <path d="M6 12.4 2.3 8.7l.7-.7 3 3 6.3-6.3.7.7z" />
    </svg>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  const [archived, setArchived] = useState(true);
  const [drafts, setDrafts] = useState(false);
  const [sort, setSort] = useState('date');
  return (
    <div className="grid justify-items-start gap-2">
      <Menu.Root>
        <Menu.Trigger className="h-10 px-4 text-sm text-link hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">View options</Menu.Trigger>
        <Menu.Popup className="min-w-56 bg-layer-1 py-1 shadow-lg">
          <Menu.CheckboxItem className={item} checked={archived} onCheckedChange={setArchived} closeOnClick={false}>
            <Check />
            Show archived
          </Menu.CheckboxItem>
          <Menu.CheckboxItem className={item} checked={drafts} onCheckedChange={setDrafts} closeOnClick={false}>
            <Check />
            Show drafts
          </Menu.CheckboxItem>
          <Menu.Separator className="my-1 h-px border-0 bg-hairline" />
          <Menu.RadioGroup value={sort} onValueChange={setSort}>
            <Menu.GroupLabel className="px-4 pt-2 pb-1 text-xs font-semibold text-ink-muted">Sort by</Menu.GroupLabel>
            <Menu.RadioItem value="name" className={item}><Check />Name</Menu.RadioItem>
            <Menu.RadioItem value="date" className={item}><Check />Date modified</Menu.RadioItem>
            <Menu.RadioItem value="expiry" className={item}><Check />Expiry date</Menu.RadioItem>
          </Menu.RadioGroup>
        </Menu.Popup>
      </Menu.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">
        Archived: {String(archived)}. Drafts: {String(drafts)}. Sort by: {sort}
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Submenus

A `SubmenuRoot` inside the popup holds a `SubmenuTrigger`, an item that opens the submenu's own `Popup` (put inside it) beside it: on hover after `delay` (150ms, focus stays), a click, Enter, Space or → (← right-to-left). ← or Esc closes only that level. Picking an item in a submenu closes every level.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Menu } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const item = 'flex h-8 cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 text-sm text-ink-muted outline-none hover:bg-ghost-hover hover:text-ink focus:bg-ghost-hover focus:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-popup-open:bg-ghost-hover data-popup-open:text-ink';
const popup = 'min-w-40 bg-layer-1 py-1 shadow-lg';

function Chevron() {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current rtl:-scale-x-100">
      <path d="M11 8 6 13l-.7-.7L9.6 8 5.3 3.7 6 3z" />
    </svg>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState('nothing yet');
  const pick = (label: string) => () => setPicked(label);
  return (
    <div className="grid justify-items-start gap-2">
      <Menu.Root>
        <Menu.Trigger className="h-10 px-4 text-sm text-link hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">Document actions</Menu.Trigger>
        <Menu.Popup className={popup}>
          <Menu.Item className={item} onClick={pick('Open')}>Open</Menu.Item>
          <Menu.SubmenuRoot>
            <Menu.SubmenuTrigger className={item} label="Export as">
              Export as
              <Chevron />
              <Menu.Popup className={popup}>
                <Menu.Item className={item} onClick={pick('PDF')}>PDF</Menu.Item>
                <Menu.Item className={item} onClick={pick('Word (.docx)')}>Word (.docx)</Menu.Item>
                <Menu.SubmenuRoot>
                  <Menu.SubmenuTrigger className={item} label="Image">
                    Image
                    <Chevron />
                    <Menu.Popup className={popup}>
                      <Menu.Item className={item} onClick={pick('PNG')}>PNG</Menu.Item>
                      <Menu.Item className={item} onClick={pick('JPEG')}>JPEG</Menu.Item>
                    </Menu.Popup>
                  </Menu.SubmenuTrigger>
                </Menu.SubmenuRoot>
              </Menu.Popup>
            </Menu.SubmenuTrigger>
          </Menu.SubmenuRoot>
        </Menu.Popup>
      </Menu.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Picked: {picked}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`label` on an item is the text typing matches (as `data-label`); give it when the item holds more than its name, such as a chevron or a shortcut.

## A combo button

A trigger can be any button: `render` hands you the trigger's props and the open state to put on your own element. `anchor` on `Popup` places the menu beside another element, here the whole pair of buttons, and `matchWidth` makes it as wide.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Menu } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const item = 'flex h-10 cursor-pointer items-center px-4 text-sm text-ink-muted outline-none hover:bg-ghost-hover hover:text-ink focus:bg-ghost-hover focus:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus';

export default function Example() {
  const pair = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [last, setLast] = useState('none');
  return (
    <div className="grid justify-items-start gap-2">
      <div ref={pair} className="inline-flex gap-px">
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setLast('Save')} className="h-10 min-w-28 bg-interactive px-4 text-start text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus">
          Save
        </button>
        <Menu.Root>
          <Menu.Trigger
            aria-label="Additional actions"
            render={(props, { open }) => (
              <button {...props} className="grid size-10 place-items-center bg-interactive text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className={`size-4 fill-current transition-transform ${open ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`}>
                  <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
                </svg>
              </button>
            )}
          />
          <Menu.Popup anchor={pair} matchWidth className="bg-layer-1 py-1 shadow-lg">
            <Menu.Item className={item} onClick={() => setLast('Save as draft')}>Save as draft</Menu.Item>
            <Menu.Item className={item} onClick={() => setLast('Save and send')}>Save and send</Menu.Item>
          </Menu.Popup>
        </Menu.Root>
      </div>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Last action: {last}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Open state

Hold the state with `open` and `onOpenChange`, or give `defaultOpen`. `onOpenChange` reports changes only, with why: `trigger-press`, `trigger-hover` (a submenu), `item-press`, `escape-key`, `list-navigation` (← out of a submenu), `focus-out` or `outside-press`. `initialFocus` on `Root` forces which item takes focus on open (`first`, `last` or `none`); left out, ↑ on the trigger starts on the last item and everything else on the first.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Menu } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const item = 'flex h-10 cursor-pointer items-center px-4 text-sm text-ink-muted outline-none hover:bg-ghost-hover hover:text-ink focus:bg-ghost-hover focus:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus';

export default function Example() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [why, setWhy] = useState('none');
  return (
    <div className="grid justify-items-start gap-2">
      <Menu.Root
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={(next, reason) => {
          setOpen(next);
          setWhy(reason);
        }}
      >
        <Menu.Trigger aria-label="Options for Lease, Silom office" className="grid size-10 place-items-center text-ink hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-popup-open:bg-layer-1 data-popup-open:shadow-lg">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current">
            <circle cx="8" cy="4" r="1.5" />
            <circle cx="8" cy="8" r="1.5" />
            <circle cx="8" cy="12" r="1.5" />
          </svg>
        </Menu.Trigger>
        <Menu.Popup className="min-w-40 bg-layer-1 py-1 shadow-lg">
          <Menu.Item className={item}>Edit</Menu.Item>
          <Menu.Item className={item}>Duplicate</Menu.Item>
          <Menu.Item className={item}>Delete</Menu.Item>
        </Menu.Popup>
      </Menu.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Open: {String(open)}. Last reason: {why}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Style it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Menu } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const item = 'grid h-8 cursor-pointer grid-cols-[1rem_1fr_max-content] items-center gap-x-2 px-4 text-sm text-ink-muted outline-none hover:bg-ghost-hover hover:text-ink focus:bg-ghost-hover focus:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:bg-transparent data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Menu.Root>
      <Menu.Trigger className="h-10 border border-interactive px-4 text-sm text-interactive hover:bg-interactive hover:text-on-primary focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus data-popup-open:bg-interactive data-popup-open:text-on-primary">
        Document options
      </Menu.Trigger>
      <Menu.Popup className="min-w-52 bg-layer-1 py-1 shadow-lg outline-none data-[side=top]:shadow-[0_-2px_6px_rgb(0_0_0/0.3)]">
        <Menu.Item className={item} label="Edit">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current"><path d="m13.7 4.3-2-2a1 1 0 0 0-1.4 0L2 10.6V14h3.4l8.3-8.3a1 1 0 0 0 0-1.4ZM5 13H3v-2l6-6 2 2Zm7-7-2-2 1-1 2 2Z" /></svg>
          Edit
          <kbd className="font-sans text-xs">⌘E</kbd>
        </Menu.Item>
        <Menu.Item className={item} label="Archive" disabled>
          <span />
          Archive (signed only)
          <span />
        </Menu.Item>
      </Menu.Popup>
    </Menu.Root>
  );
}
```
```css
/* className="trigger" on Trigger, "menu" on Popup, "item" on each item */
.trigger[data-popup-open] { background: #0f62fe; color: #fff; }
.menu { min-width: 208px; padding-block: 4px; background: #f4f4f4; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); }
.menu[data-side='top'] { box-shadow: 0 -2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); }
.item:focus { background: #e8e8e8; outline: none; }
.item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0f62fe; outline-offset: -2px; }
.item[data-disabled] { color: #a8a8a8; cursor: not-allowed; }
.item[data-checked] .check { visibility: visible; }
```

## Parts

### Menu.Root

Renders no element of its own: it holds the open state.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | | Open (controlled) |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | Open at first (uncontrolled) |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean, reason: OpenChangeReason) => void` | | After it opens or closes (changes only), with why |
| `initialFocus` | `'first' \| 'last' \| 'none'` | | Which item takes focus on open; left out, the trigger decides (↑ the last, else the first) |
| `id` | `string` | generated | Base of the ids: `<id>-trigger`, `<id>-menu` |

`Menu.useMenuContext()` returns the nearest `Root`'s or `SubmenuRoot`'s state (`open`, `popupId`, `setOpen` …), for example to turn a chevron. `Menu.ownItems(popup)` lists a popup's own items (not those of its submenus).

### Menu.Trigger

A `<button type="button">` with `aria-haspopup="menu"` (yours wins), `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, and the id `<id>-trigger`, which names the popup. A click toggles the menu; ↓ opens it on the first item, ↑ on the last.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `render` | `(props, { open }) => ReactElement` | | Render your own element with the trigger's props instead of a `<button>` |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-popup-open` | The menu is open |

### Menu.Popup

A `<div role="menu" tabindex="-1" popover="manual">` in the top layer, with the id `<id>-menu`, named by the trigger unless you give `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. Its items are always rendered (hidden while closed). Inside a `SubmenuTrigger` it is that item's submenu, placed beside it at the inline end.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `anchor` | `RefObject<Element \| null>` | the trigger | What the menu sits beside |
| `placement` | `Placement` | `'bottom-start'` | Where it opens beside the anchor (not for a submenu) |
| `matchWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | As wide as the anchor (not for a submenu) |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | Open |
| `data-side` | `top`, `bottom`, `left` or `right`: where it went |

### Menu.Item, CheckboxItem, RadioItem

A `<div tabindex="-1">` with `role="menuitem"`, `"menuitemcheckbox"` or `"menuitemradio"`. A click, Enter or Space activates it: a `CheckboxItem` flips, a `RadioItem` becomes its group's value, then `onClick` runs and the menu closes. A disabled item stays visible and announced (`aria-disabled`) but the keys skip it and activating it does nothing.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `onClick` | `(event) => void` | | On a click and on Enter / Space, before the menu closes (not when disabled) |
| `label` | `string` | the item's text | What typing matches, as `data-label` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Skipped by the keys; does nothing |
| `closeOnClick` | `boolean` | `true` | Activating it closes every level |
| `checked` | `boolean` | | `CheckboxItem`: on (controlled) |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | `false` | `CheckboxItem`: on at first |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` | | `CheckboxItem`: after it flips |
| `value` | `string` | | `RadioItem`: what it stands for in its group (required) |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-disabled` | Disabled |
| `data-checked` | A checked `CheckboxItem` or `RadioItem` |

`Menu.useMenuItemContext()` returns `{ checked }` of the enclosing item.

### Menu.RadioGroup

A `Group` of `RadioItem`s, exactly one checked.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` | | The checked item's value (controlled) |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | `''` | The starting value (uncontrolled) |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` | | After another item was picked |

### Menu.Group, GroupLabel

`Group` is a `<div role="group">` named by its `GroupLabel` (a `<div>`) unless you give it `aria-labelledby`. They add no props and no data attributes.

### Menu.Separator

An `<hr>` between items.

### Menu.SubmenuRoot, SubmenuTrigger

`SubmenuRoot` holds a submenu's state and takes the same props as `Root`. `SubmenuTrigger` is a `<div role="menuitem" aria-haspopup="menu">` with `aria-expanded`; the submenu's `Popup` goes inside it.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | the item's text | What typing matches, as `data-label` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | The submenu doesn't open |
| `delay` | `number` | `150` | Hover time in ms before the submenu opens or closes |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-popup-open` | Its submenu is open |
| `data-disabled` | Disabled |

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | On the trigger | In the menu |
|---|---|---|
| Enter, Space | Open on the first item | Activate the focused item (or open its submenu) |
| ↓ | Open on the first item | Next item, wrapping; disabled items are skipped |
| ↑ | Open on the last item | Previous item, wrapping |
| Home / End | | First / last item |
| Letters | | Next item whose `label` (or text) starts with them |
| → (← right-to-left) | | Open the focused item's submenu |
| ← (→ right-to-left) | | In a submenu: close it, focus back on its item |
| Esc | | Close this level and give focus back |
| Tab | | Close the menu and give focus back to the trigger |

The parts set `role="menu"`, the item roles, `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `aria-checked` and `aria-disabled`, and move focus in and out.

You add:

- A name for an icon-only trigger (`aria-label`).
- A visible highlight on the focused item (`focus:`), and a check mark for `data-checked`.
- For a danger item, the consequence in words (for example a visually hidden "This cannot be undone").


---

# Headless Accordion

The `Accordion` parts give you the behaviour of the styled [Accordion](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/accordion/) with no styles: a list of items, each a button that shows or hides its content, with `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` and a content region named by its button. Several items can be open at once, as in Carbon.

You own the markup inside the parts (the chevron, a heading level around the button), the text and every style. The parts show their state as `data-*` attributes for you to style on.

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { Accordion } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Accordion } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const clauses = [
  { title: 'Parties', body: 'Metro Property Co., Ltd. (the lessor) and Siam Retail Co., Ltd. (the lessee).' },
  { title: 'Payment terms', body: 'Rent is due on the 5th of each month. Late payments accrue 1.5% per month.' },
  { title: 'Confidentiality', body: 'Both parties keep the terms confidential for five years after the lease ends.' },
];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Accordion.Root className="max-w-xl">
      {clauses.map((c, i) => (
        <Accordion.Item key={c.title} defaultOpen={i === 0} className="border-t border-hairline last:border-b">
          <Accordion.Trigger className="group flex min-h-10 w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
            {c.title}
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
              <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
            </svg>
          </Accordion.Trigger>
          <Accordion.Panel className="px-4 pt-2 pb-6 text-sm text-ink">{c.body}</Accordion.Panel>
        </Accordion.Item>
      ))}
    </Accordion.Root>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

```tsx
<Accordion.Root>
  <Accordion.Item>
    <Accordion.Trigger />
    <Accordion.Panel />
  </Accordion.Item>
</Accordion.Root>
```

## Open from your code

Each `Item` is on its own: `defaultOpen` opens it on the first render, or hold it yourself with `open` and `onOpenChange`. Controlled items let a pair of buttons open and close them all at once. `onOpenChange` fires only for the user's own clicks.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Accordion } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const sections = [
  { title: '1. Definitions', body: 'The words in bold have the meaning given in this section.' },
  { title: '2. Term', body: 'Three years from 1 January 2027.' },
  { title: '3. Rent', body: '120,000 baht a month, raised 3% each year.' },
];

const button = 'h-8 border border-interactive px-4 text-sm text-interactive hover:bg-interactive hover:text-on-primary focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus';

export default function Example() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(sections.map(() => false));
  const setOne = (index: number, next: boolean) => setOpen((all) => all.map((v, j) => (j === index ? next : v)));
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xl gap-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
        <button type="button" className={button} onClick={() => setOpen(sections.map(() => true))}>Expand all</button>
        <button type="button" className={button} onClick={() => setOpen(sections.map(() => false))}>Collapse all</button>
      </div>
      <Accordion.Root>
        {sections.map((s, i) => (
          <Accordion.Item key={s.title} open={open[i]} onOpenChange={(next) => setOne(i, next)} className="border-t border-hairline last:border-b">
            <Accordion.Trigger className="group flex min-h-10 w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
              {s.title}
              <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
                <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
              </svg>
            </Accordion.Trigger>
            <Accordion.Panel className="px-4 pt-2 pb-6 text-sm text-ink">{s.body}</Accordion.Panel>
          </Accordion.Item>
        ))}
      </Accordion.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Open: {open.map((v, i) => (v ? sections[i].title : null)).filter(Boolean).join(', ') || 'none'}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## A heading around each button

The styled accordion's heading is a plain button. With the parts you choose the markup: put each `Trigger` inside an `<h3>` (or the level that fits your page) and screen reader users can jump between the items by heading, as the WAI-ARIA accordion pattern suggests.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Accordion } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const offices = [
  { name: 'Head office', address: '88 Sukhumvit Road, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110' },
  { name: 'Chiang Mai branch', address: '25 Nimmanhaemin Road, Suthep, Chiang Mai 50200' },
];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Accordion.Root className="max-w-xl">
      {offices.map((o) => (
        <Accordion.Item key={o.name} className="border-t border-hairline last:border-b">
          <h3 className="m-0 text-sm font-normal">
            <Accordion.Trigger className="group flex min-h-10 w-full cursor-pointer items-center gap-4 px-4 text-start text-ink hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-90">
                <path d="M11 8 6 13l-.7-.7L9.6 8 5.3 3.7 6 3z" />
              </svg>
              {o.name}
            </Accordion.Trigger>
          </h3>
          <Accordion.Panel className="ps-12 pe-4 pt-2 pb-6 text-sm text-ink">{o.address}</Accordion.Panel>
        </Accordion.Item>
      ))}
    </Accordion.Root>
  );
}
```

The chevron sits before the text here (the styled `align="start"`): the order is your markup.

## Disabled

`disabled` on an `Item` disables its trigger button: it can't be clicked and Tab skips it. `disabled` on `Root` disables every item. Both set `data-disabled` on the item and its trigger.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Accordion } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Accordion.Root className="max-w-xl">
      <Accordion.Item defaultOpen className="border-t border-hairline last:border-b">
        <Accordion.Trigger className="flex min-h-10 w-full cursor-pointer items-center px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">Draft</Accordion.Trigger>
        <Accordion.Panel className="px-4 pt-2 pb-6 text-sm text-ink">Version 3, edited today.</Accordion.Panel>
      </Accordion.Item>
      <Accordion.Item disabled className="border-t border-hairline last:border-b">
        <Accordion.Trigger className="flex min-h-10 w-full cursor-pointer items-center px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink hover:bg-ghost-hover data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled data-disabled:hover:bg-transparent">
          Archive (after signing)
        </Accordion.Trigger>
        <Accordion.Panel className="px-4 pt-2 pb-6 text-sm text-ink">Signed copies appear here.</Accordion.Panel>
      </Accordion.Item>
    </Accordion.Root>
  );
}
```

## Style it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Accordion } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const faqs = [
  { q: 'Who can sign?', a: 'A director listed on the company certificate, or a person with a power of attorney.' },
  { q: 'Can I sign on paper?', a: 'Yes. Print the contract, sign every page and upload the scan.' },
  { q: 'How long does approval take?', a: 'Two working days for standard contracts.' },
];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Accordion.Root className="max-w-xl">
      {faqs.map((f) => (
        <Accordion.Item key={f.q} className="group/item border-t border-hairline last:border-b data-open:bg-layer-1">
          <Accordion.Trigger className="group flex min-h-12 w-full cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 text-start text-sm text-ink hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-open:font-semibold">
            {f.q}
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
              <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
            </svg>
          </Accordion.Trigger>
          <Accordion.Panel className="px-4 pb-6 text-sm text-ink-muted">{f.a}</Accordion.Panel>
        </Accordion.Item>
      ))}
    </Accordion.Root>
  );
}
```
```css
/* className="item" on Item, "trigger" on Trigger, "chevron" on the svg */
.item[data-open] { background: #f4f4f4; }
.trigger[data-open] { font-weight: 600; }
.trigger[data-open] .chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.trigger[data-disabled] { color: #c6c6c6; cursor: not-allowed; }
```

A closed `Panel` has the `hidden` attribute, so it needs no style to hide.

## Parts

### Accordion.Root

A `<ul>`. Put it in a list reset of your own (`list-style: none`, no padding).

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables every item |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-disabled` | `disabled` is set |

`Accordion.useAccordionContext()` returns `{ disabled }` to a component inside `Root`.

### Accordion.Item

An `<li>`: one item, holding its `Trigger` and `Panel`.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | | Open (controlled) |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | Open on the first render (uncontrolled) |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | | After the user opened or closed it |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables its trigger |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | It is open |
| `data-disabled` | It, or the whole `Root`, is disabled |

`Accordion.useItemContext()` returns `{ open, disabled, toggle, triggerId, panelId }` to a component inside the item, for example to turn a chevron that sits outside the trigger.

### Accordion.Trigger

A `<button type="button">` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` (its panel's id). A click (and Enter or Space, the button's own) opens or closes the item. It takes every button prop except `type` and `disabled`; its `id` is set by the item.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | The item is open |
| `data-disabled` | The item is disabled |

### Accordion.Panel

A `<section>` named by its trigger (`aria-labelledby`), so a region landmark. It has the `hidden` attribute while the item is closed. It takes every section prop except `hidden`.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | The item is open |

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Moves between the triggers (and into an open panel); disabled triggers are skipped |
| Enter, Space | Opens or closes the focused item |

There are no arrow keys between the triggers, as in Carbon.

The parts set `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` on each trigger, and `aria-labelledby` and `hidden` on each panel. The list is a `<ul>` of `<li>` items.

You add:

- The trigger's text.
- A heading element around the trigger when the items are sections of your page outline.
- Nothing else: the chevron is decoration, so give it `aria-hidden="true"`.


---

# Headless Progress indicator

The `ProgressIndicator` parts give you the behaviour of the styled [Progress indicator](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/progress-indicator/) with no styles: an ordered list of steps whose state (complete, current, incomplete) follows the current index, `aria-current="step"` on the current one, and, when it is interactive, buttons that jump to a step.

You own the markup inside each step (the icon, the label, a second line), the words a screen reader hears for each state, and every style. The parts show their state as `data-*` attributes for you to style on.

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { ProgressIndicator } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { ProgressIndicator } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const steps = ['Contract details', 'Signers', 'Review', 'Send'];

function StepIcon() {
  const { state } = ProgressIndicator.useStepContext();
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-interactive group-data-incomplete:fill-ink">
      {state === 'complete' ? <path d="M8 1a7 7 0 1 0 0 14A7 7 0 0 0 8 1Zm0 13a6 6 0 1 1 0-12 6 6 0 0 1 0 12Zm-1-2.6-2.7-2.7.7-.7L7 10l4-4 .7.7z" /> : null}
      {state === 'current' ? <path d="M8 1a7 7 0 1 0 0 14A7 7 0 0 0 8 1Zm0 13a6 6 0 0 1 0-12z" /> : null}
      {state === 'incomplete' ? <path d="M8 2a6 6 0 1 1 0 12A6 6 0 0 1 8 2m0-1a7 7 0 1 0 0 14A7 7 0 0 0 8 1Z" /> : null}
    </svg>
  );
}

const words = { complete: 'Complete', current: 'Current', incomplete: 'Incomplete' };

function StateWords() {
  const { state } = ProgressIndicator.useStepContext();
  return <span className="sr-only">{words[state]}</span>;
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <ProgressIndicator.Root currentIndex={1} className="flex">
      {steps.map((label) => (
        <ProgressIndicator.Step key={label} className="w-32 border-t-2 border-interactive data-incomplete:border-hairline">
          <ProgressIndicator.StepButton className="group flex w-full gap-2 pt-2 pe-4 text-start text-sm text-ink">
            <StepIcon />
            {label}
            <StateWords />
          </ProgressIndicator.StepButton>
        </ProgressIndicator.Step>
      ))}
    </ProgressIndicator.Root>
  );
}
```

Each direct child of `Root` is one step, by its position: the first is index 0. `useStepContext()` gives a component inside a step its `state`, so the icon and the screen-reader words can follow it.

## Anatomy

```tsx
<ProgressIndicator.Root currentIndex={0}>
  <ProgressIndicator.Step>
    <ProgressIndicator.StepButton />
  </ProgressIndicator.Step>
</ProgressIndicator.Root>
```

## Invalid, disabled and complete steps

Three flags on a `Step` add to the state from the index:

- `complete` marks the step done whatever the current index says (`data-complete`).
- `invalid` sets `data-invalid`: show a warning in your style.
- `disabled` disables the step's button (`data-disabled`); it can't be clicked or focused.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { ProgressIndicator } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const steps = [
  { label: 'Contract details' },
  { label: 'Signers' },
  { label: 'Attachments', complete: true },
  { label: 'Review', invalid: true },
  { label: 'Send', disabled: true },
];

const words = { complete: 'Complete', current: 'Current', incomplete: 'Incomplete' };

function StepWords() {
  const { state, invalid } = ProgressIndicator.useStepContext();
  return <span className="sr-only">{invalid ? 'Invalid' : words[state]}</span>;
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <ProgressIndicator.Root currentIndex={1} className="flex flex-wrap">
      {steps.map(({ label, ...flags }) => (
        <ProgressIndicator.Step key={label} {...flags} className="w-32 border-t-2 border-interactive data-incomplete:border-hairline">
          <ProgressIndicator.StepButton className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 pt-2 pe-4 text-start text-sm text-ink data-current:font-semibold data-invalid:text-error-text data-disabled:text-ink-disabled">
            <span aria-hidden="true" className="flex size-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-current text-[10px]">
              {flags.complete ? '✓' : null}
            </span>
            {label}
            <StepWords />
          </ProgressIndicator.StepButton>
        </ProgressIndicator.Step>
      ))}
    </ProgressIndicator.Root>
  );
}
```

## Let the user jump between steps

`interactive` puts the buttons in the Tab order. A click on a step that is not current and not disabled makes it current and calls `onChange` with its index (`data-clickable` marks those steps). Hold the index with `currentIndex`, or give `defaultCurrentIndex` and let `Root` keep it.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ProgressIndicator } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const steps = ['Contract details', 'Signers', 'Review', 'Send'];

export default function Example() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(2);
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <ProgressIndicator.Root interactive currentIndex={step} onChange={setStep} className="flex">
        {steps.map((label) => (
          <ProgressIndicator.Step key={label} className="w-32 border-t-2 border-interactive data-incomplete:border-hairline">
            <ProgressIndicator.StepButton className="flex w-full pt-2 pe-4 text-start text-sm text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-clickable:cursor-pointer data-clickable:text-link data-clickable:hover:underline data-current:font-semibold">
              {label}
            </ProgressIndicator.StepButton>
          </ProgressIndicator.Step>
        ))}
      </ProgressIndicator.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Current step: {step}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Back and Next buttons

Without `interactive` the steps don't react to clicks and stay out of the Tab order: your own buttons move through the task by changing `currentIndex`.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ProgressIndicator } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const steps = ['Contract details', 'Signers', 'Review', 'Send'];

export default function Example() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <ProgressIndicator.Root currentIndex={step} className="flex">
        {steps.map((label) => (
          <ProgressIndicator.Step key={label} className="w-32 border-t-2 border-interactive data-incomplete:border-hairline">
            <ProgressIndicator.StepButton className="flex w-full pt-2 pe-4 text-start text-sm text-ink-muted data-complete:text-ink data-current:font-semibold data-current:text-ink">
              {label}
            </ProgressIndicator.StepButton>
          </ProgressIndicator.Step>
        ))}
      </ProgressIndicator.Root>
      <p className="text-sm text-ink">Step {step + 1} of {steps.length}: {steps[step]}</p>
      <div className="flex gap-px">
        <button type="button" disabled={step === 0} onClick={() => setStep(step - 1)} className="h-10 bg-secondary px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-secondary-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus disabled:bg-button-disabled disabled:text-on-color-disabled">Back</button>
        <button type="button" disabled={step === steps.length - 1} onClick={() => setStep(step + 1)} className="h-10 bg-interactive px-4 text-sm text-on-primary hover:bg-blue-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-focus disabled:bg-button-disabled disabled:text-on-color-disabled">Next</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Vertical

`vertical` sets `data-orientation="vertical"` on the root, every step and every button (`horizontal` otherwise). The layout is yours: here the line runs down the start edge.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { ProgressIndicator } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const steps = [
  { label: 'Request submitted', note: '1 Oct, 09:12' },
  { label: 'Legal review', note: 'In progress' },
  { label: 'Approval by the managing director' },
  { label: 'Signing' },
];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <ProgressIndicator.Root vertical currentIndex={1} className="flex data-[orientation=horizontal]:flex-row data-[orientation=vertical]:flex-col">
      {steps.map((s) => (
        <ProgressIndicator.Step key={s.label} className="min-h-14 border-s-2 border-interactive data-incomplete:border-hairline">
          <ProgressIndicator.StepButton className="flex w-full flex-col ps-4 pt-1 text-start text-sm text-ink data-current:font-semibold">
            {s.label}
            {s.note ? <span className="text-xs font-normal text-ink-muted">{s.note}</span> : null}
          </ProgressIndicator.StepButton>
        </ProgressIndicator.Step>
      ))}
    </ProgressIndicator.Root>
  );
}
```

## Style it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { ProgressIndicator } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const steps = ['Details', 'Signers', 'Review', 'Send'];

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <ProgressIndicator.Root interactive defaultCurrentIndex={1} className="flex">
      {steps.map((label, i) => (
        <ProgressIndicator.Step key={label} invalid={i === 2} className="flex-1 border-t-4 border-interactive data-incomplete:border-hairline data-invalid:border-error">
          <ProgressIndicator.StepButton className="w-full pt-2 pe-4 text-start text-sm text-ink-muted focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-complete:text-ink data-current:font-semibold data-current:text-ink data-invalid:text-error-text data-clickable:cursor-pointer data-clickable:hover:text-link-hover">
            {i + 1}. {label}
          </ProgressIndicator.StepButton>
        </ProgressIndicator.Step>
      ))}
    </ProgressIndicator.Root>
  );
}
```
```css
/* className="step" on Step, "step-button" on StepButton */
.step { border-top: 4px solid #0f62fe; }
.step[data-incomplete] { border-top-color: #e0e0e0; }
.step[data-invalid] { border-top-color: #da1e28; }
.step-button[data-current] { font-weight: 600; }
.step-button[data-clickable] { cursor: pointer; }
.step-button[data-disabled] { color: #c6c6c6; }
```

## Parts

### ProgressIndicator.Root

An `<ol>`. Each direct child is one step, by position, so a component of your own that renders a `Step` works as a child.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `currentIndex` | `number` | | The current step's index, 0-based (controlled) |
| `defaultCurrentIndex` | `number` | `0` | The starting index (uncontrolled) |
| `onChange` | `(index: number) => void` | | After the user jumped to another step |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | `false` | The steps' buttons take Tab and jump on a click |
| `vertical` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets `data-orientation="vertical"` |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-orientation` | `horizontal` or `vertical` |

`ProgressIndicator.useProgressIndicatorContext()` returns `{ currentIndex, vertical, interactive, pick }`. `ProgressIndicator.stepState(index, currentIndex, complete?)` returns the state a step at `index` would have.

### ProgressIndicator.Step

An `<li>`: one step.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `complete` | `boolean` | `false` | Complete whatever the current index says |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets `data-invalid` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Its button is disabled |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-complete` / `data-current` / `data-incomplete` | One of them: the step's state |
| `data-invalid` | `invalid` is set |
| `data-disabled` | `disabled` is set |
| `data-clickable` | A click on its button jumps here: interactive, not disabled, not current |
| `data-orientation` | `horizontal` or `vertical` |

`ProgressIndicator.useStepContext()` returns `{ index, state, invalid, disabled, vertical, interactive, clickable, pick }` to a component inside the step.

### ProgressIndicator.StepButton

A `<button type="button">`. The current step's has `aria-current="step"`. It is out of the Tab order (`tabindex="-1"`) unless the root is `interactive`, and disabled (with `aria-disabled`) when the step is. It takes every button prop except `type`, and has the same data attributes as its `Step`.

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Tab / Shift+Tab | With `interactive`: moves between the step buttons (disabled ones are skipped). Without it the buttons aren't Tab stops. |
| Enter, Space | With `interactive`: jumps to the focused step (nothing on the current one) |

The parts set `aria-current="step"`, `disabled` and `aria-disabled`, and the Tab order. The list is an `<ol>` of `<li>` steps.

You add:

- The label text inside each `StepButton`.
- The state in words for screen readers ("Complete", "Invalid" …), as the `sr-only` text in the first example: an icon alone says nothing.
- A heading that names the task, and the current step in text if the steps are small.


---

# Headless UI shell

Three namespaces give you the behaviour of the styled [UI shell](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/ui-shell/) with no styles:

- `Shell`: `Shell.Root` holds whether the side nav is open, so the hamburger and the side nav wire themselves to each other; `Shell.Content` is the `<main>` that tells how the side nav beside it lays out.
- `Header`: the `<header>`, the skip link, the hamburger, menus of links that open and close, icon buttons and the panel under the header, with Esc, clicks outside and focus return.
- `SideNav`: the `<nav>` with its modes (default, rail, fixed, collapsible), the overlay, links and menus, with Esc and focus leaving.

You own every element's look and position: the 48px bar, the 256px nav, the offsets of the content, the icons and the words. The parts show their state as `data-*` attributes for you to style on.

The examples sit in a box whose `transform` keeps their `position: fixed` parts inside it, and their links only change the example's state, so a click doesn't leave this page. In your app the header and the nav are fixed to the window.

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { Header, Shell, SideNav } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState, type MouseEvent } from 'react';
import { Header, Shell, SideNav } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const link = 'flex h-8 items-center px-4 text-sm whitespace-nowrap text-ink-muted hover:bg-canvas-hover hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-current:border-s-4 data-current:border-interactive data-current:bg-canvas-selected data-current:ps-3 data-current:font-semibold data-current:text-ink';

export default function Example() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState('Dashboard');
  // a router stand-in: the links change the example's page instead of loading one
  const go = (name: string, path: string) => ({
    href: `#${path}`,
    current: page === name,
    onClick: (event: MouseEvent) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      setPage(name);
    },
  });
  return (
    <div className="relative h-80 overflow-hidden border border-hairline bg-canvas text-ink [transform:translateZ(0)]">
      <Shell.Root>
        <Header.Root aria-label="Metro Contracts" className="fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-20 flex h-12 items-center border-b border-border-subtle-1 bg-canvas">
          <Header.SkipToContent href="#headless-shell-main" className="absolute -translate-y-full bg-canvas px-4 py-3 text-sm focus:translate-y-0 focus:outline-2 focus:outline-focus">
            Skip to main content
          </Header.SkipToContent>
          <Header.MenuButton aria-label="Menu" className="group flex size-12 items-center justify-center text-icon-primary hover:bg-canvas-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-active:bg-surface-1 min-[1056px]:hidden">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true" className="size-5 fill-current group-data-active:hidden">
              <path d="M2 14.8h16v1.2H2zm0-5.4h16v1.2H2zM2 4h16v1.2H2z" />
            </svg>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true" className="hidden size-5 fill-current group-data-active:block">
              <path d="M15 5.8 14.2 5 10 9.2 5.8 5 5 5.8 9.2 10 5 14.2l.8.8 4.2-4.2 4.2 4.2.8-.8L10.8 10z" />
            </svg>
          </Header.MenuButton>
          <a {...go('Dashboard', 'dashboard')} className="px-4 text-sm font-semibold focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
            <span className="font-normal">Metro</span> Contracts
          </a>
        </Header.Root>
        <SideNav.Root>
          <SideNav.Overlay className="fixed inset-x-0 top-12 bottom-0 z-10 hidden bg-overlay data-open:block min-[1056px]:data-open:hidden" />
          <SideNav.Nav aria-label="Sections" className="fixed start-0 top-12 bottom-0 z-20 w-0 overflow-hidden bg-canvas transition-[width] data-open:w-64">
            <ul className="pt-4">
              <li><SideNav.Link {...go('Dashboard', 'dashboard')} className={link}>Dashboard</SideNav.Link></li>
              <SideNav.Menu defaultExpanded>
                <SideNav.MenuTrigger className="group flex h-8 w-full items-center justify-between px-4 text-start text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap text-ink-muted hover:bg-canvas-hover hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
                  Requests
                  <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
                    <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
                  </svg>
                </SideNav.MenuTrigger>
                <SideNav.MenuPopup className="hidden data-open:block">
                  <li><SideNav.MenuItem {...go('Open', 'open')} className={`${link} ps-8 data-current:ps-7`}>Open</SideNav.MenuItem></li>
                  <li><SideNav.MenuItem {...go('Awaiting signature', 'signing')} className={`${link} ps-8 data-current:ps-7`}>Awaiting signature</SideNav.MenuItem></li>
                </SideNav.MenuPopup>
              </SideNav.Menu>
              <li><SideNav.Link {...go('Settings', 'settings')} className={link}>Settings</SideNav.Link></li>
            </ul>
          </SideNav.Nav>
        </SideNav.Root>
        <Shell.Content id="headless-shell-main" className="mt-12 p-8 transition-[margin] min-[1056px]:data-[side-nav=default]:ms-64">
          <p className="text-2xl">{page}</p>
        </Shell.Content>
      </Shell.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Inside `Shell.Root` the `MenuButton` opens and closes the side nav with no props, and gets `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. The nav is open beside the content from Carbon's `lg` breakpoint, 1056px (`data-open`); below it, the hamburger opens it over the page with the overlay.

## Anatomy

```tsx
<Shell.Root>
  <Header.Root>
    <Header.SkipToContent />
    <Header.MenuButton />
    <nav>
      <ul>
        <li><Header.MenuItem /></li>
        <Header.Menu>
          <Header.MenuTrigger />
          <Header.MenuPopup>
            <li><Header.MenuItem /></li>
          </Header.MenuPopup>
        </Header.Menu>
      </ul>
    </nav>
    <Header.GlobalAction />
    <Header.Panel>
      <Header.PanelContent />
    </Header.Panel>
  </Header.Root>
  <SideNav.Root>
    <SideNav.Overlay />
    <SideNav.Nav>
      <ul>
        <li><SideNav.Link /></li>
        <SideNav.Menu>
          <SideNav.MenuTrigger />
          <SideNav.MenuPopup>
            <li><SideNav.MenuItem /></li>
          </SideNav.MenuPopup>
        </SideNav.Menu>
      </ul>
    </SideNav.Nav>
  </SideNav.Root>
  <Shell.Content />
</Shell.Root>
```

The product name link, the menu bar's `<nav>` and the group around the global actions have no behaviour: they are your own elements.

## Header menus

`Header.Menu` is an `<li>` holding a `MenuTrigger` button and a `MenuPopup` list of `MenuItem` links: a disclosure, not an ARIA menu. Click, Enter or Space toggle it; Esc closes it and focuses the trigger; a press outside or focus leaving closes it; following one of its links closes it and focuses the trigger. A closed menu has `data-current` when one of its items is `current`.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState, type MouseEvent } from 'react';
import { Header } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const bar = 'relative flex h-12 items-center px-4 text-sm whitespace-nowrap text-ink-muted hover:bg-canvas-hover hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-current:border-b-[3px] data-current:border-interactive data-current:text-ink';
const row = 'flex h-12 items-center px-4 text-sm text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-current:bg-layer-selected-1 data-current:text-ink';

export default function Example() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState('Monthly');
  const go = (name: string, path: string) => ({
    href: `#${path}`,
    current: page === name,
    onClick: (event: MouseEvent) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      setPage(name);
    },
  });
  return (
    <div className="relative h-60 overflow-hidden border border-hairline bg-canvas text-ink [transform:translateZ(0)]">
      <Header.Root aria-label="Metro Contracts" className="fixed inset-x-0 top-0 flex h-12 items-center border-b border-border-subtle-1 bg-canvas">
        <span className="px-4 text-sm font-semibold"><span className="font-normal">Metro</span> Contracts</span>
        <nav aria-label="Metro Contracts">
          <ul className="flex">
            <li><Header.MenuItem {...go('Requests', 'requests')} className={bar}>Requests</Header.MenuItem></li>
            <Header.Menu className="relative">
              <Header.MenuTrigger className={`${bar} group gap-2`}>
                Reports
                <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current transition-transform group-data-open:rotate-180">
                  <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
                </svg>
              </Header.MenuTrigger>
              <Header.MenuPopup aria-label="Reports" className="absolute start-0 top-12 hidden w-50 bg-surface-1 shadow-lg data-open:block">
                <li><Header.MenuItem {...go('Monthly', 'monthly')} className={row}>Monthly</Header.MenuItem></li>
                <li><Header.MenuItem {...go('Yearly', 'yearly')} className={row}>Yearly</Header.MenuItem></li>
                <li><Header.MenuItem {...go('Audit log', 'audit')} className={row}>Audit log</Header.MenuItem></li>
              </Header.MenuPopup>
            </Header.Menu>
          </ul>
        </nav>
      </Header.Root>
      <p className="mt-12 p-8 text-sm text-ink-muted">Page: {page}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`current` on a `Menu` shows the mark even while it is open (Carbon's `isActive`). The menu finds a `current` item by reading the props of the elements written inside it, so set `current` on the `MenuItem` itself, not on a wrapper component under another name.

## Global actions and a panel

`Header.GlobalAction` is an icon button of two kinds: with `active` it is a toggle (`aria-pressed`); with `expanded` it is a disclosure (`aria-expanded`) for a panel. `Header.Panel` is controlled: it asks to close with `onClose(reason)` on Esc (focus goes back to what opened it), when focus leaves it, or on a press outside, but not on the action whose `aria-controls` is the panel's `id`, which toggles it.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Header } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const action = 'flex size-12 items-center justify-center text-icon-secondary hover:bg-canvas-hover hover:text-icon-primary focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-active:bg-surface-1 data-active:text-icon-primary';

export default function Example() {
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(false);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <div className="relative h-72 overflow-hidden border border-hairline bg-canvas text-ink [transform:translateZ(0)]">
        <Header.Root aria-label="Metro Contracts" className="fixed inset-x-0 top-0 flex h-12 items-center border-b border-border-subtle-1 bg-canvas">
          <span className="px-4 text-sm font-semibold"><span className="font-normal">Metro</span> Contracts</span>
          <div role="group" aria-label="Global actions" className="ms-auto flex">
            <Header.GlobalAction aria-label="Mute notifications" active={muted} onClick={() => setMuted(!muted)} className={action}>
              <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true" className="size-5 fill-current">
                <path d="M17 14.3V13l-1.5-1.5V8a5.5 5.5 0 0 0-4.6-5.4V1.4H9.1v1.2A5.5 5.5 0 0 0 4.5 8v3.5L3 13v1.3h4.4a2.6 2.6 0 0 0 5.2 0ZM10 15.9a1.3 1.3 0 0 1-1.3-1.3h2.6a1.3 1.3 0 0 1-1.3 1.3Z" />
              </svg>
            </Header.GlobalAction>
            <Header.GlobalAction aria-label="Applications" expanded={open} aria-controls="headless-shell-apps" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)} className={action}>
              <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true" className="size-5 fill-current">
                <path d="M4 4h3v3H4zm4.5 0h3v3h-3zM13 4h3v3h-3zM4 8.5h3v3H4zm4.5 0h3v3h-3zm4.5 0h3v3h-3zM4 13h3v3H4zm4.5 0h3v3h-3zm4.5 0h3v3h-3z" />
              </svg>
            </Header.GlobalAction>
          </div>
          <Header.Panel
            id="headless-shell-apps"
            expanded={open}
            onClose={(why) => {
              setOpen(false);
              setReason(why);
            }}
            className="fixed end-0 top-12 bottom-0 w-0 overflow-hidden border-hairline bg-surface-1 transition-[width] data-open:w-64 data-open:border-s"
          >
            <Header.PanelContent aria-label="Applications">
              <ul className="py-2">
                <li><a href="#contracts" onClick={(e) => e.preventDefault()} aria-current="page" className="block px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-ink hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">Contracts</a></li>
                <li><a href="#audit" onClick={(e) => e.preventDefault()} className="block px-4 py-2 text-sm text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">Audit management</a></li>
              </ul>
            </Header.PanelContent>
          </Header.Panel>
        </Header.Root>
      </div>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Muted: {muted ? 'yes' : 'no'} · Panel: {open ? 'open' : 'closed'}{reason ? ` · last close: ${reason}` : ''}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`PanelContent` is a `<section>`: named with `aria-label`, it is a region landmark. It has `hidden` while the panel is closed.

## Side nav modes

`SideNav.Root` takes the mode; `Nav` writes it in `data-ui-side-nav`, and `Shell.Content` copies it to its `data-side-nav` so you can offset the page:

- default: over the page below `lg`, beside it from `lg` (`data-open` from 1056px).
- `rail`: a strip of icons that is `data-open` while the pointer is on it or focus is inside (`data-expanded` too).
- `fixed`: always `data-open`, never an overlay.
- `collapsible`: closed at every width until the hamburger opens it over the page.

Pick a mode, then point at the nav, use the hamburger and press Esc.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState, type MouseEvent } from 'react';
import { Header, Shell, SideNav } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const modes: SideNav.SideNavMode[] = ['default', 'rail', 'fixed', 'collapsible'];

const link = 'flex h-8 items-center gap-6 px-4 text-sm whitespace-nowrap text-ink-muted hover:bg-canvas-hover hover:text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-current:border-s-4 data-current:border-interactive data-current:bg-canvas-selected data-current:ps-3 data-current:font-semibold data-current:text-ink';

const icons = {
  Dashboard: 'M2 2h5v5H2zm7 0h5v5H9zM2 9h5v5H2zm7 0h5v5H9z',
  Requests: 'M13 3.6 10.4 1H3v14h10zM10 2.4 11.6 4H10zM4 14V2h5v3h3v9z',
  Settings: 'M13.5 8.4a5.4 5.4 0 0 0 0-.8l1.4-1.1-1.3-2.3-1.7.6a5 5 0 0 0-.7-.4L10.9 2.6H8.3L8 4.4l-.7.4-1.7-.6-1.3 2.3 1.4 1.1a5.4 5.4 0 0 0 0 .8L4.3 9.5l1.3 2.3 1.7-.6.7.4.3 1.8h2.6l.3-1.8.7-.4 1.7.6 1.3-2.3zM9.6 10a2 2 0 1 1 0-4 2 2 0 0 1 0 4Z',
};

export default function Example() {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<SideNav.SideNavMode>('rail');
  const [page, setPage] = useState('Dashboard');
  const hamburger = mode === 'collapsible' ? '' : 'min-[1056px]:hidden';
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <fieldset className="flex flex-wrap gap-4 text-sm text-ink">
        <legend className="mb-2 text-xs text-ink-muted">Mode</legend>
        {modes.map((m) => (
          <label key={m} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <input type="radio" name="headless-shell-mode" checked={mode === m} onChange={() => setMode(m)} className="accent-interactive" />
            {m}
          </label>
        ))}
      </fieldset>
      <div className="relative h-80 overflow-hidden border border-hairline bg-canvas text-ink [transform:translateZ(0)]">
        <Shell.Root key={mode}>
          <Header.Root aria-label="Metro Contracts" className="fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-20 flex h-12 items-center border-b border-border-subtle-1 bg-canvas">
            <Header.MenuButton aria-label="Menu" className={`flex size-12 items-center justify-center text-icon-primary hover:bg-canvas-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-active:bg-surface-1 ${hamburger}`}>
              <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true" className="size-5 fill-current">
                <path d="M2 14.8h16v1.2H2zm0-5.4h16v1.2H2zM2 4h16v1.2H2z" />
              </svg>
            </Header.MenuButton>
            <span className="px-4 text-sm font-semibold"><span className="font-normal">Metro</span> Contracts</span>
          </Header.Root>
          <SideNav.Root rail={mode === 'rail'} fixed={mode === 'fixed'} collapsible={mode === 'collapsible'}>
            <SideNav.Overlay className="fixed inset-x-0 top-12 bottom-0 z-10 hidden bg-overlay data-open:block min-[1056px]:data-open:hidden" />
            <SideNav.Nav aria-label="Sections" className="fixed start-0 top-12 bottom-0 z-20 w-0 overflow-hidden bg-canvas transition-[width] data-[ui-side-nav=rail]:w-12 data-open:w-64!">
              <ul className="pt-4">
                {Object.entries(icons).map(([name, d]) => (
                  <li key={name}>
                    <SideNav.Link
                      href={`#${name.toLowerCase()}`}
                      current={page === name}
                      onClick={(event: MouseEvent) => {
                        event.preventDefault();
                        setPage(name);
                      }}
                      className={link}
                    >
                      <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 fill-current"><path d={d} /></svg>
                      {name}
                    </SideNav.Link>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </SideNav.Nav>
          </SideNav.Root>
          {/* several shells share this page: say the mode instead of letting Content look for it */}
          <Shell.Content sideNav={mode} id="headless-shell-modes-main" className="mt-12 p-8 transition-[margin] data-[side-nav=fixed]:ms-64 data-[side-nav=rail]:ms-12 min-[1056px]:data-[side-nav=default]:ms-64">
            <p className="text-2xl">{page}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">data-side-nav="{mode}"</p>
          </Shell.Content>
        </Shell.Root>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Left without `sideNav`, `Content` looks for the first `[data-ui-side-nav]` in the document (and in its own shadow root) after each render. One shell per page, as in an app, needs no prop; this page holds several, so the examples after the first say it.

## Without Shell.Root

Leave out `Shell.Root` to hold the state yourself: `active` and `onToggle` on the `MenuButton`, `expanded` and `onToggle` on `SideNav.Root`. The side nav's `onToggle` asks to close on Esc, a click on the overlay, or focus leaving it while it is over the page; nothing changes until you pass the new state back.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Header, SideNav } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [asked, setAsked] = useState('nothing yet');
  const toggle = (next: boolean) => {
    setOpen(next);
    setAsked(next ? 'open' : 'close');
  };
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <div className="relative h-64 overflow-hidden border border-hairline bg-canvas text-ink [transform:translateZ(0)]">
        <Header.Root aria-label="Metro Contracts" className="fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-20 flex h-12 items-center border-b border-border-subtle-1 bg-canvas">
          <Header.MenuButton aria-label="Menu" aria-controls="headless-shell-own-nav" active={open} onToggle={toggle} className="flex size-12 items-center justify-center text-icon-primary hover:bg-canvas-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-active:bg-surface-1">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true" className="size-5 fill-current">
              <path d="M2 14.8h16v1.2H2zm0-5.4h16v1.2H2zM2 4h16v1.2H2z" />
            </svg>
          </Header.MenuButton>
          <span className="px-4 text-sm font-semibold"><span className="font-normal">Metro</span> Contracts</span>
        </Header.Root>
        <SideNav.Root collapsible expanded={open} onToggle={toggle}>
          <SideNav.Overlay className="fixed inset-x-0 top-12 bottom-0 z-10 hidden bg-overlay data-open:block" />
          <SideNav.Nav id="headless-shell-own-nav" aria-label="Sections" className="fixed start-0 top-12 bottom-0 z-20 w-0 overflow-hidden bg-canvas transition-[width] data-open:w-64">
            <ul className="pt-4">
              <li><SideNav.Link href="#requests" onClick={(e) => e.preventDefault()} className="flex h-8 items-center px-4 text-sm whitespace-nowrap text-ink-muted hover:bg-canvas-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">Requests</SideNav.Link></li>
              <li><SideNav.Link href="#templates" onClick={(e) => e.preventDefault()} className="flex h-8 items-center px-4 text-sm whitespace-nowrap text-ink-muted hover:bg-canvas-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">Templates</SideNav.Link></li>
            </ul>
          </SideNav.Nav>
        </SideNav.Root>
        <p className="mt-12 p-8 text-sm text-ink-muted">The overlay covers this box while the nav is open.</p>
      </div>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Last asked: {asked}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Style it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState, type MouseEvent } from 'react';
import { Header, Shell, SideNav } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  const [page, setPage] = useState('Requests');

      <Shell.Root>

          <Header.MenuButton aria-label="Menu" className="flex size-12 items-center justify-center hover:bg-inverse-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus-inverse data-active:bg-interactive">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true" className="size-5 fill-current">
              <path d="M2 14.8h16v1.2H2zm0-5.4h16v1.2H2zM2 4h16v1.2H2z" />
            </svg>

          <span className="px-4 text-sm font-semibold">Contracts</span>
        </Header.Root>
        <SideNav.Root collapsible>

            <ul className="grid gap-1 p-2">
              {['Requests', 'Templates', 'Settings'].map((name) => (
                <li key={name}>
                  <SideNav.Link {...go(name, name.toLowerCase())} className="flex h-8 items-center rounded px-3 text-sm whitespace-nowrap text-ink-muted hover:bg-layer-hover-1 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-current:bg-interactive data-current:text-on-primary">
```

## Parts

### Shell.Root

Renders no element: only its children. It holds the side nav's expanded state for a `Header.MenuButton` and a `SideNav.Root` inside it.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sideNavExpanded` | `boolean` | | The side nav is open (controlled) |
| `defaultSideNavExpanded` | `boolean` | `false` | Open on the first render (uncontrolled) |
| `onSideNavExpandedChange` | `(expanded: boolean) => void` | | The hamburger, Esc, the overlay or focus leaving asked for this state |

`Shell.useShellContext()` returns `{ sideNavExpanded, setSideNavExpanded, sideNavId }`, or `null` outside a `Shell.Root`.

### Shell.Content

A `<main>` with the id `main-content` (the skip link's default target).

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sideNav` | `'default' \| 'rail' \| 'fixed' \| 'collapsible' \| 'none'` | found on the page | How the side nav beside it lays out |
| `id` | `string` | `'main-content'` | The skip link's target |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-side-nav` | The mode: `sideNav`, else the first `[data-ui-side-nav]` in the document (or its shadow root), else `none` |

### Header.Root

A `<header>`, the banner landmark: name it with `aria-label`. It sets `data-ui-header`, which a toaster uses to start below the header. No props of its own.

### Header.SkipToContent

An `<a>` to the content; hide it until it has focus. Inside a shadow root (a micro app) a click moves focus to the target itself, which the browser can't find there.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `href` | `string` | `'#main-content'` | The content's id as a fragment |

### Header.MenuButton

A `<button type="button">` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` (the `Shell.Root`'s side nav id unless you pass your own). Name it with `aria-label`, by its state if you like ("Open menu" / "Close menu").

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active` | `boolean` | the shell's state, else `false` | The side nav it controls is open |
| `onToggle` | `(active: boolean) => void` | | The user asked for the other state |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-active` | The side nav is open |

### Header.Menu

An `<li>` holding a `MenuTrigger` and a `MenuPopup`.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | | Open (controlled) |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | Open on the first render |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | | The user opened or closed it |
| `current` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the current-section mark even while open (Carbon `isActive`) |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | It is open |
| `data-current` | `current`, or closed with a `current` item inside |

`Header.useMenuContext()` returns the menu's state; `Header.useOptionalMenuContext()` returns it or `null` in the menu bar.

### Header.MenuTrigger

A `<button type="button">` with `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` (its popup) and `tabindex="0"` (so Safari focuses it on click and Tab reaches it). It has the same `data-open` and `data-current` as its menu.

### Header.MenuPopup

A `<ul>` with the menu's id: name it with `aria-label` (the trigger's text) and hide it while `data-open` is absent.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | The menu is open |

### Header.MenuItem

An `<a>` of the menu bar or of a menu. Following it inside a menu closes the menu and focuses its trigger. It keeps `target` and `rel`.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `current` | `boolean` | `false` | The current page (`aria-current="page"`) |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-current` | `current` is set |

### Header.GlobalAction

A `<button type="button">` with `tabindex="0"`. Name it with `aria-label` (or a tooltip that labels it).

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `active` | `boolean` | `false` | Pressed: a toggle (`aria-pressed`) |
| `expanded` | `boolean` | | Its panel is open: a disclosure (`aria-expanded`); pair it with `aria-controls` = the panel's `id` |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-active` | Pressed, or its panel is open |

### Header.Panel

A `<div>`: the panel under the header. Give it the `id` its action's `aria-controls` names.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expanded` | `boolean` | | Open (required, controlled) |
| `onClose` | `(reason: 'escape' \| 'blur' \| 'outside') => void` | | Asks to close: Esc (focus goes back to what opened it), focus leaving, a press outside (not on its action) |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-open` | It is open |

### Header.PanelContent
