```tsx
    <TreeView.Row style={{ paddingInlineStart: 8 + node.depth * 24 }} className="flex h-8 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 pe-4 text-sm text-ink-muted hover:bg-ghost-hover data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:text-ink">
      {caret}
      {children}
      {node.loading ? <span className="sr-only">, loading</span> : null}
    </TreeView.Row>
  );
}

const nodeClass = 'outline-none [&:focus-visible>:first-child]:outline-2 [&:focus-visible>:first-child]:-outline-offset-2 [&:focus-visible>:first-child]:outline-focus';
const folders = [
  { value: 'civil', label: 'Civil cases' },
  { value: 'criminal', label: 'Criminal cases' },
  { value: 'empty', label: 'Empty folder' },
];

/** A pretend server: three files after 800ms, none for the empty folder. */
const fetchFolder = (value: string) =>
  new Promise<string[]>((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(value === 'empty' ? [] : [1, 2, 3].map((n) => `${value}-${n}`)), 800));

export default function Example() {
  const [children, setChildren] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({});
  const load = async (value: string) => {
    const files = await fetchFolder(value);
    setChildren((now) => ({ ...now, [value]: files }));
  };
  return (
    <TreeView.Root aria-label="Case files on the server" className="max-w-xs bg-layer-1">
      {folders.map((folder) => {
        const files = children[folder.value] ?? [];
        return (
          <TreeView.Node key={folder.value} value={folder.value} label={folder.label} lazy hasChildren={files.length > 0} onLazyLoad={load} className={nodeClass}>
            <Row>{folder.label}</Row>
            <TreeView.Group>
              {files.map((file) => (
                <TreeView.Node key={file} value={file} label={file} className={nodeClass}>
                  <Row>File {file}</Row>
                </TreeView.Node>
              ))}
            </TreeView.Group>
          </TreeView.Node>
        );
      })}
    </TreeView.Root>
  );
}
```

## Links

Put an `<a>` in a node's `Row`. Enter follows the node's own link (after selecting it); keep the link out of the Tab order with `tabIndex={-1}`, since the node takes the keyboard.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { TreeView } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const policies = [
  { value: 'retention', label: 'Retention policy', href: '#retention' },
  { value: 'signing', label: 'Signing authority', href: '#signing' },
];

export default function Example() {
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState('');
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-xs gap-2">
      <TreeView.Root aria-label="Policies" className="bg-layer-1">
        {policies.map((p) => (
          <TreeView.Node key={p.value} value={p.value} label={p.label} className="outline-none [&:focus-visible>:first-child]:outline-2 [&:focus-visible>:first-child]:-outline-offset-2 [&:focus-visible>:first-child]:outline-focus">
            <TreeView.Row className="flex h-8 items-center px-4 text-sm hover:bg-ghost-hover data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1">
              <a
                href={p.href}
                tabIndex={-1}
                className="text-link no-underline"
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault(); // route in the app instead
                  setOpened(p.href);
                }}
              >
                {p.label}
              </a>
            </TreeView.Row>
          </TreeView.Node>
        ))}
      </TreeView.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Would open: {opened}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Style it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { TreeView } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const folderIcon = <path d="M14 4H8.6L7.3 2.3A1 1 0 0 0 6.5 2H2a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h12a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V5a1 1 0 0 0-1-1ZM2 3h4.5l1.3 1.7A1 1 0 0 0 8.6 5H14v1H2Zm0 10V7h12v6Z" />;
const docIcon = <path d="M13 3.6 10.4 1H3v14h10zM10 2.4 11.6 4H10zM4 14V2h5v3h3v9z" />;

function Row({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const node = TreeView.useNodeContext();
  return (
    <TreeView.Row
      style={{ paddingInlineStart: 8 + node.depth * 24 }}
      className="group/row relative flex h-8 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 pe-4 text-sm text-ink-muted hover:bg-ghost-hover hover:text-ink data-selected:bg-layer-selected-1 data-selected:text-ink data-active:before:absolute data-active:before:inset-y-0 data-active:before:start-0 data-active:before:w-1 data-active:before:bg-interactive data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-ink-disabled"
    >
      {node.branch ? (
        <TreeView.Toggle className="flex size-4 items-center justify-center">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" className="size-4 -rotate-90 fill-icon-secondary transition-transform group-data-expanded/row:rotate-0"><path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" /></svg>
        </TreeView.Toggle>
      ) : (
        <span className="size-4" />
      )}
      <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-icon-secondary group-data-selected/row:fill-icon-primary">{node.branch ? folderIcon : docIcon}</svg>
      {children}
    </TreeView.Row>
  );
}

const nodeClass = 'outline-none [&:focus-visible>:first-child]:outline-2 [&:focus-visible>:first-child]:-outline-offset-2 [&:focus-visible>:first-child]:outline-focus';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <TreeView.Root aria-label="Contract folder" defaultSelected={['sa']} defaultActive="sa" className="max-w-xs bg-layer-1">
      <TreeView.Node value="acme" label="Acme Co., Ltd." hasChildren defaultExpanded className={nodeClass}>
        <Row>Acme Co., Ltd.</Row>
        <TreeView.Group>
          <TreeView.Node value="sa" label="Service agreement.pdf" className={nodeClass}><Row>Service agreement.pdf</Row></TreeView.Node>
          <TreeView.Node value="pl" label="Price list.pdf" className={nodeClass}><Row>Price list.pdf</Row></TreeView.Node>
          <TreeView.Node value="draft" label="Draft.pdf" disabled className={nodeClass}><Row>Draft.pdf</Row></TreeView.Node>
        </TreeView.Group>
      </TreeView.Node>
    </TreeView.Root>
  );
}
```
```css
[role='treeitem'] { outline: none; }
[role='treeitem']:focus-visible > .tree-row { outline: 2px solid #0f62fe; outline-offset: -2px; }
.tree-row:hover { background: #e8e8e8; }
.tree-row[data-selected] { background: #e0e0e0; color: #161616; }
.tree-row[data-active] { box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 #0f62fe; }
.tree-row[data-disabled] { color: #c6c6c6; cursor: not-allowed; }
.tree-caret { transform: rotate(-90deg); }
.tree-caret[data-expanded] { transform: none; }
```

## Parts

### TreeView.Root

Renders a `<div role="tree">` and handles the keys, clicks and the one Tab stop for every node inside. It takes every `<div>` prop except `role`.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `multiselect` | `boolean` | `false` | Ctrl / ⌘ + click and Space toggle nodes; Ctrl / ⌘ + A selects all (`aria-multiselectable`) |
| `selected` | `readonly string[]` | | Selected node values (controlled) |
| `defaultSelected` | `readonly string[]` | `[]` | The starting selection (uncontrolled) |
| `onSelect` | `(selected: string[], value: string) => void` | | After the user changed the selection; `value` is the node that did it |
| `active` | `string` | | The node last activated (controlled) |
| `defaultActive` | `string` | `''` | The starting active node (uncontrolled) |
| `onActivate` | `(value: string) => void` | | After a node became the active one |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-multiselect` | `multiselect` is set |

`TreeView.useTreeViewContext()` returns `multiselect`, `selected`, `active` and `tabStop` to any component inside `Root`.

### TreeView.Node

Renders a `<div role="treeitem">` with `aria-expanded` (branches), `aria-selected`, `aria-disabled` and `aria-busy`. Put its `Row` and, for a branch, its `Group` inside. It takes every `<div>` prop except `role`.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` | | Identifies the node in `selected` and `active` (required) |
| `label` | `string` | `value` | The text typing matches |
| `hasChildren` | `boolean` | `false` | The node has child nodes in its `Group`: a branch |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Can't be selected or opened; the keys skip it |
| `expanded` | `boolean` | | Open (controlled) |
| `defaultExpanded` | `boolean` | `false` | Open at first (uncontrolled) |
| `onToggle` | `(expanded: boolean) => void` | | After the branch opened or closed |
| `lazy` | `boolean` | `false` | A branch whose children aren't loaded yet |
| `onLazyLoad` | `(value: string) => void \| Promise<void>` | | Called the first time a `lazy` node opens |

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-selected` | The node is selected |
| `data-active` | The node is the active one |
| `data-disabled` | `disabled` is set |
| `data-branch` | It has children, or is `lazy` and may get some |
| `data-expanded` | A branch that is open |
| `data-loading` | A `lazy` node waiting for its children |

`TreeView.useNodeContext()` returns the node's `value`, `branch`, `expanded`, `loading`, `selected`, `active`, `disabled`, `depth` (0 at the top level), `rowId` and `toggle(expanded)`.

### TreeView.Row

Renders a `<div>`: what the user sees and clicks. Its id names the node's `Group`. It has the same `data-*` attributes as its `Node`.

### TreeView.Toggle

Renders a `<button type="button">` that opens and closes the branch; a click on the rest of the row selects instead. It is out of the Tab order and hidden from assistive tech (`aria-hidden`), since the node takes the keyboard.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-expanded` | The branch is open |

### TreeView.Group

Renders a `<div role="group">` holding the child nodes, named by the row (`aria-labelledby`) and `hidden` while the branch is closed. Each `Group` adds one to the depth of the nodes inside.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-expanded` | The branch is open |

## Keyboard and accessibility

- One Tab stop for the whole tree: the node focused last, else the selected one, else the first visible one.
- Up / Down move through the visible nodes, Home / End jump to the first / last. Right opens a branch or moves to its first child; Left closes it or moves to the parent.
- Enter opens or closes a branch, selects the node and follows the node's own link. Space selects (toggles in a `multiselect` tree). Typing a letter moves to the next node whose `label` starts with it.
- You add the tree's name (`aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` on `Root`), the indent, the caret and a visible focus style on the row.
- Say "loading" for a loading node in its row (for example a visually hidden text), as the styled tree does.


---

# Headless Code snippet

`CodeSnippet` is the behaviour of the styled [Code snippet](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/code-snippet/) as unstyled React parts. `Code` is the `<code>` whose text, read back after each render, is what gets copied (unless you give `text`). For a multi-line snippet, `Content` holds the code between Carbon's row limits (16px rows, 15 shown while collapsed) and measures it as it resizes, and `Toggle` ("Show more / Show less") is there only while the code is taller than the collapsed limit.

The copy itself is the headless [Copy button](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-copy-button/): pass the context's `copyText` to a `Copy.Root`. You own the box, the copy icon, the tooltip, the button words and every style.

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { CodeSnippet, Copy } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { CodeSnippet, Copy } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

function CopyCode() {
  const { copyText } = CodeSnippet.useCodeSnippetContext();
  return (
    <Copy.Root text={copyText}>
      <Copy.Trigger aria-label="Copy to clipboard" className="grid size-10 shrink-0 cursor-pointer place-items-center bg-surface-1 text-icon-primary hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-copied:text-success">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current">
          <path d="M14 5v9H5V5h9m0-1H5a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v9a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h9a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V5a1 1 0 0 0-1-1Z" />
          <path d="M2 9H1V2a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h7v1H2Z" />
        </svg>
      </Copy.Trigger>
      <Copy.Status className="sr-only">Copied!</Copy.Status>
    </Copy.Root>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <CodeSnippet.Root>
      <div className="flex h-10 max-w-3xl items-center bg-surface-1">
        <div role="textbox" aria-readonly="true" aria-label="Install command" tabIndex={0} className="flex h-full grow items-center overflow-x-auto ps-4 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
          <pre className="m-0 type-code whitespace-pre text-ink">
            <CodeSnippet.Code>npm install @purpurabog/ui</CodeSnippet.Code>
          </pre>
        </div>
        <CopyCode />
      </div>
    </CodeSnippet.Root>
  );
}
```

`Root` renders only its children. The read-only textbox around the code (`role="textbox"`, `aria-readonly`, `tabIndex={0}`) is yours, as in Carbon: it lets keyboard users reach and scroll the code.

## Anatomy

```tsx
<CodeSnippet.Root>
  <CodeSnippet.Content>
    <pre>
      <CodeSnippet.Code />
    </pre>
  </CodeSnippet.Content>
  <CodeSnippet.Toggle />
</CodeSnippet.Root>
```

A single-line or inline snippet needs only `Root` and `Code`.

## Multi-line with Show more

Wrap the code in `Content`: it sets its own `max-height` and `min-height` from the row limits, so give it `overflow-y-auto`. `Toggle` appears once the code is taller than 15 rows; give the code a 16px line height (`type-code`) so the rows line up.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { CodeSnippet } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const contract = `{
  "contract": "CT-2026-0142",
  "title": "Office supplies, FY2026",
  "department": "Procurement",
  "vendor": {
    "name": "Siam Office Co., Ltd.",
    "taxId": "0105556012345"
  },
  "amount": 120000,
  "currency": "THB",
  "startDate": "2026-01-01",
  "endDate": "2026-12-31",
  "approvers": [
    { "step": 1, "role": "Department head" },
    { "step": 2, "role": "Finance" },
    { "step": 3, "role": "Legal" }
  ],
  "status": "awaiting-signature",
  "attachments": ["quotation.pdf", "terms.pdf"]
}`;

function ToggleText() {
  const { expanded } = CodeSnippet.useCodeSnippetContext();
  return <>{expanded ? 'Show less' : 'Show more'}</>;
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <CodeSnippet.Root>
      <div className="relative max-w-3xl bg-surface-1 p-4">
        <CodeSnippet.Content className="overflow-y-auto transition-[max-height] duration-150 data-expanded:pb-4">
          <pre tabIndex={0} role="textbox" aria-readonly="true" aria-multiline="true" aria-label="Contract JSON" className="m-0 type-code whitespace-pre text-ink focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
            <CodeSnippet.Code>{contract}</CodeSnippet.Code>
          </pre>
        </CodeSnippet.Content>
        <CodeSnippet.Toggle className="group absolute end-0 bottom-0 inline-flex h-8 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 bg-surface-1 px-4 text-sm text-ink hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
          <ToggleText />
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-icon-primary transition-transform group-data-expanded:rotate-180">
            <path d="M8 11 3 6l.7-.7L8 9.6l4.3-4.3.7.7z" />
          </svg>
        </CodeSnippet.Toggle>
      </div>
    </CodeSnippet.Root>
  );
}
```

## Hold the open state

`expanded` with `onExpandedChange` holds the state yourself; `defaultExpanded` only sets the start. `onExpandedChange` fires on each press of `Toggle`, and when an open snippet folds back by itself (its code got no taller than `minExpandedRows`).


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { CodeSnippet } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const env = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => `SETTING_${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}=value-${i + 1}`).join('\n');

export default function Example() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="grid max-w-3xl gap-3">
      <CodeSnippet.Root expanded={open} onExpandedChange={setOpen}>
        <div className="relative bg-surface-1 p-4">
          <CodeSnippet.Content className="overflow-y-auto data-expanded:pb-4">
            <pre className="m-0 type-code whitespace-pre text-ink">
              <CodeSnippet.Code>{env}</CodeSnippet.Code>
            </pre>
          </CodeSnippet.Content>
          <CodeSnippet.Toggle className="absolute end-0 bottom-0 h-8 cursor-pointer bg-surface-1 px-4 text-sm text-ink hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
            {open ? 'Show the start only' : 'Show the whole file'}
          </CodeSnippet.Toggle>
        </div>
      </CodeSnippet.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Expanded: {String(open)}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Row limits

`maxCollapsedRows` (15) and `maxExpandedRows` (0, no limit) cap the height in 16px rows; `minCollapsedRows` (3) and `minExpandedRows` (16) set a minimum. `Toggle` shows only when the code is taller than the collapsed limit and expanding would show more. Lower `minExpandedRows` with the collapsed limit, or an open snippet of short code folds back when it is measured again.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { CodeSnippet } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const query = `SELECT c.id, c.title, c.amount, d.name AS department
FROM contracts c
JOIN departments d ON d.id = c.department_id
JOIN vendors v ON v.id = c.vendor_id
WHERE c.status = 'awaiting-signature'
  AND c.amount >= 100000
  AND c.start_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND d.code IN ('PROC', 'LEGAL', 'FIN')
  AND v.blacklisted = false
GROUP BY c.id, d.name
HAVING count(*) > 0
ORDER BY c.amount DESC
LIMIT 50;`;

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <CodeSnippet.Root maxCollapsedRows={4} maxExpandedRows={8} minExpandedRows={0}>
      <div className="relative max-w-3xl bg-surface-1 p-4">
        <CodeSnippet.Content className="overflow-y-auto data-expanded:pb-4">
          <pre className="m-0 type-code whitespace-pre text-ink">
            <CodeSnippet.Code>{query}</CodeSnippet.Code>
          </pre>
        </CodeSnippet.Content>
        <CodeSnippet.Toggle className="absolute end-0 bottom-0 h-8 cursor-pointer bg-surface-1 px-4 text-sm text-ink hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-expanded:hidden">
          Show more
        </CodeSnippet.Toggle>
      </div>
    </CodeSnippet.Root>
  );
}
```

Here `Toggle` hides itself once open (`data-expanded:hidden`): the open block scrolls after 8 rows.

## Copy something else

`text` on `Root` replaces the code as `copyText`: show a short or safe form, copy the full one.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { CodeSnippet, Copy } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

function CopyCode() {
  const { copyText } = CodeSnippet.useCodeSnippetContext();
  return (
    <Copy.Root text={copyText}>
      <Copy.Trigger aria-label="Copy request with token" className="grid size-10 shrink-0 cursor-pointer place-items-center bg-surface-1 text-icon-primary hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-copied:text-success">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current">
          <path d="M14 5v9H5V5h9m0-1H5a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v9a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h9a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V5a1 1 0 0 0-1-1Z" />
          <path d="M2 9H1V2a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h7v1H2Z" />
        </svg>
      </Copy.Trigger>
      <Copy.Status className="sr-only">Copied with the token</Copy.Status>
    </Copy.Root>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  const token = '7f3c9a1e5b2d';
  return (
    <CodeSnippet.Root text={`curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${token}' https://api.example.com/contracts/CT-2026-0142`}>
      <div className="flex h-10 max-w-3xl items-center bg-surface-1">
        <div className="flex h-full grow items-center overflow-x-auto ps-4">
          <pre className="m-0 type-code whitespace-pre text-ink">
            <CodeSnippet.Code>curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer ••••••' https://api.example.com/contracts/CT-2026-0142</CodeSnippet.Code>
          </pre>
        </div>
        <CopyCode />
      </div>
    </CodeSnippet.Root>
  );
}
```

## Inline chip

For an inline snippet, the code is the copy button: put `Code` inside `Copy.Trigger`. The button is then named by its code, so people hear what they would copy.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { CodeSnippet, Copy } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

function Chip() {

      <Copy.Trigger className="inline cursor-pointer rounded-sm border border-transparent bg-surface-1 px-0 text-ink hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:border-focus focus-visible:outline-none data-copied:bg-layer-selected-1">
        <CodeSnippet.Code className="px-2 type-code whitespace-pre">CC-4410-PROC</CodeSnippet.Code>
      </Copy.Trigger>
      <Copy.Status className="sr-only">Copied!</Copy.Status>
    </Copy.Root>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <p className="text-sm text-ink">
      Use the cost centre{' '}
      <CodeSnippet.Root>
        <Chip />
      </CodeSnippet.Root>{' '}
      for office supplies.
    </p>
  );
}
```

## Style it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { CodeSnippet, Copy } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const log = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => `2026-03-14 09:${String(10 + i).padStart(2, '0')}:00 INFO approval.service step ${i + 1} done for CT-2026-0142`).join('\n');

function Parts() {
  const { copyText, expanded } = CodeSnippet.useCodeSnippetContext();

          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current group-data-copied:hidden">
            <path d="M14 5v9H5V5h9m0-1H5a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v9a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h9a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V5a1 1 0 0 0-1-1Z" />
            <path d="M2 9H1V2a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h7v1H2Z" />
          </svg>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="hidden size-4 fill-success group-data-copied:block">
            <path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" />
          </svg>
        </Copy.Trigger>
        <Copy.Status className="sr-only">Copied!</Copy.Status>
      </Copy.Root>
      <CodeSnippet.Toggle className="group absolute end-0 bottom-0 inline-flex h-8 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 bg-surface-1 px-4 text-sm text-ink hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">

        </svg>
      </CodeSnippet.Toggle>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <CodeSnippet.Root>
      <Parts />
    </CodeSnippet.Root>
  );
}
```
```css
/* className="content" on Content, "toggle" on Toggle */
.content { overflow-y: auto; transition: max-height 150ms; }
.content[data-expanded] { padding-bottom: 16px; }
.toggle { position: absolute; inset-inline-end: 0; inset-block-end: 0; height: 32px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; background: #f4f4f4; }
.toggle[data-expanded] svg { rotate: 180deg; }
```

## Parts

### CodeSnippet.Root

Renders only its children: it holds the expanded state, the row limits and the code's text.

| Prop | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | `''` | What gets copied instead of the code shown |
| `expanded` | `boolean` | | Showing every row (controlled) |
| `defaultExpanded` | `boolean` | `false` | The start state (uncontrolled) |
| `onExpandedChange` | `(expanded: boolean) => void` | | Each press of `Toggle`, and the fold back |
| `maxCollapsedRows` | `number` | `15` | 16px rows shown while collapsed; 0 = no limit |
| `maxExpandedRows` | `number` | `0` | Rows shown while expanded; 0 = no limit |
| `minCollapsedRows` | `number` | `3` | Minimum rows while collapsed |
| `minExpandedRows` | `number` | `16` | Minimum rows while expanded; an open snippet whose code is no taller folds back |

`CodeSnippet.useCodeSnippetContext()` returns, among others, `copyText` (`text`, else the code's text with one leading line break dropped, as `<pre>` does), `expanded`, `canExpand` (the `Toggle` shows) and `setExpanded()`.

### CodeSnippet.Code

A `<code>`. Its text is read back after every render, so its children can be any elements (for example syntax colours); that text is the `copyText`. It takes every `<code>` prop.

### CodeSnippet.Content

A `<div>` around the code of a multi-line snippet. It sets `max-height` / `min-height` from the row limits (your `style` is merged after them), measures the code as it resizes, and folds an open snippet back when the code fits.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-expanded` | Expanded |

### CodeSnippet.Toggle

A `<button type="button">` with `aria-expanded`, rendered only while the code is taller than the collapsed limit (`canExpand`). A press expands or collapses. It takes every button prop except `type`; give it the words.

| Attribute | When |
|---|---|
| `data-expanded` | Expanded |

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | Does |
|---|---|
| Tab | Moves to your code box (with `tabIndex={0}`), the copy button, then `Toggle` |
| Enter, Space | On `Toggle`: opens or closes; on the copy trigger: copies |
| Arrow keys | Scroll the focused code box |

The parts set `aria-expanded` on `Toggle`. The copy parts give a button and a polite live region.

You add:

- The read-only textbox around the code: `role="textbox"`, `aria-readonly="true"` (and `aria-multiline` for a block), `tabIndex={0}` and a name (`aria-label`).
- A name for an icon-only copy button, and the feedback words in `Copy.Status`.
- The "Show more" / "Show less" words, and a visible focus style everywhere.


---

# Headless Copy button

`Copy` is the behaviour of the styled [Copy button](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/copy-button/) as unstyled React parts. `Root` holds the text and the feedback timer, `Trigger` puts the text on the clipboard and then reports `copied` for two seconds, and `Status` is a polite live region that announces your feedback during that moment. A copy that failed shows no feedback. `Copy.useCopy` gives you the same behaviour as a hook, for a control of your own.

You own the icon, the tooltip, the feedback words and every style. The styled [Code snippet](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/code-snippet/) uses the same parts for its inline chip.

## Installation

The headless parts come with the package (there is no shadcn item; the React + Tailwind items are built on them):

```bash
npm install @purpurabog/ui
```
```tsx
import { Copy } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';
```

## Use it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Copy } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink">
      <span>RQ-2026-00123</span>
      <Copy.Root text="RQ-2026-00123">
        <Copy.Trigger aria-label="Copy request number" className="grid size-10 cursor-pointer place-items-center bg-surface-1 text-icon-primary hover:bg-ghost-hover active:bg-ghost-active focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current">
            <path d="M14 5v9H5V5h9m0-1H5a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v9a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h9a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V5a1 1 0 0 0-1-1Z" />
            <path d="M2 9H1V2a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h7v1H2Z" />
          </svg>
        </Copy.Trigger>
        <Copy.Status className="sr-only">Copied!</Copy.Status>
      </Copy.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`Trigger` is a `<button type="button">` with no name of its own: an icon-only trigger needs `aria-label` (or a tooltip that names it, below).

## Anatomy

```tsx
<Copy.Root text="…">
  <Copy.Trigger />
  <Copy.Status />
</Copy.Root>
```

## Show the feedback

For the feedback moment, `Trigger` has `data-copied`. Swap the icon for a check mark with `group-data-copied:`, or read `copied` from `Copy.useCopyContext()` in a component inside `Root`.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Copy } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

function Label() {
  const { copied } = Copy.useCopyContext();
  return <span className="text-sm">{copied ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy link'}</span>;
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Copy.Root text="https://contracts.example.com/CT-2026-0142">
      <Copy.Trigger className="group inline-flex h-10 cursor-pointer items-center gap-2 bg-surface-1 px-4 text-ink hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-copied:text-success">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current group-data-copied:hidden">
          <path d="M14 5v9H5V5h9m0-1H5a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v9a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h9a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V5a1 1 0 0 0-1-1Z" />
          <path d="M2 9H1V2a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h7v1H2Z" />
        </svg>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="hidden size-4 fill-current group-data-copied:block">
          <path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" />
        </svg>
        <Label />
      </Copy.Trigger>
      <Copy.Status className="sr-only">Link copied</Copy.Status>
    </Copy.Root>
  );
}
```

## Feedback in a tooltip

Carbon shows the label and the feedback in the button's tooltip. Combine `Copy` with the headless [Tooltip](https://parntengza.github.io/kanok-ui-docs/en/headless-tooltip/): the tooltip's `label` names the icon button, and `open` keeps it up while `copied` is true.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Copy, Tooltip } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

function CopyWithTooltip({ label, feedback }: { label: string; feedback: string }) {
  const { copied } = Copy.useCopyContext();
  const text = copied ? feedback : label;
  return (
    <>
      <Tooltip.Root label={text} placement="bottom" open={copied || undefined}>
        <Tooltip.Trigger className="inline-block">
          <Copy.Trigger className="grid size-10 cursor-pointer place-items-center bg-surface-1 text-icon-primary hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current">
              <path d="M14 5v9H5V5h9m0-1H5a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v9a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h9a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V5a1 1 0 0 0-1-1Z" />
              <path d="M2 9H1V2a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h7v1H2Z" />
            </svg>
          </Copy.Trigger>
        </Tooltip.Trigger>
        <Tooltip.Popup className="w-max rounded-xs bg-inverse-surface-1 px-4 py-0.5 text-sm text-inverse-ink">{text}</Tooltip.Popup>
      </Tooltip.Root>
      <Copy.Status className="sr-only">{feedback}</Copy.Status>
    </>
  );
}

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-ink">
      <span>0105556012345</span>
      <Copy.Root text="0105556012345">
        <CopyWithTooltip label="Copy tax ID" feedback="Tax ID copied" />
      </Copy.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Feedback time

`feedbackTimeout` on `Root` is how long `copied` stays true, in ms (2000). A second press starts the time over.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Copy } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <Copy.Root text="CT-2026-0142" feedbackTimeout={5000}>
      <Copy.Trigger className="h-10 cursor-pointer bg-surface-1 px-4 text-sm text-ink hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-copied:bg-layer-selected-1">
        Copy CT-2026-0142
      </Copy.Trigger>
      <Copy.Status className="ms-3 text-sm text-ink-muted">Copied, for 5 seconds</Copy.Status>
    </Copy.Root>
  );
}
```

The `Status` here is visible: its text is there only during the moment, so it doubles as the visible feedback.

## Copy it yourself

`onCopy` on `Root` runs before the copy with the text. Return `false` to copy something else yourself; the feedback still shows. Return nothing to let the part copy as usual (use it to record the copy).


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Copy } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  const [copiedText, setCopiedText] = useState('');
  return (
    <div className="grid justify-items-start gap-3">
      <Copy.Root
        text="CT-2026-0142"
        onCopy={(text) => {
          const summary = `${text}: Office supplies, 120,000 THB, Procurement`;
          navigator.clipboard?.writeText(summary).catch(() => {});
          setCopiedText(summary);
          return false;
        }}
      >
        <Copy.Trigger className="h-10 cursor-pointer bg-surface-1 px-4 text-sm text-ink hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
          Copy contract summary
        </Copy.Trigger>
        <Copy.Status className="sr-only">Summary copied</Copy.Status>
      </Copy.Root>
      <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Copied: {copiedText}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Disabled

`disabled` on `Trigger` disables the button: no focus, no copy. With `focusableWhenDisabled` it stays a Tab stop with `aria-disabled` and copies nothing, as Carbon's inline code snippet does, so people can still reach it and read why. Both set `data-disabled`.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Copy } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

const button = 'h-10 cursor-pointer bg-surface-1 px-4 text-sm text-ink hover:bg-ghost-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:bg-surface-1 data-disabled:text-ink-disabled';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
      <Copy.Root text="">
        <Copy.Trigger disabled className={button}>Copy (disabled)</Copy.Trigger>
      </Copy.Root>
      <Copy.Root text="ak_live_7f3c9a1e">
        <Copy.Trigger disabled focusableWhenDisabled className={button}>Copy API key (focusable)</Copy.Trigger>
      </Copy.Root>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Just the hook

`Copy.useCopy(text, { onCopy, feedbackTimeout })` returns `{ copied, copy }` without any part. Use it when the copy control is something else: a menu item, a link-styled button, a keyboard shortcut. Add your own live region.


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Copy } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  const { copied, copy } = Copy.useCopy('finance@example.com', { feedbackTimeout: 3000 });
  return (
    <p className="text-sm text-ink">
      Questions? Write to finance@example.com{' '}
      <button type="button" onClick={() => void copy()} className="cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent p-0 text-link underline hover:text-link-hover focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-focus">
        {copied ? 'copied' : 'copy address'}
      </button>
      <span role="status" className="sr-only">{copied ? 'Email address copied' : ''}</span>
    </p>
  );
}
```

## Style it


React (live React example):

```tsx
import { Copy } from '@purpurabog/ui/headless';

export default function Example() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
      {['md', 'sm'].map((size) => (
        <Copy.Root key={size} text="RQ-2026-00123">
          <Copy.Trigger
            aria-label="Copy request number"
            className={`group grid cursor-pointer place-items-center bg-surface-1 text-icon-primary hover:bg-ghost-hover active:bg-ghost-active focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-focus data-copied:text-success data-disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-disabled:text-icon-disabled ${size === 'sm' ? 'size-8' : 'size-10'}`}
          >
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 fill-current group-data-copied:hidden">
              <path d="M14 5v9H5V5h9m0-1H5a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v9a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h9a1 1 0 0 0 1-1V5a1 1 0 0 0-1-1Z" />
              <path d="M2 9H1V2a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h7v1H2Z" />
            </svg>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true" className="hidden size-4 fill-current group-data-copied:block">
              <path d="M6 10.6 2.7 7.3 2 8l4 4 8-8-.7-.7z" />
            </svg>
          </Copy.Trigger>
```
